tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 1 gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung gdug pa spun bdun

tei:div.tei:p: ra ༄0 ༷ ༄ lda 4ོ 〉༄ r+shanya 7༅༅ khriglingagesarargyalapo'isgrung/ ོ pho 4yo /0sgo 4 kho sno'3( skyo ྾bodaljongasamidamangasadabaskrunakhang/ rmya

na da ོ'i 'i da 'irgang 5 saja sla sga'i 17 rjorna sang slukhu sla sang skyo ja // /de / / 2/ / / kyu/ sa zab / ni/ /smu / / /brdong sgong spra pu7 bang7 rdong sgoyi nyi thokhya tho gu / /gu /sa / gu / / /su thu / brtaslu nasga nan skyon rgasgang gidan sprub 5 / / / / / 'i tsi /tsāzhi rjesko sgan sgoska gizhe rna skotsāsdu 5 rnyiska rta ༈ gizhirgaskarnyi // nga zhu /bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang /

mdun shog gi ri mo 'bri mkhan/ ngag dbang skal bzang /— gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung /gdug pa spun bdur /bod ljongab/ spyi tshogs tshan rig khang gi ye shes dbang 4 mos mdo smad kyi lag bris ma gzhir bzung phyogs sgrig byas pa/rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur ba/ thang dpon tshe stobs/ོbod ljongs mi dam ngas dpe skrun khang nas par dubaskrun/bod ljongs shin hwa dpe deb khang nas bkram/bode ljongs shin hwa par 'debs bzo grwa nas par brgyab/ deb tshad/ 850nga1168 1732 yig grangs khri 311993lo'i zla 3par gzhi dang po/ 1993lo'i zla 3par thengs ngang po brgyab/par grangs 01— 2nya530 132ma7——223—00341———371 52/de cardomasobasgor bhe 80

dkar chagale'u dang po/ jo rus rta rgyug rgyan 'jog dpa' dar blangs/shel brag 'o mtsho'i gter g.yang bzhes pa'i rjes/ tsho drug gling gi blon 'bangs kun 'dus nas/ gling gi rje bo'i gser khrir mnga' ཿsa/16/tshori/ /bya/rngas// (1)le'u gnyis pa/ jo rus srid mdzad khro thung yi ma rangs/ rin chen nor rdzas khyer nas lkog tu byol/ g.yu rtse rgyal dang shar bdud spun bdun la/ skyabs bcol tsha bo'i chab srid 'phrog par brtsams/ ( 76)le'u gsum pa/ dbang byed ma dang khro thung khrag ral ma/ge sar brlag ched gling gi yul du 'ongs/skyes bus dbang byed ma bzung nor mdzod kyi/lde mig 'phrog nas rnam shes dag zhing spar/ 〈rdo1 /)/rte)le'u bzhi pa/ ne ne+e gnam sman dbang byed ma la sprul/shar bdud gdug pa spun bdun yul du byon/

rgyal blon bla gnas btul zhing blo rig mnol/gling la dmag sna 'dren pa'i dpa' kha bskyed/ (163)le'u lngab/ g.yu rtses gling la dpung dmag ma drangs gong /ge sar lha dmag chas nas skung lung bzung /4 dgra bo'i nyul dmag dpa' rtul bdun gyis brdungs/ khro thung lam snar chas pa gling la 'khor/ (188)le'u drug pa/ so blon phyir 'khor gros rar gnas tshul bshad/ mi nyag g.yu rtse dpon bcas byang phyogs theg gling pas phas rgol sgar la mtshan 'gebs kyis/ spun bdun ya gyal klu mi gnyis po btul/ (259)le'u bdun pa/ khrag ral ma nyid rgyal blon rtsa ru phyin/ byang 'gro'i lam las bshol te 'phrul sgar bcas/rgyal btsun blon dmag gling la chas lam du/gling rjes dpung gi sna blangs khrag ral bsgral/ (292)le'u brgyad pa/ g.yu rtse rgyal blon gros sar gnyan stag gis/

bdud lhar sprul nas lung bstsal 'phrul sgar bzung / sgar sa gling gis bcom yang rgyal blon shor/ 'do rjes lung bstan dgra mtha' gcod lugs bshad/ (362)le'u dgu pa/ ge sar rgyal dang sga sde rjes 'ded byon/g.yu rtse rgyal blon bsgral zhing byang du phebs/a myes sgom pa snying rje'i me yis bsregs/byes don legs grub gling gi sgar du byon/ (422)le'u bcu pa/ de nas ge sar ar jag yul du byon/ jag yul 'bangs su bkug nas bde la bkod/sangs rgyas sku brnyan mun pa'i dong las drangs/rin chen gter blangs nor 'gyed tshim par mdzad/ (532)le'u bcu gcig pa/ g.yul rgyal gzhis byes 'dzoms pa'i dga' ston bgyis/ bod sgang ris med chos grwar bsnyen bkur zhus/ phu bo rgya tsha'i btsun mor dgra lha 'khrungs/ rje 'bangs kun gyis btsas ston zab rgyas mdzad/ (551)

mkhyen rab ye shes gter mdzod 'chang /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur par 'dud/snying rje'i dbang phyug 'gro la brtse/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la 'dud/log 'dren bdud bgegs thal bar brlagagasang bdag phyag na rdo rjer 'dud/gcis/ tu bsdus pa'i rang gzugs nyid/dgra lha ge sar rgyal la 'dud/rten 'brel ya rabs rmad byang phyir/gling mu pa dar zhing khas bsgyun pa/dpa' rtse rgyal 'khrungs pa'i lo rgyus che/dus babs a nes brda ris bstan/rtsa gsum yongs kyis dge legs stsol/

le'u dang po/ jo rus rta rgyug rgyan 'jog dpa' dar blangs/ shel brag 'o mcho'i gter g.yang bzhes pa'i rjes/cho drug gling gi blon 'bangs kun 'dus nas/gling gi rje bo'i gser khrir mnga' gsol byas/de yang gling chung rgyud nam mkha'i rang mdangs la/ ge sar gser gyi nyi ma shar/ dpa' rgya tsha dung gi zla ba/ rong tsha nam mkha'i dgu thig blon 'dan ma smin drug mtha' rgyas/ chung rgyud skar tshogs mtha' rgyas de yare ngo'i zla ltar rgyas yong ba'i skabs der/ rta sa na dmar gzhung drug lug sa me tog rwa ba/ 'bri sa dkar mo rog tshang / ra sa tsher lung ring mo/ bzang gsum mdo drug gong ma dang / lha gur me ri gser tog gser khri lang smu ling rtseg gdan mi gcig gdan rabs bco brgyad/ khrims yig zhal lce bcu gsum sogs dang /— g.yu sbra mthing shog sngon mo/g.yu yi mdzo mo 'gro shes/ dung gi lu gu 'ba' shes/ lcags kyi mdzo pho ru ring / dung gi lha g.yag ga pa/ be+edūr+ya yi spu rtsid/mar gad sngon mo'i rwa co/ klu g.yang lha 'bri gwa ma/ rin chen sna lnga'i spu rtsid/ ya mtshan 'o ma'i rgya mtsho sogs skya lo'i rgyu nor 2

'khor bcas stag rong btsan gyi sde pas rta su mgyogs kyi mgyogs dar la bzhag pa rnams skyes mchog nor bu dgra 'dul la thob/ de nas skyes bu khong gis shes rab kyi rtsal phyes/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rtsal phyang / ting 'dzin mthu stobs kyi gdengs bskyed nas shel brag 'o rmotsho'i gter kha phyes te/ rmog dkar rgyal ba'i don grub dang /dar 'phru nyi ma rang shar/ khrab nag zil ba thog sdug mda' rab dgu bcu go dgu/ gzhu mo ra rgod 'khyil ba/ ral gri btab pa lan med/ gri chung shel gyi yu ba/ dgra lha'i tshe gos smug po/dar mdzod o gos dkar po/ snying mdzod gos rabs bco brgyad /gnam lcags shel gyi sta re/ mdung mo khams gsum dgra 'dul/ ba dan g.yul las rnam rgyal/ phub mo sba dmar gling drug 'ur rdo pha wang stong skor/ zhags pa khams gsum rang 'gugs sosas dgra lha'i go mtshon sna dgu dang / gser ske yid bzhin nor bu/sku chings rdo rje'i brgya phreng / gser sga nyi ma rang shar/ gser yob chu srin kha sprod/ bal stan sme ba gru bzhi/ sba lcags bsam pa'i don grub/ gser srab yid bzhin nor bu/ gser smad bsam pa myur slebs/ sog lham dgu 'gril sogs sku chas sna tshogs dang / gser gyi shākya thub pa/ byu ru'i tshe dpag med mgon/ dung gi spyan ras gzigs dbang / dngul gyi byams pa mgon po/ g.yu yi sgrol ma sngon mo/ khro yi las mgon nag po/dar nag mgon po rang byang / thang sku mthong ba don ldan/ sku tshab rang grol che mo sogazlo rten mchog dang / zangs dkar 'o ma'i bcud 'dzin/ 'o ma khol chil me re/ 'dod 'byung thod pa mtshan 3

ldan/ mar khu rgyun 'bab me re/ lha klu mi yi nor bu/ rten mchog nyi shu rtsa lnga/ nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman mchog 'chi med tshe yi bdud rtsi/ dri bzang rlangs pa chil le/ dar phra rin chen phyug mo/ bla bres nam mkha' kun khyab/ sil snyan stong gsum 'brug grags/ chos dung 'dzam gling g.yas bzhagagaser 'bum dum pa bcu gnyis/ dngul bris zla ba rang shar/g.yu 'bum nam mkha'i rang mdangs/ dung bris skar tshogs bkras yag mtshal bris dum pa bcu gnyis/ gsung rten po ti brgya rtsa so/gas dang / gzhan yang rma g.yang gi gter zog be+eḍūr+ya yi bdun tshar/ mar sad smug po'i gab lha/ ke ke ru yi mchod rten/spos shel gyi ngang pa lding shes/ gzi yi dug sbral 'khyug shes/tshor (ste/ 1de/ /chos lha rdo therdordo rigadung ga nga — dkar / bar bu dgos 'bad kun 'byung bcas khyad du 'pha gas pa'i las sogs bdun sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa/'i gter zog rnams bzhes/ de nas lha mi kun gyi rje bo/bsngan pa 'dzin pa'i mnga' bdag ma sang 'phrul gyi rgyal po/gling rje ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul de nyid gser khri la mngon par 'khod/ steng lha chen tshangs pa dkar pos gtsos lha chen brgyad dang 'khor bye ba 'bum gyis gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan la sogs pa bsgrengs/ lha yi nor bu ke ke ru dang iṇ+ḍa ni la la sogs pa'i se mo do'i phreng shar dang / rin po che'i yo byad ma dun thad du khang pa brtsegs pa ltar spungs/ rol mo sna tshogs kyi sgra thodakrol/bar gnyan gyi rgyal po zur phud lnga pas gtsos gnyan 'khor bye ba 'bam gyis nor ba stag sha de wa sogs du ma phal zhing mchod pa ༷/nga raring rabargya

bsam gyis mi khyab pa byas/ 'og klu chen gtsug na rin chen gyis gtsos klu chen brgyad kyis nor bu bsam 'phel la sogs nor bu'i rigs du ma mdun thad sa gzhi byar byar bkang / rol mo'i rigs kyis mchod/ dkar phyogs drostarno la dga' ba'i lha dang gter gnas gnyer gtad yul lha gzhi bdag zo dor rnams kyis mi bzhin bkur bsti dang nor bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i maṇ+ḍa' phul zhing /steng lha dga' ba'i me tog gi char phab/ bar gnyan dga' ba 'i 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gur khang phub/ 'og klu dga' b.ri klu 4yang 'dod rgu'i smug zhag gi rgya mtsho bskyil te lha ri shel brag gi mtsho khar phu nu pha khu/ ma sru mo sman yongs kyi 'khor gyis bskor nas ngaga' spro ci rigs ngang bzhugs pa'i tshe nang 'grogs dpa' rtul po/ngas/ dang / phyi 'grogs rgyal khab khag gi ltad mo lta mkhan yongs mas khri 'bul gya nom pa phul/ de nas bkra shis pa'i smin zla gro zhun gyi sgrub sbyor nyin sku mkhar skyid kyi lha mkhar ldem pa'i nang phyag phebs gling tsho drug phu mda' bar gsum/ stod gling gser pa mched brgyad/ bar gling 'om bu tsho drug smad gling mu spyang sde ba'i/g.yas shog sga yi sde pha/ g.yon shog 'bru yi sde pha/ sga 'bru ze ma'i sde pha/ stag rong dug mtsho 'khol ma/ gru bzhi a lcags shog drug rta'u mi tsho dmar po/ 'dan sde khri skor bcu gnyis/ skya lo phyag mo ru brgyad/ sngo lo tsho chen ru dgu/ mtsho sde thog chen brtso brgyad/ sde yan tsi tsi grangs med kyis rgas maso/ bse man nas/chung a thigs yan/ bla ma dgung gi nyi ma/ grwa 'bangs lo yag snyi ma/ stag shar mda' smyug sil ma/ ma sra spang kha'i me tog a ༄ 7 5

thigs skar tshogs bkra yag 'du ra lha klu'i dpung tshogs/grangs yang bye ba gcig dang nyis 'bum chig khri lhag tsam 'dzam gling sa yi lte ba/ mdo khams gling khri bar ma/ gru bzhi sa yi gdan steng / gling sa mthong ba kun smon/ bde can sa spyod gnyis pa'i 'du ra stag thang phra mor khrom dmar nag 'tshogs te/ lha dang bla ma'i spos sna/ dge 'dun gyi rol mo ser sbreng / gong dpon mu'i dar lam ming ldan dpa' bo'i chibs bsu/ ma sru mdzangs ma'i bro glu/ skye bo yongs kyi gdan bsu bsangs khang brgya rtsa sogs kyis chas bsgrigs pa'i tshe/ gu ra'i rdza 'dabs kyi nyin lam bar ma'i 'gul lang ring mo nas skyes ba sku 'khor rta pa stong dang la brgya khra ri mi dmi bye 155pachem chem 'od mer mer tshur tshur 'ja' shar ba ltar phebs pa na chibs bsu dpa' bo'i 'go khrid/ gser pa'i a rgyas gu ru des mi su yin zhib par gsal te dga' spro'i ngang dad gus tshad med kyis na re/ ya/ a red 'dir phebs ser skya tsho/ dga' zer le nyi ma de ring red/ mjal zer le gling gi rgyal blon red/ don yang dag sangs rgyas mi gzugs red/ yid spro ba'i glu zhig len snying 'dod/ khyed 'dir bzhuḍa rnams kyis gsan par zhu zer nas/dga' ba'i nyams dang / brjid pa'i zil/ bgres pa'i 'dzum nyams dang bcas te tha la'i ya 'gyur la drangs pa'i glu 'di ltar blangs so/ rma ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ glu a la tha la tha la red/6 tha la la mo la la red/

shar po ta la bzhugs spyan ras gzigs/snying rje'i dbang phyug 'gro ba'i mgon/sku dkar gsal yid la lam mer dran/de yang yang dran bzhin gsol ba 'debs/ma 'gro drug sems can ma lus pa/rje khyod kyi zhing der 'god par shogasgos drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma mkhyen/chags sdang 'khrul pa zad par shogasems bde stong rang ngo zin par shogagaser pa'i las mgon mthu bo che/de ring pha khu'i glu sna drongs/ sa 'dir gling khri bar ma zer/'dzam gling sa yi lte ba la/gdong ra khri ru khri'i gdan sa la/chos la 'phen dang chos 'phen nagargyal rabs bco brgyad gdan sa red/'dzam gling yongs la grags pa'i sa/gur dkar po phub pa'i pha yul red/nga 'dra gser pa'i a rgyas zer/stod gling chags pa'i gzhi ma yin/rma dkar yag gangs dang mnyam chags yin/seng dkar mo nged gnyid mnyam rgas yin/nags rin chen phyug dang mnyam chags yin/7

stag ri bkra nged gnyis mnyam rgas yin/rma del yag thang dang mnyam chags yin/rdo pha wang nged gnyis mnyam rgas yin/phyug skya lo ston dang dgung mnyam yin/gling da bzhugs rnams kyi pha khu yin/dpa' rtsal drug stobs rtsal mi che ste/de tsho glu yi tshig skyor red/'dir phebs bla ma sum cu dang /ming ldan dpon po ru 'dzin sras/skya bsu phu nu glu la gson/de ring skyid kyi nyi ma la/ma sang 'phrul gyi rgyal po de/lus rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung lda na gyis/gser gyi khri 'phang gnon lugs la/gling tsho drug dbang du 'dus lugs la/pha spyi dpon blo gsal nyi ma shar/tshig dpyad lugs gser gyi thigs pa red/lha sras jo ru 'phrul po che/gling tsho drug sdod du ma bcug cing /sga yer ru 'gyur rgyag pa'i dus/'dre jo ru min pa mi zer dus/dpon khro rgyal min pa mi bstod dus/ skyabs gzig 'phen min pa mi 'chol dus/8

pha spyi dpon glu tshig 'di ltar grags/khrom dmar nag 'du ra 'tshog nyin mo/ri thang khad du snyom yang srid/gnam sa go ldog 'gyur yang srid/dpon g.yog thob thang 'gyur yang srid/sdug sdug brnyas pa nyan le min/dpon 'dir bzhugs zer le lang phod red/pha rigs seng la ma rigs klu/rtsal rdzogs seng ge dkar mo de/g.yu ral na tshod dus la rgyas/shar rma rgyal ri bdag la thang med/glu gtam gyi zhor la a khus gsungs/de tshig don brjod med yid la 'jags/de rjes gling yul phu mda' na/gling rgyal rabs dus la ma grub le'i/btsan po'i rdzong mkhar sum cu dang /lha klu dbang po'i sku mkhar bzhin/phyogs bzhi dbus lnga'i pho brang che/mkhar bzhengs pa'i lag len mi dgos dang /bsam pa'i yon tan brjod las 'das/bya dkar nag mnga' thang che yang rung /yun 'gor med pho brang lag len dka'7/de lha sras 'phrul gyis bzhengs nyin mo/

khong 'dzam gling dbang sgyur mthu bo che/stobs 'gran med 'khor los bsgyur rgyal yin/mi kho bo'i blo la hril thag chod/nyi ma de yi phyin chod nas/bya spyod ngan pa gang mdzad kyang /log lha'i sdang lta byed ma myong /do bsdo'i 'gran sems phar la zhogaci mdzad rgyal ba'i rnam thar mthong /ci gsung bka' de tshad mar 'dzin/nyams sgrib nyes pa gsog bsam med/nga bsam dkar pha khu rgad po de/skyid zer le'i nyi ma de ring red/khrom yar yar gzigs dang ltad mo 'gi/rdza skya 'gul lam ring mo nas/drel dkar dkar rnga dmar mgul dkris can/gcig mi tshad dkar po brgya rtsa 'ag/ya bdag mu spyang dpon po red/de ring lha sras chibs bsu red/'gel rgyu gter zog rang 'grig red/dre'u'i 'dur rgyug sha ra ra/breng ling khebs sna lnga 'ja' ltar shar/drel dpon mi bcu mdzes gzugs can/dar dkar gos gong ser ris can/10

gra yag gzig gi gong mtha' can/stag ral g.yu byar gser thig can/ske gri bkra 'jarlo 'od khyug se khyugarta byang ma'i 'gros stabs ling se ling /de mu spung che bgres mi bcu red/drel sngon po'i khyu sna chu bas ring /bgrangs mi lang thang stod na ba khyab/drel kha dkar rkyang khyu 'drog 'drog red/mdog mi gcig gzhung thang khyab nas 'gi/sa bdag dpa' rtul pha nu red/de ring lha sras chibs bsu red/'gel rgyu shel brag gter zog red/rgyu nom chen gser la stong skor red/bgrangs mi shes gong tshad su yis thigargyu 'jog sa pho brang rnam lnga red/gling tsho drug spyi bsod yar dar red/sgos seng blon dbu 'phang je mtho red/de yan la mtho na nam mkha' red/rgya tsha sku zil je che red/de yan la zil na nyi ma red/rong tsha dpa' brjid je che red/de'i yan la rngam na lha dbang red/skyid e shes dga' mo lha yis gzigs/11

drel smug chung yol ba'i so mtshams na/'ja' shar shar rta pa 'ga' re byung /nyams dpyad na ma sru mo sman red/chu chung chung bcad pa'i tshur tha na/rdo pha wang rta 'dra'i so mtshams na/skya rta pa lnga yi dbus ma 'di/lo rgas kyang mdzangs ma'i cha lugs can/lus bong che la sha mdog dkar/rtse lu khyung gshog lding 'dra'i gong /gong gnon nor bu g.yas 'khyil la/g.yas g.yon gser g.yu lan dzar can/za 'og tshar sbyar gos bzang la/gser dngul rin chen glo rgyano spras/dar lham pang khebs 'ja' shar 'dra/rta thog rkang rtsed ling nge ba/dga' ba'i 'dzum mdangs ya le ma/de zi ma'i a ma dkar mo red/gling ma sru yongs kyi che 'go red/chibs pa zi rta 'phur shes red/skyo grogs zi mo gra 'grig red/zi rong chags pa'i 'khri shing red/skya pa lnga yi mtshams shed na/rta rag dkar 'gros gom lam se lam/12

'dan rta gser nya'i rigs rgyud ma/ rag dkar rngog nag mi zer ram/'do ba de yi gong gnon la/ ma sru sha rgyas lus bong che/sha mdog dmar la skra mdog kham/gser rna g.yas la dngul rna g.yon/ zing dmar 'brug ris tsha sbyar can/khra bo gzi mgul dgu 'grig can/brjid 'dzum nyams bag ldan le de/kha ra bza' yi gser mtsho red/ zhe sems snang ba ma sdug gda'/yang snying chos ma'i khyad chos red/ma ḍak+ki'i sprul par bshad ma dgos/a mtshar po ma sru bzang lugs la/gtan tshe la dga' skyid 'dzoms par shogade mchan bu mo rta dmar skya/dkar dmar mdangs ldan ske bzo can/dar gos rin chen rgyan spras la/mdzes pa'i nyams bag shig se ba/gdong ka bzhi sras mo shes mtsho red/rta dmar khro rta 'tshub shes red/de mchan bu mo rta dkar skya/dar gos rin chen gser gdan la /13

mdzes pa'i rgyan cha sna tshogs 'gi/sha srab mo btsun mdzes ma 'di/gdong ya tha'i sras mo dar mtsho red/rta dkar dung 'od byang ma red/de rgyab bu mo khra bo skya/dar chu mdog gos la gser ris can/gzi mgul gser gwas brang gzhung khebs/sha mdog ut+pal sngon mo'i mdangs/gru bzhi lus tshad mdzes mo ma/'om bu'i shes gsal sgrol dkar red/de rgyab ma sru drel skya de/ut+pal mdangs la lus bong chung /rgyan cha dar gos mi bkrag ste/shel dkar phreng ba lag na thogs/ chos chen nyams la yid 'ong ma/sngo lo'i sras mo ne'u chang red/rta drel sger ming mi skos te/ de rgyab mdzes ma dar gos can/mgo la gser g.yu'i lan dzar can/mu tig g.yu byur mgul rgyan la/gser ga dngul ga gsum rgyan can/ lag gling bu mdzub rdeb khrig se khrigagro lo'i pad dkar lha mdzes red/14

rta sngon khu byug 'phur 'phur red/lo chung rang tshod zin mkhan red/de rgyab bu mo rta dmar can/dar gos na bza' rin chen rgyan/sus kyang 'gran med brjid rngam che/dmar gsal mdangs la a 'gu can/mgo mi sdod byi'u chung shing yan 'dra/rkang mi sdod yob rdung khra la la/ lag mi sdod lcags shad tshubs se tshubs/de stag rong bu mo khro mtsho red/ rta dmar rlung gshog dmar po red/thugs zhe pham che yang las bskos red/ma gser mtsho'i cha la ma nye 'gi/gtam don med mi smra dkon mchog mkhyen/de rgyab bu mo rta sngon can/gos gser 'brug sbyar ma'i tshar slog la/sram gyi pags pa'i mtha' rgyan can/gser rna gser ga gzi mgul can/rgyan cha sde chen dpon mo'i tshul/mdzangs ma dpa' brjid yid 'ong ma/rgyan dang kha dog grabs mtshungs gsum/skya sngon ma tsha zhang mdzes sgron red/chibs pa g.yu sgong sngon mo red/15

skya bar ma bu mo g.yu sgron red/chibs pa g.yu rte'u sngon mo red/ skya rjes ma bu mo dar sgron red/chibs pa sog rta rte'u sngon red/dkar gsal khrom la mi rngam ste/dmar gsal mdzes 'dzum yid 'ong ma/mi tsher dga' skyid 'dzoms par shog —skyid mtha' chos la phyogs par shogade rjes bu mo drel dkar skya/chibs sna mi dkar khrid le 'di/gdong pha chen rag bza' dge mtsho red/shes rig ri rgyal lhun po la/dbyar me tog lhun po'i rgyan cha spras/che dgu yon tan phun sum tshogs/phyi nang 'dzoms pa'i ma sru red/ma sru kun gyi gtso mo red/brgya yar 'gro'i skyabs gnas zhu sa red/stong mar 'gro'i smon lam 'debs sa red/drel dkar nyi zla 'dzum can red/de rgyab yar ltos ltad mo 'gi/sku lus lba dkar smyug ldem la/bsod nams dar gos bco brgyad mnabs/dkar gsal gangs rir nyi shar 'dra/16

mkhur tshos dmar la rgya skyegs mdogagayu smin khyung gshog brgyangs 'dra'i mgo/spyan mig la kha'i skar chen 'tsher/dung gi tshems phreng bstar ma mdzes/ljags srab zhal sgo rnam par dmar/dbu skra smug gos sku stod khebs/de la dbu rgyan bco brgyad bkod/khra bo gzi mgul dgu phreng la/rin chen ga'u gsum sbrel bkod/rgyan re re'i ming ni bgrangs tshod med/mdzes pa lha yi kha dog la/sha khrag gnyis las ma grub 'dra/sgrol ma dkar mo'i skye ba la/mdo khams rgyal mo 'brug mo red/lha nas bskos pa'i rgyal mo red/gling dkar bu mo'i dang rtse red/gzugs skye mdzes 'dzam gling 'di la dkon/de ring bkrag zil je che red/rgyan rin chen skya lo'i rgyu nor la/tshad gong thang bgrang tshod su yis zin/mdzes de bas yan la lha lus red/chibs pa khyung ru smug po red/chibs khrid a grags spun gnyis red/17

de'i gyon pa dar dang gos chen red/'dogs rgyu gser dngul glo rgyan red/rkang sog lham 'ja' ring rang shar red/mgo sog zhwa dzar lo nyil li li/rta dkar sga srab chas 'dzoms can/kha ru mdzod dar yug ring red/btsun mo khrir phebs che chos re da/ —g.yas ngogs bu mo rta dkar skya/gos rgyan mdzes gzugs tshod dang mthun/gser pa'i a zhe 'bum mtsho red/de gsham bu mo smug gu skya/bya 'brug kha sprod tshar slog la/khan sbyar chu brag sngo skya gyon/spos shel ser po'i mgo rgyan can/gser sga zi byar ske rgyan bkra/bong dang yarno lag mdzes mo ma/dmar gsal mdzes pa'i nyams bag can/'bru bza' shes rab dbon mo red/'do ba smug gu rbab 'gril red/de rgyab bu mo sngo srab ma/'a gyi so sgo yangs po ma/g.yas skra g.yon skyalan dzar can/thod gdan gser gyi pad+ma ma /18

gzi byur g.yu yi bar 'brel can/mu tig nor bu'i mgul rgyan can/tshar slog dmar la khan sbyar sngo/mdzes pa'i nyams bag ldan le de/dkar ru snang gsal sgron ma red/chibs pa dung rta dkar po red/de rgyab byung ba'i ma sru 'di/sha bkrag che la sha rgyas can/lus chas dar gos ljon shing ris/rgyan chas babs dang mtshungs po ma/tsho snum bsod nams g.yang chags pa/nag ru bsod nams dpal mtsho ma/chibs pa rag ma rlung 'phyo red/de rgyab bu mo drel bzhon can/dmar gsal mdangs la lus bong chung /spyan rtsa dmar la cung zad sgam/lus chas mdzes ma kun dang mthun/de 'bum dpon a thar sgrol dkar red/g.yon logs bu mo rag ser skya/mdzes ma kha dog dmar gsal mdogalus rgyan babs dang mtshungs po ma/dga' ba'i 'dzum bag ldan le de/brgya shog sras mo dpal yag red/19

'do ba brgya rgyug a ma red/de rgyab bu mo rta khra skya/spos shel gser gyi thod tshom can/dar gos dkar dmar 'ja' shar 'dra/gser dngul rin chen rgyan cha can/mkhur ldir dpral ba cung zad 'bur/so sgo yangs la spyan 'dzum dkar/dar yul shog dgu'i dpon mo la/sras mo nor 'dzin g.yang dpal red/'do ba byang rta khra bo red/de rgyab byung ba'i ma sru 'di/che brling mdzangs ma'i dpa' brjid can/bsod nams rin chen rgyan cha mang /rgyan cha mdzes ma kun dang mthun/khrims dpon g.yu yag dpal mtsho red/'do ba stong 'khyam ga ma red/de rjes bu mo skya pa gsum/ling gser 'brug tshar slog sum mtha' can/me tog 'dra ba'i zhal ras la/'ja' chen shar 'dra'i rgyan chas can/rkang rtsed dga' ba'i nyams 'gyur can/sngon ma tshangs sras sring gcig ma/ kun dga' g.yu yi mtsho skyid red/20

mdzes ma dpe la 'gran sa red/ 'do chung kha dkar bra bo red/bar ma g.yu mtsho dpal sgron red/gling shes pa lo ma'i gzhis 'dzin red/chos srid thogs med mkhyen mi red/chibs chung dung rta thig brgya red/rjes ma smin drug khra yag red/a skyid sras mo mdzangs ma sman/shes rig sman pa'i bdag mo red/sman dang yon tan mkhyen mkhan red/phyi nang 'dzoms pa'i bu mo red/ 'do ba dkar mo 'gros gom can/sger gyi rta ming mi shes te/de rjes mdzes ma 'ag 'a re byang /khra 'tshub 'tshub rgyan cha lergos po ma/ga shag shag zhal sgo gsal mo ma/nyams khyug khyug mdzes 'dzum yid spro ma/mtho ye rer rta pa khyu gcig byang /gling gi dpa' rtul phu nu la/༄ming thogs ru 'dren brgyad cu yod/de 'dra'i sde chen dpon mo red/re re'i ming nas bgrangs tshod med/mi tshe skyid la 'khod par shog21

skyid la 'pho 'gyur med par shogaskyid mtha' chos la 'gyur ba shogagyur nas gzhan don 'grub par shogad rung de bas mi tshad le/ rmi lam red dam dngos can red/mo sman ma sru'i ba mtha' na/lha phrug 'dra ba'i sku zil la/ 4'ja' tshon 'dra ba'i dar gos can/thog ser 'tshub 'dra'i da pa'abarjid can/khra shar shar skya da kur khyu gcig byung /skya dkar de 'dra'irwasnen /lus bong thangachatsad༄ma ldan le/mi chung chu nga dadagos tshonatho na /gser rna ltag phurag yuphur ca na /mchong dang byutho'ig shalacan /sngo dmaraladangasalasozho can/kha gru bzhikonatacasagyi the(36la/bod phrug mi chung kha bde red/rta chung bya ma 'phur shes red/dga' ba'i mgo 'phang mtho lugs la/gling mu pa rgyab rten mtho zhor red/de ring skya bsu'i sna bo red/ rta dkar dkar rta pa brgya tsho 'di/22

gling mu pa'i phyug chen grabs mtshungs red/rta dkar seng ge dkar mo la/de la nyi zla kha sprod can/lho sprin 'khrigs 'dra bcu gsum bzhon/skya pa de yi oṃ mtshams na/mi dmar dar gos dmar po can/ltag phud lnga 'gyur drug slas la/gser ga a long dung sgong can/lus skye gzugs kha 'bras legs po ma/go tshod mi dar stag ral red/'do ba sha pho gar mkhan red/gling ru'i nang g.yog che bgres red/de ring skya bsu'i sna bo red/rta rag dkar rta pa brgya tsho 'di/gling gser pa'i phyug gces grabs mtshungs red/ru dar dar skya tshubs se tshubs/skya de tsho yol ba'i rjes mtshams na/dar gos dmar po sbyar ma can/ khan sbyar gzig gi pags nga/ la/gos rtsi dmar po'i gong lag can/lus chas lus bong brjid rngam can/sna med skyon can 'phyor snang che/a thod thar pa'i zor sna red/23

stag rong dpon gyi sger blon red/rta nag smug po mdzes ldan red/de ring skya bsu'i sna bo red /mi dmar rta pa nyis brgya tsam/rong mi tsho'i phyug gces grabs mtshungs red/ru dar dmar po tshubs se tshubs/skya pa de 'dra'i so mtshams na/mi dkar dkar zhal ngo 'od mdangs gsal/gos dar ling 'od dkar dri ma med/gser dngul rin chen rgyan cha can/dga' ba'i 'dzum mdangs nyams bag mdzes/dpa' gsal thogs pa'i bu gces red/rta khra rlung zin sog dkar red/bar gling dpon po che shos red/rta khra khra rta pa brgya tsho tsam/gling bar gling shog gi bu gces red/ru dar dar khra ye re re/gong 'og rta pa'i rngam zil la/lha klu gnyan dpung chas pa 'dra/gling tsho drug min na ci la yin/bdud nag po gnya' nas gnon nges red/rgyab mthud mi sngon rta sngon can/pho ngar stag ral drug chas can/24

gser dngul glo rgyan gser ga can/lus bzo spyod lam legs po 'di/gdong gi ma phrug bu yag red/ chibs pa gdong rta byang ma red/rta sngon skya pa brgya lhag 'di/sngo chem chem char rgyun 'bab pa 'dra/khra tshub se 'ja' tshon shar ba 'dra/tsha zhang shog gi bu gces red/rta dar sngon po ye re re/ rngam zil mig gi khengs pa 'phrogade rjes rta pa gsum 'grig la/g.yas logs skya bsu'i sna bo la/mi dmar smug a ra sum slas can/gser 'brug ser po'i tshar slog gyon/ltag ral gzi byar lan dzar can/wa dmar zhwa la r+shal dkar togadapa' bo 'phrul gyi lha blon red/lha rta gser nya rag pa red/rta ser rta pa sha ra ra/mu spyang shog gi bu gces red/g.yon ru skya pa'i sna bo la/lus bong ring la gdong pa zor/tshar slog lngang la kha gyon dmar/25

mig rtsa dmar la sha mdog snum/ltag phud gser thig bum pas dkris/a bar 'phral mkhas 'phen stag red/7chibs pa zlog mo lding shes red/a tsi dpa' bo'i rnga ma brjid can/mi pho dbu 'phang mtho bar shogamatho nas dar rgud med par shogarta phos gling bzhi 'khor bar shogadaga' skyid mi rta 'bral med shogaru rgyab rta pa rta dkar khyu/sga 'bru dar zi'i bu gces red/rta dar dmar lngang ser gsum rngam/skya gsum 'grig gshar ba'i sngon ma na/mi dkar dung zla rang shar la/dar gos dkar po ling dgu gyon/zi byar rin chen rgyan cha can/ya zlotshan mngon sum lha yi lus/tshangs pa'i bu yi ngo yag red/lha rta thang dkar 'phur shes red/a tsi dpa' bo'i mdzes nyams la/mi pho dbu 'phang mtho bar shogamatho nas 'das grongs med par shogarta phos gling bzhi 'khor bar shog26

'khor nas mi rta skyid 'dzoms shogade rgyab byon pa'i dpa' bo 'di/zhal ngo dmar gsal at+pal mdogamadzes shing 'dzum la ba zhad pa'i nyams/dbu skra lan dzar g.yu yis brgyan/dar gos rin chen rgyan cha can/mu pa'i dar 'jam ngam lug red/ngo re mjal dus lug re byin/ngo lug ming can de don red/rta dkar dung bya ldem chung red/mi rta dga' skyid 'dzoms par shoga'adzoms nas dgra bzhi thul bar shogade rgyab byon pa'i dpa' bo 'di/mi sngon dar sngon rgyan cha la/gzi byar nor bu'i mgul rgyan can/dmarno gsal pho gzugs mdzes mo ma/mig rtsa dmar la byi ru can/gdong btsan a dpal snang ngu red/chibs pa g.yu bya rte'u sngon red/nyi ma de snga yan chad la/skye 'gros yid smon byed sa red/mtho ba'i skyabs gnas zhu sa red/gleng gleng gtam gyi sgo mo red/27

byang byang don gyi rdo ga la/rdoparlo rtul gral ra zin tsam red/de rgyab byon pa'i dpa' bo 'di/dmar yag stag 'dra'i dpa' brjid la/'dzoms drug rgyas 'dra'i sku chas can/rong mi tsho dmar po'i dpon po la/ya med dpa' bo stag 'phen red/gser gyi khri la rlom mi red//de ri ngalhun gyigras ra'ad/ chibs pa khri 'jam ya med red/de rgyab byon pa'i dpa' bo 'di/zhal ngo tshems phreng dung gi mdogani rgyal lta bu'i sku lus la/dbyar ljon rgyan 'dra'i na bza' can/phyi nang 'a dzoms pa'i bu gces 'di/stag rong nya tsha abartane red/phyi nang yongs kyi snying bcud red/rta byang ma rlung gi 'khor lo red/de rgyab byon pa'i pha khu 'di/mi chen dar chen dgung 'phyar ma/ bya spyod rlung gis rdeb 'dra 'di/kun gsal a khu khro thung red/rang tshod zin na rgyal/ po red/28

ma zin lha sras gong la shor/mi stong stong nang nas sger sma phab/ sems sdug nyer dgu'i smag rum la/spro spro 'dzum bag ldan mdog kha/a tsi mi zhu rta mgrin gzigs/pha stag rong rang dpon 'gyur med red/chibs rta 'phar ba rnga nag red/stag rong pha bu khu tshan la/mi rta dga' skyid 'dzoms par shoga'adzoms nas dgra bzhi thul bar shogade rgyab byon pa'i dpa' bo 'di/sku sha rgyas mgo bo'i gtsug na 'bur/gser 'brug sbyar ma'i dar gos gyon/ske dar mdud ga'u lcags phur can/sems ting 'dzin sgom pa'i nyams bag can/gling ya tha'i skyes mchog thar pa red/bka' mdo sngags ston pa'i bla ma red/chibs pa rong rta 'phur shes red/de rgyab dpa' bo byon le 'di/mi dkar lus bong rngam pa la/dar gos zi byur mgul rgyan can/sha srab srab tshems phreng gcig le 'di/mu spyang rin chen dar lu red/29

chibs rta seng ge rtsal ldan red/de rjes dpa' bo byon le 'di/seng dkar mo 'dra ba'i kha dog can/dpa' g.yu ral rgyas 'dra'i snang ngu 'di/'om bu'i a nu dpa' seng red/chibs rta gnam rta sngon po red/de rjes byon pa'i dpa' bo 'di/ gser pa'i nyi 'bum dar yag red/rta 'di ngang pa gser sgong red/ gling stod smad bar gyi dpon gsum rnam sa/mi rta dga' skyid 'dzom par shog 'dzoms nas dgra mgo thul bar shogade rgyab byon pa'i dpa' bo 'di/mi sngon na bza' dar gos sngo/ g.yu 'brug dgunge la 'khyug 'dra'i bu/dpa' rngam brjid gsum ldan le 'di/dpa' tsha zhang 'dan ma byang khra red/lan med dgung gi thog lce red/dbu 'phang a sngon dgung las mtho/mu pa gnam gyi rgyal po yi/dpa' mi 'gyur nem mkha'i dgu tshigs red/mi/ rta dga' skyid 'dzom par shoga'adzoms nas dgra bzhi thul bar shog30

skya g.yas ngogs yi 'dra'i bar mtshams nas/mu spyang bu gces rdzogs pa'i mtshams/tsha zhang 'dan gyi g.yas ngogs nas/mi dkar lha bzhin mdzes gzugs can/'ja' tshon thar 'dra'i na bza' gyon/dbu skra lan dzar gser g.yus brgyan/bu yi 'dra skya lo'i 'brug rgyas red/gzugs skye mched pha ma'i khyad chos red/rta g.yang chen dgu brgya ra gcig red/de rjes byon pa'i dpa' bo 'di/mi nag ral can lcags phur thogs/dar gos dmar smug na bza' brjid/spyan mig 'khyil la zhal mdangs dmar/a tsi dpon po'i brjid rngam la/ro stod seng ge 'gying ba 'dra/shed chen yongs la grags le de/sga sde chos skyong ber nag red/chibs pa rlung nag 'tshub shes red/mi rta dga' skyid 'dzom par shoga'adzoms nas dgra bzhi thul bar shogade rjes byon pa'i dpa' bo 'di/zhal mdog dkar la sha rgyas can/dar gos dkar po'i tshar sbyar la/31

gser dngul glo rgyan spras le de/dpa' ya med seng stag a dom red/mtshon leb chen g.yug la rang dbang thob/chibs rta stong ri dar dkar red/ zhe rtul thogs pa'i dpa' bo red/ ming dang don gnyis ma nor ba/dpa' ba'i bu la rngam brjid 'gi/mi rta dga' skyid 'dzom par shoga'adzoms nas dgra bzhi thul bar shogade rgyab pha khu rta ser can/sha rgyas lto tshil lhug ge ba/ dar ser gos dang gzi byur can/rnam sras dngos su byon 'dra 'gi/skya lo'i ston pa shes rab red/nor 'gran med phyugs kyi bdag po red/chibs rta nor bu rag dkar red/a khu ri rgyal lhun po la/ 'ad sa grongs med pa'i smon lam zhu/de rjes pha khu lus bongs can/dar gos rin chen rgyan cha gyon/sha srab gdong pa zor le 'di/a skyid nam mkha'i seng zhal red/chibs rta rag pa rngo nag red/32

gsham mthud pha khu gra 'grig red/re re'i mi rta bgrangs tshod med/ ma sang 'phral rgyal phebs nas 'gi/nyi ma'i 'ordo kyis skar ma yal/zer ba'i dpe 'di e mi bden/dbus 'dan dpon khong gi g.yon ngogs na/sga 'bru zi ma'i bu gtses mtshams/de rjes byon pa'i dpa' bo 'di/sku lus bag yang tshad ldan ma/zhal ngo 'bur la dmar gsal mdogadar gos rin chen rgyan cha legs/dga' ba'i 'dzam mdangs rgyas le 'di/༄brgya dpon ban de dmar lu red/brgya shog bco brgyad dpon po red/stong dmag gcig gi a ya red/mi rta dga' skyid 'dzom par shoga'adzoms nas dgra bzhi thul bar shogade rjes mi dkar dar gos dkar/rgyan dang na bza' grabs mtshungs legs/gdong pa zor la spyan rtsa dmar/ dkar ru'i thar pa rgyal mtshan red/chibs pa 'phar stag dmar mo red/de rjes mi pho dmar sngon mdangs/33

na bza' dmar smug thog gos nag brgya byar phreng ba bgrang mkhas 'di/nag sdu'i bla ma rgyal mtshan red/'do ba pho rog smug gu red/de rjes byon pa'i dpa' bo 'di/shin tu brjid cing che ba'i nyams/ mgo bo 'bur la sku stod rngam/ rgyan chas bzang spras dar gos gser/ de a yag shākya rgyal mtshan red/rgyal mtshan thogs pa'i bu gsum red/'do ba gser sgong rlung gcod red/ mi rta dga' skyid 'dzom par’shog 'dzoms nas dgra bzhi thul bar sho gde rjes dar gos khra bo can/ rgyan dang na bza' kha dog legs/srid gsum lag mthil 'god mi la/mo ma kun shes thig po red/sde gling ru'i yag nyes 'dri sa red/chibs pa bya rog 'phur shes red/ de rnyib byon pa'i dpa' bo la/dmar gsal rgyan gos kha dog legs/skra lcang lo'i zar bu dar snas brgyan/shin tu bag ldan bshes gnyen tshul/3 4

phyi nang bzang 'dzoms bshes gnyen can/sman pa kun dga' nyi ma red/dus min 'chi skyon zlog mi red/lha rta ngang pa 'dzum can red/gling gi shes mchog rnam pa gnyis/mi rta dga' skyid 'dzom par shog 'dzoms nas dgra bo thul bar shogade rgyab byon pa'i rta pa khyu/mi re re'i ming nas bgrangs tshod med/gling mang tshogs pho gsar du ma 'gi/dpa' rngam gzig mo khyu gcig la/gzig thig le bkrag 'dra'i rgyan gos 'gi /phyi nang 'dzoms pa'i bu gces la/mi rta dga' skyid 'dzom par shoga'adzoms nas dgra bo thul bar shogadapa' tsha zhang dpon gyi sku rgyab na/dmar nag gshin rje'i zhal ras la/me tsha tsha 'phro 'dra'i brjid rngam can/na bza' ber chen g.yung drung ris/rin chen sna tshogs mgul rgyan can/de dar 'phen dug gi sdong po red/khri khri dmag gi gdam ya red/chung rgyud chags pa'i blon chen red/35

blon chen ri rgyal lhun po red/rta pho thang dkar 'phur shes red/mi rta dga' skyid 'dzom par shoga'adzoms nas dgra bo thul bar shogade rgyab byon pa'i pha khu 'di/gling bskal pa chags pa'i rten phur red/rten phur dbus kyi ri rab red/ri rab steng gi khyung chen red/mtshan zhus na a khu spyi dpon red/spyi dpon skyid kyi nyi ma red/nyi ma tsho drug gling la shar/ —sdug gi mun pa mtha' nas gsal/rngam pa'i sku lus dar gos can/bgres shing zhi ba'i nyams ldan pa/dus yang yang 'grogs pa'i smon lam shogachibs pa sha ba brgya 'dzom gyis/'dzam gling mgyogs 'gros bskor bar shog pha khu skyes bu 'bral med shogade rgyab byon pa'i dpa' bo 'di/dmar gsal lha lus kha dog mdzes/mtshan dang dpe byad brgya 'dzoms can/za 'og sngo khra'i na bza' la/rin chen rgyan cha mdzes pas bklubs/36

dbu skra g.yu byur lan dzar can/spyi dpon snang ngu g.yu stag red/gling dkar phu nu'i mi g.yang red/chibs pa smug gu dar dkris red/dus yang yang mjal zhing 'grogs par shogade rgyab yar ltos nyams re mtshar/'od 'khyil le 'ja' yi gur khang nas/rdzu 'phrul lha yi sras gcig byon/rmi lam red dam dngos can red/tshangs sras sku bkrag mdzes bsam ste/dpe dang cha yang mi 'gran pa/lha tshangs pa zil gyis gnon pa'i bu/jo ru 'phrul gyi dpa' bo la/ya mtshan ldan pa'i lus rtsal rdzogs/rkyang rgod shugs kyis mgyogs dar blangs/bsod nams gser gyi khri la 'khod/tsho drug gling gi rgyal sar bzhugs/gling rje ge sar lha yi sras/zhal ras bco lnga'i dung zla la/mkhur tshos dmar gsal thig les spras/dbu skra gnag snum sku rgyab khebs/g.yu smin khyung gshog brkyangs 'dra'i 'ogaspyan mig la kha'i skar chen 'dra/37

dung gi tshems phreng bstar nas mdzes/dpral bar yi ge a yis mtshan/ljags la pad+ma'i lo 'dab can/mtshan bzang dpe byad sku la rdzogs/'dzam gling khams na 'gran med khyed/sku na tshod chung yang rtsal chen rdzogs/skal ldan bu yi snang ngo la/dus gsum sangs rgyas bla ma dngos/rtsa gsum dkon mchog kun 'dus sku/sku la dgra lha'i dmag sprin 'khrigs/'ja' 'od zer rgyud la mchod lha 'khor/ mchod lha'i gar stabs 'khyug se 'khyugamado ltar rgyal ba shākya thub/ sngags ltar gu ru pad+ma 'byung /rang dang 'dun pa'i bla ma sogs/dbyer med bla ma sangs rgyas dngos/mi phyed snying nas skyabs su mchi/de sngon ma shes 'phrul dbang gis/sku jo ru'i mdzad spyod rnam thar la/bkur ba btab cing snying nas smad/the tshom log lta shar ba kun/de ring khyod la snying nas bshags/phyin chad 'gal ba'i rigs mi bgyid/38

mi 'bral rtag tu 'grogs par smon/e ma grogs mched rta pa tsho/ya mtshan chen po'i rgyal po la/rma shel brag gter byon na bza' la/gos smug po 'ja' tshon rang shar can/rdul dang dri mas ma 'gos pa/de slob dpon pad+ma'i ber chen red/dgra lha'i tshe gos mi zer ram/des gtsos dar gos rgyan cha mang /rin gong thang byin rlabs bshad ma dgos/sku chas sku la bzhes pa'i dus/skye‘ 'gro thams cad zil gyis gnon/dbu la pad+ma'i sgom zhu gsol/de steng gser gyi rdo rje'i togagazi byar mu tig gser gyi garin d+mon sna tshogs mgul rgyan dgu/chos kyi rgyal po'i cha lugs can/khyod 'dra srid pa gsum la ngakon/steng na gdugs dang rgyal mtshan 'dzin/'og na rkyang rgod 'phel po chibs/gser gyi sga chen wang se wang /gzi khra man yob chen khra la la/gser gyi srab la g.yu yi mthur/39

rin chen gong thag gser gyi rmed/chu brag dzar lo spungs se spungs/thog grum gser 'brug kha sprod la/bzo dras ma dgos lhun gyis grub/mgul dom gser tog rin chen rgyan/rta mchog mthong dga' don grubarmechibs/rngam pa'i ze rngog 'gyur ba 'dra/dal na sa gzhi'i khams na 'phyo/brel na bar snang bya ltar lding /lag pa g.yug 'og lam 'dre 'dul/rkang pa 'dor bas sgab 'dre 'dul/rta mchog rin chen lha yi 'phrul/lha mi lhan gcig 'dzoms pa'i dus/hor la gnya' sga gtod par shogabadud la thod mda' 'phrod par shogs tham cham la 'bebs par shogamon shing khri'i dgra mgo non par shoga'adzam gling dkar po'i yul sa nas/smon log bdud rnams thul bar shogagayang chen rdzong gter lon par shoga'adzam gling chos la 'khod par shogagegs dpung phye mar brlag par shogaganod byed ma lus thul bar shog40

de ring tsho drug gling gi dpon/skyid nyi mas gar khyab zil gyis khyab/mtho 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po thogargyal po'i mdzad pa chos la dbang /sku la gegs med bskal brgyar brtan/mthong thos skye 'gro grol nas kyang /rigs drug 'dren pa'i ded dpon shogade ring mjalabasathog ma nas/dus yang yang 'jal bsu byed par shogargyal blon dam tshig mthun par shog dus rtag tu 'bral med smon lam shogang pha khu'i smon lam 'grub kyang 'grub/blo dkar dam tshig sel med yin/dga' e shes gling dkar skya bsu tsho/skyid e shes mi lus don ldan med/khong rgyal po phebs pa'i sku g.yas na/dpa' rgya tsha dung gi zla ba tshes/rngam pas gzhan snang zil gyis gnon/gos darwa rin chen rgyan cha bkragarta rgya bya kha skor kyi li li/mtho ye re dpa' rngam brjid dang ldan/ma sang 'phrul rgyal sku g.yon na/rong tsha smin drug khra yag shar/41

sku na tshod chung yang che brjid ldan/g.yang chen mi yi nor bu red/chibs rta gro bo 'phur shes red/sde gling ru nam mkha' yar langs la/sku mched gsum nyi zla skar gsum shar/ dus rtag tu 'gro ba'i rgyan mchog shogargyal po chen po'i sku rgyab na/dkar dkar ber chen gyon pa la/dar dkar dgung la 'phyar ba 'dra/rin chen rgyan cha mdzes pas bklubs/bong ring sha bkrag legs po ma/yab chen seng blon rgyal po red/rta pho ga ma rlung gshog red/dus rtag tu deng bzhin skyid 'dzom shoga'adzoms nas dar rgud med par shogade mchan mi pho che brling cano/dar gos rin chen rgyan cha can/ shin tu nyams che gzi brjid can/mi chen rgyal ba lhun grub red/chibs rta ga ma ya med red/de rgyab bla ma gser zhu can/chos gos na bza' ngur smrig can/chibs chen 'do chas sha dag la/42

bla ma zhi 'od bzang po sogs/gling gi bla ma sum cu red/rta chen de la de mtshungs red/de rjes bla bzang gsham mthud 'di/ban gser zhwa can la thub pa'i rigs/sngags pa mthu chen chos skyong rigs/ zhwa khra bo can la bon po'i rigs/ming ldan de drag phebs le red/ mi re re'i lo rgyus shod long med/sku blon nye bar phebs nas 'ag/lho sprin 'khrigs 'dra'i bsangs shig thong /snyan sa gsum g.yo ba'i rol chas khrol/lha dang bla mas dar lam gyis/gong sa dpon lus phyag 'bul gyis/stag shar dpa' bos bro re khrob/ma sru rnams kyis maṇa bsu gyis/dga' e shes gling dkar lha yi khrom/tshe rtag tu spro dga' phun sum tshogs/glu yang yang len pa'i smon lam shogaces mi rta ma nor ba so sor gzigs shing gsal ba'i glu de ltar btang bas skya bsu der 'khod tshang ma dga' spro tshad med ngang nye bar phebs pa dang lha bsangs dang rol mo'i sgra grags/ dar btang phyag phul/ bro gar 'khrab pa dang / maṇa bsu sogs kyis 43

bsus te/ rma de'u yag na bkra'i thang stod du sgar btab nas rgyal blon mo sman rnams 'dzoms te dga' skyid rtse dga' ci rigs ngang 'dod yon phun sum tshogs par longs spyad de rten mchog la mchod pa rgya che phul/ de yi phyi nyin pho brang mi 'gyur seng 'brug stag rtse rdzong du chibs bsgyur gnang skabs/ pho brang gi phyi rol du gling lha sde dkar po'i skye bo rgan gzhon med pa khrom dmar nag 'tshogs/pho brang gi mkhar steng nas gdugs rgyal mtshan dang ba dan mdung dar la sogs pa 'phyar/ lha dang bla ma mdo sngags kyi grwa 'bangs rnams kyis ser bsu dang / rol mo'i rigs dkrol ba sogs dga' spro'i bsu ba tshad las 'a das pa byas te pho brang seng 'brug gi 'du ra nyi 'od khang du gser khri dang dngul khri g.yu khri tsan dan gyi khri stag gzig gung dom sogs gdan rab bco brgyad kyi gral ring bco brgyad bkod pa 'i dbus sagaser khri'i steng lha sras 'phrul gyi rgyal po/ dngul khri'i steng 'bum pa'i rgya tsha zhal lu dkar po/ dung khri'i steng rong tsha/ g.yu khri'i steng snang du g.yu stag tsan dan gyi khri'i steng du khu bo rnam gnyis bzhugs/ de min dpa' rtul phu nu rnams bab thob kyis khri dang gdan la 'khod pa dang / gling ya tha'i skyes mchog thar pa dang / mi chen rgyal ba'i lhun grub gnyis kyis gser dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal steng rin chen sna tshogs kyi tshom bu bkod pa phyag la bsnams nas rgyan chas phun sum tshogs pas brgyan te gral gdong nas bzhengs te glu 'di gsungs so/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu a la tha la tha la red/44

tha la gling dkar skyid pa'i glu/skyid nyi ma shar nyin glu zhig len/glu so skye ngag dang mi mtshungs pa'i/bzang mdog g.yo med nam mkha'i klong /smon lam mthun rkyen nyi zla 'char/rten 'brel legs byas phun sum tshogs/mi dge'i mun pa gzhom pa'i glu/de ring 'dir tshogs khrom la len/chos mdo sngags grub pa'i gtsug rgyan gyis/ris med rtsa gsum mchog gsum la/gsol ba 'debs so shis pa stsol/sa 'di rma yul bde mchog zhing /bde mchog nor bu'i pho brang nas/srid pa 'dzam gling chags tshul gtam/rgyas na nyi zla bshol rogs red/rma khams gling khri'i yul ljongs 'di/'dzam gling chags pa'i lte ba yin/rma g.yang 'dod rgu'i bsti gnas red/rgya dkar nag gnyis kyi gong ba yin/gangs ri zur bzhi logs brgyad la/gnam a sngon she' dkar btsugs 'dra 'di/zo dor rma rgyal spom ra red/bod khams gnyan chen ya gyal red/45

gling rgyal rabs yongs kyi byes lha red/mi 'gyur sa yi rten phur red/g.yas ri chags pa'i ri rtse na/rgyal blon bka' gros 'tshogs 'dra 'di/rma stod btsan lha bcu gsum red/'dzam gling gzhi bdag 'du sa red/rgyal blon pho skyes bla ri red/btsan rtsal chen dgun la thog ser 'phro/mgron yar mar ming nas brjod phod med/de mchan g.yon lung ri rtse na/bu spun dgu dgra la rngam 'dra 'di/rma stod mthon po dgu 'gril red/zo dor dgra bla'i so pha red/sdang dgra tshur thog mi 'khel ba'i/ri g.yang chen chags pa'i zur mtha' na/nam yar langs nyi ma shar 'dra yod/khra phu 'dzam gling la kha na/khra rgan nyi ma'i rdzong chen chags/blo ya rabs byas la 'pho 'gyur med/mdun ri tshorjo mgron gshar 'dra yod/de rma yul rab kha'i ri dgu red/bod 'dzam gling g.yang rnams 'du ba'i ri/ri ya mtshan ldan pa brgya brgya'i dkyil/46

stag lpags thang la brgyangs 'dra 'di/'du ra stag thang khra mo zer/shar rma yul bde mchog sa spyod zhing /lha drug cu rtsa gnyis bkod pa dngos/mngon sum ya mtshan lam mer yod/de dbus 'phrul gyi pho brang 'di/bzhengs pa mi 'dra skyes pa 'dra/skyes pa'i pho brang lhun gyis grub/mkhar rmang gzhi sngon mo khro yi mkhar/de las mgon nag po'i 'phral bzo red/phyi rdo rje ra bas bskor ba la༄/bar ye shes me ri me phung bkra/nang sgo srung khro bo las mgon dngos/de mngon sum mjal dang byin rlabs thob/pho brang thog khang dgu brtsegs 'di/ chos rgyud sde dgu yi dkyil 'khor rdzogs/shag chod stong dang rtsa gnyis la/skal bzang stong rtsa'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs/g.yu bya ru'i rab gsal bco brgyad 'di/chos rmo 'dres ji bzhin gzigs pa yis/'gro kun mthong zhing grol ba'i brda/mthong thos 'gro ba 'dren pa'i brda/'og khang thog rtseg gsum po la/47

zad med rgyu nor longs spyod mdzod/mi mgon dkar pos gnyer kha byed/gling dgos 'dod nor la spyod pa'i brda/bar khang thog rtseg gsum pa la/gong dpon 'du ra sum cu yod/de gnyan chen sku lhas srung skyob byed/chos khrims srid nyams pa med pa'i brda/steng khang thog rtseg gsum po la/lha bla ma'i sgom khang sum cu yod/rten lha khang zhing sa de mtshungs yod/de lha chen tshangs pas gnyer kha byed/chos bshad sgrub nyi 'od khyab pa'i brda/'dzam bu chu gser las bzos pa'i/steng la gser 'phru bcu gsum yod/'dzam gling khams kyi yul ljongs na/rten mchog mngon par 'phags pa'i brda/'ja' 'od gur khang phub pa 'di/gnas dang yul gyi zhing skyong dang /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i brda/phu bo dung skyong lha 'khor 'bum/nu bo klu sbrul klu 'khor 'bum/yab chen ger mdzo gnyan 'khor 'bum/sring lcam 'od 'phro sman mo 'bum/48

nor bu bzang po tshong 'khor stong /las smon lha mi bzang 'dzom gyis/ rten mchod pho brang lhun gyis grub/mi bu lha yi sras gcig pu/ stobs dang rdzu 'phrul 'gran med pas/spyod ngan jo rur brdzus pa la/nged can rtog tshogs ngan pa yis/ sku gsung thugs dang 'gal ba'i las/ma shes 'gal 'khrul ci bgyis pa/rje khyed kyi spyan sngar mthol zhing bshags/phyin chad srog las gces par sgom/de ring lha nyi dkar po la/rten 'brel yag gi mgo mo 'dir/gzhal med khang 'di'i pho brang dbus/dri bzang chu yis chag chag btab/gyad dang seng ge nor bu dang /shugs rtsal ldan pa'i rta mchog gis/btegs pa'i gser gyi khri 'phang mtho/dar chen zab dgu 'bol ba'i gdan/dar gdugs rgyal mtshan rma bya'i gdugs/gdugs mngon par mtho ba'i ma 'og na/dus gsum sangs rgyas gcig bsdus pa'i/'phrul sras ge sar lha yi sras/49

rus ni che ba smug po gdong / stobs rtsal 'gran med mgo nag rgyal/sku bkrag legs pa lha dbang sras/mtshan dpe byad legs pa sangs rgyas sku/gter byon na bza' bzhes pa'i dus/chos kyi rgyal po'i cha lugs can/zhal mjal bzod dka'i gzi brjid can/khyod ni bla ma sangs rgyas dngos/mdzad pa yon tan grangs las 'das/dga' ba chen po'i sor bcus 'dud/de ring mi dbang khri la phebs/zer bzod dka'i nyi ma shar ba 'dra/g.yas kham pa dngul gyi khri steng na/zhal lu zla ba rang shar bzhugs/g.yon dri med dung gi khri steng na/'gran med nu bo rong tsha bzhugs/nyi zla dkar gsum gral gyis gtsos/gung gral g.yu khri'i gdan steng na/gling phu nu'i g.yang chen snang ngu bzhugs/g.yas g.yon tsan dan khri steng na/spyi dpon khro thung rnam gnyis bzhugs/g.yas gral stag gzig gung dom gdan/gdan rab gral ring bco brgyad steng /50

mi dbang phu nu sum cu bzhugs/rtsa gral dar gdan ring mo'i steng /chags chen pha khu rnam pa bzhugs/gsham mthud ru 'dren rnam pa bzhugs/g.yon gyi rtsa gral dar gdan steng /ma sru mo sman rnam pa bzhugaso/ mdo khams rgyal mo 'brug mo dang /zhal ta bu mo rang 'khor drugayang 'khor mdzes pa'i bu mo brgyas/bdud rtsi ja chang skyems zhu 'bul/dus yang yang 'dren pa'i smon lam zhu/rgyalazlan phu nu gser zhal rgyas/gser zhel rgyas pa'i mdun drung na/dngul dkar maṇ+ḍal rgya che'i steng/ye shes mkha' 'gro lnga mtshon pa'i/'bru lnga'i maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bkod/gzhi dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la/phyi lcags ri 'khor yug mu mkhyud dbus/ri yi rgyal po ri rab bkod/ de'i phyir gling bzhi gling phran brgyad/mngon sum bkod cing mngon sum 'bul/gling bzhi gling pon dbang bsgyur shogadapag bsam shing dang 'dod 'jo'i ba/51

rang byang ma rmos lo thog 'bul/bsojo nams nor gyi bdag por shoga'akhor nor bu btsun mo blon po dang /glang po rta mchog dmag dpon bcas/rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun 'bul/ji bzhin stobs rtsal lhun grub nas/srid gsum dbang du 'du bar shogazad med gter gyi bum pa 'bul/'dod dgu'i gter la spyod par shogasgeg mo phreng ba glu ma gar/ me tog bdug spos snarnga gsal dri/mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad po 'bul/sems yul brgyad dag pa'i brtan thob shogablo ma rig mun gsal nyi zla 'bul/phyogs las rnam rgyal rgyal mtshan 'bul/mngon par mtho ba'i gdugs mchog 'bul/bdag tu bzung dang ma bzung ba'i/stong gsum 'jig rten yo byad kun/dngos 'byor rdul snyigs sprul byas te/rtsa gsum kun 'dus lha yi sras/dkon mchog kun 'dus khyed la 'bul/bdag cag tshogs gnyis rdzogs sor shoga'abras bu sangs rgyas thob par shog ༄༄52

khyed gzhan don 'bad med mtha' rgyas shogaglong sde rmongs pas nyes byas bshags/de sngon mdzad par rjes yi rangs/mi 'gyur gser gyi khri 'phang steng /bskal brgya'i bar du g.yo med brtan/nag phyogs ming yang mi lhag par/mngon spyod drag pos 'dul bar smon/thul nas yul khams chos la 'khod/༄ 4dge ba cu 'i bstan pa dar bar shogadar nas dge ba ci bsags pa/khams gsum 'gro ba yongs la bsngo/thams cad byang chub myur thob shogarje/rgyal po gangs dkar seng ge la/dpa' rtul phu nu g.yu ral rgyas/sder chags gzhan kun zil gnon ltar/smon log bdud sde thul bar shogagater byon rten mchog nor bu yis/mchog dngos gru char 'bebs par shogarten mchog pho brang bcud la bzhugs/gling yul 'gro ba 'dren par shoga'adzam gling snyan pas yongs khyab nas/ thams cad yon du 'gyur ba shogade ring dga' spro'i lhan rgyas bzhin/53

rtag tu 'di bzhin 'dzoms par shoga'adzoms nas dge bcu'i bstan pa spel/bdag gzhan bla med sa thob shogadakon mchog gsum gyi bden mthu yis/smon lam glu don 'grub par shogaces glu phul ba dang sbrags maṇ+ḍal g.yu byur gser dngul rin chen lngas byar bur bkang nas mdzod dar gyis dkris pa re gnyis ga'i phyag stu bsnams nas lha sras 'phrul gyi rgyal po'i mdun gser lcog steng phul ba dang / lha sras nas/ 'o na de bzhin legs tshogs phun sum tshogs pa ba zhin ba dag gzhan rnams bkra shis par gyur cig gsungs nas mi chen gnyis la mdzod dar re mgul la bsgron nas dbu thod gtugs/ dpa' rtul rnams nas slar gser dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal dang bkra shis mjal dar re phul nas gral la slar 'khod pa dang / mdo khams rgyal mo 'brug mo dang / tsho chen ra bza' dge mtsho/ sngo lo skyid kyingane'u chung / gro lo'i pad dkar lha mdzes/ spyi dpon bu mo g.yu sgron/ ya tha'i bu mo dar sgron/tsha zhang bu mo mdzes sgron gyis gtsos che khag bu mo ma sru rnams kyis/dar zab kyi gos dang rin chen rgyan spras te mchod lha lta bu'i mdzes 'dzum nyams bag ngang gser rkyan dang / dngul rgyane ja chang bdud rtsi bzang pos bkang nas rgyal blon yongs la sum bltams re phul ba dang / sngo lo skyid kyi ne'u chung / sgrol ma sngon mo'i skye ba/mtshan ldan ye shes mkha' 'gro ma des rgyal blon phu nu lhan rgyas/skyes bu khri la 'khod pa/ 'dzam gling chos la 'god thub pa'i ltas 54

bzang po mngon mkhyen yid la wa ler gsal nas dga' spro tshad med skyes nas yid bag tsha dang bral te dngul rgyan chang gis bkang nas co ga drug 'gyur gyi rta la drangs pa'i smon lam gyi glu 'di phul lo/o ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu a la tha la tha la red/tha la ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/la la tshig gi gcod lugs red/ shar po ta la yi gnas mchog nas/spyan gzigs sgrol ma dkar sngon ma/gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes gzigs/rkyen phyi nang bar chad zhi bar shogs 'di rma yul gling dkar dbus/pho brang 'phrul mkhar nang rol red/nga 'dra sngo lo'i ne'u chung zer/ 'byor pa zhan te sde pha'i rgyud/skye ba dman te skye lus mtho/'byang ba shing la lo shing lugasga rlong lcam khong dang lo mnyam yin/skyid zer le kha sang de ring ram̐d/gling dkar khra mo'i yul ljongs nas/mi lus thob pa don ldan red/sgos chos la spyode na yang ldan red/rgyal blon mjal ba bsod nams red/55

gral gcig tu 'khod pa yang bsod red/mi tha mal mi mthong bla mar mthong /sel dri mas ma gos yang mthong red/gser khri dar gdan yang steng na/mngon mtho gdugs kyi ma 'og na/ma sang 'phrul gyi rgyal po khyed/de snga nyi ma'i yanachodal/ mdog ngan 'gog mo'i jo ru'i dus/bya spyod ngan dgu gang byas kyang /kho mo'i blo la dad log med/khyed ni sangs rgyal sprul pa dngos/mdzad spyod rdzu 'phrul phyag rjes mthong /tsho drug gling gi rgyal sa la/'god pa blo la hril thag chod/de ring rgyal sa che la phebs/dus yang yang khri 'phang mtho bar shogachang bdud rtsi 'dren pa'i thog ma yin/dus yang nas yang du 'dren par shogaskur dgra bla'i go mtshon bzhes pa'i dus/smon log bdud sde thul bar shog stobs shugs smon lam 'gran med mthus/g.yang rdzong gter kha lon par shogastobs bcu lhun gyis grub pa yis/56

'dzam gling chos la 'god par shogabyang sems char chen 'bebs pa yis/zug ngu'i me chen zhi bar shogathugs rje thabs mkhas lcags kyu yis/dad pa'i a long bzung bar shogabazung nas 'pho 'gyur med par shog g.yas dngul khri kham pa'i gdan steng na/khra 'khyil le zhal lu dkar po bzhugs/ sku bkrag mdangs bco lnga'i zla ba shar/gsung yig drug chad med chu bo'i rgyun/thugs bde gsal lo tog khog na rgyas/pha bzang po'i bu la nor 'khrul med/mu pa gnam gyi rgyal po yis/gling tsho drug bu bzhin skyong bar shogagayon dung lo 'bar ba'i khri steng na/nu bo rong tsha dmar leb bzhugs/sku bkrag lha yi sras dang mtshungs/dpa' rtsal seng la g.yu ral rgyas/gling dkar yul gyi rgyan gcig pu/sku mched gsum 'dzam gling dbang sgyur shogapha dang khu bo dpa' rtul dpung /dpa' rngam stag gzig gra rgyas khyu/gra 'dzom drug thig le mi nyams shing /57

nag phyogs bdud dgra'i sha khrag za/snyan grags yongs la khyab par shogagling g.yu mtsho nam mkha'i me tog la/rkyen ngan pa ba mos mi ldang zhing /rang so so'i las bskos lha yi mdun/ bkrag mer re bsam don 'grub par shog sde dbu nag 'khor ba'i rten phur shogasde mnga' 'bangs dpag bsam ljon shing la/phyug yar 'phel 'bras bu sa gzhi khengs/rma g.yang zas nor phun tshogs nas/tshe rtag tu dga' skyid 'dzom par shob/de 'dzoms nas chos la spyod par shogangs smon lam btab tshad 'grub kyang 'grub/gling dkar bu mo'i chos lugs la/dkon’mchoge gsum gyi bden mthu yod/bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum/glu len pa'i 'go mo yag par shogatshig brjod pa'i 'bras bu 'grub par shogade ring gnam skar tshes dus bzang /nga ser mo 'khrul ba'i rmi lam la/gser khri lang ma ling rtseg steng /sku sna tshogs ston pa'i skyes bu bzhugs/sku g.yas nas mjal na shāka thub 'dra /58

5g.yon mjal ston pa gshen rab 'dra/mdun nas mjal na pad 'byung 'dra/rgyab nas mjal na zo dor 'dra/dgra bla wer ma kun 'dus dngos/hor bdud mon 'jang bdud chen bzhi/bstan dgra cham la 'bebs nges red/kla klo'i kha gnon yong nges red/mgo nag skyabs mgon yin nges red/'dzam gling chos la 'khod nges red/rigs drug thar lam 'dren nges red/gter rdzong bod la phebs nges red /dkon mchog dbu 'phang mtho nges red/sde gnyis dge 'dun rgyas nges red/bsod nams bde skyid 'byung nges red/a skyid mo e shes lha yi khrom/sdug gi mun pa mtha' nas yal/ser po gser gyi kha dog de/me la bsregs na rang mdog mngon/pho chen rta pho'i rgyug rtsal de/'gros rtsal sbyangs na mgyogs dar thob/ma sang 'phrul gyi rgyal po yis/rdzu 'phrul ngom nas gter sgo 'byed/lha yis bskos pa'i skyes bu de/5 9

dus la bab na 'gro khams 'dul/'phrul mkhar lha yi pho brang la/rgyal blon gser 'al lhan du rgyas/rim gyis bdud dgra'i gnya' nas gnon /dga' ba'i skyid nyi 'go mo red/glu yang yang len pa'i rten 'brel shogazhal yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam yod/glu 'khrul pa byung na mthol lo bshags/ngarga 'khyal ba byung na bzod par gsol/rgyal blon thugs la de ltar zhogaces glu de ltar blangs shing rgyal po sku mched gsum dang spyi dpon snang ngu sogs che drag dpa' rtul rnams la bdud rtsi'i chang phul/ rgyal mchog lha sras nas g.yu drug dkar lag mthil tsam rgya ngar gyis/ bcings te ne'u chung la gnang / dpa' rtul phu nu thams cang dga' spro'i glu rtsed sogs la rol nas bar khang rab gsal nye 'od du bzhugs//4 gter byon gyi lha thams cad ldir gyis bar snang nas bya 'phur ba bzhim dpa' bo mkha' ljo5gro 'i dar lam nas ro'/ cho/'i sgra ngang bcas thog bang gi lha khang shag chod re re'i mang mngon surma/ du phebaru te bzhugs/ gral 'a 'bod nas 'ja' shar dri bzang sa phyogs kun la khyab/ phyi rol la me tog gi char bab pas der 'khod dang/'a rtu'/ dang gling sde tham sa cad4'a dad spro tshad med thob cing dad pas ma ja' zhing stan dang5 ngang ma/chod pa/'i yo byad bas rma4 gyis mi khyab pa phul naṭar smoṅge kru ma rgya chen btab/ gling dkar dze 60

sde gzhan tshang ma kha skyid khog la mi shong bar/ yid la skyid pa'i 'go mo shar/ che rgyud stag rong khro thung ni bsam bsam ci la bsams kyang gling gi rgyal sa dang/ 'brug mo'i mdzes sdug skya 31tho'ajug lha:rdo 166 /)sgo /)rde shādhe/ cedro/ /ste|'a rgyu ra gas da la 'char / na zas la bcud da pa/ mtshan mo gnyid mi khug pa sogs byung yang / gus gus 'dud 'dud du sdod pa las bya thabs bral/ de nas zhag bdun bar che drag thams cad 'tshogs nas dga' skyid ston mo'i ngang la gnas nas dgyes ston grol khar gdong gi spyi dpon rgyal po des 'gro 'dug dgos tshul gyi glu 'di dpa' bo'i rngam brjid dang bgres pa'i ñcāms dang bcas te dal ba ring mo'i ngag rta la drangs nas gsungs oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ glu a la tha la tha la red/tha la la mo la la red/ la la ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/shar ri bo ta la'i pho brang nas/longs sku thugs rje chen po de/sku mdog dkar ba gangs ri'i mdogaphyag bzhi rtsa phyag thal mo sbyar/bol mor yid bzhin nor bu bsnams/g.yas 'og shel phreng g.yon pad dkar/longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas kyis brgyan/rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs/61

zhal mjal ba mi bzod gzi brjid can/spyan lam mer brtse bas bdag la gzigs/yid gdung ba chen pos gsol ba 'debs/ma 'gro drug sems can thar lam drongs/glu len pa'i 'bras bu smin par shogatshig brjod pa'i dgos pa ldan par shogs 'di sa ngo ma shes na/rgya dkar nag chags kyi gong ba red/'dzam gling chags pa'i rten phur red/pho brang seng 'brug nang rol na/rgyal blon 'du ra 'tshogs mdun red/nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na/gling srid pa chags pa'i ru ma yin/smug po gdong gi gdung rgyud yin/gdong rje 'phra dmar rgyal po zer/gling sde pas rmi shes yod le med/rgyal blon gros tshogs gzhi ma yin/de ring lha nyin dkar po la/bskal pa bzang po'i dus chen shar/phun sum tshogs pa'i rten 'brel 'grigs/nag phyogs bdud dgra'i kha gnon la/ slob dpon pad+ma'i rgyal tshab mchogargyal kun ye shes gcig bsdus gar/62

gzhan gyis mi thub stobs po che/ma sang dgra bo'i sku gcig skyes/gling spyi dpon gser gyi khri la 'khod/sgos yang bsod spyi dpon lha zhal mtho/gser khri mi 'gyur gdan steng na/sku g.yo med brtan par bzhugs nas kyang /bdag 'gro ba kun la mgon gyur cigasku mched gnyis khri 'phang rtag tu mtho/phyi nang tshe ring yon tan ldan/tsho drug mgon pa'i dpung gnyen shogadapa' rtul phu nu gral ra 'dzoms/mi re ri'i yon tan grangs las 'das/phyi dgra yis dpa' rtsal 'gran rgyu med/ 'gran med stag mo gzig mo khyu/ dpa' bo'i gral ra mi zhig shog 'dir bzhugs rgyal blon gser zhal rgyas/snyan lhang nger a khu nga la gson/dpe) na 'dra ma e 'dra gda'/dpag bsam shing gi lo 'dabs la/'bras bu smin pa shod mi dgos/ lha klu'i longs spyod mig gis ltos/shing 'bras bu bskal pa'i las bskos red/mkha' dbyings nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor des/63

mun pa gsal ba shod mi dgos/skye 'gro'i grang sel lus kyi rgyan/'od 'khyil le bskal pa'i las bskos red/re 'dod 'byang ba'i 'dod 'jo'i ba/ 'o ma 'dod rdogu 'byang gnas gter/ byang gling longs spyojo mig gi rgyan/yid ltar 'dod 'jo bskos thang red/rma shel ri brag gi gter byon la/byin rlabs dngos grub shod ma dgos/ya mtshan rdzu 'phral mig gis ltos/byin theb se rterno bzang las bskos red/slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas khong / dbu nag bod la bka' drin che/shar gling dkamastod la sgos drin che/'dzam gling g.yas bzhag gter g.yang 'dis/ma 'ongs bsam don lhun gyis 'grub/lhun grub mnga' bdag ge sar rgyal/gter nor bu pha nor bu bdag red/byin rlabs dngos grub che ba'i rtags/'ja' tshon bkrag zer khyug se khyugarang sngags snying po 'brug ltar sgrogamangon sum mkha' la bya ltar lding / gang gis ma sgrib zang thal phebs/64

rang rang mos pa'i zhal khang bzhugs/bcom ldan shākya'i bzhugs lang 'di/ gtso bo gser gyi shaka thub la /'khor gser gyi sangs rgyas stong sku red /gang nas byung med mngon sum rtags/'dzam gling rgyan gcig ghan rdo la/gser dngul dung mtshal g.yu bris sogs/gter byon gsung rab po ti rnams/ chos rtsig rang byon dgung dang mnyam/thugs rten su ri mchod rten brgyad/mngon sum lha nas bab pa 'dra/gang nas byung med mngon sum bzhugs/khro yi las mgon nag ngo/ 'di/ sgo srung tshul du rngam par bzhugs/phan dang bde ba 'byung ba'i gzhi/thub bstan shākya'i gtsug lag khang /mi nub dar zhing rgyas gyur cigadung gi spyan ras gzigs dbang la/li ser las byon nye sras brgyad/mngon sum bzhugs pa'i lha khang 'di/rten mchog phan dang bde ba'i gzhi/byang chub sems dpa'i gling khang red/mi nub dar zhing rgyas gyur cig65

byu ru'i tshe dpag med mgon dang /gdan khri dkyil 'khor rang byon 'di/mtshan la tshe dpag lha khang zhu/mi nub dar zhing rgyas gyur cigade mtshams byang sgo dkar mo na/dngul gyi byams pa mgon po la/dngul gyi nye sras rang byon 'di/mtshan la byams pa lha khang zhu/mi nub dar zhing rgyas gyur cig de mtshams shar sgo sngon po na/g.yu yi sgrol ma nyer gcig bzhugs/mtshan gsol sgrol ma lha khang zhu/mi nub dar zhing rgyas gyur cig lha sku mthong ba don ldan dang /dar nag mgon po rang byon gyis/'u gu mi 'gro sdod kyin gsungs/tshoms chen nyi ma rang shar nang /rten mchog rnam gnyis lam mer bzhugs/bla bres nam mkha' kun khyab de/rma bya'i sgro gur phub pa bzhin/bar snang yol ba khyab par 'khod/dar khra rin chen phyug mo de/bar snang mkha' la lan gsum 'khor/66

yang mthar gser gyi khri rgyab 'phyar/gter gyi mdung cha de bzhin 'khor/dgra lha 'khor ba'i me ri 'bar/'khor la 'khor ba'i zi ra 'tshub/sil snyan nyi 'od rang mdangs 'di/ma dkrol rang 'khrol sgra chen khengs/chosi dung dkar mo rgyang grags de/'bud mkhan med kyang rang byung grags/nyi 'od rdzu 'phrul lha khang zhu/mi nub dar zhing rgyas gyur cigadzhai khyim dzam la rang byon lnga/gter byon rgyu nor khyad 'phags rnams/byang shar bang mdzod dbus la bzhugs/gnod sbyin 'dod 'byang mgon khang zhu/mi nub dar zhing rgyas hūṃr cigazangs dkar 'o ma'i bcud 'dzin de/g.yang mar khu mer re thab khar bab/thab lha g.yang gi lha tshogs 'khor/phun tshogs bkra shis me thab khang /mi nub dar zhing rgyas gyur cigade nas che drag rgyal blon la/rang rang tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i phyir/rten mchog bzang po'i zhing sa la/67

sna tshogs mchod pa'i dge rtsa dang /khyad par ngo mtshar rmad byung ba'i/spos dang mar me zhal zas gsum/mchod pa kun gyi snying po yin/'dod yon longs spyod tshogs mchod de/rma chod pa'i tshogs rdzogs nye lam yin/ting 'dzin yid kyis spros mchod de/bla na med pa'i mchod pa zab/chu gtsang dri dang byug pa dang /me tog gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang /ba dan rol mo'i bye brag sogs/ ma chong pa kun gyi mig rgyan yin/phyi yi rgyan dang nang gi bcud/de phyir mchod tshogs brtson par mdzod/mchod pa'i gegs skyon ser sna las/nyes pa'i dri mas ma gos zob/che 'byor chung gsum blo dang bstun/mang na bza' shes gros kha bsdur/thams cad blo 'dun ma bor dgos/da yang de bas mi tshad pa'i/ rdo 'bum sa tsha lha khang dang /jo dar phyag skor kha ton gyis/ dge ba rim nas rim du sgrubs/68

sdug dang sdig pa ci nas spongs/ma nus sprang por sbyin pa thong /'gro ba yongs la phan sems chongs/ri klung rgya sdom dge bcu'i khrims/khrims yig zhal lce'i nang gsal brten/pha ma bu tshar gtan bde thob/de sogs a khu'i mngags gtam de/ dpon 'go so so'i sde 'bangs la/thos par sgrogs shing thub par sdoms/nga a khu bka' btsan che ba'i don/ gling dkar nam mkha' rang mdangs la/spyi dpon gnam gyi skya rengs shar/sku mched gsum nyi zla dkar gsum bkra/gling dpa' rtul 'gyur med sa gzhi brling /gnam sa lhan zhal rgyas lam nas/'bangs rtsi shing bzhin du yar dar rgyas/bod sgang pa'i bstan chus yar dar shogad rung gtam gyi rdo ga la/dper na 'dra ma e 'dra yod/nor bu ming thogs brgya yod de/dgos 'dod 'byung ba re re tsam/thog bzung g.yu 'brug brgya yod kyang /nor bzung g.yu 'brug re re tsam/69

glang chen stobs ldan brgya yod kyang /glang mche ba drug pa re re tsam/rgyal po ming thogs brgya yod kyang /ma sang 'phrul rgyal re re tsam/da rung dper na 'dra ma gda'/dbus kyi ri bo mchog rab la/gling bzhi gling phran brgyad kyis bskor/ri rgyal g.yo ba mi mnga' yang / ri rab che ba'i khyad chos yin/lha chen tshangs pa brgya byin la/steng khams lha gnas yongs kyis bskor/lha dbang gzhan la mi dogs te/stobs dbang thang btsan pa'i khyad chos red/'og phyogs klu chen brgyad po la/klu phran bye ba sa yas bskor/klu dbang gzhan la mi dogs te/de mthu stobs che ba'i khyad chos red/gling rje ma sang 'phrul rgyal la/'gran med dpa' rtul phu nus bskor/'phrul rgyal gzhan la mi dogs te/sto/babarga mnga' thang che ba'i khyad chos yin/yang snying tshig gi 'bras bu la/rgyal po'i thugs blo 'dri sa la/70

dar 'phen dug gi sdong po khong /dpa' rtsal yon tan che dgu 'dzoms/khra mo rdzong gi nang bcud mdzod/nu bo rong tsha dmar leb 'di/sku na chung yang stobs rtsal che/sku mched zhal lu mnyam bkod mdzod/tsha zhang 'dan ma byang khra dang / sga sde chos skyong ber nag gnyis/dpa' la mi spyang dkar po gsum/dpon 'go gsum gyi mnga' 'bangs nas/hrag bsdus de drag gcig stong dmagardzong bzung rgyal po'i sku srung gyis/rgyal blon zhal lu mnyam bkod mdzod/gser pa'i nyi ma'i 'bum thub dang /'om bu'i a nu dpa' seng dang /mu spyang rin chen dar lu gsum/stod smad bar gyi dpon po gyis/hrag bsdus rta dmag sum stong grangs/gling dkar phyi yi so srung gyis/phyi dgra nang la ma btang dgos/do gal byang na rim lta byed/mdo khazlos rgyal mo 'brug mo khyed/rje la gus shing ci gsung sgrubs/71

bla ma sangs rgyas 'du shes kyis/dpa' rtul kun la 'thad par gzob/nang 'khor bran g.yog byams kyis skyong /'gro 'dug ba ma mang che brling ldan/mdzad spyod chos la brtson na 'thad/sngo lo'i bu mo ne'u chung ma/shes rig yon tan brgya ldan ma/sgrol ma sngon mo'i sprul pa dngos/nyon mongs med cing byams sems ldan/sga seng lcam khong dang sku mched red/phyi tshul a 'brug zhal ta ma/nang don rgyal la sri zhu sgrubs/ming snga phyi bar la chen chun dang /gzugs legs nyes bar la ming thogs gyis/rgyab rgyu nor yod med dpon g.yog tshul/don sgrol ma'i sprul pa las bskos gcigadapa' rtul mi res g.yu dar re/che 'don bkra shis smon lam zhus/nga spyi dpon rgas pa'i col gtam min/gong ma lha'i lung khrig khrig yin/de bzhin dpa' rtul tshang ma rnams/rang mkhar zung la rang chus 'tshos/lar gzhi rgyal po'i bka' gsung sgrubs/72

yul khams dge bcu'i khrims kyis sdoms/༄dkar po chos la ci 'grub gyis/mi rje ge sar rgyal po 'di/lha nas bskos pa'i lha phrug red/nag phyogs bdud kyi kha gnon red/mgo nag mi yi skyabs gnas red/sangs rgyas bstan pa spel mi red/shar bdud mi nyag rgyal po gcigalho bdud shing khri rgyal po gnyis/nub bdud hor ser gur dkar gsum/byang bdud pho 'dre klu btsan bzhi/de phyogs bzhi'i bdud chen bzhi po red/gling dkar khra mo'i sger dgra red/'dzam bu gling gi spyi dgra red/sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dam nyams red/da rung de bas mi tshad pa/smug po 'jang gi sa tham rgyal/stag gzig nor gyi rgyal po sogs/rdzong chen bco brgyad yod rabs yod/rdzong chung tsi tsi grangs med zer/zer srol bden srol gnyis ka red/gnad dus lha yi lung dang bstun/lha gong ma'i bka' lung gnang ba'i dus/73

blon dpa' rtul dpa' rtsal ma chung dgos/tshe gtan du rang rgyud ma rtsub dgos/mi mang sar kha lce ma mang dgos/gnyen nye ba'i khrel gzhung ma ral dgos/gtam don me da rgyal kha ma thob dgos/tshig yang gtam 'bras bu ma bor dgos/gtam lkog nas shob shob ma smra dgos/ngos gdong lang mchil mas ma brnang dgos/de a khu'i glu yi 'dra ma yin/de ring lha nyin dkar po la/tshig smras tshad gser gyi thig pa shogadon yang dag chos su 'gyur bar shogaglu 'khrul pa byung na mthol lo bshags/ngag 'khyal ba byung na bzod par gsol/'dir tshogs rgyal blon thugs la zhogaces gsungs par thams cad kyis mngon par bstod/ de'i nang nas khro thung dang gdong btsan/ a dpal sogs stag rong shog 'ga' shas glu don yid la ma babs par ma dga'/ rgyal mo 'brug mo yang ni'u chung rgyal po'i sku bcar du dgos pa rang gi gong la shor dogs kyis yid la cung ma babs kyang spyi dpon dbang btsan pas thag bcad par ci bya bral/ dpa' rtul yongs nas ne'u chung la bkra shis pa'i g.yu dari re dang bkra shis smon lam mdzad de mnga' gsol/ stag rong dpon gyi yid la ma babs par rten gyi 74

mchod thebs su thu le 'bri bcu dang / g.yang dkar lug bcu/tshe re ra bcu bcas yod zer bas dpa' rtul thams cad ha gad kyis pho brang bkang / de nas dpa' rtul tshos yid mos pa'i dbang gis rang gi mnga' thang gi phyed cha mchod rtsar bsngos/ nya tsha a brtan nas thu le 'bri brgya mchod rtsar bsngos pa sogs bya ba rnams legs par grub rjes dga' ston grol te dpa' rtul rnams yid spro zhing mi 'jigs pa'i gdengs thob nas rang rdzong du phebs/gdong 'bum pa'i zhal lu dkar po de nyid sku mched rnams dang sger blon tsho bcas dga' spro'i gsung gleng ci rigs ngang zhag dgu bzhugs nas grol/ rgyal mchog dang rong tsha/ dar 'phen/ blo chen khra glag spyang gsum sku srung dmag dang bcas pas seng 'brug dang ja mkhar bzung nas tshogs rdzogs kyi mchod 'bul la sogs pa chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam thar bskyangs te dga' skyid zung 'brel gyi ngang la bzhugs par gda'o/

ra le'u gnyis pa/ jo rus srid mdzad khro thung yi ma rangs/rin chen nor rdzas khyer nas skog tu byol/g.yu rtse rgyal dang shar bdud spun bdun la/skyabs bcol tsha bo'i chab srid 'phrog par brtsams/de nas a khu khro thung rgyal po yab sras thams cad mgo 'phang dma' zhum zhum gyis rdzong du 'byor/ bu nya tsha ni nyams snang med par dga' skyid ngang bzhugs/ stag rong dpon po ni bsam blo bzhi gsum bcu gnyis/ blo rtse nyi shu rtsa lnga bkod nas rang dgar sdod mi thub/ bsam pa blo la shar nas zhag lnga'i nyin stag rong dpon gyis nang tshan che drag thams cad mdun du bos nas za btung phun sum tshogs pa la longs spyad mthar 'jigs pa'i chas bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i ngang har min hur glu'i ngag rta la drangs pa'i glu 'di ltar blangs so/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu a la tha la tha la red/tha la la mo la la red/la la ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/76

me ri 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas/srid pa a long khong seng nas/yi dam rta mgrin dmar po mkhyen/bstan pa'i byas la spyan gyis gzigs/'bod na snyano gyis gsan rogs gyis/bsgrubs bsgrubs rgyang thag ma ring zhigabasten bsten mthu rtsal ma chung zhigajo rus dgos min lung bstan dus/khro rgyal bstan byas 'pho 'phyug dus/de dus lha med r+shathu med red/bslu zer na lha yis bslu nges red/da bslu med lha yis rgyab rten gyis/sa 'di srib sa khol mo rdzong /pho btsan po min na sa zin dka'/rdzong 'dir pho rog snying rdzong zer/dpon mthu chen min na zin le min/nga 'dra nga ngo los shes te/lha rta mgrin dmar po'i skye ba la/gdong gi khro mchog rgyal po zer/ chung ma las skyes nas bsnyen sngags bgrangs/mthu rtsal 'khrul la rang dbang thob/khra mo gling gi 'go dpon yin/ gra yag gdan kha gnon mi la/77

'gran med stag gzig dpa' rgod bu/nya tsha a dpal bu bzhis gson/ka bzhi dpon dang g.yu thog dpon/stag tsha bya chen khang ne sogs/ru 'dren dpon 'go bcu gnyis gson/a rgod thar pa'i zor sna sogs/go chod rgyug byed mi dgus nyon/gros byed dbang chen mi gsum nyon/de snga nyi ma yan chod la/smug po'i gdung rigs sras gsum yod/spyi dpon seng blon nga rang gsum/a pha gcig gi bu rgyud yin/gling gdong rigs che 'bring chung gsum zer/spyi dpon gdong rigs che bar grags/rang rang bstan chas 'tsho ba'i dus/spyi dpon o ro khorke snyog gibu che ba glen pa chos rgyal de/rong la phyin nas rong mos bsad/nus med a ya ma nus dus/ spyi dpon ro la dbugs thogs des/ci drag mthe bong slong ba'i dus/mi bsad ra mda' rjes gcod la/stag rong stag 'phen gzig 'phen gnyis/78

stag gzig 'dra ba'i dmag dpon byas/rong mi tsho'i dmag dpung zhib bsdu byas/gling dmag khas len kha snon byas/dmag dpung rong gi yul la phab/rong rje dbu dkar rgyal po des/rong dmag khri tsho bcu gnyis bsdus/dpa' bo'i g.yul chen 'gyed pa'i dus/dmag dpon stag gzig kha sprod de/rong lba ba can de la la ded/la la ded cing la na bsad/rong grum bu can de mthur la ded/mthur la ded cing mthur na bsad/dpa' 'dra mnyam can de thang la gshib/thang la gshib cing thang la bsad/rong dbu dkar rgyal po gri ngar drangs/rong bza' rong gi rgyu nor bcas/mi bsad sha lan stong 'gyur blangs/da rung de bas mi tshad pa'i/de rjes lo gcig song mtshams su/ma dkar rta yag 'gog la shor/sngar bzhin ra mda' ci drag zer/a phos rna mchog ma g.yar dus/gser khri lang ma ling rtseg dang /79

khrims yig zhal lce bcu gsum dang /khrims srid dbang ba'icho lo tham/dgra thub gtan bdag 'bul rgyu dang /dpa' bo chibs las gzhol ba'i rten/bzang gsum mdo drug gong ma dang /g.yag sa kun dga' ra ba dang /'bri sa dkar mo stag tshang dang /lug sa mon thog ra ba dang /ra sa tsher lung ring mo dang /rta sa na ba gzhung rgyas sogs/stag rong dpon la sger 'bul byang /yig bris 'ba' dang the'us marnon/de nas sdod du ma bcug dus/stag rong pha bu blon tshogs bcas/dpung dmag 'gog gi yul la phab/'gog ra lo ston pa 'phrul po che/thabs dang stobs kyis cham la phab/'gog gling zla ba dgu la 'khrugaming thogs skyes pa yu med bzos/chos nang pa red de bstan pa bsnubs/don yang thug spyi dpon kho yi sdigargyal kha khra mo gling gis blangs/'gog nas 'gog bza' lha mo bsus/80

rta su mgyogs rgyan bzhag seng blon thob/che rgyud stag rong sde pa zer/tsho drug gling gi spyi dpon byas/thob dbang thang che bas 'phrog le min/ gtam pa tshig gi kha dan yin/yig bris 'ba' gan bzhag le yin/dpa' bo dpa' ba'i dpa' dar yin/mdang sum chu 'gyur nya 'gyur dus/'gog bza' ma la bu gcig skyes/mtshan rtags ngan pa jo re langs/mi ngan yul gyi dkrug shing tshar/me 'bar thog shing skam bsnan pa bzhin /se lu 'gram sngon khog gyad che/bu ro ga rtag dpa' snying che/'dan gyi bu phrug mda' kha tsha/rong tsha snang ngu g.yu stag gnyis/dpa 'a rgod stag phrug tshang la nyal/dus ngan blo 'phrul skyid sdug gcigakha zhe med pa'i bsam pa mnyam/stag rong byus la gzan nas byung /jo ru skyes nas da bar du/rngan chen ngan dgu ma btang med/lag ngan phyugs la ma brkus med/81

g.yang gi be'u mgo dgu de/be'u 'dre zer nas brkus nas song /ma zad be'u rtsag mtha' gyong bzos/dgun gyi lhan pa sel bar byas/rgod ma 'phar ba rnga nag la/g.yang rta gcan gzan mgo can 'khrungs/brgyugs na nam mkha'i bya rjes dos/zla gcig zla ngo ma lon dus/rta 'dre red zer bsad nas shor/ma zad rta ko'i lham chung bzos/phugs kyi rta g.yang nyams par byas/mi dmangs nang nas sma 'bebs dang /bya dmangs nang nas spu btogs mang /ngas tsha bo red bsam bzod pa bsgoms/don gal lan mo ma sprad dus/ngan pa rang rgyud je gyong red/mthar thug dbang thang bstan jus dang /skya lo'i mi rgyu 'khor bcas 'phrogaslob dpon pad+ma'i gter g.yang brkus/gling dkar yul bcud nyams par byas/na ning gzhes kyi lo dus su/gdan gyi khri 0daphang rtsod pa'i dus/ma babs rgya tsha khri 'don byas/82

ya bdag stag 'phen thang la phab/jo ru mi min 'dre min gyis/brdungs brdungs skungagazhi nad kyi4thebs /da rung ci yong so mtshams red/don de la bsam zhing zhe rtsa bskyed/zhe rtsa bskyed bzhin dmag dpung 'bebs/drag po'i g.yul gcigam 'gyed na/stag rong gson bas shi ngadaga'/gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la/lto pho ba'i yi gar ma chun na/sbrang bu ram yin yang zhim rgyu med/lus dro ba'i nyam sa la ma phan na/dar gos chen red kyang bzang rgyu med/chus bstan pa'i byus la ma phan na/bu tsha bo red kyang yag rgyu med/de tsho gtam gyi gsang cha yin/da rung gtam gyi rdo kha yod/rta la mgyogs zhan zer rgyu de/skya mkhas pas lam gzhung drang zhan yin/ mtshon la rno chod zer rgyu de/dpa' bo'i g.yugs tshod dam slod yin/mda' la skyen zhan zer rgyu de/dmigs pa'i 'ben la gtad lugs red/83

mi pho'i dpa' rtsal zer rgyu de/bsam pa blo thag gcod zhan yin/do gal snying chu dkrug zhan yin/yang snying a khu khro rgyal ngas/drag sngags nus pa zor 'dren gyis/ri rab rtse nas bshig kyang nus/ stobs chen drag sngags rdzas sbyor gyis/nyi zla thang la 'beb kyang nus/ srog 'dren 'gugs pa'i phyag rgya yis/chu bo gyen la ldog kyang nus/ mig 'phrul ya ma bzung dgu yis/snang srid bran du bkol kyang chogapha bu sde 'bangs 'dzoms pas na/chus srid rang dbang bdag pas chog glu 'di a khus bka' bcad yin/ bka' bcad gser gyi thigs pa yin/gser thigs bdag med byed lam med/'dir 'khod thugs la de ltar zhogaces glu 'dir blangs par stag 'phen nya tsha stag tsha sogs ge sar 4ra/ dad pa thob pa'i stabs kyis blo la shin tu ma bab/ gser mtsho yang khro rgya'— la 'in tu zhe khrel yang de ma thag ci ma zer/gzig 'irben ni yid the ma tshom du gnas/ gdong btsan a dpal ni glu de blo thog tu bab cing a khu 'a phyogs / a thod thar pa'i zor sna ༄84

sogs shes med blon po dang bran g.yog 'ga' ni gtam de phyogs la snang ba spro ba zhig byang / ka bzhi dang / khang le/ bya chen sogs ru 'dren rnazlos ni sku rje seng chen rgyal po la dad pa dang dam tshig nyams pa las shi ba dga' bsams kyang lam seng ci ma zer/de nas g.yas gral gyi 'go nas stag rong a nu stag 'phen des 'dir bzhugs pha khudaponaslon tshogs/ shes rig khog la mi bkra ste/ bu rang gi bsam tshul e 'dra yod zer nas glu 'di ltar blangs so/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ glu a la tha la tha la red/tha la gling gi glu gsham red/ la la ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang nas/gu ru pad+ma 'byungaganas la/ rtsa gsum raba'abyams rgya mtshos bskor/gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes gzigs/byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs par shogagling gi yul lha zo dor mkhyen/ bsam pa'i don chen 'grub par shogs 'di rma khams glingakhri'i yul/dag pa lha yi zhing khams zer/sgos su chos ldan sacha red/g.yas lung stag la 'dzom rgyas 'dra/85

'dzom drug steng la stag rong chags/stag rong zer ba de don red/g.yon lung gzig la khra rgyas 'dra/gzig thig le'i dkyil la gzig rong chags/che btsan gzhi kha bsdoms pa'i dus/bu la stag 'phen gzig 'a phen thogs/rdzong la pho rog snying rdzong zer/yang dag rta mgrin sgrub gnas red/rta mgrin skye ba khro rgyal dpon/snyan lhang nger stag 'phen nga la gson/da res a khu'i gsung tshig la/slar ldog zhu ba ma yin te/do gal mi zhu ka med red/ dper na 'dra ma e 'dra gda'/dbyar zla gsum 'khrungs pa'i lo tog de/dgun la 'khrungs na lha zhing red/'pho 'gyur dbyar dgun rnam zlas bskos/de la rtsi bcud 'gyod rgyu med /'dzam gling bskor ba'i pho chen rta/dal brel med na rta mchog red/chad lus 'byang khams las kyis bskos/de la lhu bzhi rāgyod rgyu med/dbyar gsum bzhos pa'i mdzo mo de/86

skam rgyu med na 'dod 'jo'i ba/'bab dang skam pa dus tshod bskos/de la lho phrug 'gyod rgyu med/gling tsho drug ya bdag stag rong dpon/'gyur ldog med na lha bskos red/'pho 'gyur srid pa'i bskos thang la/de la stag rong 'gyod rgyu med/spyi dpon khro rgyal seng blon gsum/a pha gcig gi bu rgyud red/ pha dang khu bo khyad par med/bu dang tsha bo dbye ba med/pho su tshar rgyal sa sus bdag red/hab thob rtsod gzhi byed don med/gtamangan rgyal khams sgrogadon med/ ma sang 'phrul gyi rgyal po de/o rgyan pad+ma'i rnam sprul red/dus gsum sangs rgyas sprul pa red/dkar phyogs lha yi rgyab rten red/nag phyogs bdud kyi gshed ma red/sa rma smad 'dre yi lung pa na/sha mong spang las rdol ba bzhin/'gran gyi do med sras gcig 'khrungs/skyes nas rdzu 'phrul mthu dang ldan/87

bdud mo'i bu chung stobs ldan 'di/'dzam gling srog bdag yin rabs yod/de zhag gcig gong nas brtul rabs yod/spyang nag mi bzan spun gsum de/ gling yar mar 'gro ba'i rgya lam bkagami phyags gnyis de gson za byed/zla rgecig zla ngo ma lon dus/'ur khra ring brgyab nas bsad rabs yod/ma zad pho 'dre mo 'dre brtul/ sa rma smad 'dre yul4lha lung bsgyur/mdzad mdzad gleng gzhi rdzogs mtha' med/gling gi phu mda' bar gsum na/btsan po'i rdzong mkhar sum cu bzhengs/ma zad seng 'brug ja mkhar bzhengs/rma smad yul khams rgya zhing bzos/'dan ma rgyal po 'i nas g.yang phab/gling yul 'dug skyid che bar mdzod/mdzad mdzad a khus dgongs tshod red/rma shel ri'i brag nas gter rdzong phab/nga 'byang gzhi lci bas ma slebs kyang /gtarmo thos pa tsam gyis yid spro skyes/khong chos rgyal lhas bskos nges thag chod/gdan khri ra'i rtsod gleng byas nyin mo/88

do bsdo ba'i spobs pa ma shar byung /sngar rkang 'bam nad gzhi rtsa nas sangs/mi dge'i rtogs tshogs yid la med/zi ma yul gyi rta g.yang phab/phu nu yongs la rta 'gyod mdzod/stobs shugs a khus mthong tshod red/da rung de bas mi tshad pa /gling gzu pas gzu brgyab bcad don bzhin/klu btsan dpon la thod mda' dang / gur dkar rgyal la gnya' sga dang /sa tham shing khri gtsor gyur pa'i/nag po'i bdud rnams 'dul ba dang /g.yang rdzong bco brgyad 'beb rgyu sogs/btsan po'i bka' yis bcad ngon bzhin/khong ge sar min na su yis thul/stobs de 'dra med na byed blo med/don med zag pa 'khon gyi gzhi /sdug bsngal rin gyis nyo don med/'di phyi gnyis sdug byed don med /khong ge sar gser gyi khri kha gnon/khyod pha khu tsan dan khri steng bzhugs /thugs blo gcig sems gcig la gtod/bsam pa dar dkar yug lam sbrel 8 9

mthu rdzu 'phrul yod na bdud la ngoms/dpung kha tshan yod na dgra steng chos/ de 'jig rten las mtha' ya rabs red/nga kha sngon lo yi mjug ma nas/lus la nad gzhi grib kyis thebs/skabs re sangs te skabs re thu/la rgya nad kyis gtong bsam med/ btang yang ge sar 'gras rgyu med/'di phyi gtan brlag byen don med/pha khu bo'i thugs la de ltar zhogaces glu de ltar blangs pas a khu'i yid la ma bab ste ngo dmar 'phyur 'phyur mig dmar sgor sgor du song rung stag 'phen la zhed pa'i stabs kyis ci yang smra ma nus/ de ma thag gdong btsan bu yi a dpal de yis glu 'di ltar blangs par gda'o/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu a la tha la tha la red/tha la la mo la la red/la la ngag4gi 'gugs lugs red/lha mkhyen no dkon mchog rnam gsum mkhyen/bu bdag la gdong grogs ma g.yel ci ges 'di tsho khra mo gling gi yul/ra chab chu yi 'dus mdo na/rdza brag su rnang ma 'og na/90
