btsan po mkhar gcig chags le 'di/mkhar btsan pho rog snying rdzong la/mi btsan po stag rong bzhugs mkhar red/nga 'dra gdong btsan a dpal zer/pho rgod po'i ming g.yer mi che ste/pho rang mgo thon pa'i bu zhig yin/de nas pha khu yab sras tsho/rong mi tsho dmar mo'i rje dpon gson/gson zer na gtam gyi rdo kha la/don snga phyi blo la gzhigs shing gson/rma khams gling gi yul srol la/khrel gzhung nas bsrungs mkhan gcig kyang med/a khu spyi dpon snyan grags can/gtam chags bzhag 'pher nges yin mdog ba/gsung de la chags bzhag 'pher nges na/gces pa'i bu de dgra la shor/bu gcig bas mi tshad gnyis tsam shor/de dus blo dpyad dpa' rtsal sogs/gal gnad dus gling dkar gda' le min/kho spyi dpon 'u la thug pa'i dus/mthe bong stag rong tshang la bslangs/ci drag gang drag phyag rgya bcas/skyabs 'gro smon lam khrug khrug byas/ —91

stag rong sems kyis ma bzod nas/ra mda' sha lan rjes gcod la/drag po dmag si g.yul gcig 'gyed/'gog rong gnyis ka yu med bzos/bu 'dod bu mo mnangs su blangs/las dbang seng blon dpon dang 'brel/gzhan gyis mi thub bu zhig skyes/mtha' ma stag rong bstan la gzan/'gog rong yu med bzos pa yi/las kyi rgyu 'bras bslu med na/phung rgan se lu 'gram sngog de/ phan btags rgyu 'bras los yod red/kho spyi dpon gyod kyi rgya mtsho red/mtsho dkyil nas dkrug mi spyi dpon red/gdong ngos su lang mi ge sar red/ thad der byang ba'i dgra bo la/pha khu bo yirdo ya nga che rgyu med/'jig rten gna' mi'i gtam dpe la/rma nye bas phab na dga' rgyu med/mgo gser skus gcag na byin rlabs med/zas dug tu 'gyur na phan rgyu med/ zer yang zer 'a bden yang bden/da rung dper na 'dra ma yod/92

kha skom pa'i nyams la ma phan na/mtsho ma pham 'gram na dga' rgyu med/lus grang ba'i nyams la ma phan na/shar khri gdugs shar kyang phan rgyu med/nad tsha gzer 'joms la ma phan na/sman bzang drug zos kyang zhim rgyu med/bstan pa'i byus la ma phan na/pha khu bo red kyang 'jigs rgyu med/de dang 'dra ma khrig khrig red/da rung dpe bzhan 'dra ma yod/kha lo bslab rgyu'i rta gsaṃr de/yod na mi dga' med na dga'/med na sems bde blo thag chod/yod na 'dzing rtsod b.re smid bral/ g.yo ngan gshe ba'i gnyerjo 'bre' de/yod na mi dga' med na dga'/med na nye ba'i phugs thag chod yod na sems rtsub sdug 'a/ gcad/dpe zlo srol bden srol sanyis ka reng /gnyen nye bas mi phan sem sa tha4/ chod/ zhing dang so nam nye ba sogs/phar la yod na tshur yod dpe/ khu bo nye ba'i bya ngan de/93

blo la bskor na snying khams 'khrugaspyi dpon khu bor bsam gyi med/yu med gtan bral byed snying 'dod/ge sar rgyal por bsam gyi med/drag po'i g.yul chen 'gyed bsam yod/rkyang bu kha dkar bya ma rta/g.yu bya'i bang kha 'gran bsam yod/pha lu khro mchog rgyal po de/rong 'bum tsho bdun gyi dpon po red/rta mgrin dmar po'i skye ba red/sngags dang 'phrul la rang dbang thob/nang mis bka' la ma brtsis na/ gzhan mas bka' nyan khag po red/bka' dang 'gal na 'di phyi phung /de phyir bka' nyan gsung bstod gyis/dmag dang bu rta'i gra sgrig dang /dpa' bo'i g.yul chen 'gyed lugs sogs/che drag kun gyis gros kha gyis/'dir bzhugs phu nu'i thugs la zhogaces glu de ltar blangs pas/ a khu khro thung ni rma byas dbyar rnga'i sgra thos pa bzhin 'jigs pa'i chas dang dga' ba'i nyams 'gyur bstan te gong gsal don de rang gzhan kun gyis nges par sgrub dgos zer/ ya thod thar pa'i zor sna dang / rgu ru bu yi 94

kher rgod/ smug btsan rnyob pa lag ring / nyi khri bu yi lhun glub/spyang mo bu yi rjes med sogs kyis dgra 'thab kyi khas len stag mo ngar ngar byas/ de yi dus gzig 'phen gyis thugs bsam mang du bskor bas dpa' rtsal rdzu 'phrul gang gi cha nas ge sar la lan ya mi zin/ yon tan ldan pa'i bla ma la rung yang mi rung bdag cag blo gdon gyis bslu ba nges par yin 'dug dgongs nas skabs thig ci ma gsungs de yi dus su sru kha ra bza' yi gser mtsho des a khu sngag rong rgyal po'i bka' dang gdong btsan bu yi glu de thos pas log par shes shing / ge sar la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob pa'i dbang— gis a khu shin tu snying gzer te tshe 'dir bral thub na ci ma rung stam pa'i gdeng dang bcas te kun gyis mthong sar gus guru/ zhum sum̐m/ gyis chang zhig drangs nas gsham gyi lcog sner gtad de glu 'di lta— blangs par gda'o/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu a la tha la tha la red/tha la la mo la la red/sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na/rang snang lha yi zhing khams nas/rgyal yum rdo rje phag mo la/ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor/skyo lhang nge'i ngang nas gsol ba 'debs/skye tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med shogs 'di srib pa khol mo rdzong /95

stag rong chags pa'i rdzong mkhar red/phu nu pha lu 'dzom sa red/'dzoms nas gros ra tshogs sa red/blo yag nyes gnyis kyi so mtshams red/nga 'dra 'dri bshad ma dgos pa'i/'dan kha ra bza' yi gser mtsho ma/kha ra rgyal po'i sras mo yin/stong sde bco brgyad dpon cho/ yin/gser rna dngul rnas brgyan mi yin/sde dpon tshang ma'i gces phrag yin/saces phrag snying gi thig le rmin/stag rorngo tsharngo gi khyim gzhi la/ thod pas sgo rdung byas le min/nya yus khyi bkag 'ong le min/ a skyid nam mkha'i seng zhal dang /sger blon shes mchog rab gsal gnyis/dpon g.yog so bdun sgo la bab/mdzo khyung dkar brgya la ja rgyab brgya/ja 'thu lung ma nyams khrug se gda'/g.yag ru rgyas brgya la mar rgyab brgya/mar ko kha ma nyams khrig se gda'/kha ra rgyal po'i sgo la btang /bu mo slong ba'i slong rten zer/96

da rung de bas mi tshad pa'i/gra yag stag lpags dgu tshan dang /gser dngul gnyis la bre 'jal byas/'jam pa gtam gyi mgo skor dang /rtsub po dmag gis sdig mo gnyis/bshad bshad mgo bskor bu mo bslus/sna sa stag rong bsus le red/rgyab rtsa pha mas bskyal le red/nga 'gro'i gdam ga byas le min/nang gling nas ma sru ma rnyed zigaphyi rgya nas rgya bza' ma rag zigastag rong rgyu med ma red de/dpon khro lu'i rgyus rgya lon le red/gzig rong a zhe 'bum mtsho la/gzig 'phen dar gyi thig le 'khrungs/stag gzig gzhis kha bsdoms pa'i rjes/'bum mtsho ma dbang rkyen dbang shor/khro lu'i kha rjes ci la dbang /ma lu'i sras mo lha sgron mar/'gran med dpa' bo stag 'phen 'khrungs/stag rong gzhis la bsu rtsis dus/rta pha'i mi tsho dpon la shor/gyod dmar nag 'khrug chen 'byung grabs dus/97

a khu spyi dpon rgyal po des/gleng gleng gtam gyis bzhag don la/bu stag 'phen snyag rong dbang rgyu byas/ma lus khro lu ma 'dod dus/mi tsho dpon la 'jog rgyu byas/mo rin bdams dus nyer lnga thob/de yang spyi dpon bka' drin red/'gro 'dug spyod lam bya ba de/bgrangs na nyin grangs 'dzad sa med/de nas a khu stag rong dpon/bu rgyud stag mo gzig mo 'di/dgra lag ma bzhag bzhugs rogs gyis/ge sar lha yi rgyal po la/do bsdo ma byed 'dug rogs gyis/spyi dpon ri rgyal lhun po la/g.yo 'gul ma byed bsdad na dga'/de snga nyi ma yan chod la/ lan na a khu khyod rang lan/ma yum 'gog bza' lha mo la/lha sras sku la mnga' ba'i dus/rgya bza'i rgyab gnyer a khus 'tshos/bshas na sha med khal rgan gcigabazhos na 'o med 'bri rgan gcig98

skya na 'gro med rta rgan gcigabreg na bal med lug rgan gcigaphub na khog med sbra rul gcigagayog a sdug yang mtha'i skal ba ltar/bka' gzu gcod byed mi khro lu red/da rung de bas mi tshad pa'i/sa rma smad mi med yul la bzhud/mi med yul la lha sras 'khrungs/'ja' dang me tog char pa bab/ltas bzang po mig gis mthong ba'i dus/stag rong sdod du ma tshugs nas/rma smad yul la lta ru phyin/ bu lte dmar gsod du ma thub nas/mgo zangs skyogs 'dra zhig byang nyin mo/'jam shur re pho brang mkhar r+ghaṃng bzung /dma' zhum se gtam gyi rdo ga bshad/byas byas khro lus mi dran nam/stobs rdzu 'khrul yod na mi ngoms na/pham kha khur don ci la red/da rung byas byas gleng tshod med/de rjes bar gyi bzhag so la/lha yis lung bstan byung yin zer/ 'brug mo'i skra bdag byed kyin zer/99

skya lo'i rgyu bdag yong gi zer/ston chen bco brgyad bzhag dgos zer/de mi yong bu mos kha da byas/bshad bshad gtam la ma nyan nas/khro lus ston chen bco brgyad bzhagar tha' ma pham kha bco brgyad khur/yang yang mtha' shi bco brgyad myang /ngo tsha med pa sprel rgan ngo /dpa' snying med pa wa mo'i bu/phyi nang rme ngas dkrug ḍa ru mgo/mi khyod la yon tan spu tsam med/sku rje seng chen rgyal po la/ do bsdo phod btsugs du ma de/byas byas blo yis skor rdzogs gyis/rma she la brag gter sgo phyes nyin mo/bu su red dbye ba de nas gsal/'u/sa rdzu 'khrul rtsal kha 'byed nyin mo /song ma lha dang bar ma gnyan/ 'og ma klu dang dgra lha'i tshogs/dkar phyogs lha dang lha mo yis/phyag dang bskor ba mchod pa'i tshogs/ro' mo'i sgra yi bye brag rnams/sanam sa/ bar snang 'ur gyis gang / 100

bdud dam sri yin kyang dad pa 'tshor/'dre shi bdag yin kyang dbang med 'du/khyod phung rgan dad pa ma g.yos na/bdud dam sri nang gi yang sri red/khong 'dzam gling bod kyi lha skal red/nag po bdud kyi kha gnon red/dkar phyogs bstan pa 'dzugs mi red/tsho drug gling gi rgyal po red/'dzam gling rub kyang thub le min/ stag rong dpon po yug po mchu/sdod rgyu yod tshe ma bsdad na/mtha' ma rten dang bral nges red/'gran bral ge sar rgyal po des/tsan dan khri la stag lpags btings/khu bo gnyis po 'dra mnyam bzhagagling gi stod smad dpon gsum dang /stag rong bu gsum 'dra mnyam mdzad/a tsi bka' drin che lugs la/khyod 'dra ba'i sku rgyud ma rtsub gda'/khong bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems red skyabs snying nas mchi'o thugs rjes zung /skye tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med thos a khu spyi dpon rgyal po de/101

shes dang dgongs dpyad nyi ma shar/dpa' dang rtsal drug phun sum tshogs/kun gzhi brling ba ri rgyal 'dra/bu gsum sku na phra ba'i dus/stag rong byas la ma phan med/lo dgu lta rmig byed don med/byas na thub pa'i re ba med/gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la/ dgon pa shor kha'i gra chung de/rtsa ba'i bla mar dam tshig nyams/nag po'i dkor la grong yul nyul/de 'khor ba mtha' med lhung rtags red/pha khyim shor kha'i bu phrug des/drin chen pha mar sdang lta byed/rang 'dod che bas rgya grong nyul/de mtha' gzhug sprang 'khyam snga ltas red/yu/la sde shor kha'i dpon chung des/rgyal sa che la 'gras ya 'tshol/rkun jag gnyis kyi gtso bo byed/yul dang srog shor snga ltas red/dpe dang don gnyis khrig khrig red/tshig nyan long med pa'i khol ril mgo/mig gor log sdang lta ra pho mig102

mgo 'gag rkang 'phul tho zhan 'dra/mchil zhag gdong la btab zhan 'dra/rus 'drud rang chus tshong mi khyod/sha lder nga la brgyab zhan 'dra/khyod stag rong zas skal chad rtags red/tsho chen stag rong sras blon tsho/pha khro lu'i bya spyod 'di la ltos/nga gser mtsho bsad kyang 'gyod pa med/kho bla tshong bsam blo bskor dang dga'/gdong btsan a pho dpal 'byor lags/pha khu bo smyo bar kha da gyis/smyo gcer rgyug byang nyin byed blo med/ces glu mjug ma rdzogarā gong nas a khu stag rong gi yid la ma 'thad cing gnong skyon gyis gzer thog gri mdung brtsegs pa lta ra bzod bsran ma thub nas mig log sdang ltas go 'grig da lta ci dgos/ ber ser po phyi ldab brgyab/ dngul gyi sder mo sbrags ma gser mtsho'i brang dkyil du brgyab nas har gyis langs shing /tshoms chen ka ba'i logs na ral gri zhig yod pa shubs sbrags khyer te gser mtsho'i thog tu mchongs byang ba dang / gzig 'phen gyis de ma thag a khu'i lag pa nas darmi du bzung ba dang lhan/ nya tsha shin tu thugs rgyal bzhengs te yab stag rong gi lag nas gri tshur 'phrog ste gri'i shubs kha spar nas glu thung 'di blangs so/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/103

a la tha la tha la red/tha la la mo la la red/la la ngag gi 'gusas lugs red/dgra bla wer ma'i lha tshogs rnams/gsol ba 'debs so sdongs grogs mdzod/pha dang yu/la dang nga rang gsum/'dri bshad mi dgos kun gsal red/de nas tshur nyon stag rong dpon/drin chen ma lu'i bshad tshig de/'khrul med gser gyi thigs pa red/gling rje ge sar lha sras de/dalar phyogs lha yi srog shing red/sangs rgyas stong gi thugs sras red/bdud dang ru tra'i kha gnon red/sku la rdzu 'phral yod mi red/e yod khro rgyo dpon gyis shes/sku la bsdo bsdo 'gras 'gras de/khyod mi dgos nga yi blo la gsal/gsung la skur ba btab btab de/brtsis na grangs kyis long sa med/brtsigs na a sngon dgung dang mnyam/sems kyi log lta dran 'khrul de/bar snang thal rlung bzhin du 'tshub/104

mi khyed la yon tan til tsam med/de e yod gling dkar khra mos gsal/a khu spyi dpon rgyal po de/be+e ro tsa na'i rnam 'phral red/gling dkar thog ma'i༄ gzhi ma red/phu nu kun gyi rten phur red/yod na de yod spyi dpon red/med na de med spyi dpon red/do bsdo snang ba 'khrul lugs la/yang bsdo chag sgos ded lugs la/khrel med gzhung med sprel rgan ngo /chos la rgyab 'gal ru tra dngos/kha sang seng 'brug stag rdzong du/rten bdun mchod thebs dge rtsa bsngos/pha khro lus 'bri bcu ra lug bcu/gtam de byas phu nus ha bgad ldir/ngo tsha med pa'i khyi rgan maso// nga ser sna'i mdud pas ma bcings te/pha bu 'dzing rtsod 'byang gis dogs/ phyi dgra bo'i rtsa nas rūg rgya bcas/zi ma'i blon la phyi nang bsgyur/de dus lo rgyus nga rang gsal/nang bza' tshang steng la dpa' rngam can/105

bzang la phan med stag rong dpon/ngan la lan med bud med ngo /mi khyod kyi lo rgyus gleng nyan med/pho bla tshong mkhan de med na spro/de ring nya tshas gri ngar drangs/gtam rgyud 'dzam gling khyab le bzo/sang nyin bla ma seng chen gdan/snying nor rgyu yi brgya 'bul byed/stag rong thar pa thob le byed/las de las ma gtogs byed rgyu med/tshig kha tsam ma yin mig gis ltos/ces glu de mjug ma rdzogs gong nas a khu shin tu skrag yod pas glu mjug rdzogs ma thag nya tshas gri shubs nas phyang ste nam mkhar 'phyar ba dang lhan du khro thung gzig 'phen gyis thor phyes nas 'jus yod pa phyir 'then byas te gzim phug g.yung drung dga' 'khyil nang du phyir ltas med par 'dzul nas mtshal sgo dmar po phyi nang gnyis kyis sgo bcad/ a khu'i rgyab rtsa gdong btsan gyis byas nas nya tsha dang / gdong btsan gnyis glu shag re gnyis tsam yod rung / stag 'phen gzig 'phen gnyis dang che drag ka bzhi dpon dang bya chen khang le sogs kyi bar dbye nas de nyin 'dun gros de tsam la grol/ de yis rkyen byas phyi nang kha ra bza' dang nya tsha gnyis dre'u bco lnga la yo byad dang bza' bca' bkal nas 'khor g.yog bdun dang bcas gzig lung gi dben ri bkra shis rtse lung du 106

phebs/ de nas zhag gsum gyi nyin stag 'phen dang gzig 'phen gnyis kyi thugs rgyud dkar phyogs lhas bskul te mi dbang seng chen mjal bar 'gro 'dod pa zhig byang nas thugs gros 'grig ste dre'u dgu la yo byad bkal te dpon༄ blon lnga byas te phebs nas seng 'brug stag rdzong du sku mched brtse zhing mthun par bzhugs kyang pha stag rong gis 'dun gros zer ba rgyal mchog ge sar mdun zhu ma spobs/ rgyal mchog gis zag med mngon mkhyen gyis gzigs kyang shar bdud gdug pa spun bdun 'dul ba'i dus la bab pa mkhyen nas ci ma gsung / de yi dus su a khu stag rong rgyal po de nyin gsum la rig pa gtan la ma phab mtshan gsum rmi lam ma zin/dkar phyogs lha yis blo kha bsgyur nas sems rgyud kyi zhe sdang ma zhi bar ci drag bsam blo bzhi gsum bcu gnyis/ blo rtse nyi shu rtsa lnga bkod pa'i mthar/ ser po hor la bcar na bshan pa rgyal po dang / rgya tsha/ sras lha'u soḍa gnyen nye yin pas mtha' mjug mi leḍa/ 'jang ni rgyus rgya ye mi che/ zi ma rong chon gi nang na sa btsan gshin rje'i gre ba 'dra ba'i nang gling mu pa'i dgra ya mthu dang rtsal nus che ba/ dngos yod mi dang dngos med 'dre shar bdud gdug pa spun bdun zer ba dang gtso bo mi nyag g.yu rtse rgyal po jag la chas pa'i lam khar bdud mo dang 'phrad nas rang yul du ma log par/ der sa btsan bzung nas ar jag gi grong tsho du ma chags yod cing / ar jag kha shas kyang ngo shes mthun zab che/ der phyin na phyi nang g.yo bsgyur gyis mu pa dang spyi dpon la dgra thub pa thag chod bsams te gdong btsan dang / ya thod thar pa'i zor sna/107

rgu ru bu yi kher rgod/ rmug btsan snyob pa lag ring / nyi lji bu yi lhun grub/ spyang lo bu yi rjes med/ bya ma bu yi 'ug mig sogs blo mthun pa rnams nang du bos nas de lugs kyis rgyus rgya dang byed spyod la a khu blo lam bstan pas la la bdud kyis bslus/ la la las rlung sngon smon dbang gis blo mthun te 'gro ba'i grabs la brtson te gong rnams khyim du log ste rang rang la mos pa dang / blo 'khel ba rnams dang brtson/ phal che ba la gsang rgya dam po byas/ zhag gsum song ba na stag rong gi che drag rnams dang gzhan g.yog rnams rma lha ri'i mgul lam ring mo nas bsgugs/ de'i nub mo srod 'khor phag gi dus dre'u sum cu la rgyu nor 'in tu rin chen rnams bkal nas a khu dang / gdong btsan gnyis kyis 'khor gsum bskor te g.yog 'khor dang bcas blo the tshom med par chas nas sngon rjes bsdoms pas rta pa bzhi bcu zhe gsum dang dre'u khyon bsdoms bdun cu don gcig la bkal te a khu'i ngag blo bzhin nyin mtshan sgo sbrel song bas nyin zhag lnga'i nang zi ma rong 'gag gi g.yas lung rdza brag dar dmar gyi yol ba 'dra ba brag rtse mda' ltong 'dra ba'i bar na pha wang nag po mi lpags brgyangs 'dra yod pa'i nang na/bdud kyi sgo srung bud med gcer bu gla ba bzhon pa zhig dang /yang bud med dmar mo bya glag nag po bzhon pa gnyis yod pa gnyis gas skad sgra chen pos bod kyi sa 'bu mgo nag byang / a kho tsā ging gnyis mgyogs par shog zer ba lan gsum borlo pa dang lhan/a khu dpon blon rnams rta las bab/ snying 'dar sil sil gyi ngang a khu na re/ tshe ring bud med lo brgya ma/ dgra gnyen gnyis po 108

ma nor dgos/ gnyen zer ba a khu stag rong yin/ khong mi nyag g.yu rtse rgyal po la/ o chung ngu'i dus nas 'dris zab che/ don gal chen mjal du yong ba yin/ rngam 'jig nged la ston dgos med/ la so srung ba'i drin chen mo/ da res sna bo byed rosas gyis/gser dngul gnyis kyis brngan pa byed ces smras pas/ so srung bya ma byi mgo dang / bya glag sder mchu ma gnyis kyi bsam pa la dgra dwogs pa byed pa gling sa 'bu mgo nag red zer a phos zer ba thos/de'i yul nas 'ong ba yinazer bas ma bzang snyam nas bya ma byi mgos so srung rgyu dang byi nag sder mchu mas gzhis su g.yu rtse rgyal la 'phrin skyel rgyur thag bcad de bya nag bzhon nas 'phur thal/ so srung byi mgo mas/ bud med mdzes sdug dang ldan pa zhig la brdzus te/ khyod rnams der cung sdod dang nged kyi mgron slebs yong zer bas/ khro thung dpon blon rnams brag mda' ltong 'dra ba'i tshur nang la rta drel gyi rgyab cha phab ste ja bskol nas bsdad/ khro thung dang / bud med so srung gnyis glu len res 'ga' yod kyang nyob dogs kyis bzhag khro thung nas bud med dbang sdud kyi sngags brgyab pas khro thung la mo khong khro dang dogs pa'i sems med par mgu ba'i sems su gyur/ sa btsan brag dmar lcags ri 'dra ba'i dkyil spang nags 'dres pa'i ri chen bcu gsum dang / ri chung brgya dang rtsa brgyad/ ri chen re la mtsho chen re/ de yi gzhi dkyil na brag da mar lha srin sde brgyad 'du ba'i phug pa yangs shing rgya che ba rdo rje 'khor lo sdom pa'i gnas yin kyang / bar skabs mi min lha 'dres bdag tu bzung / gling chos la 'phen gyi sku dus su srin rme 109

zhig la klu srin khams kyi bya thul nag pos 'khrig pas klu nag phyogs mi dang mthun pa zhig skyes/ ma de dang bsdebs nas bu rgyud bdud rigs mang du 'phel/ klu yis rigs las chad stabs longs spyod nor rdzas du ma 'dzoms/ mi min lha 'dre'i rgyud las chad stabs cho 'phrul yang ldan/de nas pha spyi dpon gyis gling la dbang bsgyur ba'i dus slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas la dpal gyi bsam yas nas lta ba log pa pho gyong gza' 'am dmar rgyan ma de sngon smon log pa'i las 'phros klu srin bdud kyi rigs rgyud la skyes nas lus rtsal stobs dang ldan/ming la yang yid 'phrog dbang byed ma thogs/ khrag la rngub cing /sha la dga' ba thams cad de yi dbang du gyur te smad 'tshong kun tu rgyu la ltar mi dang lha 'dre thams cad 'dus nas sdig mo che de la 'khrig pa na/ smon log dam sri bdun gyi skye ba dus gcig sgo nga nag po bdun bdud kyi nyi ma nag po'i dus sa srod phag gi dus su skyes/ zhag bdun gnyis lon pa'i dus kha bye ba na mi pho sngo nag dmar ljang ser dkar drug dang bud med dmar mo ral dmar can zhig skyes pa na che ba sngon po klu mgon zhes/ klu srin dam nyams bu zhig yin/ nag po stong bdud lan med zer/ dam nyams bdud kyi brdzus bu yin/ dmar po btsan skya 'bum thub zer/nyams pa btsan gyi brdzus bu yin/ ljang gu shed chen ya med zer/nyams pa rmu yi brdzus bu yin/ ser po mi rgod ya med zer/ dam nyams rgyal po'i brdzus bu yin/ dkar po shel gyi lag ring zer/nyams pa the'u rang 'phrul bu yin/ tha chung bu mo khrag ral ma/110

/ pams gsum dbang sdud srog bdag mo/ ci yang brdzu ba'i stobs kyang ldan/ lo rgyus rim pa bzhin du gsal/ zhes dus gcig la shar bdud gdug pa spun bdun skyes nas ring du ma lon par nag phyogs kyi las la thogs med du brtson te/ ri dwags sna tshogs dang chu nang nya sogs bsad de sha la longs spyad/ 'jig rten gyi so nam mi min bdud srin gyis bslabs pa rnams lo re bzhin dar rgyas su song / mi nyag g.yu rtse rgyal po zhes pa shar gyi bdud chen zhig yin pa des mi nyag yul ljongs rgyal sa 'dzin pa'i dus/ spun zla lha'i rnam 'phrul me stag chos kyi dbang phyug dang spyod pa ma mtshungs pas dkar phyogs lhas blo kha bsgyur te hor bdud gur dkar dang /byang bdud klu btsan sogs la bod ljongs dbang du bsgyur thabs bka' gros la brtson bsams nas rang g.yog bcu gsum khrid/gser dngul nor bu'i rigs dang dar zab sogs drel rgyab lnga bcu bkal te zi chim gling nas brgyud de zi rong la slebs skabs tha chung bu mo khrag ral ma dang 'phrad nas rtsal 'gran glu len sogs byas mthar phan tshun gnyis ka mgu ste nyams pa bdud kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol/ khrag ral mas btsun mo byas/ brag dmar lha srin 'dra ba'i phug pa'i nang logs su bdud mkhar 'jigs su rung ba brtsigs nas g.yu rtse'i rgyal sa zhes ming btags pa dang lhan/ pho brang gi phyi rol brag rtsar dug mtsho zhig 'khyil ba de la lhan skyes lha bdud kyi bla gnas chags/ bdud sde stong skor gcig chags/ar jag gi gtso 'dzin byas te dge ba khyad du bsad de khra mo gling du ar jag thengs gsum brgyugs nas yab seng blon la rgya gza' /11

bsus nas lo gsum mtshams dpa' rgya tsha 'khrungs pa'i lor/ mu pa tshang gi lha'u 'od gsal gyis gtsos mi bcu phrag bsgril te rta nor sum brgya ma zin tsam shor/ pha khu spyi dpon dpon blon lnga ra mdar phyin pas/ bdud blon mi rgod ngo dmar gyis gtsos /de drag mi lnga sha lan du log de rjes khro thung tshang la dmar po btsan skya 'bum thub kyis gtsos ar jag bco lnga byung ba khro thung gis phyi nang bsgyur te spyi dpon stod gnas mjal la phebs nas ma bzhugs pa'i shul la jag sna khrid de mdzub mos bstan te spyi dpon tshang gi nor phyugs lnga brgya lhag dang rgyu nor 'phrog bcom shor/ de rjes khro thung dang me stag g.yu rtse gnyis rma a gnam bar mar 'phrad skabs stag rong dpon gyis dgra la ngo bstod kyis sku rje 'khrungs pa'i lor gling stod smad bar gsum gyi nor phyugs sum brgya lhag tsam 'ded du bcug pa sogs byas so/ de nas bya nag sder mchu ma de chu tshod gcig nas g.yu rtse rgyal po'i mdun du slebs te bod kyi sa 'bu mgo nag gi nang tshan gnyen a khu stag rong yin zer ba'i mi zhig gis khong me nyag g.yu rtse rgyal po dang lo chung ngu'i dus nas 'dris zab che/don gal ches mjal du 'ong ba yin pas/ da res sna bo byed rogs gyis zer ba la/ nged gnyis gros byas nas nga cha 'phrin 'bul du 'ong ba yin/ mos 'phrang srung nas bsdad yod zer bas mi nyag g.yu rtse'i bsam pa la/ a khu stag rong zer ba gling gi dpon po yin skad/ de rjes ma ngan 'gog tshas na ning stag rong khri las phab zer nyul ma tshos bshad srol 'dug pas bden pa 'dra/don gnad can zhig yod par nges bsams nas gtam mi mang nyung 112

tsam zhig dris nas rgyal po kho rang 'gro rgyur thag bcad/ 'khor du dmar po btsan skya 'bum thub de yang sngar 'dris che bas e red lta ru 'gro zer/ mi nyag g.yu rtse rgyal po de/ mi sngon go mtshon sngon po/ g.yu yi ral pa nyi le/ mthing gi sma ra khyugs se/ lus bong che thang shing tsam la/ dug gi rlangs pa 'thul/ rta nag 'brong 'dur rlung gshog la/ srin po pho mo'i thod sga btsugs/ srin lpags gsar rnying gi nang gzar/ gong thag glo nag sbrul sngon la byas pa'i gong du sa gzhi yom yom shig shig byas te bskyod pa dang lhan btsan skya dmar po de mi dmar go mtshon dmar po dmar gtor khrag gis bran 'dra khrag gi kha chu thar re/ shu sgra sil chom di ri/rta dmar rlung gshog can la seng ldeng gi sga/ khra men gyi yob/ saser gyi gong rmed/ g.yu yi mthur/ gser srab sogs mdzes par brgyan pa'i gong du bud/ g.yas stag ral mda' mos bkang g.yon gzig shubs su gzhu mo bcug ral gri sked la bskor/ phrag la mdung mo khyer/ dbugs len gyi rkyal pa sha btags byas /sbrul gyi lcag tshan mkha' la 'phyar nas btsan bdud kyi cho 'phrul chen po'i dug rlangs kyis nyi ma sgrib le byas pa'i mun gseb glog 'od 'khyug pa'i nang skar ma da' chas pa bzhin du chu tshod gsum nang nub kyi 'phrang ma'i la kha bdud kyi so pha'i rtsar dpon blon gnyis slebs pa dang lhan/ khro thung har langs kyis dbugs hal hal ngang ga'u'i nang nas dar zhig len grabs yod pa'i tshe dmar po btsan skya 'bum thub des bdud glu ha ra hur thung la drangs pa'i glu /'ji blangs so/113

glu 'u na a la tha la red/thu lu 'u la la mo red/'jig rten khams la mnga' mdzad pa'i/ gu lang dbang phyag mthu bo che/'bod do kha 'jon sdongs grogs mdzod/nyi ma zla bas mgon skyabs mdzod/sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na/zi rong gnyis kyi so mtshams na/sa btsan po rim pa gsum gyis bskor/ming 'bod na ko ḍa'i yul ljongs zhes/phyi btsan po brag ri chab kyis bskor/nang brag ri lcags ri brdungs pa 'dra/ lus gshog drug med na thar sa med/'di na 'phrang gcig gda' le 'di/nub la mi ro'i 'phrang kha red/shin tu rtsub 'gyur tshal gyi lam/so srung bu mo spun gnyis 'di/ko ḍa yul gyi zo dor red/mthu dang nus pa drag rtsal che/thog dang ser ba nad kyi bdagadangos yod dngos med gnyis ka red/bsten na mgon skyabs byed mi red/nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na/114

sa srin klu bdud bu rgyud la/sgo nga dmar po'i nang nas skyes/dmar po btsan skya 'bum thub zer/btsan rgod dmar po'i brdzus bu yin/sha dmar za zhing khrag dmar 'thung /mgo nag kun gyi dbugs len yin/skya rogs mi sngon rta sngon 'di/a sngon gnam gyi nyi zla red/dog mo sa yi ri rgyal red/rgya mtsho'i nang gi nor bu red/mi nyag g.yu rtse rgyal po zer/stobs klu btsan dpon dang 'dra 'dra yin/'dra 'dra'i nang nas lhag le yin/rtsal sa tham dpon dang 'dra 'dra yin/'dra ba'i nang nas rgyal le yin/khebs pa gur dkar dpon dang 'dra/'dra ba'i nang nas che le yin/mthong tshad 'du la thos tshad zhed/rgyal 'di 'dra'i gong la su yang med/de tsho gtam gyi yin lugs red/da res tshur chas mgron chung khyod/gnyen a khu stag rong yin pas zer/khong mi nyag g.yu rtse rgyal po la/115

chung nas 'dris zab che bas zer/ma zad mjal du yong yin zer/gtam dang 'phrin cha ci 'dra yod/g.yo chen mgo bskor ma yin pa'i/tshig gsum bla bo drang na dga'/drang na dga' bas drang gtam gyis/shar kha yangs na nyi zla 'char/rgya lam yangs na 'gro lam bde/gtarma kha yangs na shod kha bde/zer yang zer la bden yang bden/da rung nyon dang 'dra ma yod/rta gsar mthong rgyu kha sngon de/rgyug kha yangs te dbugs shed med/dgos nges dus la chad lus med/rta gsar mgo bo bskor rogs red/gos phugs med a she dkar po de/'jam sha che ste drod kha med/dgos nges dus na bug ral che/gos ngan mgo bo bskor rogs red/khyi ngan a ma'i o phrug de/bkag kha yangs te ngar kha med/dgos nges dus na rku la 'chor/khyi ngan mgo bo bskor rogs red/116

rgyus rgya med pa'i mi gsar de/gtam kha bde ste mtha' phugs med/dgos nges dus na phyi nang 'gyur/mi ngan mgo bo bskor rogs red/de 'jig rten gtam gyi dpe don red/bya rgyal thang dkar rgod po de/mdog dkar rgyang gshog legs 'dug ste/gshibs na bya 'a gshin dri bro/bya thang dkar rgyus rgya the ma tshom/stag rtsi ha la'i me tog de/mdog sngo dmar bkrag mdangs legs 'dug ste/snom na dug gi dri ma bro/me tog rgyus rgya the ma tshom/chu 'og na ba'i rtsa mngar de/lce la reg na mngar sha chags/yun du brten na pho nad slong /rtsa mngar rgyus rgya the ma tshom/a khu stag rong rgyal po de/ngo shes kha gtam legs po mang /yun du 'grogs na phyi nang 'gyur/a khu'i rgyus rgya the ma tshom/a kyang gtam gyi ku re yin/sa btsan gshin rje'i gre 'gag la/117

'grim dgos nges do gal ci 'dra yod/mi nyag g.yu rtse'i rgyal blon dang /'phrad dgos ngag gtam ci 'dra yod/khra mo gling gi rje dpon khyod/'bangs sde skyong lugs ci 'dra yod/dpa' rtul blo 'khri ci 'dra yod/ma ngan 'gog tsha jo ru de/da lta sprang 'khyams gang na song /sde dang lung pa'i byed spyod sogs/ 'gro 'dug spyod lam ci 'dra yod/glu go na gtam la de lan gyis/ma go glu la 'bras bu med/tshur chas yid la de ltar zhogaces glu de ltar blangs nas gnyis nas a khu khro thung yin pa ngo shes nas rta las babs pa dang / stag rong dpon blon rnams kyis kha gad gad/ sgyid pa gug gug lus gus gus kyis chibs pa bzung ba dang gdan bshams pa sogs byas te gdan la 'khod pa dang lhan stag rong dpon nas khyi bdag po dang 'phrad pa ltar dga' ba'i nyams 'gyur tshad med pa bstan nas/ dar dang gser dngul bre gang / nor bu ke ta ka zer ba gdong ra khri la lha 'dres phul ba'i nor bu za 'og sna lngas dril ba de phul nas na re/ 'dir phebs rgyal blon 'gran bral gnyis/ sa 'dir phebs pa bka' drin che/ don chen po'i zhu ba e 'dra yod zer nas rang gi ngag rta 118

la drangs nas glu 'di blangs so/glu a la tha la tha la red/tha la glu yi len lugs red/ la la ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/lhan skyes lha la gsol ba 'debs/khro rgyal nga la sdongs grogs mdzod/bden pa'i glu sna 'dren rogs gyis/sa 'di tsho'i rgyus rgya nged la med/ring ring rna bas thos kyang myong /a pho bzhugs pa'i yab yul red/nga 'dra nga ngo mkhyen bzhin pa/rma khams tsho drug gling yul nas/sa btsan rdza ma yar 'gag nas/yang btsan pho rog snying rdzong nas/nga a khu stag rong rgyal po zer/'gog tsha jo ru ma tshar gong /rgya tsha gling la ma skyes gong /dpon khro rgyal min pa zer rgyu med/sdang ba dgra yi kha gnon yin/byams pa gnyen gyi skyabs gnas yin/gling dkar chags pa'i gzhi ma yin/phu nu 'khor ba'i rten phur yin/brgya yar mar 'gro ba'i sna gtad yin/119

da dus gleng na zhe re pham/spyi dpon gyod kyi rgya mtsho dang /jo ru mi lpags 'dre gtum gnyis/za 'dod khyi spyang kha sdeb byas/rgyab rtsa rgya tsha 'dan mas 'tshos/bden chen mi de khrims la sbyar/rdzun ma'i bu la ngo so bstod/brgya yar 'gro mar 'gro'i gshar lam gcod/tshong dpon nor bu bzang pos gtsos/tshong dpon kun gyi rgyu nor 'phrogam bsags nor la longs su spyod/'dan za hor rgyal po'i nas mdzod brkus/pho khram yongs la nas 'gyed bkyes/nyam chung a skyid sde pha de/g.yang dkar lug gi mnga' bdag red/khra chung mig gis ma bzod nas/lug g.yang phab zer 'phrog nas thal/pho khram yongs la lug 'gyed byas/da rung de bas mi tshad pa'i/zi ma rgyal po'i rta khyu de/'gog tsha jo rus brkus nas thal/le dang kha yog nga la phogagatam gtam yang mthar a khu dkar/120

zi ma stag zhal rgyal po des/a la ya lan rta jag bcad/mthun mthun pho khram dpung pa gtor/rgya tsha bu ro ga bsdad dang /spyi dpon se lu 'gram sngon dang / jo ru 'dre ngan phung 'gyod gsum/mi gsum pho gsum 'go khrid byas/zi ma rgyal blon sku la bsdos/gling dkar pho khram rta 'gyed byas/stag rong dpon la rta skal bcad/rta skal bcad pas ma phongs te/a khur rtsis med brnyas bzhag byas/bskal pa dus tshod de nas bzung /stag rong tshang la sgos dgra byas/g.yang gi be'u rtags ldan brkus/ming la be rkun nag jo thogs/ rta g.yang 'gran gyi do med bsad/rta lug jo ru'i rkang lham byas/rkang gi rta lngam dmar po thogs/jo rus byerdo byed su yis byed/rim rim ngan shor skag lang gis/rkun ma'i rgyab rtsa khyarmo pas 'tshos/rin chen gser gyi khri kha 'phrog121

skya lo'i rgyu nor ya bdag byas/seng 'brug stagartse'i nang bcud byas/kho gling gi rgyal po yin no zer/phyogs gzhan yongs la dril bsgrags byas/stag rong rdog pa'i 'og tu mnan/bu stag 'phen yod de na tshas mnar/gzig 'phen yod de kun gzhi brling /nya tsha bsam med bong ring de/a pha'i kha la ngag 'khri med/bu yag gdong btsan a dpal 'di/dpa' rtsal stobs shugs 'gran med kyang /mi gcig dpa' bas byed blo med/rta chen g.yu bya rte'u sngon 'di/'dzam bu gling gi rta g.yang red/brgyugs na nam mkha'i bya rjes dos/rgya dbus bskor na mi 'gyod de/rta gcig mgyogs pas byed blo med/rgyab rten khyed la byed bsam gyis/blo mthun gros kha nang nas 'grigamathun mthun yib nas yong le yin/gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la/tshong dang nye ba dga' thang gsum/e yag bsams nas byas le yin/122

mkhar dang sgo mo a shing gsum/e btsan bsams nas bzos le yin/dga' rogs shag rogs jag rogs gsum/e bzang bsams nas bzos le yin/de nas rgyal blon drin chen gnyis/nga rang a khu khro rgyal de/skye sa khra mo gling la red/bsam pa nag po bdud la dga'/bdud kyi bstan pa chus la bsam/bsam bsam don gnyis e 'grub bsam/stag rong dpon po khro rgyal ngar/gling gi rgyal sa ma dbang yang /da rung stag rong pha gzhis la/sde la dug mtsho khol ma zer/brtsis na khri skor bcu gnyis yod/sde yan tsi tsi grangs med yod/phyag la 'gran zla yod le min/drosdad na dar gzab 'bol gdan yin/btung na ja chang 'o ma yin/zos na kha mngar sbrang rtsi yin/bcud che sha thud mar gsum yin/yin yang bsam blo mi dga' 'dugami min 'phrul gyi jo ru de/

btsan 'dod khengs sems je che yis/klu btsan 'gran gyis do med la/nyag phran thod mda' sprod dgos zer/ser po gur dkar rgyal po la/dpa' ba'i gnya' sga sprod kyin zer/'jang sa sa tham rgyal po de/ral gris kham bgos byed kyin zer/lho mon shing khri rgyal po de/'bar ba'i me la sreg kyin zer/nag phyogs kha dag gtong gi zer/da rung bshad bshad gleng tshod med/gleng nas lag len mi shes te/thos pas a khu tshig pa za/ byang khog dar gyi yol gsham na/dran pa rdza ri rang byon la/zhe sdang na bun thu lu lu/ bzod pa bsgoms pas mi non 'duga'athab bzhag na a ya los yong ste/mtha' gzhug rgyal kha mi thob 'dugami thob rtsa ba bu la thug bu rgyud nang gros mi 'grig 'dugade yin yang kho la a'u tsi/khyod mi nyag g.yu rtse rgyal po de/124

zhal ma mjal lo grangs du ma song /sku zhal ras bkrag mdangs je che red/zhal mjal dus snang ba dgung dang mnyam/sku gzi brjid 'ur re mjal lugs la/nga rang bsam pa 'grub lugs la/jag dpon btsan skya 'bum thub khyed/bde mo'i sku khams bzang lugs la/rmi lam min na skyid pa la/skyid skyid nyi ma shar le red/sdug gi mun pa yal le red/bkra shis dar gyis sna drangs pa'i/rin chen nor bu ke ta kha'i/yon tan lo rgyus rim gyis zhu/gling dkar rgyu nor las kyang dga'/gser dngul tram kha bre gang bcas/de ring mjal ba'i mjal rten yin/nga stag rong a khu dpon blon 'di/rgyal po'i rdzong la khrid rogs mdzod/tshe 'dir skyid sdug mnyam skyong zhu/legs nyes zhu ba rim gyis yod/rdzun g.yo gtam ma yin dga' rab dpang /bden can bden mtha' sdem gsal yong /glu 'khrul pa byang na mthol lo bshags/༄ 125

ngag 'khyal ba byung na bzod par gsol/'gran med rnam gnyis thugs la zhogaces glu de ltar blangs pas mi nyag g.yu rtse rgyal po'i bsam pa la/ stag rong dpon gyi tshig bden pa gser gyi thigs pa red/jo ru nag btsog de 'dzam gling phung la 'jug pa'i mi red/ des nged cag bdud kyi rgyal khab yongs la 'tshe ba yong ba thag chod/khro thung 'di phyi nang bsgyur ba'i sna 'dren du 'bod ma dgos grogs su khug pa 'di 'dud lha'i kha 'dzin red bsams te/ kha 'dzum khog 'dzum dang bcas dga' ba'i nyams bstan te na re/ thag ring nas byon pa'i stag rong dpon 'o ma brgyal phebs pa yag nas byung / dga' ya le rgyal po'i rdzong la 'gro/ las skyid sdug bya ba mnyam rgyu byed/ mthun mthun gros kha rim gyis yod zer bas a khu dga' nas blo bag phebs pa byung / 'phrang srung bud med gnyis kyis khrag rkyal pa gang dang / 'brong sha rkang pa gnyis khyer byang ba kho gnyis kyis lhag med bzas pas stag rong dpon blon ha zlos te mi 'di'i stobs la bsams nas yid mgu/ de nas btsan skya dang so srung bya ma gnyis kyis 'phrang gi lam bsal te rdo pha wang rnams g.yas bsgril g.yon bsgril byas te stag rong dpon blon rta drel dang bcas pa bsus rjes g.yu rtse dang bya nag sder mchu ma gnyis kyis sngar bzhin rdo pha wang chen pos lam bsubs nas 'gro lam med par byas nas rting mnan nas yong ba dang gling stag rong shog shin tu zhed dgos pa byang / de nas stag rong dpon blon rnams de nub la mo'id+nghar sgare bab/ g.yu rtse rgyal blon gnyis rdzong du song / so 126

srung gnyis phyir log nas 'phrang la der gnas/ phyi nang stag rong dpon blon la bdud kyi rdzong dpon zhig yod pa des sgar gra bsgrigs te 'tsho zas ci rigs kyi sri zhu byas te mi khyim gcig pa ltar nyams pa bdud dang spyod pa 'dres so/stag rong gi gzhis sdod gnyer 'bum dga' nas khro thung dpon blon bskyod song ba mthong nas blo ma bde kham kum gyis nya tsha dang gser mtsho gnyis la cha byas pas ma tshad skyid lha mkhar du stag 'phen dang gzig 'phen gnyis la bang mi btang bas sras rnams dus gcig tu 'dus te khro thung dpon blon gyi rjes 'ded du gzig 'phen dang nya tsha gnyis kyis skya pa brgya khrid de rjes 'tshol bzhin sha khyis sha ba 'ded pa ltar song bas zi ma gling gi sa mtshams nas byang rlung sbud pa'i rkyen gyis rjes ma mthong nas/ ma gi'i khra bo la dang ma gi'i zi ma gnam la'i sgo la man chad dang / byang zi ma'i mgron lam bar ma'i tshun chad btsal kyang rjes ma rnyed nas khra mo gling du zhag dgu'i nang tshur 'byor nas ci bya med pa'i skabs/ gser mtsho'i ngag bzhin sku rje ge sar rgyal po'i mdun gang ci'i thad ci drag bka' slob zhu bar bu nya tsha a brtan dpon blon lnga phebs/rdzong srung dmag gis chibs kha blangs te mdun bsus te rdzong bzhugs rgyal blon 'tshogs pa'i sar 'byor nas/ yu mar ja yi skyems zhus drangs/ nya tshas dar btang nas 'gran med ge sar rin po che/ don gal chen zhu ba 'di 'dra yod/ thugs dgongs pa g.yo med glu la gson/ zer nas tha la ldem chung la drangs pa'i glu 'di ltar phul lo/ /37

oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ glu a la tha la tha la red/4— tha la glu yi len lugs red/ la la ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/skyabs bslu med dkon mchog rnam gsum mkhyen/chos sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba shogalha klu gnyan gsum dgra lha'i dpung /mthun rkyen wer ma'i tshogs rnams la/gsol ba 'debs so sdongs grogs mdzod/yul khams chos la 'gyur ba shoga.a ni khra mo gling gi yul/rma yul bde mchog nor bu'i yul/rdzong lha mkhar chen mo'i nang shed red/nga 'dra mi mtsho dmar po nas/bu stag rong nya tsha a brtan zer/gling mtho dma' yongs kyi gces phrug yin/zhu mi dgos rgyal mchog thugs kyis mkhyen/gser khri rin chen khri steng nas/zhal mjal na ngan song skye sgo gcod/gsung thos na tshe 'di'i 'gal rkyen sel/ thugs bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che/'di phyi'i skyabs gnas rin po che/thugs 'khrul med dal gcig nga la gson/128

a pha stag rong dpon po de/rgyal po khyed la lta ba logabla ma sangs rgyas mi ru 'dzin/nang phu nu yongs la 'khon 'gras byed/tshe rogs a ma'i steng na rtsub/mi mthun dgra bo nang la bsu/blo dang gros kha phyi la byed/mig log sdang lta nang la byed/dus rgyun blo kha dran 'phrul tsha/khrel dang ngo tsha skyid sdug med/dus nyin dus las kyang da dus rtsub/nyin shas sngon gyi nyin zhig la/stag rong nang gros dgos do zer/nang 'khor gros la tshogs pa'i dus/rje la do bsdo bya dgos zer/pha nu nang me byed dgos zer/dmag dang bu rta bsdu dgos zer/nged spun gsum a ma gser mtsho bzhi/ru 'dren phal cher blo gros gcig zer zer a ya ma nyan dus/pho khro lus lag len ma la 'thab/ma rgyab bu yis 'tsho 'dra'i skabs/lag len gal la thug pa'i dus/129

che 'gos rnams kyis bar mtshams bzung /gdong btsan a pha'i rjes la 'brang /ya thod thar pa'i zor sna sogs/shes med nang g.yog 'ga' re bcas/rgyu zab rgu bkal nas ri byol song /nged a nu gzig rong dben la bsdad/bu mched gnyis rje yi mdun sar gnas/cha bang mi 'byor nas ra mdar song /rjes zhib par btus nas gshar na yang /zi rong gnyis kyi sa mtshams nang /byang rlung kham pa 'ur ba'i shul/yar mar song ba'i rjes ma mngon/ya gi'i zi ma'i gnam la man/ma gi'i rong gi khra la yan/byang zi ma'i mgron lam bar ma tshun/ri klung kun la zhib par nyul/pha khu song shul ma mthong lags/gzig 'phen nya tsha rta pa brgya/zhag dgu'i dus mtshams tshur la 'byor/ci bya med pa'i dus gcig shar/de nas ge sar rin po che/a kha ma bzhi dpon po der/dam sri gdug 'dre snying la zhugs/130

mngon sum gson 'drer gyur na4thal/las ci byed chags bzhag 'pher le min/las yag nyes gnyis kyi so mtshams 'dir/thugs mkhye na pa'i bka' slob gnang du gsol /zhu phod lar nas ma yin te/rgyal ge sar yin yang brtsi rgyu dang /nga nya tsha yin yang brtse ba sogs/a pha dpon la med nges red/sdang ba dgra la blo snying gtad/sgos dgra spyi bo'i gtsug la khur/byus phyi nang gong ba brje nges red/gser phye chu la 'pho nges red/da res 'di 'dra ma byung dgos/rab na a pha mkhar la gdan/'gro dbang med pa'i mtshams sbyar byed/'bring na pha bu gson bral byed/rgyu nor skal ba gang drag sprod/tha na pha bu nang me byed/gtam ngan phyogs kun grags le byed/kha tsam min pa'i zhu ba la/gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la/zas ma la bskungs nas su la sbyin/gtam pha la gsang nas su la shod/131

ska bas bla ma mi bsten su zhig bsten/rdope zer yang zer la bden yang bden/da res 'gro spyod 'di byed sogs/bka' slob bdud rtsi'i char zim gyis/ bdag cag skom pa'i gdung bsal zhing /tshim pa'i bka' khyab gnang du gsol/glu 'khrul ba song na mthol lo bshags/ngag 'khyal ba song na bzod par gsol/'gran bral rgyal po'i thugs la zhog ces glu 'di ltar phul bas rgyal mchog ge sar rin po ches thugs brtse ba dang bcas bu nya tsha la byug byug mdzad nas ting nge 'dzin gyi dgongs pa la mnyam par bzhag pa'i mthar bka' mngag gi mgur glu 'di khrom chen zil gnon gyi ngag rta la drangs nas gsungs so/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu a la tha la tha la red/tha la la mo la la red/la la ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang nas/gu ru pad+ma 'byang gnas la/rig 'dzin rgyobe thob rgya mtshos bskor/yengs med ngang nas gsol ba 'debs/bde chen thug sa kyi dgongs yangs nas/132

byin rlabs dngos grub char ltar phobs/rang rgyud zhing sa brlan par shogabyang sems myu gu 'khrungs par shogagazhan phan lo 'dabs rgyas par shogasku gsum 'bras bu 'khrungs par shogs 'di rma yul gling dkar stod/rdzong 'dir seng 'brug stag rtse zer/nga 'dra gling rje ge sar zer/rgyal ming thogs pa da zhag red/tsho drug gling gi rje dpon la/las bskos gong ma lha nas bskos/nag phyogs bdud kyi kha gnon la/bskos pa smon lam yod pas zer/las ka bya ba rjes la red/de nas lha phrug dpa' rtsal can/khyung sgo nga'i nang nas gshog drug rgyas/stag ma lu'i khog nas 'dzoms drug rgyas/bu na tshod chung ste shes rtsal ldan/bu khyod yon tan ldan pa'i mi/ge sar la dad pa ma 'chug gda'/sku la bar chad ma byung na/gling dkar chags rten yong nges red/thugs sems skyo ba ma gnang dang /133

mdang gsum nyal ba'i rmi lam na/rgya stag khra bo me ri can/de 'khor dbyi gzig gcan gzan 'ga'/nags ri phyug mo'i rtse mo nas/seng ges g.yu ral bsig pa'i dus/rgya stag shar la mchongs pa rmis/shar dug ri'i gseb la 'dzul ba rmis/ri de nas na bun 'thul ba yis/gling lha khang mun pas sgrib pa rmis/de rjes lha klu gnyan gsum dang /gling lha mis me chen spar ba yis/shar dug ri lhag med bsregs pa rmis/stag gzig 'dzoms drug ma nyams pa/seng dkar mo'i 'khor la 'khri ba rmis/shar nags ri bsregs pa'i shul mal na/gser dngul g.yu byur mar gad sogs/nor sna zad med rdol ba rmis/da rung nyams snang grangs las 'das/dpyad na rmi lam ma zhan gda'/rgya stag stag rong dpon la lta/gzig thig le gdong btsan dpon la lta/dbyi gcan gzan so so'i 'khor la lta/nags ri ri rgyal phyug mo de/134

gling dkar ma sra'i bla ri red/skya lo tshang gi sgerdo ri red/seng ge seng chen nga la bla/g.yu ral sngon po bsigs pa de/dpa' kha rgyal sa bdag pa'i rtags/rgya stag shar la mchongs pa de/stag rong shar la bskyod pa'i brda/shar la dug ri yod rgyu de/shar bdud gdug pa zhig la lta/stag dug ri'i gseb tu 'dzul ba de/shar bdud khrod du 'gro ba'i brda/ri de nas na bun 'thul ba de/bdud nag phyogs dgra zhig lang ba'i rtags/gling dkar lha khang sgrib rgyu de/gling gi chus la gzan pa'i rtags/gling lha mis me chen spar ba de/lha mi'i dpung bsgrigs dpa' kha mes/gdug pa nag phyogs bsregs pa'i rtags/stag gzig seng la 'khri rgyu de/pha khu stag rong yab sras de/ge sar nga la tshur 'khor rtags/nags bsregs mal nor mdzod rdol ba de/rin chen gter rdzong lon pa'i rtags/135

rmi lam dpyad gzhi legs nas byang /a khu stag rong rgyal po de/ ༄lha rta mgrin dmar po'i sprul pa red/srid gsum dgra la langs kyang rung /lus srog la dgra yis tshugs le min/ge sar nga la sdang rgyu de/gong ma lha nas smon lam khyad/dgra sna zan khrid byed mi red/nga yang dam tshig nyams don med/bu yang pha la sdang don med/sde 'bangs khra mos khrel don med/dpa' rtul thugs la 'gal don med/gser mtshos sri zhu ma 'chug dgos/gegs med dbu thon nges thag chod/lha khang g.yung drung 'khyil pa la/tshogs dang mar me gsar 'bul gyis/dam can chos skyong mchod bstod mdzod/'di dang 'di byed 'dun gros de/gong ma lha yi lung dang bstun/ring min cha ngag rim pas yod/sras dang gser mtsho gzhis sdod la/mu tig rin chen se mo do/brgya phreng re re'i skyes ma yod/136

rgyu chung yang rten 'brel phun sum tshogs/mu tig bstar la brgyus pa bzhin/lha rgyud sras rgyud mi nyams shing /dam tshig rnam par mthun par shogalha sras nya tsha'i thugs la zhogaces 'gag med rdo rje'i gsung glu de ltar bstsal bas nya tsha rjes su yi rangs te la mo gdan las bzhengs nas phyag btsal zhabs spyi bor blangs so/ de nas zhag gsum bar rdzong du bzhugs te rgyal blon thams cad gsung gleng sna tshogs pa dang dga' skyid kyi ngang la bzhugs/ de'i tshe ne'u chung nas kyang rgyal mchog rin po che'i bka' lung dang mthun pa'i rmi lam zhig nya tsha la brda bkrol bas don zhib par yid la rtogs nas 'bral mi phod pa'i 'dun pa dang bcas phyir log ste pho rog snying rdzong du 'byor nas rgyal mchog rin po che'i bka' lung dang ne'u chung la rmi lam byung tshul sogs zhib par brjod pa'i don thams cad yid la chud nas bde bar bzhugs shing sku rim la 'a bad do/

le'u gsum pa/dbang byed ma dang khro thung khrag ral ma/ge sar brlag ched gling gi yul du 'ongs/skyes bus dbang byed ma bzung nor mdzod kyi/lde mig 'phrog nas rnam shes dag zhing spar/de yi dus su a khu khro thung dang mi nyag g.yu rtse rgyal po gnyis bka' gros la brtson pa'i tshe dam nyams bdud kyi rten phur yid 'phrog dbang byed ma de khrag gi ral pa gyen la gzengs/ mche bzhi rdza ltar gtsigs/ nu ma mdzod dar gyis bsdams/ rngam rngam brjid brjid ngang mi rta'i khrag phor pa gang btungs nas na re/ da res 'dir bzhugs rnam pa gnyis/ 'gro dang spyod pa e 'dra byed zer nas bdud mo'i ngag rta 'am 'am la drangs pa'i glu 'di blangs theṭa/glu 'o na a la 'o na red/la la 'o na la mo red/'o na ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/sdig pa'i mun pa nag po'i klong /khams gsum skye 'gro'i srog gi bdag138

klu bdud nag po khrag mig ma/nag phyogs bdud kyi 'khor tshogs 'bum/'bod do mchod do kha 'dzin mdzod/sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na/zi gling gnyis kyi sa mtshams na/sa btsan brag dmar lcags ri'i dkyil/yang btsan lha 'dre'i 'du ra na/glu srin bdud kyi pha yul red/'brong nag snying rdzong nang bcud la/bdud kyi rgyal blon 'du ra red/nga 'dra nga ngo e shes do/nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na/sa srin a ma nag mo la/klu srin bya thal rgyud gcig 'khrungs/mi rgyud bdud sde mang du 'phel/bdud sde'i rgyud pa ma 'gyur ba/yid 'phrog dbang byed dmar mo zer/lha mi yongs la nga dbang che/nga mthong nga dang nga dbang che/longs spyod sha dang khrag la byed/skye 'gro yongs kyi srog dbugs bsdu/ gdug pa bdun gyi a ma yin /'phrul nga bas che ba dbang phyug gda'/1 )()

zil nga bas che bas nyi ma gda'/brling nga bas che ba ri rab gda'/de min gong la yod snang med/de nas stobs ldan bdud kyi rgyal/gling mi a ra rgya bo gson/da ste gtam gyi 'dra ma la/seng phrug chung ste brnyas rgyu med/gcan gzan kun gyi rgyal po red/'brong phrug chung ste brnyas rgyu med/ru thur can gyi rgyal po red/bya rgyal khyung phrug brnyas rgyu med/'dab chags yongs kyi rgyal po red/nga gdol pa'i bu mor brnyas rgyu med/bdud srin gdug pa'i rgyal mo yin/gtam rang che min te yin lugs red/gling dkar sa 'bu mgo nag de/skyes nas nyi ma da bar du/nag po bdud kyi bstan nga/ la/ma byas pa la gcig kyang med/bdung kyi g.yang rten stobs ldan de/nag phyogs bdud srin mig snying yin/sru ro/ sa srin glu me ma/nyams bdud yongs kyi srog thing yin/140

stobs rtsal lo rgyus nga yis shes/kho skyes nas de yang mthong rgyu med/4pho 'dre klu btsan rgyal po yis/bdud mo nga la mdun gros la/'dzam gling mi la mi zhed de/smon lam las kyi 'bras bu yis/'gog phrug ya bo mi zin do/bla bya sha bzan spun gsum de/skye 'gro zas su za bas zer/nyul ma btang ba rjes med red/de rgyab btsan rgod spun bdun btang /gar song a med ya med red/de rgyab klu btsan song bas zer/la dgu mthong ba'i mig sbyar zhing /lung dgu snyob pa'i lag pa bcagasrog rta rnga tsam de ma bcad tsam/bltas na than dgu tshang ba'i bu/'thab na 'gran gyis mi do zer/rgyal chen de yang zhed nas 'dug da rung zi ma stag zhal rgyam/byang phyogs sde 'bangs yongs kyi rgyal/lan med gshin rje nag po red/blon chen khri tsha rgya stag de/ 111

dngos yod dngos med bdud kyi bu/byu ru dmar po'i rwa co can/khams gsum srog bdag yin pas zer/de yang jo rus phung nas thal/'do ba'i g.yang chen kho la shor/zi ma sa yul jo rus bdagami de 'dras byed byed su yis byed/nang gnyen 'dun steng na ra bas gyong /yid chad yul la chags med byas/lo ring du song na 'dzam gling phung /brjod mi dgos lag mthil ri mo red/dgra me stag gnyis de ma 'gyangs zer/zer ya nga zer la bden yang bden/da res rtags ma nga la bab/sna 'dren a khu khyod la bab/rgyal po che bas gzhis la bzhugs/gdug pa blon dang ma 'bral dgos/a zhang klu srin sbal mgo la/blo 'dri dpung g.yar ci dgos ltos/tha chung bu mo khrag ral ma/a ma'i dpung la ba'i phyir shogami rta'i sha khrag tshim par zo/rdzu 'phrul rlung gi rkyal pa la/142

nad kyi rkyal pa snga sor sdoms/dbugs len rkyal pa phyi sor sdoms/mtshon gyi gru gu dbyings la 'phyor/zhe sdang phyang la mgyogs par 'gro/nyin mo sno chen rtse nas lta/sa yul lung pa'i chags tshul lta/do nub mun pa smag rum na/jo ru rgya tsha spyi dpon gsum/rab na mngon sum zhags pas 'ching /btsan thag nag sha le bdud yul 'khrid/snying tshim pa'i las de bya rgyu yin/mtha' na bla tshe srog dbugs len/dbugs len rkyal pa'i nang la btsud/rgyal blon yongs la spyan gzigs 'bul/bstan pa rim pas bsnubs pas chogabaka' gros 'dun ma de thog yin/rgyal blon thugs la de ltar zhogaces glu de ltar blangs pa na/ stag rong dpon gyi bsam pa la jo ru ni glog las bang mgyogs/ thog bas stobs che/ nyi ma bas blo gsal ba zhig yod pas mo mnyam du phyi log 'gro dgos pa ma bzang yang / da byed rgyu med pa'i las la thug pas mi 'gro smras na dpa' med pa'i mtshang du 'gro ba ma zad/ bdud kyi rgyal blon gyis ci byed mi shes pas sa yul mdzub ston du phyin nas rang nyid thar 143

thabs mig 'phrul gyi las shig byed bsams nas/ khro thung gis mi dpa' ba'i dpa' mdog mi dga' ba'i dga' mdog mgo 'phang mtho ye re/ 'dzum mdangs bstan nas na re/ ya a zhe rgyal mo'i zer thog tu nga rang yang blo mthun/ sa rgyus ni nga che/ stobs ni khyed btsan/ phung 'dre gsum de lag tu lon na ci ma rung zer/rgyal po'i bsam pa la bdud mo dbang byed ma 'di 'dzam gling yud kyis nyul/ dngos yod dngos med gang la yang brdzu ba'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs yod pa ma zad/ khams gsum gyi srog bdag yin pas su la yang mi dogs bsams nas de bzhin gyis zer/ der khong gsum thams cad khra mo gling la 'gro rgyu thag hril gyis bcad nas bza' bca' gang dgos tshar ba dang lhan/ bdud mo dbang byed ma dang tha chung khrag ral ma gnyis rlung gi rgyal po'i 'khor lo mig gcig gru gang sa la ma reg bar snang du bya ltar lding ba de bzhon/snga ru la nad kyi rkyal pa phyi ru la dbugs len gyi rkyal pa mtshon gyi gru gu dang zhags pa/ gzhan yang dgra sta kha che sogs mtshon cha lus la bskor/ stag rong dpon la rgyug byed 'phar ba zhig bskyon nas nub tu kha bltas te sa gzhi rib rib tu 'gro ba'i skabs rma g.yang nor bu'i sa cha bde mchog lha yi pho brang / 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan gcig rten mchog mthong ba don ldan mdun/ gling rje mi yi nyi ma 'dzam gling bstan pa'i sgron me/ dbu nag bod kyi lha skal/nag phyogs bdud kyi kha gnon de nyid kyis rtsa gsum lha la tshogs mchod zhig 'bul gyin du grangs bsags nas bzhugs pa'i tshe/skyes bu'i gser lcog gi steng / ma ne ne gnam sman dkar mo de 144

nyid ḍa ki'i cha lugs sku chung la gar stabs shig se byon nas 'od zer sna lnga'i klong nas dbyangs snyan gsal la ma 'gag pa'i lung bstan gyi glu 'di ltar bzhengs so/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/oṃ na mo gu ru de lba yi/glu a la pha rgyud nam mkha'i glu/tha la ma rgyud sa gzhi'i glu/la la dbyer med zung 'jug glu/dgongs pa chos dbyings khyab gdal che/sgrib med gsal ba'i glu zhig len/'gag pa med pa'i ngag cig 'gugs/'khrul pa med pa'i brda zhig sprod/sa 'di snang stong bde chen zhing /snang ba sgrib pas ma g.yeng zhigadag pa'i zhing khams lhun grub brjid/ma dag tha mal rgyal po'i mkhar/lha sras chos rgyal sku mdun red/nga 'dra nga ngo mkhyen gsal te/gatshas chen rgyu ma tha la'i grong /rtsa gsum lha yi bzhugs gnas nas/rang byang rang gsal sku zhig bzhengs/lhan rgyos a ne rgod lcam dkar/ma lha gsal ba'i sgron me yin/145

de nas lha sras mi yi dbang /a jo jo ru rin po che/ rgyal ge sar mtshan de thogs le red/chas ngan lus ngan nod le red/lus rdzu 'phrul gra sgo bye le red/gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la/dbyar chung lon pa'i rta chung de/mi sdod thang rgya bskor ran red/ bskor nas thang rgya chod nyin mo/rta pho chen grags pa thob le dgos/zhag gsum lon pa'i stag phrug de/mi sdod ma rjes 'brang ran red/'brang nas sha za khrag 'thung dus/stag 'dzom drug grags pa thob le dgos/zla gsum lon pa'i 'brong phrug de/rdza khra yag sgang ze 'grim ran red/'grim nas rtsa chu longs spyod dus/ru thur ming g.yer thob le dgos/rgyal sar phebs pa'i ge sar dpon/ma dal bdud srin 'dul la phebs/phebs nas bdud thul g.yang rdzong longs/bu dgra 'dul grags pa thob le dgos/yang snying tshig gi rdo ga la/146

'di nas shar gyi phyogs rol nas/zi gling chags pa'i mar nang nas/yi dam 'khor lo bde mchog gnas/rtsub 'gyur chen po'i bkod pa la/de wam ko ḍa zhes kyang bya/mi min lha 'dres bdag tu bzung /rgyal dbang pad ma ka ra yis/bod yul chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus/smon log dus gcig bdud yul skyes/sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa'i dus/khyod ge sar 'dul ba'i gnyen por byon/ru yang pho gyong dmar rgyan ma/rje dang chos la lta ba logabar skabs gtsug lag gdon bcu'i gral/mi min klu srin bdud kyi rgyud/sman mdzes ldan smad tshong dbang mo che/mi dang lha 'dre yongs la sdeb/sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa'i bdud/shar bdud gdug pa spun bdun skyes/skye gnas sgo nga'i nang nas rdol/bya 'dab chags min te bar snang 'phyo/stobs dang cho 'phrul ya ma zung /gnam lo 'di la ma thul na/147

phyis nas bdud bzhi'i dpung dang sdeb/gnam sa go ldog bsgyur grabs dang /dga' rab dbang phyag ngh+rung 'brel na/'chi med lcags srorgo 'thob par 'gyur/khyod khri srong lde'u btsan sgyu 'phrul yin/las kyi 'bras bus 'dul skal yod/btul nas bde zhing 'arged dgos yod/dad pa 'dun pa byed par dka'/mngon spyod drag pos ma bsgral na/nyams pa bdud kyis thog brdzis yod/de ring gtam gyi yang snying la/ khu bo rta mgrin dmar po de/gong ma lha nas smon lam mthus/da lta phan yang da lta gnod/thugs byams pa'i zhe sha ma dkrugs na/khyed skyes bus ci mdzad shes le min/de phyir stag rong bka' drin che/nyams pa cham la 'bebs ran yin/ sangs rgyas bstan pa g.yo 'gul med/gtor yang nor bu len ran yin/klu srin ar la gtad ran yin/yang snying de ring gdong gang la/bdud mo yid 'phrog dbang byed ma/148

tha chung bu mo khrag ral ma/rang rang rdzu 'khrul stobs phyang nas/khra mo gling la chas nas yong༄ /sa rgyus mdzub ston a khu yod/ sgrib shing rlung gis 'khor lo btags/dgra sna mu pa'i shog la gtad/ge sar spyi dpon rgya tsha la/so srin bzhin du sdang nas gda'/srung ba rdo rje'i gur khang gi/stong gsum ga'u kha sbyor nang /chung rgyud mi rta 'bral med gyis/zo dor dgra bla wer ma yis/dbang byed bdud mo bzung du yod/khas blangs dam bca' legs nyes lta/rgyu mdzod rin chen lde mig dang / klu bdud dmag sgam beng gi sgam/cho 'phrul du ma'i lde mig yod/de rnams phyag tu ma 'phrod na/nyams pa spun bdun 'dul thabs med/bdud mo'i snying gi khrag chu de/bdud kyi bla mtshor ma btab na/klu bdud kha 'dzin g.yel le min/tha chung bu mo 'chor yang srid/149

stag rong ma 'chi stag rong thongs/ a mtshar po'i las gcig yong nges thang /dgra bla'i bu mo stag chas ma/dbang byed mar brdzus bdud yul thongs/bya ba mtshar mtshar grub nas yong /de rgyab lha mi bka' gros yod/de ring skyes bu le ma ring /glu 'khrul pa byung na bzod par gsol/lha sras rgyal mchog thugs la zhogaces glu de ltar bzhengs nas der mi mngon par song / ge sar rgyal pos lha la gtang rag phul te ra mda' sbran rdo rje'i gur khang phub pa'i nang ting nge 'dzin gyi dgongs pas mi 'jig gling spyi dang chung rgyud mi dpon che gsum btsud nas bzhugs/ de yi dus su bdud mo gnyis dang / stag rong dpon gsum bdud kyi cho 'phrul dang bcas te dus tshod yos kyi steng nas bskyod pa na rta yi dus tshod der gling dkar chags pa'i mar sham/ rma rgyal spom ri'i mdun shod/ khra phu 'dzam gling la khar slebs pa dang / khro thung gis yul sde sa yul mdzub mos bstan kyang rgyal mchog ge sar gyi srung 'khor gyi mthus bdud mo gnyis kyi 'ja' dang me ri las gzhan ma mthong bas bdud mos 'ja' dang me ri las gang yang mi 'dug zer ba dang / stag stong dpon nas sgrib shing bsngags te lag tu gtad g.yung drung nag po'i sngags gyen log brgya bsngags te sa dang rde'u gtor ba na glo bur du sprin nag 'khor te ser ba thar thar du 150

bab pa na gling rje la khro thung dad pa dang / lta ba log pa'i mthus srung 'khor la bug ral shor ba dang lhan bdud mo gnyis kyis mkhar mi 'gyur dngul chu khro rdzong lam mer mthong ba dang 'gro zer bas/stag rong dpon shin tu zhed nas nga rang 'gro ba mi nus/ dpa' rgya tsha ni stobs rtsal dang 'khrul che bas/ dpa' rgya chos mthong na bzung sdig gsod gsum nges par byed yong bas/ ngas 'dir sgug gin 'dug khyod mthu chen gnyis 'gro nus na lan ya su yis mi 'pher zer bas/ mo rang gnyis nga rgyal che ba'i stabs kyis 'o de bzhin du bya'o zer nas/ mi sdug srin mo'i gzugs la nad sna dgu yi rlangs pa 'thul ba/ nu ma phrag la bkal/ mche ba len phur ltar gtsigs/ ngo la ngo mtho bco brgyad yod pa/ kha gdangs khrag thigs zags pa/ lus la rang 'doms bco brgyad yod pa/ sbrul nag gi skra chun byas pa/ sbrul ser khra dang dkar khras ske rags dang lham sgrog byas pa/ rlung gi rkyal pa mi gcig de chad lus med pa ser sprin la bzhon/ sa gzhi 'gul ba 'dra'i ngang nas dngul chu khro rdzong gi sgo har gyis phyes nas cho 'phrul gyi mkhar nang thon pa na nyin de'i snga nyin der ra bza' la sras g.yang chen zhig btsas te dpa' ya med rgya tsha 'al dkar gyi thugs la sras der 'tshub ngo shar te a khu sgom chen gting med mdun thugs rtags zhus te sras la sku rim sgrub rgyu'i yon 'bul du dpon blon rta pa lnga dang dre'u bcu la bkal te phebs nas rdzong du ma bzhugs pa dang thug te nang du rgya bza' dang ra bza' gnyis dang bran g.yog bcas yod sar slebs pa dang / bdud mo 'jig rngam che ba'i rkyen gyis der /51

yod nang 'khor thams cad snying kha ru 'tshangs te skrag tshad kyi cho sgra dir ri btab pa dang lhan/ ra bza' dge tshos dkon mchog gsum dang gling rje ge sar gyis gzigs zer bas/ bdud mo'i rna bar/ da mgyogs par mi thub pa'i bu gsum dang ge sar la mor shog zer ba thos/ pa dang khang pa me 'od kyis gang ba mthong nas/bdud mos 'gro zhor du rgya bza' lha dkar gyi pang du lha sras chung ngu de yod pa khrag ral mas khyer/ rgya bza' lha dkar bdud mo dbang byed mas lug gu bya glag gis khyer ba bzhin mchan 'og tu bcug ste rlung sbud pa ltar song ba'i tshe/ dgra lha'i gnyen stag dmar po des mi dmar rta dmar nyil le/ rma rdza mdun lung shog chen bco brgyad de dmag gis bkang / gnyan chen sku lha ger mdzod des mi ser rta ser nyil le rma sked mgron lam bar ma'i del chen bcu gsum de dmag gis bkang / gtsug na rin chen dang zo dor rma rgyal spom ra gnyis kyis sprul pa'i dmag gis phyogs yongs bkang / ge sar skyes bu don grub khong ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs te 'khor gsum legs par bskor/ 'do chen rkyang rgod 'phel po la sga gtad srab bkon mdzad pa'i steng du bud nas sku 'khor rnams la 'di bya 'di byed gsung ba'i long khom med pa'i ngang bya rgyal bar snang la 'phur ba ltar rjes snyeg gi ra mdar phebs pas bdud mo gnyis kyis rma sked rtse thang bar ma nas yul kun dmag gis bkag tshar ba mthong nas/ khrag ral ma ni 'thab pa'i spobs pa ma shar nas da ngas skyi bser rlung la brdzus nas ma song na do zla yod pa ma red zer/bdud mo dbang byed ma ni rlung drag pos rjes nas ded pa'i rkyen 152

gyis snying khams cher g.yos te/ khyod rang de bzhin gyis dang ngas dpa' rtags gling yul du grags pa zhig byas nas slebs yong zer ba dang lhan/ dgra lha ge sar rgyal po de nyid glag nag thad la gzhum pa bzhin du/ 'khor gsum rngam zil che le/ 'od zer bkrag mdangs shig se 'khor dgra lha'i dmag tshogs nyil le der phebs pa dang lhan mos 'jig rngam dang bcas phyir bskor nas mtshon gyi gru gu de bsgril byang bas skyes bu'i sku yi phyogs su me tog gi char dang 'ja' 'od༄ lam lam du shar ba las ma gnod/ mos nga rgyal drag pos thul du re nas lag pa gdengs te byung ba na/ rgya bza' mchan 'og nas thang du lhung byung bas skyes bu'i ral gri de lan gsum g.yug pa gnang bas dang po des rlung gis rkyal pa gshags nas mo thang du 'gril nas thal rlung bar snang la 'ur/ gnyis pas dbugs len gyi rkyal pa gshags te skye 'gro stong gi bla srog rnams rang gnas su btang / gcig mo'i lus la thebs te 'phrul gyi rtsa sgo bsdus te nag thom me thang ru bsgril ma thag gling rje mi yi nyi mas zhags pa khams gsum rang 'gugs de ske la bkon nas gru gu bzhin du bsdams nas mgur 'di bzhengs so/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu a la dkon mchog gsum la len/tha la rtsa rlung rgyud nas byon/la la dam nyam cham la phobs/khrag 'thung pad+ma he ru ka/de ring bdud mo ma rung pa'i/153

skye rgyud chod la sha khrag rol/rnam shes mi ldog byings la spor/dgra lha wer ma mthu ldan rnams/gtang rag bdud rtsi dpa' skyems bzhes/bdud srin bstan pa mthur du gnon/dkar phyogs bstan pa yar la bstod/sa 'di lha lung rma ri'i zhol/rma ri rtse lung bar ma zer/dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rtse ba'i sa/dga' ba'i gro gar 'khrab sa red/skyid pa'i glu dbyangs len sa red/dgyes pa'i zhal ras ston sa red/nga 'dra khyod tshos ma shes na/skye ba 'di yi gong rol du/dang po skye ba lha la blangs/lha chen tshangs pa'i sras po yin/stong gsum byams dang snying rjes bskyangs/mchod yul gong ma spyi bor bkur/ dge des mi yul lus gcig blangs/bod kyi rgyal po mthu chen dpal/tshangs pa lha yi me tog zer/rtsa ba gsum de snying ltar gces/dkon mchog gsum de gtsug na bkod/154

nyam thag sprang slong bu ltar bskyangs/bdud srin sdang dgra ar la gtad/de rgyab lha la skye ba 'ga'/smon lam bden pa grub mi yin/de nas gling la skye ba blangs/rus ni smug po gdong las chad/gzhan gyis mi thub stobs chen yin/stobs chen jo ru zer ba yin/nag po bdud srin kha gnon yin/chos dkar po'i bstan pa 'dzugs mi yin/dad na bla ma sangs rgyas yin/'gras na srog gi spu gri yin/da res thug pa'i bdud mo khyod/gling dkar lha lung gong ma la/bdud mos 'dre lag ci la brkyangs/mu pa gnam gyi rgyal po la/do bsdo phod 'dzugs ci la byed/lha mkhar dngul chu khro rdzong la/chos ma ṇi'i rang sgra 'u ru ru/bdud nag po'i thog rgyug ci la red/sras po lha phrug tshangs skal de/bdud mos khyer don ci la red/sku ma yal da lta lag na zhon/155

zos pa yin na skyug la shog ma byung nyi ma rtsa gcig la/dmar dza re gsod lugs rnam pa brgyas/khyod sa steng 'dug res tshang le yin/'dir yong ba'i rgyu mtshan ci 'dra yin/dam nyams gdug pa spun bdun dang /g.yer grags can gyi g.yu rtse rgyal/rku jag gnyis la snga so gtad/g.yo gtam rdzun la phyi so gtad/gling zos zos so dkar mche rtse dig gyod snga song rting pa rjes lus yin/zhags pa khams gsum rang 'gug 'di/'phangs na skyi bser rlung yang zin/bsdams na ri rab yin kyang 'khyigacho 'phrul mthu rtsal che mdog kha/lus gru gu bzhin du bsdams pa ltos/rtsal yod na nam mkha'i bya bzhin 'phur/'phrul yod na sa 'og 'bu bzhin 'dzul/dpung yod na ser bzhin 'gril la shogade min thar bsam snang ba mtho/tshig yag nyes gnyis kyi ster len gyis/lag yag nyes gnyis kyi mtshams la yod/khyod bdud mo'i yid la de ltar zhog156

ces glu de ltar bka' bstsal yang mor dad pa'i snang ba ma skyes nas ngas khyod la ston mo zhig bya yi sdod dang zer ba'i lhan/mos kha gdangs pa'i nang nas sbrul nag shin tu che ba zhig mgo ye re phyi rol du mngon byung ba dang lhan dug rlangs kyi dris ge sar khong dbu nag thom thom byas byung bas phyi chad zhig mdzad pa dang lhan/sbrul de phyi rol du mngon nas yang sbrul de'i kha nas sbrul du ma byung ba dang / skyes bu khong thugs cung yengs pa dang lhan bdud mos rlung du brdzus nas shor du nye ba na dgra bla wer ma kha ba bzhin du babs te dgra lhas zhags sne bsdams/ wer ma zo dor rnams spul pa'i bya chen sa gzhi gang bar sprul te sbrul thams cad gyur mid byas/ sngon ma'i sbrul che ba de mgon po legs ldan gyi dpa' rtags su lon/mo yang shin tu zhed nas ci bya med par cho 'phrul sna tshogs kyi lde mig dang rgyu nor gyi lde mig rnams bskyugs pas lha klu gnyan gsum gyi phyag tu son/ de nas ge sar khong gis dri ba mang du mdzad pas mo nga rgyal gyis myos te a lan ster du ma nyan par yod pas skyes bu'i thugs la phung mo 'di sngon yang bsam yas nas lta ba log ste gtsug lag gi gdon byas nas bar srid la 'khyams/ da lta yang dge ba khyad du bsad cing sdig pa dang du blangs/ dam sri spun bdun gyi a ma ru skyes/ dge ba la ched du sdang ba 'di'i skye rgyud bcad nas rnam shes dag zhing la 'god dgos par 'dug dgongs nas/stong nyid kyi dgongs klong la snying rje cher 'khrungs pa'i drag po'i sku ru bzhengs te/ bdud mo'i brang dkyil zhabs g.yas pas mnan/phyag g.yas pas gri chung shel gri yu dkar de shubs nas phyung ste smon 157

lam gyi glu 'di bzhengs so/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu a la tha la tha la red/tha la glu yi len lugs red/a la ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/glu a la dkar phyogs lha yi dbyangs/tha la gling dkar khra mo'i glu/la la rang snang sprod nyin len/sdig chen bdud mo'i skye rgyud chod/rnam shes rgyal ba'i klong du spor/sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas par mdzod/ka ga chos sku'i klong yangs nas/rgyud pa dgu ldan bla ma la/bzod med gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/bdud mo'i skyes rgyud skyes bus gcod/rnam shes bde chen zhing du drongs/ ri nag phyogs bdud kyi bstan pa snubs/sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas par mdzod/lnga ldan longs sku'i zhing khams nas/yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs la/bzod med gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/bdud mo'i skye rgyud skyes bu gcod/rnam shes bde chen zhing du drongs/158

nag phyogs bdud kyi bstan pa snubs/dkar phyogs bstan pa dgung la bstod/spyi gtsug bde chen 'khor lo'i zhing /rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad la/bzod med gdung bas gsol ba 'debs /bdud mo'i skyes rgyud skyes bus gcod/ rnam shes bde chen zhing du drongs/nag phyogs bdud kyi bstan pa snubs/dkar phyogs bstan pa dgung la bstod/lha klu gnyan gsum dgra lha'i dpung /wer ma zo dor lha tshogs la/'bod do kha 'dzin sdong grogs mdzod/bdud mo'i skyes rgyud skyes bus gcod/sha khrag gtang rag mchod pa 'bul/rnam shes dag pa'i dbyings la sbyor/nag phyogs bdud kyi ru dar bsnyil/dkar phyogs rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan phyor/khyod bdud mos dad pa mi 'jog na/drag pos mi bsgral ka med red/gri chung shel gri yu dkar 'di/slob dpon pad+ma'i kha ṭam dang /tshangs pa lha yi shel gri dang /drag khros dmar mo'i gri gug gsum/159

a jo rdo rje legs pa yis/lcags sna dgu la khan sbyar nas/rang byung phyag mtshan gsum po brdungs/gong lha gsum gyi phyag la 'bul/khrab chen zil pa thog sdug dang / ral gri btab pa lan med dang /gri chung shel gri yu dkar gsum/gong ma lha yi bzhed don bzhin/grub nas smon lam gter rgyas btab/gter pha nor bu yis blangs le yin/ blangs nas zla kha ma lon yod/de ring mkho ba khyod steng mkho/phung mo'i gzugs gzhi so sor phral/'khor ba'i 'khrul thag chod par shogashes rab ye shes gri gu 'di/nyon mongs dug lnga'i rtogs tshogs gtubs/ye shes lnga yi klong du bsgral/ 'bras bu phyir mi ldog par shogabazod med snying rje'i phyag len 'dis/sdig pa'i phung po zhig nas kyang /thar pa'i skas la mngon 'dzegs te/ bde dge'i sa lam yongs rdzogs shogade tshe rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mdun/160

gsung zab dam pa'i chos thos nas/byang chub sems mchog rgyud pa skyes/sprul pas gzhan don nus par shogakhyod nyid sa lam ma rdzogs bar/nga yi thugs rjes mi btang zhing /thugs rje thabs mkhas lcags kyu yi sa/ yang nas yang du 'dzin par nges/dkon mchog gsum po rgyang mi ring /rtsa ba gsum po thugs ma g.yel/bdud mo'i bem rig khral nas ni/rnam shes chos kyis byings su drongs/'pho ba gdams pa'i gseng dang sbyar/bde chen rgyal sa'i sras su shogabadud nag po'i mgo bo non par shogagling skyes bu'i smon lam 'grub par shogaces glu de ltar bzhengs nas ya nga bag tsha med par lta sgom spyod pa'i rtsal phyang nas stong srid snying rje'i ngang nas bdud mo'i brang gshags pa na zlo tsha tsha bod sa 'bu mgo nag gis nga bsad byang zer ba las gzhan zer long med pa tshe 'phos te dad pa'i 'bye shes ma skyes stabs skyes bus lam sbyong nan gyis mdzad kyang zhing du spar ma thub nas lho nub za byed srin po'i yul rda sha ra'i grong khyer du srin po ma ru kya'i bu mo zhig gi lus la thal lo/ de nas skyes bu ge sar dgra lha'i rgyal po de nyid kyis bdud mo'i snying phyi rol tu phyang / snying ༄ 161

/bug de dgra bla'i gnyan stag ming sring la gnyer kha bcol/ sha rnams tshogs bshams te dgra bla wer ma thams cad la gtang rag tu phul nas lhag ma med par mdzad/ rgya bza' lha dkar la khrus dang bla bslu mdzad pas rim gyis sos/ bdud mo tha chung khrag ral ma de skyi bser rlung la brdzus te srod phag gi dus su rang yul du slebs/lha bu de mngon sum bdud mo'i kha ru song bas phyis lha phrug rnams la bdud mo'i bar chad che ba 'ong / de ni dam tshig la sel lan tsam mor ba'i rkyen gyis yin pas rjes su dam tshigs mig la gces pa bya dasos pa gal che bo/ stag rong yang ge sar gyis bdud mo'i rjes ded cing ri lung dmag gis khengs pa mthong nas chu bo'i nang du nya saser mig zhig la brdzus nas mkhar pho rog snying rdzong du sras lcam gyi phyogs su 'gro bsam yang ci nas kyang 'gro ma phod par phyir log pa na bzhon pa 'phar ba rnga nag kyang dgra bla wer mas btul te 'ja' ltar yal nas med pas zhag gnyis song nas/ sgo srung bdud mo gnyis kyi rtsar 'jigs dngangs dang bcas slebs nas rdzun gtam mang du bshad kyang khog nas rogs bdud mo gnyis ka jo rus bsad tshar yod/ ji ltar bshad na drag rang nyid mgyogs tsam shi na dga' snyam pa'i ngang lto stogs pa'i skabs bdud mos sha khrag byin pa rnams bzas pas 'go lha du ma 'grib song / de nas gling rje'i sku mdun du 'dan ma dang sga sde dpa' la mi spyang gsum phebs nas bdud mo thul ba dang rgya bza' sos pa dang dus mnyam/sras lha'u shor ba la thugs 'gyod che yang ci bya bral te sku 'khor rdzong mi 'gyur seng 'brug stag rtse'i nang du phyag phebs so/—— 162

le'u bzhi pa/ne ne gnam sman dbang byed ma la sprul/shar bdud gdug pa spun bdun yul du byon/rgyal blon bla gnas btul zhing blo rig mnol/gling la dmag sna 'dren pa'i dpa' kha bskyed/de nas dgra lha'i lcam sring ma ne ne de nyid kyis bdud mo'i snying khrag de shel bum nang btsud/ bdud mo dbang byed ma ji bzhin du sprul nas dbugs kyi rkyal pa'i nang bdud dam nyam ma rungs pa'i snying btsud de dgra lha'i wer ma'i mthu chen po dang bcas skad cig nyid du glog 'khyug pa bzhin so srung bdud mo gnyis kyi rtsar phebs pa dang / bdud mo gnyis 'dar sig sig skad thon la ma thon ngang lus/ a khu khro rgyal gyis dbang ma mthong ba dang /shi gson 'phrad pa ltar dga' nas 'o brgyal zhus shing 'thams pa na/sprul pa'i dbang byed mos khyod snying med wa mo'i bu/ pho byas gcig kyang med par 'dir phyir log tu 'ong dgos pa ci yin zer nas khro rgyal la thal lcag me thag bshos pa lta bu gsum brgyab/ gdong 'a/ mchil zhag gsum btab par gda'/ de la dgos don gsum yod de/ dgra bla wer ma'i lcam sring mos thal lcag gis nyams pa 1()0

bdud dang spyod pa 'dres pa'i grib sel ba dang / mchil zhag gis sa grib ngan pa'i mnol ba sel ba/ ngan smras kyis bdud la blo ngakar ba las ldog pa'i thabs so/ de nas khro thung nag 'thom mer sar 'gyel ba yar langs te shin tu skrag cing yid skyo ba'i ngang na re/rgyal mo de 'dra ma byed bcol ba'i rgyu de ma nor dgos/ skyabs pa'i mi de ma sdug dgos/ g.yar pa'i skyin tshab ma zhan dgos/zer ba ltar 'di 'dra byed thabs med/ sngun nyi ma la brten na e dro/ rgyab ri bo la brten na e brling / phyag dang 'grogs na e snum/ rgyal dang 'grogs na e btsan gyi 〈pe ltar nga da res las nyam chung ba dang sdug pa 'ong ma myong zer nas mig nas mchi ma zim zim byung ba na/ sprul pa'i sring lcam dbang byed ma na re/ nged do gal nas khyod bsu ba la song ba min/ khyod do gal 'u thug nas nged la skyabs btsal te thod pas sgo brdungs/ 'phongs kyis khyi bkag nas slebs byung ba ma tshad/ byed rgyu yod mdog gi gtam/ ci bshad yid la bskor ba ma zad kha sang dpa' mdog kha pho tham/ tham du yod tshe bu gzig 'phen zer ba dang jo ru gnyis kyi dmag ngangu/nga byung skabs khyed gnyis gar song ma mthong / nga rang gis 'thab pa'i rtags ma mgo 'di la ltos dang zer nas sprul pa'i cho 'phru'/ gyi mgo zhig bstan byung bas gzig 'phen gyi mgo yi/na pa snang ba ra༅ra nas khro thung snying 'dar la dbugs sto/da du 'tshangs te mig hur hur ci cha med par lus pa'i tshe/ sprul pa'i lcam sring mos bdud mo so srung ma re re'i mgo la dgra sta re brgyab ste barmed/ khro thung ni ci byas bshad rgyu yod pa ma byang ba'i ngang der sprul pa'i lcam sring mos 16/ rabye

slar khyod nga rang gi lhan du 'gro 'am mi/ 'gro bsdad na ngas za ba yin zer bas stag rong dpon shin tu skrag mas 'dar te a ra zing zing gis ngas ci skya ze zhus pas wer ma'i sprul pas dred mong 'ig byung ba la 'di bzhin nas 'gro zer nas a khu dbang med du dred 'a/ bskyon nas khrid pas 'dar sil sil gyis nam bzas yo nga / bdud mo 'di rgyal khab 'di na dbang che khas btsan/ jo rus kyang ya bo mi zin pa gdug tsub che ba 'di 'dra zhig 'dug skyabs gnas chu la zhus na 'phongs 'khyags la sbyar/ mgo bo me la bsngas na skra dang ko le 'tshig 'dre dang bdud la skyabs zhus na mtha' ma rang srog gcod zer ba nges par bden/ ma zad snying dang 'dra ba'i bu gzig 'phen de mos bsad/ nga dran rgyu mang bas yong rgyu mang /bya lag mang na rkang chag kha smras mang na rogs dang 'gras zer ba nges par bden bsams pa ma zad/ khyim gyi dga' skyid dang longs spyod/ gser mtsho dang nya tsha stag 'phen sogs kyis zer lugs rnams dran/ lar rang nyid kyi ring la ge sar la do bsdo ba phyi nang bsgyur/ da dung yang nga ge sar gyis khri 'phang mthon por bzhag pas ge sar bka' drin shin tu che bar 'dug nga dgra 'di'i kha sngon nas phyir log tu 'gro rgyu rnyed dka' bas ci 'dra byed dbos nga/ra 'dug bang/mas nas sla ra blo 'gyur nas kri ga pa'i dbang gis ge sar dang dgra bla wer ma rwa5 ri da kyis gsol ba du ma btab pa'i ngang gdug nga/ sputsha bdun gyi rdzong rtsar spru 'a/ pa'i bdud mo dbang byed ma dang khro thung gnyis/sngar ji lta ba la zil rngam log 'gyur gyis che ba cig byas nas thon pa dang / rgyal blon rnams de sngon tha chung /6 5

/gug ral ma ma 'byor bas thams cad blo mi bde mya ngan gyis non ras yo da pa de yi/ phyi nang 'ag gnyis mtshams sprul pa'i dbang byed ma 'byor bas thams/ cad dga' spro tshad med pa shi gson 'phrad pa lta ra byung / de nas thams cad gros la 'tshogs pa dang lhan sprul pa'i dbang byed mos cho 'phrul gyis gral mdor dbugs len gyi rkyal pa kha phyes nas snying dmar hril hril du byang nas pho byas yod mdog gis rngam rngam brjid brjid kyis zhe sdarngo sbrul gyi khri steng du hor 'dug cig byas nas glu 'di ltar blangs par gda'o/glu 'u na a la tha la red/tha la 'o na 'a 'u red/'a 'u ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/ sha khrag rgya mtsho 'khyil klong nas/bdud mo las hur drag mo'i sku/'khor tshogs bye ba 'bum gyis bskor/a zhes 'bod do kha 'dzin mdzod/ bas/ma don 'grub 'a/ rgyal kha bsto/da/sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na/zi gling gnyis kyi sa mtshams na/mi min lha 'dre 'i 'du ra na/ gdug pa nag po'i pha yul la/nga bdud mo chags pa'i rgyal sa red/nga 'dra gnam sa gnyis kyi bdagami dang lha 'dre'i ya bdag yin//66

skye 'gro ku/ 3 gyi srog bdag yi/na/gdol pa nas ngo 'i bu cho/ yin rgyu na skyi bsir rlung las mgyogs//bsko ra na 'dzam gling yud kyis bskor/'thab na gshin rje'i bu la 'thab/rang bstod min te 'dra ma'i glu/mi dbang g.yu rtse rgyal po gson/rang rgyud gdug pa spun bdun nyon/kha sang kha yi nyi ma la/nga dang bu mo khrag ra'/ ma/sna bo stag rong dpon dang gsum/song song gling dkar yul la song /gling dkar yul gyi sa cha la/'ja' tshon sna lnga zi li li/me ri me phung 'u ru ru/zhib par la lung ma 'byed thal/nga dang tha chung khrag ral gnyis/khra mo'i rdzong la 'dzul nyin mo/dpa' rtags bu dang bud med khyer/phyir log shar shar song ba'i dus/la lung med pa dmag gis khengs/khrag ral gar song rjes med red/rna bo stag rong 'ja' ltar yal/167

dpung med nga rang gcig pur lus/g.yas shog dmag la 'thab pa'e dus/brgya lug spyang kis gtor gtor byas/de drag mi chen du ma bsad/ga 'o na shog dmag la 'thab pa'i dus/ram nag ser bas rdung rdung byas/khas btsan brgya brgya thang la bsgril/rjed 'ded dmag la 'thab pa'i dus/rdzong chen sgo mo 'dan 'dan byas/de drag mo rde'u bzhin du btus/tshur yong bkag ma'i bu dang 'thab/'bru drug zor bas gcod 'dra byas/bsad bsad brgya brgya grangs las 'das/dpa' rtags dgra bo'i snying la ltos/nga rang gcig pu'i byed las la/sgang sgang ro yis gang le dang /gshongs gshongs khrag gis gang le bzos/jo ru ming g.yer grags pa can/'thab na a ya yong nges red/dpa' rtul zer ba'i rgyang g.yer can/nga bud med a ya ma red thal/bsad bsad bshan pa shor le red/spun bdun gros kha 'grig pas na/168

gling dkar yu med bzo nges red/klu btsan thugs kha dgyes nges red/hor ser po'i bzang bstod yong nges red/sa tham dbu rna thon nges red/bdud nag po'i bstan pa mtho nges red/ngas sang nyin gzhis go chod le byed/bu dpa' rtsal can de jag la song /bya ba rgyun thag bsdams na dga'/gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la/pho le lo can gyi las ka de/las da las bsam bzhin ro la sbyar/mo rus ma can gyi zas sbyin de/zas da sbyin ngang nas khyi la 'chor/dpon snyoms las can gyi sde skyong de/sde sa skyong bsam bzhin sprang 'khyam shor/pho nus med can gyis jag gcod de/jag da gcod bsam bzhin mu la 'chor/de zer srol bden srol gnyis ka red/da rung gna' mi'i gtam dpe la/dka' ba'i las gcig ma byas na/dkon pa'i za ma mi rag zer/gom gsum gom pa ma spos na/'gro bsam pa'i sa la mi slebs zer/169

dbyar ston za ma ma bsags na/dgun dpyid bde ba mi rig zer/lus dka' ba'i 'thab 'dzing ma byas na/gtam snyan pa'i rgyal kha thob le min/de zer srol bden srol gnyis ka red/da res rgyal po dbu 'phang7mtho/gdug pa spun bdun dpa' rtsal rgod/nag phyogs sde 'bangs bu rta dar/dpa' ba'i jag gcig ma bcad na/za ma bud med grong 'du 'dra/da rung bu mo dpa' snying rgod/kha sang ci byas las la ltos/las la lta bzhin bsam blo skor/rgyal blon sngon sngon sngon la phebs/sngon la 'gro bzhin dpa' rtsal ngoms/nga bdud mo rjes rjes rjes nas yong /a zhang gdol pa nag po la/drag po dmag gi dpung g.yar zhu/klu srin gdug pa'i beng chen la/las dmag nyi khri chig stong yod/de tsam gling la zhed dogs med/lo rgyus sems la khrig se yod/dpe bzhag na 'dra ma e 'dra gda'/170

tsan dan nags kyi gzhi dkyil nas/stag mi sha za ba'i grags pa can/ma mthong gong nas snyan pa khyab/'gram bcar na khyi rgan ri byol red/rdza ri zil ma'i sgang lam nas/'brong mi rung zer ba grags pa can/ma mthong gong nas rgyang g.yer can/'gram bcar na g.yag rgan ri byol red/rong chen smyug ma'i gseng lam nas/lho mi rgod zer ba'i g.yer po can/ mthong tshad thams cad gsod pas zer/'gram bcar na mi rgan gcer rgyug red/rma khams khra mo gling yul nas/jo ru zer ba'i grags pa can/mthong tshad cham la 'bebs pas zer/'gram bca bu chung go khrab can/ngas bshad bshad min te 'dra ma'i glu/gling dkaro dpa' rtul o zob can/mi ma shi gson lpags bshu bas zer/dpa' rgod 'brug la 'gran mi red/lag len 'ja' dang nor mi red/ de e red mi red ltos dang gsal/ sman nga 'dra ma thub shor le red/

lo bcu gsum lorno pa'i jo ru bu/rtsal lus skyed ma rdzogs btul na dga'/dgra me stag gnyis de chung ze gsod/zer ba'i dpe de bden nges red/jo ru rim gyi lus dar na/ nam zla ci byed shes le min/nga bsdad na gzhis go chod nges yin/rdzong yul dgra la 'chor dogs med/klu srin dmag gis srung bas chogasong na dgra mtha' bcad pas choga'achi med lcags kyi srog rtsa thob/ma yin yin mdog byed le min/don bden bden 'dra na thugs la zhogami bden dgongs pa tshom don med/ces ma yin yin mdog gi glu de ltar blangs pas las kyi dbang gis thams cad la mi 'jig pa'i gdeng thob nas zhe spro gting nas lang / dbang byed mar dpa' rtags dang rgyal kha chen po tshad med pa thob 'dug bsams nas dga' spro tshad las 'das te gdug pa spun bdun gyi mi res dpa' glu re blangs/ khro thung ni snga nyin nas blo log stabs kyis 'di bya 'di byed smra ma nus/ gdong btsan a dpal nas gling gi chags tshul dang sdod lugs kyi glu blangs pa nyob dogs kyis ma bkod/ de mthar bya ru dmar po'i khri steng nas mi nyag g.yu rtse rgyal po des gros thag gartsod pa'i glu 'di dpa' bo'i 172

ngar smra hur thung la drangs nas blangs par gda'o/glu lu na a la 'u na red/la lu 'o na len lugs red/sdig pa'i na bun 'khrigs pa'i klong /steng khams lha yi gzhal yas nas/bdud rgyal dga' rab dbang phyug la/bdud 'khor bye ba 'bum gyis bskor/mi rta'i khrag gis mchod pa 'bul/'bod do kha 'dzin rgyab rten mdzod/mi nyag ha ri rtse dgu mkhyen/gar song rgyab rten dgra lha mdzod/ri rgyal g.yu ri rtse rgyal mkhyen/mi dpa' rta hrag kha 'dzin mdzod/sa 'di bdud kyi 'du ra la/ar jag jag pa'i skung lung red/ri btsan rdza dang gangs kyis bskor/btsan po'i lcags ri brdungs pa 'dra/de 'og thams cad nags ris bskor/spu gri'i ra ba byas pa 'dra/ri chen re la mtsho chen re/ri chung re la mtsho chung red/ lcog steng chang phor bshams pa 'dra/rdzong btsan gshong mo dgu 'gril la/ 173

'bum dgu dmag gis a lan dka'/mtsho nas g.yu 'brug gyen 'gro 'dra/de'i phyi brag gi gur khang ri/mkhar steng dbu gdugs phub pa 'dra/rten 'brel ma bsgrigs lhun gyis grub/phyogs mtshams rdzong mkhar drug po chags/lan med dpa' bo'i rdzong mkhar red/nga 'dra nga ngo los shes te/skye ba gcig la skye res gnyis/mi tshe gcig la bskos pa gnyis/skye sa mi nyag rong la skyes/shar mi nyag shed chen rgyal po de/gling pho yis ma bsad mo yis bsad/bshad bshad gtam gyi srol la gda'/shed chen de yi sras po la/mi nyag g.yu rgod lan med 'khrungs/rgyal po khas btsan grags pa che/'jang bza' sog bza' rgya bza' gsum/rgyal khab gsum nas btsun mo bsus/'jang bza' me tog lha mtsho la/mi nyag chos kyi dbang phyag 'khrungs/sog za 'u shang skyes mo rā/mi nyag g.yu 'od ston pa 'khrungs/174
