rgya bza' kong yan che mo la/nga rang g.yu rtse rgyal po srid/ rgyal sa ma 'cham ma red do/chos dge ba'i rtsod gzhi byas pas phung /chos dge ba am de go ba'i dus/dran pa'i nang nas gzer gcig rgyu/bzod glags med pa'i zhe sdang 'bar/dam chos bla ma zer ba de/mthong na sha pha khyad par med/dgra jag rngon la bskyod lugs sogs/ gleng na yid spro khong nas skye/a ban mi dbon rnam gnyis mdun/brgya gsod stong gsod khas len byas/dga' rab mngon sum zhal gzigs thob/'bral med srung skyob byed pa dang /dgos gal che'i dus la thug pa'i dus/rmu thag rgyud nas bsu 'ong gsungs/bsus nas lha la 'bral med yin/de tsho gtam gyi glu zhor red/yang dgos don gyi snying po la/klu sri na bdud kyi sde 'bangs kyi/rten phur yid 'phrog dbang byed ma/zhi ba lha 'dre mi gsum gyi/175

khyod rtsal mthong bas dbang du 'dus/khros na skye 'gro'i srog gi bdagadapa' rtags rtags ma 'di la ltos/dbu thon dga' spro tshad med che/rten 'brel shin tu legs nas gda'/gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la/lo legs ljang pa'i dus nas legs/'bru rdog po rgyas lugs kha kha red/rta 'do chen rte'u'i dus nas legs/gzugs 'gros gom yag lugs kha kha red/dgra jag 'go mo'i dus nas yagarting pa yag lugs kha kha red/zer yang zer la bden yang bden/a ma'i bka' la yar ldog med/dbang byed khyed dang khrag ral gnyis/zer zer gzhis go chod le gyis/spyang grung rig pa ma 'phyug dgos/jo ru mi min 'dre min gyis/ci byed yid gtad nges med red/ sang tshes bdun gcig gong rol na/yul sde'i dpung dmag zhib bsdu byed/rgyal blon mdun gyi dpung nas brgyan/rma khams gling yul khra mo la/176

rgod po'i dpung pa ngom rgyu yin/dpa' rtags dbang du bsdu rgyu yin/ma ngan 'dog tsha jo ru la/dpa' rtsal rdzu 'phrul ci 'dug lta/skya lo'i khrom gshog 'brug mo la/gzugs skye mdze4legs zhan ltad mo lta/dpa' rtul zer ba'i ming g.yer can/ngar btsan dpa' snying ltad mo lta/longs spyod glu dang mtshungs pas zer/zer tshad e bden ltad mo lta/nged cag byes kyi 'gro 'dug de/rim pas rgyal blon gros kha bstun/tha chung snying grogs khrag ral ma/dga' rab lha la khrag mchod dang /bya dang dud 'gro'i dge mchod gyis/bla gnas dug mtsho nag po la/khrag sna du ma'i mchod 'bul gyis/bya ser 'ug pa spun gsum de/spun zla g.yu 'od mdun du thongs/drag po'i dgra jag chas lugs dang /dpa' bo rgyab chad mi red pa'i/dpung dmag rogs dan mdzad rogs zhus/zhu ba'i bka' rgya nyams med phul/

ma zad klu btsan rgyal po la/gros kha rogs dan bka' bstun rnams/gzhis sdod gtso mo gnyis la babs/byed 'gro'i dgra jag thengs gsum byed/de rjes mi rnokyang cha ngag yod/zhag bar dga' skyid 'du ra byed/skyid pa'i bro 'khrab lha gsol byed/sa dang lung pa'i rgyus rgya mkhan/stag rong dpon blon rnams la bab 'tsho zas ci 'dod longs spyod mdzod/gling dkar 'bangs su chud pa'i dus/stag rong rang mal bzhag pas chogade lugs 'gro sdod bslab bya de/ma nyams so so'i yid la zhogaces glu de ltar blangs shing gros thag de thog tu dbang nas zas mdzod longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo phyes yul sde kun la cha dang bang chen gyis khyab par byas nas 'du ra bsdus te stag rong dpon blon dang bcas pa la zas kyi ston mo rgya chen po bshams te thams cad ci 'dod la longs spyad de bsdad/ de yi nub mo dbang byed mas gong gi bdud mo'i snying khrag dang rdzas ngan dgu sbyor bya khyung sngags sbyar bcas bdud kyi bla mtsho'i nang btab pas klu srin gdol pa nag po dang / klu nag mi bzan/ chu srin mgo can sogs dang / bdud kyi bla nya bdun po sogs skad cig nyid la sha 178

rus bye nas zhig par gyur to/ gzhan yang gdol pa nag phyogs can gnas pa'i mtsho la 'o mas mchod pa phul nas nag phyogs kyi mgon skyabs dang phral/ yang sbug mdzod nyi shu'i lde mig blangs te sgo phyes nas yang mdzod du khrag zhag gi mar me bdun yod la snying khrag btab pas tshag sgra chen po'i ngang nas bla gnas mar me bdun po yal/ klu srin bdud kyi rten phur pha wang nag po zhig yod pa sring lcam mos dgra stas phye mar gshags/ de yi nang nas bdud kyi bla srog lus sbal pa la mgo bdun yod pa 'phyi ba tsam zhig byang ba de nyid ci ltar byas nas 'dul dgos gzigs pas/ radro ge sar khong yin dgos kyang sa thag gis 'gyang bas ci bya bral/ yang rta mgrin dmar po'i sprul pa stag rong dpon gyis thul bar mkhyen nas/dgra bla'i sring lcam dbang byed du brdzus pa khong gis bdud kyi bla srog de lcags spar srub khang du btsud de mi 'chor ba'i gzer btab/rgyal po g.yu rtse dang gdug pa spun bdun la mnol ba'i rdzas sna dgu sbyor de lo zla'i chang la sbyar te myos par blud/ khyi dug khyi bal dang /spyang dug spyang bal/ mi dug mi bal la sogs kyi dud pa bar snang khyab par bdug pas thams cad ci dran med pa chang gis ra ro ba ltar de nub thams cad nyal/ sa srod phag gi dus dgra bla'i sring lhum dbang byed mar brdzus pa de nyid kyis bdud rtsi'i chang bel gang dang lcags spar khyer te 'jigs su rung ba'i cha byad kyis phebs pas khro thung yang tshur 'byor te nyal nas yod khar sring lcam der phebs te/ stag rong dpon 'dir phebs zer nas zur du bos nas am phrag nas dar gyi do li zhig bskyangs nas 'dir rkang pa spos dang 179

zer bas rkang pa de'i steng bzhag pa dang lhan bar snang la khyer song snyam pa'i snying stong stong ngang sa rgyus med pa'i mi med sa mdog nag seng zhig tu slebs/ sring lcam lha'i sprul pa dbang byed mas ye shes kyi mes nyin mo ltar gsal bar byas te lcags spar sar bzhag nas chang de a khu la gtad de glu 'di ltar bzhengs so/glu 'o na a lu tha lu red/tha lu 'o na la lu red/ la lu bdud mo'i len lugs red/sman nga la 'go ba'i lha srung rnams/kha g.yel nga la sdong grogs mdzod/rang chung mi nyams dgung la bstod/sa 'di ar jag skung lung la/yang dgos mi med re thang red/nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na/nag po bdud kyi rgyal mo yin/khams gsum za ba'i dbang chen yin/skye 'gro'i srog gi bdag po yin/nga yi gong la yod snang med/de e yod stag rong dpon gyis shes/bskyabs na skyob pa'i dpon mo yin/de nas nyon dang khro rgyal dpon/ skyems po chang gi nying khu 'di/ dpa' med dpa' kha chud pa'i chang /180

bshad na gtam gyi 'phrul 'khor yin/lus rtsa kha 'byed pa'i lde mig yin/gom gsum spos pa'i tshegs gla yin/chang 'di ngom par khyod kyis thung /lcags kyi spar bu 'di'i nang la/bdud mo nga yi sgos dgra yod/dkar po lha gral la khod le min/nag po bdud gral the le yin/pho mthong tshad srog rtsa gcod pas zer/gdug pa dug gi kha rlangs can/kun ga'i cho 'phrul ci yang ldan/sbrul dkar ser dmar ljang sngo nag mgo dug gis na bun thu lu lu/mthong na skyi g.ya' zing ba yod/mtho ba gnam la shor dwogs yod/dma' ba sa la 'dzul dogs yod/de ring nyi ma'i yan chod la/chos dge ba rna bar gleng sa med/lha bla ma zer dus zhe spro la/mi stag rong sngags kyi sdong po la/skyabs da res btsal ba'i dus shig byang /lha yi dam yod na gsal snang sgoms/༄sngags bsnyen pa yod na grangs su bzlos/181

lus rdzu 'phrul yod na rtsal kha phyung /thugs ting 'dzin yod na mnyam par zhogang res 'di nyid ma thul bar/ rong ci byed rang dbang med/dgra gdug pa 'di nyid thul ba'i mtshams/'di byas mi la gleng chog med/so so'i rang tshugs rang gis zung /khyod kyang gling dkar stod la song /rgyal blon rnarmes dang rim gros kyis/ngas kyang bdud yul gzhis sa gnon/nag po bdud kyi bstan pa 'tsho/nga bdud mo srog gcod sha la dga'/sha gsar pa'i rigs de zhim sha che/bdud mo'i skom chu khrag la dga'/khrag dron mo'i rigs de mngar sha che/yun ring na stag rong za yang srid/de ring pho byas go chod na/rin chen gser gyi dpa' dar yod/gling dkar a khu'i yid la zhogaces glu de ltar blangs nas chang de snod phor zhig tu blugs nas stag rong dpon la drangs pa dang khro thung ni de sngon glu de thos pa dang gang ci'i thad skrag nas 'dar khum khum dzu yod pa chang de gsum gtams shig btungs pas bdud rtsi lha'i chang des lus kyi 182

rtsal bye bde gsal gyi nyams 'bar/ mi 'jigs pa'i gdeng thob ste lha rta mgrin he ru'i bskyed rdzogs gsal ba la zhugs te lha 'bod glu bskul gyi glu 'di ltar blangs par gda'o/oṃ ma tri mu yi sa le 'du/a dkar a dmar du tri so/nag po hi hi dmar dmar hūṃ/glu len na dkon mchog gsum la len/ngag bkug na bde stong rgyud nas 'gugs/sems som nyi med pa'i rang zhal lta/sems ngo bo rta mgrin he ru ka/lha rta mgrin gzhan la mi srid de/'bod pa lha chos che ba yin/'bod byed thugs dam gnad skul yin/ye shes me phung klong yangs nas/stag lha me dbal rta mgrin zhu/'bod do kha 'dzin sdong grogs mdzod/dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i phrin la mdzod/ye gshen g.yung drung bon gyi lha/gnam sa gang ba'i lha yi dmagadagra bgegs 'dul ba'i zhal bzhes bzhin/'bod do dgra bgegs cham la phob/khra mo gling gi 'go lha che/dgra lha'i gnyan stag lha 'khor 'bum/183

dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i gnyen po che/da res a khu'i grogs la byon/nyam pa dgra bgegs cham la phobs/lha chen tshangs pa lha 'khor 'bum/'bod do a khu'i grogs la byon/nam maba'i dbyings kyi rgyu lam chod/nyam pa dgra bgegs cham la phob/gnyan chen sku lha gnyen 'khor 'bum/da res 'bod do grogs la byon/dgra bgegs bar snang rgyu lam chod/nyam pa byad ma cham la phob/klu chen gtsug na klu 'khor 'bum/da res 'bod do grogs la byon/dgra bgegs sa gzhir rgyu lam chod/nyam pa byad ma cham la phobs/gnam rim pa bcu gsum yang steng nas/ne ne gnam sman dkar mo la/snang srid ma mo 'bum gyis bskor/srid gsum gsal ler gzigs pa bzhin/da res 'bod do grogs la byon/dgra bgegs ma shor gsal bar gzigs/nyam pa 'dul ba'i dpung rogs mdzod/phu bo dung skyong dkar po dang /184

nu bo klu sbrul 'od chung dang /sring lcam the le 'od 'phro sogs/ge ge'i lha dang srung ma rnams/da res a khu'i grogs la byon/nyam pa dgra bgegs cham la phobs/gnam sa bar gyi wer ma dang /dgra bla dgu khri dgu 'bum dang /rma rgyal rma rigs zo dor lha/da res 'bod do grogs la byon/sdang dgra gnod byed cham la phobs/dkar phyogs bstan skyong gzhi gnas bdagadam can chos skyong 'khor bcas rnams/a khus 'bod do grogs la byon/sdang dgra gnod byed cham la phobs/rang byang ye shes ge hom dung /ye sherlo mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs bzhugs/nyon mongs dug lnga'i rāng gzugs nyid/mngon sum dgra bgegs gnod byed 'di/ye shes ral gris phye mar gtubs/rnam shes bden chen zhing la drongs/phung po lha yis zhal du mchod/dud pa gnam la ma 'phyur zhig sngo mar nad sprin ma 'tshubs shig 185

sdang dgra rdog pa'i zhabs la gnon/lha rtsa gsum da res thugs ma g.yel/dpa' rtags a khus thob par shog ces glu de ltar mjug rdzogs pa dang dgra bla'i sring lcam dbang byed mas lcags spar kha phyes pa dang lhan khro thung gis srin gri shubs nas phyungs te mig btsums shing lha snang ma 'bral ba'i ngang gri gcig rjes gnyis rjes lan dgus bla gnas de dum bur gtubs/ rnam shes la 'pho ba btab/ slar bla gnas sbal pa'i sha khrag de lcags spar du bsdus te dud pa mi 'thul bar tshags su btsud nas me la bsregs te mnan pa mdzad pas gdug pa spun bdun gyi bla gnas yongs rdzogs thul lo/ de nas sring lcam bdud mor brdzus pa des bzhin ras cung gsal ba'i mdangs phyung nas gser sbar ba gang khro thung la byin nas na re/ gser 'di khyed kyis sbal sbrul bsad pa'i rngan pa yin/ lar yul khams la sbal sbrul med pa ci yod de khyod la dpa' rtsal dang stobs shugs rdzu 'phrul ci 'dug bltas pa las/khyod lus 'dar sil sil mig btsums shing lta mi phod pa ci byas pa thams cad ngas mthong / yul khams 'dir khyod mkho gal mi che bas rang yul du log na dga'/ da lan ngas khyod la ku re rtsed mos sbal sbrul gsod bcug pa de dag gzhan la gleng na yon tan cher med pa ma zad/ khyod kyi mtshang brus pa ltar las mi yong bas gsang rgya byas na dga'/ ngas kyang mi smra bas chog da khyod nyal sa'i sar ngas skyel chog zer/ bya ba bzang po grub par sring lcam mo thags dgyes kyang bdud yul du dga' ba mi skye ba'i sun phyang 1/ri/khro/() ra ga

pa'o/ de nas sngar ltar dar gyi do li brkyangs pa'i steng rkang pa bzhag pa na sngar ltar du mig btsum pas yud kyis stag rong dpon gyi gzim mal du thon/ stag rong nas bsam pa la/ rgyal blon gzhan rnams nga la 'dun pa dang blo chags 'dug kyang / bdud mo 'di ni dbang che khas btsan dran 'phrul tsha bas stobs kyang che/gzig 'phen kyang bsgrungs nges par yod shas che/ nga 'dir slebs nas yun ring ma song bar kha sang lam nas dma' 'bebs kyi gtam dang rdung rdeg de tsam byas pas ma tshad shin tu zhed pa'i dred la bskyon/ do nub gsod rgyu sbal sbrul las med kyang dgra bgegs chenapo zhig yod mdog gis mgo g.yog btang ste nga'i rgyud rim gyis shor/ da yun ring na bdud mo 'dis rdung rdeg gsod gsum gyi legs po mi byed pa thag hril chod red 'dugabasams pa ma zad/rang yul gyis dga' skyid rnams lam lam dran nas gling gi lha srung la gsol ba btab nas nyal lo/ nyi ma de yi phyi nang bdud kyi rgyal blon thams cad bla gnas btul ba'i rkyen dang brgyal ba'i rdzas bdug gi mthus blo gzhan cher dpyad rgyu med pa dga' spro'i ngang dmag bsdu go mtshon rtsis bsher sogs la brtson bzhin gnas so/187

le'u lnga pa/g.yu rtses gling la dpung dmag ma drangs gong /ge sar lha dmag chas nas skung lung bzung /dgra bo'i nyul dmag dpa' rtul bdun gyis brdungs/khro thung lam snar chas pa gling la 'khor/de nas rma khams gling yul khra mo rdzong mi 'gyur dngul chu khro rdzong nas dpa' mi 'gyur rgya tsha zhal dkar de nyid sras lha'u'i don ched a khu sgom chen gting med 'jal zhing gser dngul dang rdel tshad bcu re phul zhing sras kyi sku rim zhus pa na/ sgom chen gting med kyi zhal nas khyed kyi sras de gling lha mi yongs kyi mi g.yang spyi dpon dpon gyi snang ngu dang dbyer med pa dgra bla gnyan stag gi sprul pa zhig yin kyang nang dam tshig chag nyams kyi gdon bgegs zhugs pas des dbang dka' yang / rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam 'phrul sku seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul gyi bka' gsung tshad mar sgrub dang phyis smug po 'dong gi rgyud pa tsho drug gling gi rgyal po/ ge sar thugs kyi sras po/ sdang ba dgra yi kha gnon/ byams pa gnyen gyi 'khri shing gling mi 'thor brtan pa'i gzhung zhing / 'dzam gling du grags pa'i lha sraṭa4 dgra bla ngang gis 'du ba/ wer ma 188

rnams kyi 'khor sa/ dpa' rtags g.yul rgyal dpa' bo zhig 'byung ba snang gsungs pa'i rdo rje'i bka' lung dri ma med pa zhal bzhes thob/ gdong 'bum pa'i zhal lu de nyid kyi dgongs pa la/rmi lam 'tshub 'gyur yang che/ da ci bya bral ba la 'gyod pa cher byed rgyu mi 'dug dgongs nas legs zhus dang bcas phyir log myur bar phebs pas seng 'brug stag rdzong du 'byor ba dang / gling rje mi yi nyi ma ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po khong mjal zhing gsung gleng mthar shar bdud srin mo byung tshul sras dang rgya bza' shor lugs sogs zhib par gsung gleng mdzad pa dang / rgya tsha thugs rgyal bzhengs te nyi ma sang nas dmag dpung bsdus nas dmag rgyag rgyu yin gsungs pa'i glu len 'ga' re yod kyang nyob dogs bzhagalha sras ge sar rgyal por dgra lha na chung stag cha ma bdud mor brdzus nas phebs lugs/ slar yang ne ne'i bka' lung la bstun na rang cag pho byas legs lam mchis pa'i bka' lung bstsal bas zhal lu dkar pos gtsos dar 'phen dang sga sde/ dpa' la sogs lha sras ge sar rgyal po'i bka' ltar thugs gros mthun/ de nas zhag bdun song ba'i tho rangs glang gi dus tshod la/ ma ne ne gnam sman dkar mo de nyid zhabs la seng ge dkar mo chibs/ rol du ma he sngon mo khrid/ dbu rigs lnga'i thor tshugs ldem se ḍa ma ru'i 'phyang 'phrul shig se/ rus pa'i rgyan cha khrol le/ dar gyi cod paṇa su re/ phyag na thod pa'i ḍa ma ru khrol dngul gyi dril bu sil le/dri zhim spos dud tshubs se 'ja' dang 'od zer 'khyil le/ lta bas mi ngoms pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba/ bcu gsum lon pa'i lang 18 9

tsho can zhig byas nas mdun gyi bar snang la khra lam mer byon nas/gsung snyan pa gling bu ltar badza dang ma ṇi'i glu dbyangs lan gsum mdzad nas/ — gling skyes mchog ge sar rin po che/ thugs zhi ba byang chub sems nyid ngang / nga ne ne'i glu la gsan bzhes 'tshal zhes gsungs nas thang dkar ldem glu la drangs pa'i mgul glu 'di bzhengs so/ oṃ mi ṇi pad+me hūṃ/oṃ gu ru de wa ḍak+ki ye/rang sems dga' ba'i pho brang nas/bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum/ gsol ba 'debs so rgyab rten mdzod/sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun mkhyen/'gro drug bde la 'khod par shogam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral gong ma la/rgyal ba'i yum mchog sher phyin ma/shes rab nyams mgur tha la la yid ma yengs lhang nger gsol ba 'debs/skye 'gro shes rab dgongs pa rtogs/chos sku'i zhing la dbang bsgyur shogamakha' 'gro'i tshogs gral bar ma la rgyal yum rdo rje phag mo khong /ye shes lnga yi nyams dbyangs sgrog khams lnga gnas dag yum chen mo/ 19rte

—rang shar rang grol gsol ba 'debs/longs sku'i zhing la dbang bsgyur shog ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral mgo ma nas/ṭ+wāṃ~X byā ṭ+wāṃ ñcāni ༵ ṭ+wāṃkā ṭ+wāṃ dh+riljonā ṭ+wāṃ~X/ 'ching grol ngang nas gsol ba 'debs/ —skye 'gro snang shar lam la sbyor/ sprul pa'i zhing dang dbang bsgyur shog nga 'dra sku gsum mkha' 'gro ma/ ne ne gname sman dkar mo yin/ — ma shes blo yi rdzi bo yin/ ge sar rgyal po'i gros rogs yin/ —sdo ṭ+wāṃ/zlo bye ṭ+wāṃ / r+sha ༵ ༵༵ ༈༵ yo/ nga / shar skya rengs 'od dang 'grogs nas yong /ṭ+wāṃ~X byā ༵ngas spya ༵ ṭ+wāṃ~X ṭ+wāṃ ༵ ༵na/ /kā ༵tā ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃṭ+wā ṭ+wāṃ~X rjida' yang rung / dgra lha'i sring lcam stag chas ma/ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃngh+ru byeṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ ༷༵ hūm̐ṭ+wāṃ ༵/ ga 4 /nyi1

sna tshogs mthong ba'i cho 'phrul bstan/bsad bsad dpa' dam 'brug ltar grags/dgra jag gcod lugs gzu gcig brgyab/rgyal blon kun gyis bden par rtogs/mnol ba'i rdzas ngan chang dang sbyar/rgyal blon kun gyi dbang po 'grib/rdzas ngan du ma'i sbyor sde bduga'ago ba'i bdud lha nyam par byas/bdu srin mo yi snying khrag dang /drag sngags rdzas kyis bla mtsho skem/ bla yi chu gnas thabs kyis btul/bla yi mar me khrag gis skem/bla rten pha wang sta gris gshags/de'i nang bla srog dbyer med pa'i/sbal pa'i lus la sbrul mgo bdun/dngos yod mi yi 'dul skal las/rta mgrin dngos sprul khro thung la/bdud mor brdzus pa'i 'jigs bskul gyis/mi med gnas la a khu bos/ bla srog drag pos bsgral du bcugazhi bas gser phye'i gtang dag phul/drag po'i gshed bskur du ma btab/bdud la blo kha 'gyur nas yod/192

blo 'dun ge sar ma 'phyag yod/khro rgyal mkhyen pa mi che rāng /drag sngags nus pa tshad bzung med/mi 'gyangs gling la yong tan yod/yab sras khra mo gling la mkho/de gzhan nyams pa bdud kyis bslus/lhan gcig gling la sdod skal med/las bskos nam zla ci mtha' red/g.yu rtse gdug pa spun bdun 'di/rang yul skung lung bzung shor na/lo gsum gling gi ya lan dka'/ma zad bdud dmag rgyab bsnan na/gling mi rtar dka' ngal du ma 'byung /de snga bya ba bzang po 'grub/da phyin gling rje mi yi dbang /gling tsho drug phu mda' bar gsum nas/rje dpon dpa' rtul sum cu dang /zhe rtul khra glag spyang gsum dang /rang shog rta dmag brgya yis bskor/pho rgod mda' 'dzoms ga zhu 'dzoms dgos/snying bcud rgyal po med thabs med/dam nyam bdud kyi rgyal blon de/bdud dang btsan dang 'dre mo dang /193

dmu dang rgyal po the'u rangs dang / 'gong po 'dre btsan skye ba'i rgyu/ 4 rang rang stobs rtsal du ma yod/ a khu sgom chen gting med dang /che bgres bla ma bcu gsum phebs/khra mo dmag gi bsrung ba dgos/snga dro bka' brgyad bsnyen sgrub skyol / nyin dgung go lha sde brgyad gsol/ dgong mo bsad bzlog bsrangagasam zab/ ra ra༅rgyun par ting 'dzin srung 'khor gnad/skabs der bsur dang chang bu brngas/zi smad gnam khri bar ma nas/ dpa' rtul dpung gis sgug ma gyis/ dmag sgar g.yu ri'i 'ung lung zung /mi nyag g.yu rtse rgyal po de/ ge sar rje yi 'dul skal yin/nyem pa klu srin gdug pa'i bu/ mi ston rta sngon go mtshon sngo/ klu mgon stong thub ya med zer/dpa' tsha zhang 'dan ma—sa thod mda' sprod/mi nag rto nag go mtshon nagartem pa ba/dud kyi brdzus bu la/nag po stong 'dud lan med zer/194

chos skyong sga sde'i 'a dul skal yin/mi dmar rta dmar go mtshon dmar/dam nyams btsanagyi brdzus bu la/ dmar po btsan skya 'bum thub zer/ stag rong gzig 'phen 'dul skal yin /mi ljang rta ljangago mtshon ljang /nyam pa dgu yi brdzus bu yin/shed chen 'gran gyi ya med zer/de snang ngu g.yu stag 'dul skal red/mi ser rta ser go mtshon gser/dam nyam rgyal po'i brdzus bu la/ser po mi rgod ya med zer/ seng stag dpa' bo'i 'dul skal yin/ mi dkar rta dkar go mtshon dkar/nyam pa the'u rangs 'phrul gyi bu/dkar po shel me lag ring zer/ya med rgya tsha'i 'dul skal yin/ gzhis sdod bu mo khrag ral ma/dngos yod mi yis lag len dka' / khams gsum kun gyi srog bdag de/ 'ching byed dgra lha gnyan stag yin/'dul mi ma sang rgyal la bab/gzhan yang bdud dmag chig stong de/195

shi la mi 'tsher bu gcig red/gcig rgyab gnyis snon byed mi red/dpa' rtul yongs kyi dgra skal red/sdang dgra yu med bzos pa'i rjes/a mtshar po'i las shig byed rgyu yod/rin chen gter g.yang 'bebs sa yod/sde brgyad grogs la bsgyur rgyu yod/ bdud yul lha zhing bsgyur rgyu yod/bdud mi stong la bsgyur rgyu yin/de ring snon gyi tshes gsum la/dpa' dro'i g.yul chen 'gyed rgyu yin/de lugs dmag 'gro 'gal med mdzod/khyod lha zhal dung las dkar ba yin/nag phyogs mun pa sel bar shogaglu 'khrul pa byung na mthol lo bshags/ngag 'khyal ba byang na bzod par gsol/'gran med rgyarlo mchog thugs la zhogaces lung bstan de ltar gnang bas rgyal mchog gi thugs la zhib par rtogs nas gtang rag mi maṇ+ḍal phul/ ne ne rim gyis 'ja' ltar yal/ de nas nam gsal ba dang lhan/ dar 'phen dang / 'dan ma/ dpa' la sogs nang du bos nas lung bstan byung tshul gsungs pas thams cad shin tu spro ba'i ngang / gling gi rje dpon tshang ma la sku 'khor de drag rta pa brgya re bsdus nas tshes 196

dgu nyin ja mkhar rdzong du 'byor dgos pa'i bka' khyab bang mi dus gcig tu btang nas gling yul khyab nga/ra mdzad pas thams cad kyis mkhyen bzhin de drag rnams lha bla'i lung dang bstun te tshes dgu nyin rgyal mchog rin po che'i mdun du gri shubs nas phyungs pa ltar dpa' bo'i rngam zil 'tshub se dmag lnga stong tsam khas len du bud pa thams cad phyi rol du gur sna tshogs phub nas sgar gra bsgrigs thog rgyal mchog ge sar mdun mjal dar phul zhing tshoms chen du gdan rab bshams pa'i steng phu nu thams cad rang rang bab thob kyi gral la 'khod pa dang / rgyal blon tshang mas phun sum tshogs pa'i zas ston la longs spyad pa'i mthar/ rgyal mchog ge sar rin chen de nyid tshes bco lnga'i dung zla las mdangs gsal ba gzi brjid dang ldan pa'i ngang nas/ ka ye dpa' rtul phu nu dpung / ma ne ne gnam sman dkar mo des/ lung du gnang ba e 'dra 'dug gsungs nas dgra lha'i khrom chen zil gnon la drangs pa'i mgul glu 'di ltar bzhengs so/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu a la tha la tha la red/tha la la mo la la red/la la ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/gnas dgu pa'i dbyings kyi gzhal yas nas/dkon mchog rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i sku/rtsa rgyud dpal ldan bla ma la/gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas 'debs/197

byin rlabs thugs kyi klong nas stsol/khams gsum chos la 'khod par shogs 'di tshor rma khams gling yul zer/chos khrims srid gnyis kyi sa cha red/mi nga 'dra gling rje ge sar zer/ mi dang lha yis bskos le red/ blo ma rig mun pa bsal mi la a khu ga ne gom pa gson/'bum pa'i rgya tsha zhal dkar gson/gser pa'i nyi 'bum dar yag gson/dpa' rtul stag gzig gra rgyas gson/gson zer ba tshig gi rdo ga la/ bslu med lha yi bka' lung la/shar bdud gdug pa spun bdun de/smon lam log pa'i dam nyam bdud/klu srin bdud dang btsan gyi bu/dmu dang rgyal po the'u rangs dang /gri btsan 'gong po dam nyams rigs/lus can dngos su brdzus pa'i bu /cho 'phrul stobs rtsal yod do gsung /a khu sgom chen gting med dang /che bgres bla ma bcu gsum de/dmag sgar srung bar phebs dgos gsung /198

sgom bzlas bka' slob rim pas yod/sngon bkod yi ge nang gsal bzhin/che bgres gra 'bangs sum brgya la/sri zhu 'tsho sbyor ci dgos rnams/'gal med mu pa rang gis sgrub/mi nyag g.yu rtse rgyal po de/ge sar nga yis 'dul dgos gsung /klu srin gdug pa'i brdzus bu la/klu mgon stong thub ya med zer/rang mdog mi sngon rta sngon can/dpa' 'dan mas thod mda' sprod dgos gsung /nyam pa bdud kyi brdzus bu la/nag po stong bdud lan med zer/rang mdog mi sngon rta nag can/chos skyong sga sdes 'dul dgos gsung /nyam pa btsan gyi brdzus bu la/ dmar po btsan skya 'bum thub zer/rang mdog mi dmar rta dmar can/gzig 'phen dpon gyis 'dul dgos gsung /nyam pa dmu yi brdzus bu la/shel chen gral gyi ya med zer/rang mdog mi ljang rta ljang can/snang ngu g.yu stag 'dul skal gsung /199

nyam pa rgyal po'i brdzus bu la/ser po mi rgod ya med zer/rang mdog mi ser rta ser can/seng a dom khong gi 'dul skal gsung /nyam pa the'u rangs 'phrul gyi bu/dmar po shel mi lag ring zer/rang mdog mi dkar rta dkar can/dngatha' ya med zhal lu'i 'dul skal gsung /gzhan yang bdud dmag chig stong de/shi 'tsher med pa'i dpa' rgod khyu/dpa' rtul yongs kyi dgra skal gsung /gzhis sdod bu mo khrag ral ma/khams gsum kun gyi srog bdag mo/dngos yod mi yis lag len dka'/'ching byed dgra lha gnyan stag dang /'dul mi nga rang yin pas gsung /dgra bla'i sring lcam stag chas mas/bdud sde'i snying bcud dbang byed brdzus/bdud yul mdzad pa'i bya ba la/bdud yul bdud kyi bla gnas la/bla mtsho nag po gting med la/gdol pa nag po'i grong khyer chags/klu chen nag po mi bzan la/200

zla rer mar ngo'i nyer dgu'i dus/mi gson po re yi rngan mchod dgos/klu bdud chu srin mgo can la/rta dang nor phyug brgya 'bul dgos/der srog mchod phul na yul bde zer/ma zad bdud kyis bla nya bdun/nya chung khri khri kha la 'debs/lta bas mi bzod gdug rtsub can/bdud kyi bla gnas de rnams la/bdud mo dngos kyi snying khrag dang /rdzas ngan nag po dgu sbyor gnyis/bya khyung sngags kyi drag sbyor gyis/bla mtsho'i nang du btab pa yis/bla mtsho'i nang gnas gdol pa'i rigs/thams cad ming med mngon sum btul/gzhan yang nag phyogs gnas pa'i mtsho/dkar phyogs la bsgyur 'o mas mchod/nag phyogs rnams kyi mgon skyabs bral/sbug mdzod kun gyi yang phugs na/nyam pa'i tshe yi ngo bo la/khrag zhag mar me bdun po de/bdud mo'i snying khrag rdzas kyis btul/klu srin bdud kyi rten phur la/2(31

pha wang nag po dgu 'gril yod/de yang khong gis sta gris gshags/de'i nang gdug pa spun bdun gyi/bla tshe srog gsum gnas pa yi/sbal pa'i lus la sbrul mgo bdun/dngos can mi yis 'dul dgos stabs/rta mgrin sprul pa khro rgyal dpon/thabs mkhas ngang nas bsgral du bcugashin tu legs tshogs phun sum tshogs/de sngon bya ba yar ngo'i zla/bdud kyi rgyal blon tshang mas des/ rang yul skung lung bzung shor na/ lo gsum lan ya dka' 'o gsung /sring lcam bdud mor brdzus pa yis/thabs stobs du mas blo bslus nas/tshur la dmag jag chas nges yin/'di zla'i tshes pa bcu dgu la/dpa' bo'i g.yul 'gyed dus yin gsung /zi smad gnam khri bar ma na/dpa' rtul sgug ma dgos 'dug gsung /lha sgar khra mo'i dpung dmag 'dis/g.yu ri'i skung lung bzung dgos gsung /sdang dgra yu med bzos pa'i rjes/202

rin chen gte ra g.yang 'beb rgyu dang /sde brgyad grogs la bsgyur dgos gsung /bdud mi stongs la 'gyur rgyu dang / bdud yul lha zhing bsgyur dgos gsung /de tsho lha yi lung bstan red/ 'gro 'dug sgar bkod mi dgos pha/dpa' rtul dgra jag byang ma red/dpa' skong bslab bya mi dgos pa'i /phu nu dgra mda' zil ma red/rta brgyugs na bca' bcom mi dgos pa/'do chen rgyug rta byang ma red/khrab chen gsum phrugs ma dgos pa/srung ba rdo rje'i gur khang red/ nyu la ma so kha mi dgos le/ ye shes sgrib med lha lung yod/rgyal gzhan rgyab rten mi dgos le/dkar phyogs lha srung mnyam chas red/dmag 'gro babs mdzub 'dzugs mi dgos le/ khas len nga 'gro kho 'gro red/de gling dkar khra mo'i ya tshul red/song nas pho byas go chos de/smon lam lha yis bskos pa red/yul khams dge la bsgyur mi de/203

slob dpon pad+ma'i pho nya yin/khri srong lde'u btsan rnam 'phrul yin/dpa' rtul grub chen sha stag red/dgra mi thub zer ba srid dogs med/de tshe rten mchog bzang po'i mdun/gzhis sdod a khu ma sru yis/phyag skor mchod pa bzang po phul/smon lam bzang po'i rgyas 'debs mdzod/zla gcig gnyis tsam las 'gor dogs med/gru gsan na snying gi dga' ston gyis/ma gsan glu la don 'bras med/dpa' rtul phu nu'i thugs la zhogaces 'gag med rdo rje'i rang sgras de ltar bka' bstsal ba la tshang mas mngon par bstod/ a khu spyi dpon rgyal po'i bsam pa la/a khu'i ma yig po ti dmar chung na/ bde mchog nor bu'i dkyil 'khor na/ pha rigs seng la ma rigs klu/ rtsal rdzogs seng ge dkar mo de/ g.yu ral na tshod dus la rgyas/ shar rma rgyal gdangs ri'i ya bdag dus/ rgya stag shar ri'i nags la 'dzul/nags dug gi mtsho mo'i rba rlabs g.yo/ khyung chen mkha' nas lding ba'i dus/ klu bdud gdug pa ar la gtad/ snying nor che bdun gter rdzong 'byang / thabs shes sgron me ma sbar na/ dug mtsho'i 'ob la lhung rdogs yod/ zhor du brag dmar lho sgo phyes/spyang thang nag po'i mche bzhi choms/ byang g.yag kham pa zhags 204

khas 'tshos/ mtshams kyi sde 'bangs me tog bkra/ zhes pa'i lung dang mthun pas yun mi 'gor snyam pa sogs brnyas bcos byed mi nyan dgongs nas/ tsan dan gyi khri'i steng dmar yag stag gi gdan steng nas bgres nyams 'dzum zhal gyi ngang nas na re/ rgyal mchog gtsor bzhugs rgyal blon rnams/ a khu nga la dar gcig gson zer nas dal ba ring mo'i ngag la drangs nas glu 'di ltar blangs so/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu a la tha la tha la red/tha la la mo la la red/la la ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/gsol ba 'debs so thar lam drongs/'khrul snang bar chad zhi bar shog /sa 'di rma g.yang chags pa'i sa/bde skyid dpal gyi ra ba red/nga 'dra a khu ga ne gom/srid pa chags pa'i mi rgan yin/lha rabs gsum gyi lha rgan yin/gling dkar chags pa'i gzhung shing yin/phu nu 'du ba'i rten phur yin/ma sang rgyal po'i khu bo yin/blo yag nyes mthong ba'i mi rgan yin/3()5

de tsho gtam gyi yin lugs red/gser khri ser po'i gdan steng nas/rma bya'i gdugs kyi ma 'og na/dus gsum sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku/nag phyogs bdud kyi kha gnon che/ gling rje ge sar lha yi sras/lha sras 'dra ba'i zhal ras la/mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs/dpral bar yi ge a yis mtshan/dgra bla'i me stag tha ra ra wer ma'i zi ra 'tshub se 'tshub/'gran med chos rgyal rin po che/snyan lhang nge a khu nga la gson/g.yas gral dung khri'i gdan steng nas/gdong 'bum pa'i zhal lu dkar por gson/stod gling bar gling smad gling gsum/gling gi dpon chen gsum po gson/che rgyud stag rong sras gnyis gson/dar 'phen dug gi sdong por gson/ 'dan ma dpa' la sga sde gsum/phu nu dpa' rtul 'dir bzhugs gson/gson zer ba rgyal po'i bka' lung de/lha lung gser gyi thigs pa red/206

nor 'khrul med pa khrig khrig red/gnam la nyi zla skar gsum 'dzoms/mun pa gsal ba'i dus skabs red/sa gzhir rtsi bcud lo tog rgyas/skye 'gro'i dbul phongs sel ran red/bar la rgyal blon sde gsum 'dzoms/nag phyogs bdud sde 'joms ran red/a khu'i ma yig ludwa bstan la/bde mchog nor bu'i dkyil 'khor na/pha rigs seng la ma rigs klu/rtsal rdzogs seng ge dkar mo de'i/g.yu ral na tshod dus la rgyas/shar rma rgyal gangs ri'i ya bdag dus/nang rgya stag shar ri'i nags la 'dzul/nags dug gi mtsho mo'i rba rlabs g.yo/ khyung chen mkha' na lding ba'i dus/ zhor du brag dmar lha sgo phyes/spyang thang nag po'i mche bzhi bcom/byang g.yag kham pa zhags pas 'tsho/mtshams kyi sde 'bangs me tog bkra/de sogs lung bstan du ma 'dugad res brnyas bcos bya rgyu med/mi nyag g.yu rtse rgyal po de/ 207

sangs rgyas chos kyi bstan dgra red/ bdud chen bzhi yi nang gral red/dga' rabs mgon po'i phru gu red/cho 'phrul sna tshogs yod nges red/dam nyam gdug pa spun bdun de/smon lam dam nyam ru tra des/sde brgyad gdug pa'i brdzus bu la/dpa' ya dpung rogs gdol pa klu/dngos med bar chad nyer 'tshe che/dgon sum cus rgyal bka' dag tshar re/yul dud khyim mi res rgyal 'bum re/sngags phur thogs mi res gtor zlog re/shin tu do gal sri mnan byed/tshes grangs bzang la lha gsol te/yul grongs re res jo rgyun re/nga a khus gser phye zhal bu gang /chos dge ba'i mthun sbyor zhal 'debs yod/lha dkon mchog gsum po thugs rje myur/rtsa ba gsum po byin rlabs che/rkyen bar chad zlog pa the tshom med/lha mis dpung sdeb ma byas na/do gal rgyal kha thob par dka'/dpa' ba'i dpung tshan ma g.yos par/208

rang dgar brnyas pa byed rgyu med/rdzong srung dpung dmag sngar ltar bzhugs/phyi yi so srung dpung dmag de/dpa' ba'i dpung rogs chas na bsam/zhor du ci dgos shes le yin/lha yi lung dang sbrang char gnyis/sngo chem chem sa la ma bab par/lha bya 'jol mo ma gtogs pa/skye 'gro gzhan gyis dbye 'byed dka'/lha yi lung dang drag po'i mda'/'ur dir re 'ben la ma thebs bar/dpa' bo'i dpung mtheb ma gtogs pa/de gzhan kun gyis dbye 'byed dka'/lha yi lung dang gshin rje'i 'gas/zhags pa mgul la ma thebs bar/lha mngon mkhyen mnga' ba ma gtogs pa/'gro drug gzhan gyis dbye 'byed dka'/dpe ngan 'dren min te 'dra ma'i tshigargyal blon dbyings la bskor na bsam/lar spyir rgyal po'i bka' lung bzhin/bka' nyam med spyi bo'i gtsug la khur/dad 'dun pa bzang po snying la chongs/snying la 'chang bzhin zhe sha bskyed/2()1

bod dbu nag 'dug chus 'grub par shog sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas par shoganag phyogs mgo bo non par shog glu 'khrul ba byung na mthol lo bshags/ ngag 'khyal ba byung na bzod pa gsol/rgyal blon rnams kyi thugs la zhog ces glu de ltar blangs pa dang thams cad kyis bden par go nas legs zhus dang spyi dpon gyis yon sbyor gser dang mu pa gnam gyi rgyal por gser rdel tshad sum cu/ dpa' rtul mi res 'khos bstun phul bas dngul rdel tshad drug cu lhag byang ba spyi dpon gyi bka' bskul ltar gong rim gyis yon sbyor mdzajo/ gzhis sdod bla grwa pha khu ma sru mchog dman rnams kyis kyang gzhis byes lharna ma rgyas bar sku rim rgyun par g.yel med bsgrub rgyu'i khas len mdzad/zhag gsum bar dga' spro tshad med ngang bzhug༅ ne'u chung gi rmi lam la 'om bu dang mu spyang dpon la zhan par rmis pas rgyal blon yongs la drang por zhus pa na/ rgyal blon rnams kyis gzhis su bzhugs rgyu bka' yis bcad pa na dpon rnam gnyis kyis lhan du 'gro 'dod kyi glu re gnyis tsam yod pa nyob dogs kyis bzhag par gda'o/ de nas tshes bcu gsum nyin dgra bo rdung ba'i tho ba khra bo dmag gi ru dar/ 'bum dmag khra mo'i snying bcud 'dan ma g.yu rgyal thog rgod de mi sngon rta sngon go mtshon sngon po dgus bskor te g.yu 'brug mtsho las lang 'dra dang / 'bum dgu dmag gi a ya/sdang ba dgra bo'i gshed ma lan med gnam lcags thog lce dpa' ya 210

med zhal hūṃ dkar po de mi dkar/rta dkar go mtshon dkar pos bskor te lha tshangs pa g.yul du chas 'dra zhig byas nas phebs pa dang / mchan khebs dpa' bo mi dgus thog ser 'tshub pa bzhin dmag gi ru sne drangs / ru dkyil rgyal mchog ge sar nyid zhal ras bco lnga'i dung zla la mkhur tshos mtshal gyi thig le ris/ spyan mig khra la g.yu smin sngo/ tshems phreng dung la tshems rtse rno/ ljags srab zhal sgo rnam par dmar/ ye shes spyan rnam par bkra la dbu skra gnag snum 'ja' 'od 'khyil/ dgra bla wer ma sprin bzhin 'du/dgra bla'i go mtshon sna dgu sku la bzhes nas lha yi dbang po brgya byin g.yul la chas pa lta bu mjal phod dka' ba'i zil dang gzi brjid kyis khams gsum dbang du 'du le srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa zhig mdzad nas chibs pa rkyang rgod 'phel por 'do chas yongs rdzogs spras pa'i gong du thon pa dang phu nu dpa' rtul sum cus rang shog dmag gi ru sne drangs te thams cad lha phrug g.yul la chas pa ltar zil rngam 'bar ba grabs mtshungs stag gzig ri bor yan pa 'am 'brong khyu rdza lam gshog pa/ rta pho'i sna sgra dir re rmig bzhi sgra chen 'ur ri/ mi pho'i khrab 'od lhang se dar 'phru rgyal mtshan spungs se/ dpung dmag chig khri lhag tsam gyis bskor nas khra shig shig 'ur ldir phebs pa na/ sgrol ma dkar sngon gyi rnam sprul skya lo'i seng lcam 'brug mo dang ne'u chung lug gu'i tshar yag gnyis rma ri'i lha khog bar phebs skyel du byon nas rgyal blon phu nu rnams la skyel chang drangs shing / sgrol ma dkar mo'i skye ba seng lcam 'brug mo des mdzes gzugs rgyan chas mtshungs pa med pa'i ngang smon lam gyi 211

glu 'di dgu seng drug 'gyur la drangs nas blangs par gda'o /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ /glu a la tha la tha la red/ tha la la glu yi len lugs red/ la la ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/shar g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing khams nas/sgrol ma dkar mo tshe yi lha/'jigs pa brgyad las skyob mdzad ma/sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig la/gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes gzigs/rkyen ngan bar chad zhi bar mdzod/sa 'di rma yul dag pa'i zhing /rma lha ri rtse lnga'i mar sham la/bde skyid dga' spro'i sa cha red/nga 'dra skya lo'i sras mo la/mdo khams rgyal mo 'brug mo zer/sgrol ma dkar mo'i skye ba yin/skye gzugs bu mo'i phud gcig yin/shes rab yon tan che mi yin/skyabs 'gro smon lam 'grub mi yin/de ring lha nyi dkar po la/rtags dang rten 'brel legs pa'i dus/lha sras rgyal mchog khri la phebs/212

dpa' rtul phu nus mtha' nas bskor/dga' zer le bstan pa yar dar red/skyid zer le nyi ma tshur shar red/bdud kla klo'i mun pa rang dwangs red/rgyal blon nyi zla skar gsum de/khra 'khyil le mkha' nas shar ba'i dus/gling bzhir 'grim skor las kyis bskos/gza' dgra can kha rlangs mi dogs pa'i/tshangs pa lha yi dpung gnyen yod/rgyal blon dpa' rtul yongs rdzogs de/da res ar jag 'dul ba'i ched/dgra 'dul ba'i mgo mo tshugs pa'i dus/dgra lha rnams kyis srung bar shogawer ma rnams kyis skyob par shogakhrab dkar mo'i nang nas bzhed 'don 'grub/sku srog brag las sra bar shogarmog dkar mo'i nang nas dbu lo dkar/khams gsum zil gyis non par shogasked gri bkra'i rgyud nas dgra lha 'khor/mda' gzhu'i rgyud nas wer ma 'khor/ba dan rgyud na zo dor 'khor/sdang dgra'i glo snying len par shogagater rdzong bod la 'bebs par shog

zhabs dar lham mnabs yob chen gnon/bdud kla klo'i mgo bo non par shog— rta 'do chen bcibs nas 'dzam gling skor/r+ghaṃ gling chen dbang du 'du bar shog sku bsod ri rgyal lhun po la/ dbang thang nyi zla'i mgul rgyan can/bsod nams rol mtshos mtha' nas bskor/'bangs 'khor 'gro drug zad med bzhin/dbus ri rab ji bzhin g.yo med shog ri rab yon tan ci mnga' ba rgyal blon yongs la 'dzoms par shog nyi zlas gar khyab chos kyis khyab/ rigs drug 'dren pa'i bla ma shogamun pa sel ba'i sgron me shog dbu nag yongs kyi gtsug rgyan shog rgya le'u can gyi bdag po shog rgya gar chos kyi bdag po shog bal ras dkris can gyi mnga' bdag shogalha nas bskos pa'i chos rgyal bzhin / nyam pa'i bar gcod mi 'byang zhing /'gro don 'bad med lhun rgyob shogade ring 'dren pa'i bdud rtsi'i chang / bod kyi 'bru chang sngon mo dang / 214

'bras mo ljongs kyi 'bras chang dang /tsha ba rong gi rgun chang dang / 7chang rigs mi gcig du ma'i chang tshe dpag med dang pad+ma 'byang /grub rgyal rnams kyi tshe chang zesres/mkha' 'gro'i tshe chang bdud rtsi 'di/de ring rgyal blon yongs la 'dren/dbu 'phang mtho ba'i rten 'brel yod/sku tshe ring ba'i rten 'brel yod/ci bsam grub pa'i rten 'brel yod/rten 'brel bdud rtsi'i legs chang 'di/yang yang gsol la yang yang 'dren/ dus rgyun par 'dren pa'i smon lam 'debs/dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum/mdo khams gling gi lha srung rnams/ mi 'bral gos kyi gong ba bzhin/dpa' rgyal blon rnams dang mnyam chas mdzod/shar bdud gdug pa thul bar shogache nor g.yang du lon par shogasnyan pas phyogs kun khyab par shogade ring bzang mo yag la phebs phebs zer nas sang la zhal mjal shogasku rgyal blon 'di bzhin mjal bar shog pe/ da

glu 'gal 'khrul shor na mthol lo bshags/'gran med rgya blon thugs la zhog ces glu de ltar blangs shing skyems chang bdud rtsi yang yang drangs/ de nas rgyal blon rnams chibs gong du thon pa dang lhan ne chung lug gu tshar yag gis gser dngul gyi dong rtse du ma dang bkra shis pa'i dar re btang nas smon lam gyi glu 'di ne chung gi rang glu drug 'gyur la drangs nas phul lo/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ glu a la tha la tha la red/tha la glu yi len lugs red/la la ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/shar po tā la yi zhing khams nas/spyan gzigs sgrol ma dkar sngon la/yid mos pa chen pos gsol ba 'debs/thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes bzung shogs 'di rma zla sgang gi yul/'dzam gling sa yi lte ba la/rma yul bde mchog nor bu'i zhing /chos rgya gar chags pa'i gdam ya yin/rgya gar gdam ya zer ba'i don/chos gser bris nyi ma shar ba 'dra/dngul bris zla ba tshes pa 'dra/dung bris rgyu skar bkrag pa 'dra/216

g.yu bris nam mkha' dngas pa 'dra/mtshal bris me lce mched pa 'dra/chos rtsig a sngon dgung dang mnyam/gter byon lha yi sku tshab la/'phur lding gsung sgron ngo mtshar can/chos che ba'i lo rgyus bshad tshod med/khrims rgya nag chags pa'i ngo ya yin/khrims yig zhal lce bcu gsum yod/khrims dung dkar mo rgyang grags yod/khrims rnga gsal ba 'brug grags yod/khrims thang khrims chas rang 'grig yod/'dzam gling chags pa'i sa cha red /'dzam gling rgyal sa zer ba'i don/gser khri lang ma ling rtseg steng /bla bre nam mkha' khyab par brgyab/dar khra rin chen phyug mo phyar/ mdzes byed rma bya'i dbu gdugs phub/dbu gdugs de 'dra'i ma 'og na/sku mi 'gyur 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs/gsung mi 'gyur 'gro 'dul spyan ras gzigs/thugs mi 'gyur phyag na rdo rje dngos/rigs gsum sprul pa chos kyi rgyal/ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul bzhugs/

dgra mgo rdung ba'i tho ba la/ dpon chen dpa' rtul sum cu bzhugs/yang 'khor ru 'dren brgyad cu byang /lho 'dzam gling gzhan la re dgorlo med/ chos rgyal khrims dar ba'i sa cha red/nga 'dra sngo lo'i ne'u chung la/chung nas bsam pa chos la mos/che rgyus dpa' mdzangs mi ldan te/ smon lam bden pa 'grub mi yin/ 'dzam gling skyong ba'i rgyal blon rnams/'du 'khyil le gzhi4bral gnon pa'i dus/tshangs pa lha 'khor 'du ba 'dra/'ur chil le dmag la phebs pa'i dus/brgya sbyin yul du bskyod pa 'dra/ dpa' rtul 'khor gyis bskor ba'i dus/nye dbang las la chad pa 'dra/ blta bas mi bzod gzi brjid kyis/sde brgyad mi min lha 'dre dang /khams gsum srid gsum dbang du 'du/de ring rten 'brel thog ma la/ shar bdud 'dul la phebs pa'i dus/ lha o rgyan pad mas kha 'dzin mdzod /dbu dar 'phra 'di le 'bral med shog218 ༄ 4

lha chen tshangs pa dkar po dang /phu bo dung skyong lha 'khor 'bum/sku rgyal blon rnams la kha 'dzin mdzod/rmog dkar 'di la 'bral med shogaganyan chen sku lha ger mdzo dang /dgra bla gnyan stag lha 'khor 'bum/sku rgyal blon rnams la kha 'dzin mdzod/khrab dkar mo 'di la 'bral med shogaklu chen gtsug na rin chen dang /klu sbrul 'od chung klu 'khor 'bum/sku rgyal blon rnams la kha 'dzin mdzod/sked 'khor gsum 'di la 'bral med mdzod/rma rgyal spom ra gzhi bdag tshogs/rta mgrin rta lha re man ta/sku rgyal blon rnams la kha 'dzin mdzod/sku dgra lha lha 'khor bye ba 'bum/wer ma dgu khri dgu 'bum bcas/sku rgyal blon rnams la kha 'dzin mdzod/gos gong ba bzhin du 'bral med shogarma khams gling gi lha srung dang /bod kyi mgul lha bcu gsum dang /dge bsnyen nyi shu rtsa gcig dang /bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis dang /3 19

dregs pa'i ded dpon sum cu dang /sngags bdag dregs chen bco brgyad dang /dkar po'i phyogs la mgon dga' rnams/sku rgyal blon rnams la mgon skyabs mdzod/lus grib ma bzhin du 'bral med shog phebs zer na khri gdugs nyi ma de/nub nas yol kyang shar nas shar/gling bzhi 'od kyis gsal ba bzhin/sku rgyal blon byes 'gro'i don gnyer te/lhun gyis 'grub pa'i bkra re shis/bdud nag po'i kha rlung ma stog par/zil chil le tshur tshur phebs pa shogasteng na bzhugs pa'i dkon mchog lha/rtsa rgyud bla mas srung bar shogasku rgyal blon rnams la kha 'dzin mdzod/g.yas na dpa' bo bye ba 'bum/gar gyi stang stabs khrig se khrig g.yon na mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi sdes/ dgyes pa'i brda glu kyu ru ru/ sku rgyab dgra bla wer ma rngam/rngam pa'i bzhad sgra lhang se lhang /mdun na dam can chos skyong 'tshub/ bran ltar las byed sha ra ra/ 220

rgyal blon rnams dang 'bral med gyis/gdug pa'i dam sri thul bar shogabadud snying sha lha yi rngam zas mdzod/snying khrag chos skyong dpa' skyems mdzod/bdud kla klo'i bstan pa mthur du gnon/chos dge ba'i bstan pa dgung la bstod/dam chos skyid kyi nyi ma de/'dzam gling yongs su khyab gyur cig—sku bgres med gdon gyis mi tshugs shing /tshe dpag med dang mnyam par shogagasung la 'gag pa med par shogatshangs dbyangs chos kyi sgra sgrog shogathugs la 'khrul pa mi mnga' zhing /skye med chos sku'i don rtogs shogayon tan 'phrin las mtha' rgyas te/khams gsum srid gsum dbang 'dus shogagong ma lha yi bden tshig de/ bar ma mi nas 'grub par shogatshangs pa lha yi bden tshig dang /khro bo rnams kyi mthu rtsal dang /nor lha rnams kyi dngos grub dang /dam can chos skyong kha 'dzin bcas/'bad med ci bsam lhun grub pa/221

sku rgyal blon yongs la bden 'grub shogade ring lha nyin bzang la phebs/sang gling yul nor bu'i sa cha la/ser 'khyil le gser zhal mngon par shoga'ur dir ri gsung sgra sgrog par shogadaga' ya le'i thugs 'dun gnang bar shogasmon lam gang btab 'grub par shogaglu 'khrul ba byung na rje blon bshags/ngag 'khyal ba byung na bzod par gsol/rgyal blon rnams kyi thugs la zhogaces glu de ltar phul zhing gzhis sdod yongs kyis phyag dang smon lam bcas mjal dar phul/ rgyal blon rnams nas 'brug mo dang ne'u chung gnyis la dar lan dang dbu thod bstsal zhing phan tshun 'bral mi phod sa tsam gyi ngang du phebs/ skyel ma rnams kyis gling gi bla grwa rjes phebs rnams la'ang bkra shis kyi dar dang gser dngul gang 'byor rten 'brel gyi tshul du phul zhing smon lam bkra shis bden tshig zhus te gling gzhis su tshur phebs nas sku rim dang dge ba rlabs chen la brtson zhing bde bar bzhugs so/ de yi dus gling dkar khra mo'i bla grwa dang rje dpon tshang ma rma la'i rtse la bar ma brgyab nas zhag lnga'i gong zi ma yul gyi ma tha/ zi chim rgyal gyi tshur tha/li mi bal rgyal gyi ya tha khra mo gling gi sa mtshams zi la'i gnam khri bar ma/ rgya yar mar tshong pa'i gshar lam/ dben lung de'u chen bcu gsum/ tshogs rten gral star bsgrig 'dra/ de'u chen re re'i 222

bar na/ spang ljongs gser gzhong 'dra bcas shin tu btsan pa'i gnas der/ sgar dkyil lha dang bla ma/ bla ma'i chos sgra 'ur re de'i phyir rgyal blon las gur/ rgyal blon 'du ra 'khyil le/ de'i phyir drag po'i dmag sgar/ dpung chen las gur mngog sna lnga'i gur tshon bsgrigs nas 'ur chil le sgar babs༈ ri chen re re 'i dkyil gshong na rta khyu rnams las dmag gis 'tshos/ lha dang bla ma rnams/ ma dang mkha' 'gro'i brda lung ltar g.yel ba med par sgrub la brtson/ a khu sgom chen gting med/ yongs med rang grol chen po/ grub chen chos kyi bla ma sogs bla chen gsum ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs nas srung ba rdo rje'i gur khang rgyun chad med par bsgoms shing / dam nyams dgra bos mi tshugs nga/ mdzad do/de yi dus su gdug pa bdud kyi yul du ni ar jag jag rkatsha gyi gtso bo/ bdud kyi rgyal blon bdun pos nga 'gro khas cherno gyi dmag 'chi 'tsher med pa gcig stong gcig brgya lhag gong tshes brgyad nyin bdud kyi pho brang 'gram du 'dus te thams cad gdol pa'i nags ri rngam pa dang / bdud kyi dug mtsho nag po sogs bla gnas rnams la sha khrag gi mchod pa'i yo byad khyer nas song bas bla ri nag po'i rtse nas lha ma dga' bas ser ba dras po dang thog dmar gsum lhung bas dmag khrod kyi rta gsum dang bdud dmag lnga bsad/ than gyi wa mo brgyal/ mtsho la 'ja' 'od 'khrigs/ klu byas ngas ngur gyi skad byin/ klu ras dkar gyi thod dkris can mang pos nges cag dkar phyogs la gnas pa yin pas sha khrag gi mchod nga mi 'dod zer snang gi sgra byung ba thos/ sngar gnas pa'i klu ring sa 2 2 she

ba/dol pa nag po dang / klu mi bzan/ chu srin mgo can/bdud kyi bla nya sogs ci yang ma mthong bas rgyal blon rnams shin tu blo dogs skyes nas dmag bshol rgyur gros ma byas par bsam pa phyogs gcig tu mthun pa na/ lha klu gnyan gsum gyis bdud dmag bshol bar mkhyen nas de ma thag dgra bla wer ma'i sprul pa gong gi gdol pa nag po dang / klu nag mi bzan/ chu srin mgo can bla nya sogs 'a/ sprul te sngar las dgu 'gyur gyis rngam pa lta bas mi bzod pa mer mer yer yer du mthong ba sha khrag sogs mchod pa'i yo byad thams cad dga' ba'i nyams dang bcas te rol ba mthong bas/ bzang ngan 'dres pa'i rtags mtshan mthong nas rdzong du phyir log dgra bla'i sring lcam dbang byed mor sprul pa de nang po klu yi dmag g.yar du song ba yin zer nas yud tsam nas sprul pa'i dmag gi sgam gcig khyer nas byang ba dang / sgam de'i nang nas 'ur 'ur dir dir shig shig mi r+shad dang mi mtshungs pa'i glu dang gtam bshad pa sogs phyi rol la lhang lhang thos pa na rgyal blon rnams kyis 'di na dmag grangs ci 'dra yod na zer bas/sprul pa'i dbang byed mas bdud kyi rgyal blon rnams dogs pa bsal zhing blo bde ba'i phyir glu 'di rang ngag la drangs nas blangs so/glu 'u na a lu thu lu red/ tha lu 'o na la lu red/la lu ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/ sha khrag rgya mtsho 'khyil klong nas/sman nga la 'go ba'i lha srung mkhyen/2to4

gos gong ba bzhin du 'bral med skyong /sha dang khrag gi mchod pa 'bul/rtags ma a sngon dgung la bstod/rang chus mi nyams brtan par shogs 'di gdol pa bdud kyi yul/ sha dmar za zhing khrag dmar 'thung /gsod la spro zhing jag la skyid/longs spyod 'dzoms pa'i sa cha red/nga 'dra 'dri bshad ma dgos pa'i/sa gzhi chags pa'i rten phur yin/nam mkha' chags pa'i dgung thig yin/dpag bsam shing gi sdong po yin/ bdud sde chags pa'i a ma yin/lha mi 'du ba'i a ma yin/bsgrangs mi dgos yul sde kun gyis shes/'gran med g.yu rtse rgyal blon gson/ nga lo rgyus gtam gyi bang mdzoda'an/ 4snga dro thogs med 'bu rar phyin/ mi min lha 'dres zer srol la/ sde brgyad drag rtsal ngom pa dang /bzang ngan 'dres pa'i cho 'phral red/ khyod rgyal blon re dogs che btī rkyen/ 5sems dogs pa med na mchog go zer/225

dgong mo klu yul zhang rtsar song /'gro lugs spyod lam gros gcig byas/rgyal kha thob pa'i gsung bzang gnang /rogs su drag po'i 'khrul sgam g.yar/sgam 'dir 'jig rten kun shong zer/rang dgar mi yis mjal chog med/gdol pa nag po'i snying nor red/nang na las dmag dgu khri yod/dung gi mi la dung gi rta/dung gi khrab rmog 'khor gsum can/g.yu yi mi la g.yu yi rta/g.yu rmog g.yu khrab rang mtshungs yod/bya ru'i mi la byar khrab can/rmyor rmog byarngo khrab rang mtshangs yod/rgoser gyi d+me la gser gyi rta༄/gser rmog gser khrab rang mtshungs yod/dngul gyi mi la dngul gyi rta/ dngul khrab dngul rmog rang mtshungs yod/zangs kyi mi la zangs kyi rta/zangs khrab zangs rmog rang mtshungs yod/lcags kyi mi la lcags kyi rta/lcags khrab lcags rmog rang mtshungs yod/mi re dpa' ba'i ngar lam la/226

ri rab yin yang rgyang du 'phen/rgya mtsho yin kyang hub kyis 'thung /'jig rten yin yang bla 'og bsgyur/mi re re'i stobs la 'gran rgyu med/don gal po che la rim gyis gsal/ sngar bka' bcad gasko ra gyi ri mo 'di/phyis blo 'gyur bsam pa zhe la med/rgyal blon jag la phebs pa'i gzhis/dgra la 'tsher bsam zhe la med/rgyal blon dpa' rgod lan med bu/gling sdug tsam la mi dgos pa'i/lho 'dzam gling rub kyang thub bsam med/nga yang byes la sems khral med/khyed rnams nged la thugs khral spong /zla ba gcig gi gong mtshams nas/bya rgod po brag la 'khor ba bzhin/gzhis rdzong mkhar khra mor phebs par shogade rjes bdud chos ci gos lta/rab na gling dkar rgyal sa 'phroga'abring na kha dbang nor dang phral/mtha' na dpa' rtul mgo ske len/rtags ma dgung la grags nges yin/e zer ltos la mi zer ltos/227

rgyal blon thugs dang a ma'i sems/phyi tshal mi gcig so so yang /narngo don srog gi ngo bo gcigakhyad par dbye ba su yis nus/sna khrid stag rong lam rgyus mkhas/ dga' rab dbang phyag sdong grogs myar/klu bdud gdol pa (ba rten che/ ༄ g.yu rtse rgyal po dbang thang mtho/gdug pa'i blon chen dpa' rtsal che/bdud dmag chig stong thog las tsha/dgra mi thub zer ba srid dogs med/glu rgyal blon rnams kyi thugs la zhogaces zer bas rgyal blon thams cad dpa' tshud nas de byas grags rgyu yod pa zhig bya bsams nas yid gnyis med pas sems hril thag chod/ nyi ma de yi phyi nangs skya rengs shar ba'i dus 'gro 'ga'/ med pa'i las la brtson te nam langs pa dang / klu mgon stong thub ya med de mi sngon rta sngon go mtshon sngon po rnga phru bya 'phru can 'jigs su rung ba'i dpa' tshul can dang nag po stong bdud lan med de mi nag rta nag ral pa dmar nag lcags kyi khrab rmog 'khor gsum bskor te bdud kyi rgyal po las la chas pa ltar gyis dmag gi ru sna khrid/ khro thung dang gdong btsan rgu ru bu yi kher rgod sogs stag rong dpon blon lnga yang sa dang lo rgyus yod phyir chas/ dmag sked du mi nyag g.yu rtse rgyal po dang / dmar po btsan skya 'bum 228

thub/ ser po mi rgod ya med gsum 'khor gsum rgyan gyis sprab /mgyogs pa'i rta la bzhon cho 'phrul mi zad pa'i dpa' rngam brjing gsum ldan pa'i ngang dmag dkyil chas/ ru rgyab dkar po 'el chi) lag ring de mi dkar rta dkar seng ge la g.yu ral rgyas pa lta buḍi dī nyams 'bar ba zhig byas/ 'khor du sger thub blon po dguru/ bskor nas bdud kyi ar jag dpon blon rnams the tshom med par shar gling dkar la song nas de byas bod la grags pa zhig bya bsams te bskyod nas de nub zi la'i tshur nang la sgar btab/de'i phyi nangs zi rong nas brgyud so lta byi mgo dang glag sder ma gnyis kyi phyogs la thon nas song yang sngar ltar du bsu ba dang che bkur byed mkhan ma byung bas rgyal blon rnams kyis so srung bdud mo gnyis 'dug sa'i nang du bltas pas nang du yang mi 'dug ci yin na bsams shing blo dogs shar ba dang lhan yang ma ne nes de ma thag bdud mo gnyis ji lta ba bzhin brdzus nas 'phar ba dang gla ba la bzhon pa'i tshul gyis der 'byor nas bdud kyi rgyal blon la gus gus zhum zhum gyi glu blangs pa kha shas yod kyang dgos med nyob dwogs kyis bzhag mnol rdzas sna tshogs btab pa'i dug gi myos chang rgyal blon rnams la ngoms par drangs so/ de nub zi la'i la rtsar sgar babs/ de nas rim gshar mus gling rje mi yi nyi ma dus gsum sgrib med des bdud kyi rgyal blon nye bar slebs yod tshul gsungs pa dang / de yi dus su dpa' bo g.yul chen 'gyed pa la snying nas dga' ba cher rgyas pa/ 'bum pa'i zhal lu dkar po dang / dpa' tsha zhang 'dan ma byang khra/ dar 'phen dug gi sdong 229

rnga sgyu/ gzig 'phen dar gyi thig le/ dpa' rgod nya tsha a brtan/4rtsesher pa'i nye ma 'bum thub/ stobs chen chos skyong ber nag bdun po rang (ngakhor blon po ger thub bcu res bskor nas/ nga nga/'a mi rngam zil shig se/ rta byang ma'i 'gros stabs lam me/dag lha wer ma sprin bzhin 'dus te/ lha dang bla mas rab gnas dang srung ba 'gyed nas myur stabs su phebs nas zi la'i gnam khri/ bar ma nas bsgugs pa dang / de nub bdud kyi rgyal blon rnams rmi lam dang nyams ltas shin tu ngan par byang nas nangs par rgyal blon thams cad gros ra la 'tshogs pa na r+sha le lag ring gis the'u rangs 'phrul gyi sho rdel btab pa na dgra ngo che bar babs pas/srin po brag gi mar sham spang del chen gyi khug so der sgar bab/klu mgon stong thub ya med dang / the'u rangs bu she le lag ring / ser po mi rgod ya med gsum nyul ma la 'gro/ sne khrid sa rgyus mkhan gdong a dpal 'gro dgos pa sogs bdud kyi a blon gyis gros thag bcad pa dang a khu'i bsam par nga lha na du song na dga' bsdad na mi legs/ mdang gsum gling gi lha mi mang pos bsus pa rmis pas/ gling gi rgyal blon la lha yi lung bstan pyung yod pa thag chod/ lar bdud kyi rgyal blon dpa' ngar che ba las dpung tshan cher mi 'dug nga rang stag rong dpon po ni da lta 'bangs g.yog las zhan pa bdud mo dbang byed mas de sngon mi 'os pa'i rdung rdeg dang mtshang 'dru rngan chen de tsam bton/ blon tshogs dang rgyu nor dre'u bcas bdud yul du lus kyang 'gyod pa ci yod/ bdud kyi rgyal blon mngon sum red 'dug pas gling ge sar gyis 'dul dgos 230

pa smos ci dgos/ de dus mi dang rgya nor rang lag yin bsams nas na re/ a pho blon chen rnam tho tsho/ pho gsar bu la zhad gcig yod/ pho rab pho 'bring pho mtha' gsum/ pho mtha' so la 'gro ba'i dus/ sngon bya ra mi shes phag dang 'dra/ rjes phyi ltas med pa 'dre dang 'dra/ lus sbas skung mi shes ke re re/ so phar la mthong khar tshur la mthong / lus 'khor gsum sha le dgra lag 'gro/ pho 'bring so la 'gro ba'i dus/ sngun spyang ki lta bu'i so zhig byed/ rjes sre mong lta bu'i bya ra byed/ sgang gshong rgyud nas bya ra byed/ tshur la mthong dus phar la mthong / don ci dgos blo la skor rdzogs byed/ pho rab so la 'gro ba'i dus/ sngon ri la bya ra nyi ma shar/ rjes la phyi bltas zla ba shar/ nyi zla'i blo gsal bya ra byed/ lus de sgang 'bur grib la nyal/ rdo shing phung rgyud nas so gcig byed/ dgra jag pas mthong khar rang gis mthong /mnang tshur chod bsam don yid bzhin 'grub zer yang zer la bden yang bden/ nga mi rgan nyams myong che ba'i bu/ bu rnams lhan du phebs pa na/ nga yang lhan du 'gro rgyu yin/ gling ngam ar jag su thug na'ang nged rnams la dgra phyi nang dbye ci med/ de'i nang tshan nga rang la jo ru spun sogs dgra dang thug na lhag par sdang nges yin pas de lugs mi rgan yang ma phyin na sems kyis mi bzod pas lhan du 'gro ba yin zer bas/ klu mgon na re/ nged rnams kyi rta 'di tsho brgyugs na nam mkha'i bya rjes zin pa'i rta yin pas dpon khyod kyi rta 'dis rjes zin sa ma red zer bas khro thung na re/so dang bya ra byed cing 'gro ba la de tsam brel ba'i don ci yod/231

g.yu bya dang rkyang rgod gnyis kyis rjes zin pa rgyal khab su la'ang yod dka' ba de gnyis kyi rjes rta 'dis zin gyi yod/ rta gzhan gyi rjes mi zin pa e srid na zer nas ha bgad byas pa dang /bdud blon rnams kyi rta yang bdud kyi 'phrul rta yin stabs shin tu mgyogs pas rjes zin mkhan su med snyam pa'i nga rgyal yod pas tshig de thos ma thag mtshang la phog nas/ da 'o na 'gro 'gro zer/ a khu yang 'gro rgyu thag chod nas za btung byas/ mgyogs pa'i rta la sga gtad srab bkon/ 'gro chas sogs khyer/ 'khor gsum rang mdog ltar bskor te/ shin tu mgyogs pa bya 'phur ba ltar yong bas/ phyed yos lug gi chu tshod der zi la'i gnam khri bar ma'i thang dkyil du brag ri zhig yod pa'i 'gram na dpa' rtul rnams kyis bsgugs nas yod par bdud blon gsum dang gdong btsan bcas mgyogs pa'i dbang gis bya 'phur ba bzhin gling phyogs la gtad nas 'gro ba'i lam khar gshar byang ba dpa' rtul rnams kyis gzigs pa na sha khyis sha ba mthong ba hor mi bzod pa'i nga rgyal cher 'khrugs te gcig shul gnyis thog gyis blon 'khor rnams der bzhag ste dpa' rtul bdun po su yin 'dri ba la chas pa ltar phebs pas kho pa rnams kyis mthong nas gdong btsan ni ngo tsha ba dang rgya tsha la shin tu zhed pa'i stabs ngag 'dar ba'i ngang nas gzigs dang blon chen rnam pa gsum/ pha gi'i mi bdun rta bdun 'di/dpyad na gling gi dpa' rtul 'dra/ dpung med byang thang thug lugs la/ las yag po ma byung tshar nas 'gi/ myur bar phyir log byas na bsam zer bas/ bdud kyi 'phrul blon rnams de sngon 232

dpa' rtsal rgod khas btsan pa'i stabs kyis tshig de thos pas gdong btsan la shin tu zhe khrel yang ci ma zer/ de ma thag bdud kyi 'phrul blon thams cad dpung pa'i sha rgod phrig mtheb mo'i srang sha rgyas/ rmog dkar 'dabs ra phab/ khrab dkar gyi rgyun thag bsdams te dgos pa'i chas grabs yongs su rdzogs par byas te mi gsum de phyi chad med par shar rgyag gling dkar dpa' rtul gyi gdong der hril hril byung ba na/ 'bum pa'i zhal lu dkar po de dpa' rngam gyis thog ser 'khrug pa dang stobs rtsal dpa' rgod cher rgyas bzhin/ rta pho rgya bya sog dkar de ngar chen gyis rgyug 'dur byas te nye bar thon pa dang rta kha bkag ste dpa' glu 'di ltar blangs par gda'o/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu a la tha la tha la red/tha la la mo la la red/la la ngag gi 'gug lugs red/gnam a sngon shel gyi gur khang nas/lha chen tshangs pa lha 'khor 'bum/da res 'bod do mkhyen pas gzigs/chos dkar po dbu 'phang mtho bar shogabar snang skyi bser rgyu lam nas/ser po gser gyi sku mkhar nas/gnyan chen sku lha gnyan 'khor 'bum/da res ma g.yel kha 'dzin mdzod/233

lus 'khor gsum can gyi dgra lha mdzod/sa gzhi rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i gnas/ sngon po g.yu yi mkhar nang nas/gtsug na rin chen klu 'khor 'bum/kha 'dzin mdzod la rkyen ngan sol/zo dor rma rgyal spom ra mkhyin/sdang dgra sgrol la snying khrag 'thungs/dkar po'i bstan pa dgung la bstod/sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na/zi ma rong gi sa mtshams na/khra mo gling gi pha tha na/mdo khams gnam khri bar ma zer/rtsi me tog gnyis kyi pha yul red/rta rkyang gnyis kyi rtsed ra red/gcan spyang jag pa'i 'grim lam red/khram pa dpon med sdod sa red/bu nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na/rma khams gling yul khra mo nas/brgya rtsa brgyad sa tsha'i 'bum khang nas/stong rtsa brgyad mchod rten ra ba nas/khra shig shig ma ṇi'i rdo mkhar nas/rdzong mi 'gyur dngul chu khro rdzong nas/'bum pa'i zhal lu dkar po zer/234

byams pa gnyen gyi skyabs gnas yin/sdang ba dgra yi kha gnon yin/smug po gdong gi rgyud pa yin/de tsho yin lugs 'dra ma red/chu phar kha'i mi bzhi rta bzhi can/brel tshub tshub gang la 'gro le yin/rgyab pha yul gang nas yong le yin/ sgos mi sngon rta sngon dar 'phru can/rta mgyogasal bya rjes zin mdog kha/nyams dpyad na gdong btsan a dpal 'dra/snying med rus med shig gu chung /pho mtshang tshong dgra la phyag rgya bca'/pha bla tshong khro lu ḍa ru mgo/gling sde pas ma dris lo rgyus shes/bu khyod la de 'dra yod snang med/gling dkar khra mo'i spyi glud khyod/pho—ro phar ma 'gro tshar tshar shogangs stag rong gzhos rlo mi 'jog re/mtshon sngon mo khyod 'a/ rdeg le min/lha goje ma'i bka' dgongs 'ga' dwogs yod/tshig bden 'bras a lan rim rim yod/khyod da rung phar phar 'gro srid na/mtshon rnon pos kham bgos mi byed re/

glu mang po mi len zur la bud/zur la bud na mtha' gzhi brling /de gzhan mi gsum glu la nyon/shar gling dkar nor bu'i sa cha la/'dre nag pos thog brdzis ci go red/lha yul dag pa'i sa cha la/bdud nag dngos rgyug ci go red/chos ldan 'phags pa'i gdan sa la/bdud mu stegs sgar 'debs ci go red/kha sang zla ba sngon ma la/bdud mo gling dkar stod la byung / de byas rtags ma len bsams te/gling rje lha yi mi dbang des/ bdud mo thar pa'i lam la drangs/de ring byang ba'i bdud blon gsum/chag sgorlo rgyab nas ded le red/byur rkyen gyis sngun nas bsus le red/bos dang a gnyis 'phrad le red/ra tshe zad sgang gi ri rtse 'grim/dmar thar re gsod pa'i snga ltas red/nya tshe zad zan gyi rjes la 'brangs 'gul shig se bzung ba'i snga ltas red/gla tshe zad gla rnga shing la brdar/236

rtsi bzang drug 'tshor ba'i snga ltas red/bdud tshe zad byang thang jag 'a/ chas/de ring yong ba ma lo gda'/nged gling mi mi bdun rta bdun 'di /sngon gyod da gyod gnyis ga'i don/gal chen rgyang nas chas le yin/ chas zer na don 'bras smin le byed/srog gces na mgo rgu phyag 'bul gyis/de min thar bsam zhe la med/glu go na tshig la ster lan gyis/ma go glu la 'bras bu med/skya mi gsum yid la de ltar zhogaces glu de ltar blangs pas bdud kyi brdzus bu gsum po de glu de thos pas shin tu ngar chen 'bar bas/ de'i nang nas the'u rangs 'phrul gyi bu brgyud she le lag ring des rang dang mnyam pa'i mi gsum dbye ba 'byed mi shes pa ltar byas nas shin tu che ba'i nyams dang bcas gri yi dpa' lung la bcangs nas ngar chen gyi glu 'di ltar blangs par gda'o/glu 'u na a lu tha lu red/tha lushu na la lu red/la lu glu yi len lugs red/mi min 'phrul mkhar pho brang nas/a pha dkar nag1 3 gsum mkhyen/ 237

byus bstan pa'i srang mda' ma yo zhigadapa0 rtags bu skyes lag na zhoga.a ma 4 4ga mo sna yag ma/dgra mgo gnon la dgra snying phyangs/sa 'di tsho dang 'a yag tharngo cherno red/mi phos dpa' mdog shod sa red/rta phos bang kha rtse sa red/nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na/ar jag bdud kyi yul gling na/sa btsan yang 'gag skung lung na/mab/ ra btsan gshong mo dgu 'gril na/a ma gcig la ming sring bdun/sgo nga'i nang nas rdol le yin/bu drug sto/bas la che chung med/rta bdun mtsho mo'i nang nas 'khrungs/mgyogs pa'i bang la khyad par med/brgyugs na rgya dbus nyin gcig 'khor/dkar po she le lag ring zer/dkar po the'u rangs 'phrul gyi bu/she le zer ba pha rus red/lag ring ming gcig thogs pa'i don/lung dgu'i phar nang bsnyabs na zin/nam/ mkha'i bya yang sbar na zin/238 ོ

ri rab mtho yang rtse nas 'gugs/gting zab mtsho nas nor bu len/lag ring thogs don de 'dra red/gling gi jag pa mi bdun nyon/yang sgos mi dkar rta dkar can/dpa' gtam 'brug la 'gran le khyod/yang dag rgod g.yer grags mdog kha/dper na 'dra ma e 'dra gda'/rang snang bya khri gshog 'jum de/kho pa'i yan la med snang de/lcags khra 'jum skyen kha sngun nas/khra 'tshub se gshog sgro bar snang 'thor/rta chung tho sngon 'gros gom de/rang snang thang rgya chod bsam ste/pho chen rta pho'i kha sngun nas/lus rngul nag dza re chad rabs yo da/pu shud khra mo'i dar 'phru de/rang snang 'ja' bas mdzes bsam ste/rma bya khra mo'i kha sngun nas/skya tshubs se 'ja' 'od yal ba'i ltas/gling sdug jag pa'i dpa' rtsal de/rang snang jag cig chod bsam ste/pha rgod dpa' bo'i ngar lam nas/23 9

dmar dza re rang srog 'chor ba'i ltas/zer zer tshig gi brnyas gtam la/srog gces na mgo sgur phyag 'bul zer/zer zer khyod rang mgo 'bul gyis/a phos mi gsod tshe thar gtong /rjes rjes rgyal blon phebs nas yod/shar rma khams gling la chas le yin/pho jo ru zer ba 'i grags pa can/dpa' rdzu 'phrul ci 'du ga lta mi yin/ja mkhar zer ba'i grags pa can/mkhar btsan ci 'dug lta mi yin/sman mo g.yer can gyi 'brug mo la/gzugs skye mched ci 'dug lta mi yin/gling dpa' rtul zer ba'i pho khram la/dpa' ngar btsan ci 'dug lta mi yin/sde phyag chen zer ba'i grags pa can/norno longs spyod ci 'dug lta mi yin/lta mi dgos lag len byed mi yin/dpung rogs mi sngon rta sngon 'di/ gdol pa nag po'i bu rgyud la/glu mgon stong thub ya med red/rta sngon glu rta lding shes red/mi ser dar ser phyar 'dra 'di/240

rgyal po 'gong po'i bu rgyud la/mi rgod khri thub ya med zer/rta 'di gser rmig rag pa red/'gros shugs rgyug la dal lhod med/bu nged tsho gshin rje'i bu rgyud red/gri 'di tsho gshin rje'i las gri red/thang 'di tsho gshin thang skya mo red/mi bdun dpung la zhed bsam med/'bum 'bum dmag gi a ya yin/gtam a lan nyi ma bshol rogs red/glu go na rna ba'i bu ram gyis/ma go glu la 'bras bu med/tshur chas skya pa'i yid la zhogaces glu de ltar bla/ngas shing thung hril hril tshur byung ba na/dpa' rtul rnams kyang ngar chen cher rgyas te glu lan ngas 'debs dgongs nas yod kyang / gdong 'bum pa'i zhal lu de nyid thugs rgyal drag po bzhengs te spacha mig la kha'i skar chen la spyan rtsa dmar po khrag gis g.yos/ zharā das bco lnga'i dung zla de/ rdza ri la char sprin 'khrigs nga/ bzhin zhal mdangs log ste na re/ dam nyams gdug pa bdud kyi bu/ dpa' rgod bu la shod long dang / nyan long 'dzing long bco brgyad yod zer ba ltar khyod de tsam ma brel glu 'di nyon gsungs nas ya zi'i dpa' lung la bcangs nas glu thung 'di gsungs so/ 241

oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu a la tha la tha la red/tha la la mo la la red/la la glu yi len lugs red/lha klu gnyan gsum dgra lha'i tshogs/zo dor wer mas kha 'dzin mdzod /lha dkon mchog rgyab rten ma g.yel zhigabu dpa' bo'i byes lam yag par shogs 'di zi rong sa mtshams red/lha bdud dpung pa bsdur sa red/dpa' ngar zhan mthong thag chod sa red/nga 'dra gdong gi zhal lu dkar/nyam chung byams pas skyong mi yin/dgra 'chi bdag a ya sprod mi yin/klu mgon stong thub nyams pa'i bu/the'u rangs 'phrul bu she le dkar/rgyal 'gong 'phrul gyi bu rgyud gsum/'bod ma dgos sa 'dir khug lugs 'a//lha dkar phyogs dam can nus mthu red/mda' la rang dbang thob le'i bu/'dan ma g.yul rgyal thog rgod yod/mdung la rang dbang thob le'i bu/dar 'phen dug gi sdong po yod/242

dpa' rgod tshad la 'jog pa'i mi/gzig 'phen dar gyi thig le yod/stobs chen dpe 'jog byed sa la/gser pa'i nyi ma 'bum thub yod/shed chen rgyal khams grags le de/rga sde chos skyong ber nag yod/dpa' rtsal g.yul chen 'gyed mi la/rong mi tsho'i dpon po nya tsha yod/mtshon la grub pa thob le de/dpa' rgod rgya tsha nga rang red/gri gu zigayug la byang le red/rnon po ya zi skar phran 'di'i/'byang khungs che ba shod khom med/ya trī gri 'di lcags mdog dkar/so kha smug la ltag pa dkar/bkra ris me lce mched pa 'dra/gser gyi rang mdangs tshub se tshub/phyar na lha 'dre bran la 'du/g.yug na dgra bo lhu dum phral/btag na mdzes mo lus kyi rgyan/gri shubs mdzes g.yu 'brug 'khyug pa 'dra/phyar zer na me ri 'bar ba 'dra/g.yug zer na glog lce 'phro ba 'dra/27/ 0

'dra ba gsum gyi gong rol nas/gri g.yug she le bu la g.yugakhyod dang nged gnyis srog dmar 'brel/a ba re la snying re rje/sha khrag bya spyang kham zan byed/rnam shes gtan med bar dor 'khyam/lam de la ma gtogs 'gro sa med/khyod rang yid la de ltar zhogaces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang lhan gnyis ka dpa' snying 'brong las che ba bzhin seng ge'i ngar 'thab ltar thog tu mchongs res byas te gri g.yug thengs bcu skor byas pas go khrab bcad pa las ci ma gnod/ rgyab phyogs nas dar 'phen gyis mdung brgyab/ g.yas phyogs nas gser pa'i nyi ma 'bum thub kyis rdo dkar po lug thang tsam zhig the'u rangs 'phrul gyi bu mi rta 'dus 'dzoms kyi mdor brgyab pas thal tshub phyur te 'gyel ba dang lhan kho'i sprul pa zhig pa dang / slar the'u rangs kyis dbugs dbyangs nas rta de tshubs se yar langs te phar tsam bros/ de yi durā mnyam du klu mgon gyi thog tu dpa' tsha zhang 'dan ma byang khra dang / gzig 'phen dar gyi thig le gnyis mchongs pa dang / dang po 'dan mas mda' gser ltong ma gsum bstud brgyab pas dang po de snying kha'i me long steng thebs nas snying khebs gtor/ gnyis pas rmog steng rnga 'phru bcad/ gsum pa snying khar thebs kyang de nyin 'dul ba'i dus la ma bab pas nag thom thom gzer yer yer tsam las ci ma thub/244

khos kyang myur bar dug mda' gnyis 'dan ma'i steng springs byung bas dpung zur la the4bas pas byang bu khra tha re gtor/ yang gcig nu ma g.yas pa'i steng byung ba na sku la mtshon gyis ma tshugs kyang dug grib kyis nag bun bun byung bas lhas bar snang nas khrus chab gtor bas khra lam mer dang / gzig 'phen gyis gri gsum btab pas ma chod cing me stag tshub tshub byung ba dang lhan khos gri bton te phan tshun gri kha 'gran yang sus kyang glags ma khel/ gzig 'phen gyis zhags pa btab ste myur stabs su 'then pa dang rta las ma lhung tsam la gris bcad/ yang 'dan mas gri shubs la btsud de mda' zhig ngar bskyed nas brgyab pas khos g.yas phyogs su sgyur tsam byas kyang phrag g.yon dpung pa'i sha rgod la mda' rmas shig byang ba dang khos cung mi legs par shes te phar tsam rtab rtob rkyos phyi chad byas/ser po mi rgod ya med de dang / nya tsha sga sde gsum gdong thug pa dang / gsum gas mdung 'gran byas kyang khe pham dbye ba ma chod/de nas gri 'gran yud tsam byas kyang dbyer ma chod pas sga sde thugs rgyal bzhengs te ral gri shubs la btsud nas mi rgod ya med kyi thang rtsa nas phyag gis myur stabs kyis bzung nas g.yug pas rta thog las sar phab pa dang lhan sga sde yang thang du 'gril/ nya tshas zhags ske la btab nas 'then pa dang rgyal 'gong gi cho 'phrul gyi me 'od bar snang khengs te dngos med du mi rta gnyis po phar tsam slebs pa dang lhan gdong btsan zur nas rta las babs nas skrag bzhin ci bya med par gnas pa des gus gus zhum zhum gyis dar btang / dpa 'a rtul bdun pos rjes bzhin ded pas/ kho rang rnams kyis de ring 245

rtags ma de tsam las rgyal kha lon pa mi 'dra bas gzhi sdod rgyal blon sar snyan sgron gyis bka' skor la 'gro na dga' zer blo mthun nas rlung ltar mgyogs par song / khro thung rjes bzhin du yong ba dang /dpa' rtul rnams dang gdug pa'i bu gsum 'thab pa nye ma ring nas mthong bas shin tu skrag cing snying kha la 'tshangs te lus 'dar sil sil byed dgos pa byang / de nas gdug pa'i blon po gsum phyir log tu chas yong ba༄ dang dpa' rtul gyis rjes ded byas pa yang mthong nas khug cig la phar tsam brgyugs pa dang skrag che ba'i dbang gis rkang pa sa la ma tshugs sgyid pa 'dar zhing bcings pa ltar sa la 'gril ba dang lhan dpa' rtul rnams nye logs su phebs pa dang /chibs pa 'phar ba rngog nag gis gling gi mi rta ngo shes nas mchil ma sran ril tsam btang nas hu hu dang hi hi zer nas 'tsher lhang drag tu byas nas gling dpa' rtul rnams kyi gdong thal 'tshub pha le byang ba na/ 'do chen rnams kyis shes nas thams cad mi bzod tho'i dga' tshor gyis hu hu dang hi hi yi sgra dir ri bsgrags/ dpa' rtul rnams kyis khro thung de phyogs yod pa shes nas cang shes la bdag po gar yod dris pas phyi ltas kyis hu hu zer bas dpa' rtul hrug 'dzoms kyis de phyogs phebs pa na/ a khu ci bya med par brag pha wang thod gtug cig gi bar na mi chung zhig la sprul nas 'dzul yod pas dpa' rtul rnams kyis khro thung ma mthong yang cang shes 'do chen rnams lha rta yin pas shes nas rta rnams pha wang rtsar 'dus nas 'tshub dkyil le yod pa phar tshur mi 'gro bar lag pa sa la brdabs te 'tsher skad byas byung ba dang / 'dan mas a khu 246

der yod pa mkhyen nas rta las mgyogs par bab nas pha wang bar khung zhig yod pa'i nang la bltas pas a khu ni bu chung lo bdun tsam la dbyibs khro thung ltar kha spu 'dar sil sil mig cer re bltas nas 'dug pa la dpa' 'dan ma byang khra de shin tu nyams mtshar ba'i ngang nas na re/ brag khung gseng bzhugs pa'i a khu dpon/blo gya gyu mang na yong rgyu mang / sems 'tshub 'tshub ma mang glu la gson zer nas tha la drug 'gyur gyi ngag la drangs nas glu 'di blangs so/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ glu a la tha la tha la red/tha la ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/la la tshig gi gcod lugs red /skyabs bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum/gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas 'debs/byin rlabs thugs kyi klong nas stsol/'bral med thugs rjes zung du gsol/sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na/zi ma bar ma rong ma gsum/gling dkar chags pa'i sa mtshams red/zi smad gnam khri bar ma zer/rgya yar mar tshong mgron gshar lam red/bu nga 'dra nga ngo e shes 'duga'adan sde g.yu mtsho 'khyil sa nas/247

'dan mtsho la gser dngul chags sa nas/ka phu shug ri'i bar lam na/'dan sgrol ma'i gsung dbyangs sgrog sa nas/rdzong shar lung ri drug nang bcud la/dpa' mi 'gyur 'dan ma g.yul rgyal yin/glu mi 'gyur tha la drug 'gyur yin/tshig mi 'gyur gser gyi thig pa yin/gdan gru bzhi gnon pa'i stag rong dpon/brag sngon mo'i khung gseng ci la bzung/dpa' ngar mas har glu mi len nas/dbugs rgyu ba 'gags nas ci la 'dugadapa' ngar mas a lan mi sprad nas/'jam shur re rang yul ci la 'ongs/mtho rgyal po'i dpung ya mi skyor nas/dpon g.yog med kher 'khyam ci la red/lus rdzus 'phrul bya ltar mi lding nas/'dar cum cum sdug sgur ci la byed/khyod rang dbang yod dus ma bsdad na/sma rang khur dus zhe 'gyod med/gnyen rogs kyi kha tā ma nyan na/dpon sprang du 'khyams dus zhe 'gyod med/gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la/rta 'tshub ril ba des bdag po phung /248

bu rang snang can des khyim gzhis phung /sman 'dzum ril ma des rang lus phung /dpon dran 'phrul can des rang sde phung /de zer yang zer la bden yang bden/da rung gna' mi'i gtam dpe la/lha bla ma 'khor bar 'khyam kha ru/ chos grub mtha' rtsod gzhi chags sdang skye/ser mo gzhan la skur ba 'debs/chos zhe nas ma shes 'khor bar 'khyam/stong log 'gro kha'i tshong phrug de/tshong dpon gzhan la 'gran bsdur byed/ zong bzang ngan mi lta gang byang nyo/yang snying mtha' ma sprang la rlokhyam/pha khyim shor kha'i dman chung de/bu mo gzhan la zur za byed/bu bzang ngan mi lta gang byung 'tshol/brang nu chu dza re sprang la 'bud/dpe zer srol bden srol gnyis ka yod/lding che na thang dkar klad yu 'khor/rgyug che na gla ba g.yang la lhung /mchong che na stag mo sked pa bud/btsan che na dpon po sma phab khur/gces che na o yos ya kha ldag249

za che na mar dkar mchin kha na/gshibs che na g.yog mos rje bo rdung /yun ring na blon pos rgyal la 'khon/de e red ye shes stag rong dpon/rdzong btsan po pho rog snying rdzong la/'dug thub na dar zab 'bol gyi gdan/gyon thub na dar gos tshar sbyar gos/lto yi gas 'chun na 'dod yon zas/lag mngag bcol phyi nas kun gyis sgrub/dpon rang tshugs zin na 'bum tsho'i dpon/tshe rogs kha ra gser mtsho ma/shes rig yonatan che brling ldan/bu stag gzig 'dra bas mtha' nas bskor/blon dug tsher 'dra bas dpung nas brgyan/sde dug mtsho 'khol ma'i bkur bsti mtho/'dug ma thub ri byol ci la byed/mu pa gnam gyi rgyal po de /sangs rgyas stong gi thugs sras red/rigs gsum mgon po'i sku skye red/o rgyan pad ma'i rnam 'phrul red/nag phyogs bdud kyi kha gnon red/dkar phyogs bstan pa 'dzugs mi red/rdzong chen bco brgyad 'bebs mi red/250

'dzam bu gling gi rgyal po red/dbu nag bde la 'god mi red/khyod log lta'i sdang ltas ci la byed/sa rma smad yul la 'gog bza' phud/5 skyabs gnas a sngon gnam la byas/blo 'dri bdud btsan 'dre yi yul/myang myong sdug bsngal bshad tshod med/rtsa ba bshad na khyod la thugalha sras sku na phra ba'i dus/sku la bsdos shing gsung la brnyas/ma byas pa la gcig kyang med/khro thung dpon gyis bsam blo skor/ge sar byang chub sems dpa' 'dis/yang yang bzod pa bsgoms le red/pha dang khu bo'i thugs chags kyis/gdan mdun gral gong la bzhag le red/sku 'gyur ldog med pa che brling des/tsan dan khri kha rang 'jags red/rta rgyug kha chad ma ma bgos na/gser khri skya lo'i rgyu nor de/ge sar dpon gyis bdag don med/khyod go ba yod pa'i mi yin na/sngar byas zhib kyis bsam blo skor/251

phyin chad rig pa gtan la phob/da res phyir phyir sgo la bud/dpa' rgya tshas gtso byas dpa' rtul la/rgyab 'gal byas pa'i bshags pa phul/phyin chad gshis ro ngan pa yis/nga che ngan 'khur dkrug gzhi sogs/slad nas mi byed 'ba' gan phul/'gran med gzig 'phen nya tsha gnyis/gling dkar khra mo'i snying bcud yin/ge sar rgyal la brtse gdung che/sku mched thugs sems gcig pa'i phyir/phu nu gnyis kyi ngo la 'jogam sang 'khrul rgyal ma mjal bar/dpa' rtul rnams kyis btsan khrims med/ drin chen pha ma'i las kyis grub/lan ldog ma mdzad bsod nams dman/dpon chen sga sde thugs gzhi lhod/ nga 'dan ma kha lag snga ba'i gtam/gtam sbas skung med pa tha ra ra/lus 'jig rngam ma che sgo la bud/go na rna ba'i rgyan gcig red/ma go glu la 'bras bu med/dpon stag rong yid la de ltar zhog252

ces glu de ltar blangs pas khro thung cung zad sems dpa' bskangs nas 'dar bzhin sgor bud pa dang lhan/ khro thung gi dpa' rtul rnams la gus gus zhum zhum ngang / rgya tsha dang nya tsha dar 'phen sogs kyi thugs la ma bab kyang 'dan ma'i bka' gsung la brtsis te ci ma gsung / de nas a khu stag rong dpon nas glu 'di ltar blangs so/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu a la tha la tha la red/tha la la mo la la red/la la ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/ rang snang lha yi zhing khams nas/sprul sku tshe dbang rig 'dzin dang /bon sras bla ma'i tshogs bcas la/gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje gzigs/ bden pa'i glu sna drang du gsol/sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na/zi gling gnam khri bar ma 'dra/nga 'dra gdong gi ma bzhi dpon/dbang po dar dus yongs la grags/rgud pa'i dus na khyi bas lod/ mu pa gnam gyi rgyal po la/sku mched gsum nyi zla skar gsum 'dzoms/'dan ma dgu thig skya mo bkra/253

spyi dpon ri rgyal lhun po la/phu nu ri bran mtha' nas bskor/gnam sa lhan gcig 'dzoms le de/skye 'gro chags pa'i 'khri shing red/dbu nag yongs kyi rten shing red/bskal pa chags pa'i gzhi ma red/'bum pa'i dung zla rang shar dang /phu nu mi dbang dpa' rtul rnams/thugs byams pa'i klong nas nga la gson/mu pa'i lha sras ge sar la/zhe gting nasadad pa ci la 'gyur/khong dbu nag bod kyi lha skal red/a khunyi tsha bo seng chen rgyal/bu dang tsha bo khyad par med/byang khog khrag la ska sla med/ de snga a khus rten 'brel bsgrigs/bsgrigs pa ma nor lhun gyis grub/ston chen bco brgyad yon bdag byas/ge sar la rgyal kha bco brgyad thob/nga khro thung dran 'phrul ma bkrab na/khong ge sar byang sems sangs rgyas la/thugs khro ba'i nyams 'gyur ston le min/khro thung thugs rtsa ma bsgrims na/254

khong ge sar ge re lang le min/las 'dra min sna tshogs ma byas na/sgang grags pa gsum la grags le min/a tsam mi zhu ku re yin/yang dag don gyi rdo ga la/rdzong pho rog snying rdzong bzung ba'i dus/yi dam rta rmagrin dmar po des/nga a khu ma sdod a khu song /shar phyogs ar jag yul la song /mi nyag g.yu rtse rgyal po dang / dam nyams gdug pa spun bdun gnyis/khyi dang spyang ki kha sbrel bzhin/skyid sdug las mtha' mnyam pa'i dus/gling dkar yu med bzo 'o gsungs/ma zad sang phod lo dus su/klu btsan sa tham gur dkar gsum/shar bdud mi nyag 'di dang bzhi/bdud bzhi dus gcig blo mthun na/lho 'dzam gling rub kyang mi thub gsungs/de phyir 'di lo'i nyi ma la/char sna rlung khrid khyi sna gzan/mgo skor gling la bsu mi la/'dug ma bcug a khu lha yis btang /2/rwa du

btang ba'i mda' mo sgro bzhin de/dmigs pa'i 'ben la phog nas yod/yi dam lha yi lung bstan de/'gal na 'di phyi gnyis ka phung /bsams nas zhe rus gting nas skyes/dngos su lha yi lung bstan de/gsang rgya khrom la bsgrags phod med/de phyir a khu dpon blon de/song song bdud yul song le yin/bsgrubs bsgrubs lha lung bsgrubs le de/nga dang gdong btsan rgu bu gsum/de min g.yog dang rta drel sogs/ar jag yul la dan gta' bzhag mi nyag rgyal blon chig stong dmag4 bos dang e gnyis dus 'dzom gyis/khra mo gling la chas nas yod/ya gi'i la gsham dmag sgar yod/de drag bdud blon gsum gyi rogs/pha bu dbang med btsan khrid byas/gzhis sdod bdud mo ma bu la/gdol pa'i 'khrul dmag sgam gcig 'gi/de gzhan dmag dpung rgya cher med/pha yul rdzong gi lo rgyus de/ /256

a khu'i lag pa'i mthil la bkra/ de nas mi dbang rnam pa tsho/dgongs 'gal shor ba thugs khag med/snyan gsan ma bsgron a khu lan/nyes pa shor baṃ snying nas bshags/phyin chad kun dang mthun par byed/kha tsam min pa'i glu chung yin/'dir bzhugs rnams kyi thugs la zhogaces a khus glu de ltar blangs pas gzhan dpa' rtul rnams/ kyi thugs la lha yi lung byang yod med mi shes kyang rgyal mchog rin che+o.a khu dgra lha zan khyod phyi 'dre nang bsgyur la skye sngon lha yul nas bskos pa yin gsungs pas da lan yang mi nyag rgyal po dang gdug pa spun bdun 'dul ba'i ched du yin pa 'angu bsams 'dan ma na re/ gling seng chen ni mkhyen pa nyi ma las gsal/ rdzu 'phrul glog las myur/ mthu nus thog las btsan pa zhig bzhugs par bka' drin ji ltar gnang ba rje rgya mchog rang gi dgongs pa la gsal ler yod pas da lan bshad pa mang bas ci phan/ da 'gro 'gro zer/nya tsha dang gzig 'phen thugs dga' ya le song yang da dung a khu khro thung la bzang ngan gyi tshig gcig kyang ma ster/ de nas tshang ma sngon rjes bsdoms te gling sgar la tshur phyag phebs/ rgyal mchog dang spyi dpon gnyis kyis gzhis bzhugs dpa' rtul phu nu'i 'du ra 'dus/ bdud blon gsum dang a khu yab sras byung tshul dang bdud blon la 'dzing tshul chad lhag med par zhus pas dpa' tsha zhang 257

ci/ sa/ bdud 'dre la mda' rmas thub pa dang kun la dpa' dar 1//zengs bstod mdzad/ a khu yab sras gnyis la bdud kyi nyam — grib bsangs pa'i ched dmag sgar gyi zur zhig tu gur phub bza' btung bzhag ste rgyal blon rnams mjal ma bcug g.yog mkhan yang ma bzhag par zhag bdun bar sdod dang bka' lan bskyal yong gsungs nas de gar snang chung ltar bzhag ge sar rin po ches 3/ nga ma lha la bka' lung zhus nas de lugs ltar bya gsungs pa ltar ngasotsha mchog rtsa ba gsum pos rgyud skul g.yo med ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs so/

le'u drug pa/ so blon phyir 'khor gros rar gnas tshul bshad/mi nyag g.yu rtse dpung bcas byang phyogs thegagling pas phas rgol sgar la mtshan 'gebasakyis/spun bdun ya gyal klu mi gnyis po btul/de yi dus su dam nyams bdud blon gsum po de ya ra 'byor ba dang lhan rgyal blon gros ra 'dus te the'u rangs 'phrul gyi ba nges glu 'di ltar blangs so/glu a la 'u na la la red/la la 'u na bdud kyi glu/bde mo ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/rlung nag 'tshub ma'i gzhi dkyil nas/mi rta'i sha khrag mtsho 'khyil dbus/longs spyod chen po'i pho brang nas/gu lang dbang phyug bdud kyi rgyal/brgya stong gsod pa'i khas len 'bul/nag phyogs bstan chus brtan par shogaganam thel bar thel sa thel ga sum/ 259
