a bus pha la gdung bas 'bod/thus/sa brtse ba'i kha 'dzin ma g.yel mdzod/sa 'di zi rong bar tha na/brag dmar del chen mar sham red/nga 'dra gdug pa'i spun gral la/mi rgod she le leg ring zer/de snga g.yer chen dgung la grags/bya ba blo lam 'gro mi yin/ 4de nas 'gran med bdud kyi rgyal/ rje blon rnams kyis glu la gson/de ring nyul ma'i so pha red/stag rong rjes lus gar song med/nged mi bzhi myar bar song ba'i dus/zi ma gling gi rā mtshams na/gnam khri bar ma'i thang chen na/gling gi dpa' rtul mi bdun 'phrad/bu gdong btsan kha nas 'di ltar zer/pha gi'i mi bdun rta bdun 'di/ dpyad na gling gi dpa' rtul 'dra/dpung med byang thang thug nas 'gi/las bzang po gcig ni ma byang 'dugamyar bar phyir log bros na dh+rir/sgrog de thos zhe spro gting nas skyes/260

blo hril thag bcad nas gdong la bcar/gtam sa gsum grags pa bya bsam yang /phar g.yug mtshon gyis mi chod 'duganyag phran mda' mo mi phog 'dugarnon po mdung gis mi 'dzer 'dugasprul pa'i stobs la mi zhed 'dugadapa' rtul gcig rgyab gnyis mchong red/bya rgod pos thed la rub rub red/gri g.yug glog dmar 'khyug 'khyug red/'thab 'thab don gyi bzhag so la/mi ser rta ser bzhin pa yi/dpa' ngar ldan pa'i bu zhig byung /rdo pha wang gyad rdo brgyab nas byung /nged mi rta thal ba 'tshub se bsgyel/the'u rangs 'phrul gyi dbugs dbyung nas/gnas skabs mi rta mgo thon kyang /'phrul gyi rta la skyon che bzos/shi gson dbye ba rjes ma red/glu mgon dpa' ngar tshad bzung med/mi dkar rta dkar skya le zhigami sngon rta sngon skya le gnyis/ṭ+wāṃr+sha ༵ r+sha ༵/ ṭ+wāṃ~X ṭ+wāṃ/ ṭ+wāṃzlot+t+waṃ ༵khyu/ga red/ 261

yang snying rnon po ral gris bcad/mda' nyag phran phan tshun du ma btab/yang snying mda' rmas cung zad byung /mi nag ral pa nag po can/rta nag 'brong las rngam pa bzhon /dpung rogs mi dkar rta dkar can/gnam thel dkar po'i bu 'dra byung /'thab 'thab mtshon kha ma song bar/zhags btab sbar 'dzing byang ba'i dus/ya med khong gis dpa' chordo bzung /phyir log rlung ltar chas nas 'ongs/blo lam gang 'jog cha med re da/stag rong dpon po khro thung de/phyi nang bsgyar ba'i phung dkrug can/kun gyis rdope 'jog byed sa red/da ni mi sdod rang yul 'gro/mi nyag yul nas dmag g.yar zhu/ yang na do nub btsan lung zezung /sa 'di ngan dgu 'dzoms pa'i sa/'di na sgar 'debs nyan le min/yang na 'di nas byang stod mtshams/rgeyu stod ri la skung lung yod/de na dmag sgar khra mo 'debs/262

yul phyogs kun la zhib par dpyad/song na dgra jag chod le byed/nges cag rgyal blon bdun po la/so so'i lha yis kha 'dzin byed/dpa' bo'i dpung gi skyor ya dang /rdzu 'phrul med pa gcig kyang med/yod nas mkho ba'i dus skabs red/dper na 'dra ma e 'dra gda'/chas kyi gsos pa'i pho chen rta/dgos do gal la mo ma phog na/rta pho chen zer ba'i rgyang g.yer dang /chas gong thang sprad le stong pa red/byams pas bskyangs pa'i bu tsha de/dgos nges nyams la ma phan na/bu tsha zer ba'i rgyang g.yer can/byams snying rjes bskyangs pa stong pa red/dka' ngal gyis brtsigs khang pa de/dgos dus kha char ma khog na/ rang khyim zer ba'i g.yer po che/tshags rtsol bas brtsigs pa stong pa red/bu dpa' rgod zer ba'i blon chen tsho/don gal chen dgra jag ma bcad na/blon ngar rgod zer ba'i grags pa can/263

ming snyan grags che ba stong pa red/dpe dang don gnyis khrig khrig red/ de ring gling gi mi bdun de/ sngon 'gyod da 'gyod gnyis ga'i don/sna gtad nged rang tshang yin zer/de ring mi rta rang 'grig las/'khor g.yog med cing bza' bca' med/sa yul gzhan dpung rogs yod nges red/las ci mdzod rgyal blon thugs gros skor/glu gsan na a la ya lan mdzod/'dir tshogs thugs la de ltar zhogaces glu de ltar blangs pa dang lhan/ mi nyag g.yu rtse rgyal po des gu lang dbang phyug dang the'u rangs dkar nag khra gsum la 'bod pa'i rdzas kyis bdug mi lpags kyis g.yab mo 'phyar/mi rkang drag 'bud byas/ gzhan blon po rnams kyis rang rang gi 'go lha la bden bdar ci drag tu byas pas de yi nyin par nyi ma nag chen nam dus sbyor ngan pa'i rkyen gyis bdud lha 'grib ma thub nas/bdud lha rnams nam mkha'i sprin dang bar snang gi rlung bzhin 'dus/de yi nang nas gnam the'u dkar po de 'ja' 'od kyi klong nas ra dkar la bzhon bzhin kho cag la glu 'di ltar blangs par gda'o/bswo bswo/cho ya cho ya 'o 'o/drag thung drag thung rang 'khor las la 'dus na 'o 'o/264

a tsi glu yi len lugs re na 'o 'o/rgyal blon skyabs me da thang stong 'khyams lugs 'o 'o/gling lha'i bar chad bslu ba red na 'o 'o/nga 'dra mgon po'i gnam thil red/bsdad na rgyal sa zin le med/geyo can gling lha'i phung nas thal/bros na yar yar byang la song /ma ngan jo ru 'gog tsha des/drag po dmag gis skung lung zung /ma zad rgyal blon bla tshe brkus/bzang po'i 'dun ma ma legs 'dugabyang la 'gro ba'i don rtsa la/zi ma sde pha'i ma tha na/nag shod mi med lung dgu yod/brag dmar dgung la bsnyegs 'dra'i nang /bdud kyi a mye 'bum thub yod/spyang nag g.yas kham brdzu mkhan yod/'chi ba slong ba'i sman dpyad yod/'dzam gling phung pa'i stobs 'phrul yod/sa de na gdong pa ma gtad na/gzhan rgyab gnyer btsan kyang byed blo med/sa der slebs rgyal blon bsam don 'grub/mi nyag g.yu rtse rgyal po khyed/26 ri/rta

dbyings nas thog lce bcu gsum chos/bar snang rlung gri'i 'phrul 'khor thong /sa gzhi stobs kyis steng 'og bsgyur/shar bdud gdug pa'i bu rgyud tsho/rang rang stobs kyis rtsal chen phyungs/zas nor sgyu ma'i 'phrul chas de/do nub gang 'dod dngos grub ster/me 'bar rdzas kyi 'phrul 'khor dang /gad dang chu yi cho 'phrul ngom/dmag sgar khra mor srung ba dgos/rim rim ma sdod yar yar song /'bral med sdong grogs byas pas choga'adir tshogs yid la de ltar zhogaces de ltar zer nas the'u rangs mi mngon par song shul du thob rdzas dang me 'bar rdzas kyi 'phrul 'khor sogs dngos su bzhag yod pa rnams bdud rgyal lag tu son/ de nas rgyal blon dang nyam pa bdud kyi dmag dpung rnams yar yar byang la 'gro rgyu blo mthun gros kha 'grigs/ nyi ma de yi phyi nang rje dpon dpung bcas gnam khri bar mar sgar 'bab nas bsdad de nas mi nyag g.yu rtse rgyal po de bya go bo zhig la brdzus nas mtho yer yer gyis nam 'phang bcad de phyogs kun la dgra e 'dug bya ra byas/ khyad par bdud lha'i lung ltar del chen gyi khug so'i bar snang la 'phur nas bltas pas gling sgar yongs rdzogs lam mer mthong ba dang / dus mnyam du rgyal 266

mchog ge sar rin po che'i thugs la bdud rgyal yong ba khra lham mer shar bas gzhu mo ra rgod 'khyil chen nang du mda' mo sha bzan sgro dkar bzhag nas myur bar 'phang pas bar snang me lces khengs te bya go bo'i sgro gshog thar re btang nas sar mar mar lhung ba na bdud kyi lhas dpung grogs byas nas sgar du shor/ de nas gling gi bla ma rnams kyis drag po'i me hom sbar nas bskyed rdzogs zung du 'jug pa'i sgo nas dam nyam gdug pa dngos su bkug ste mer bsregs nas thal ba mnan/ 'go ba'i lha gsol mdzad/ nyi ma de'i phyi nang skar chen khra mo ma shar/ ngar chu chab la ma thim gong bza' btung mdzad de lha sras ge sar rgyal po dang / 'bum pa'i rgya tsha zhal dkar/ snang ngu g.yu yi me tog gser pa'i nyi 'bum ngar yagadar 'phen dug gi sdong po/ dpa' tsha zhang 'dan ma byang khra/seng a dom mi yi spyang ki/ sga sde chos skyong ber nag gzig 'phen dar gyi thig le/ dpa' bo nya tsha a brtan/ brgya dpon 7 ban de dmar lu bcas la de drag rang 'khor bcu res bskor nas rlung ltar chas pa dang / skya rengs cha/ gsal ba'i gong phyogs mtshams kun nas bdud sgar gyi nang du mchongs pa dang / shar phyogs nas snang ngu dang / nyi 'bum// 'dan ma/ dar ngaphen bzhi dpung bsgrigs nas bdud dmag bzhi bcu skor bsad pa na klu mgon dang dmar po btsan skya 'bum thub/ sheng checha 'gran gyi ya med gsum gyis gdong bkag naca// so sga gro yos 'cha' 'cha'/ ngamar nag srin po'i kha ngo la/ zhe sdang dug gi rlangs pa raphyar/ khra chang mig rtsa /khrag gis g.yos te mchong byang bas/༄shi ༄shi ra༅ 267

gling che rgyud dang stod gling tsha zhang gi khas len rang dmag bco lnga g.yas 'gril g.yon 'gril du btang byang ba na/ dpa' tsha zhang 'dan ma byang khra de mi bzod pa'i thurkos dgongs 'khrug ste/ klu mgon gyi gdong de ra sngo rgyang nger thon nas na re/ ya bsod zad mi sngon rta sngon can/ khyod shi la ma brel glu la nyon gsungs nas mda' stong sprad de glu 'di ltar blangs so/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu a 'a/ tha la tha la red/tha la la mo la la red/la la glu yi len lugs red/gling dkar lha dang srung ma rnams/mason skyabs kha 'dzin ma g.yel ciganyam/ pa'i bu la thod mnga' sprod/klu klo'i bstan chus ma/thur du gnon/sa 'di sa ngo ma/ shes na/zi ma gling gi ma tha na/zi rong sanyis kyi sa mtshams na/zi smang sanarma4 khri bar ma zer/rmi rgod dngu nga nga ngom sa reng/ rta rgo da rgyug la byang sa red/ yang sgoru/ thang chen gru gsum de /dam nyam phung ngo/ gnon sa rer /nga 'dra nga ngo ma 'es na/ 268

dpa' tsha zhang 'dan ma byang khra zer/ge sar rgyal po'i gung blon yin/phar 'gro dmag gi ru sngon yin/ khas len stag mo ngar mi yin/dpa' ngar phyi chad med mi yin/tshur yong dmag gi ru mjug yin/ru mjug dmag gi sgo mo yin/nam mkhar ral shan 'debs mi yin/rlung zer ma lag gis lon mi yin/sa gzhi 'dam ltar brdzi mi yin/ri rab 'ben la 'jog mi yin/bu nga 'dra gong la lha dbang gda'/'thab ya gshin rje chos rgyal gda'/'dzing ya pho 'dre klu btsan gda'/rtsod ya sa tham rgyal po gad('a/de min su yang yod snang med/de tsho dpe don yin lugs red/da res thug pa'i mi sngon ska/ kha sang bu la nor ya med/4dpyad na dam nyam klu mgon 'dra/khyod dang nga gnyis dus 'dzoms 'di/mang po'i tshang nas bskos le red/gtam pa med de 'grig le red/rdzo ta9

bos dang a gnyis 'dzoms le red/de ring 'dan ma gshin rje'i bu/gshin rje nga la thug le red/rma khams gling yul rgyal blon la/gong ma lha nas dam tshigs nyams/bar ma mi nas kha chad bsgos/de ring thug pa spro lugs la/dam nyam gdug pa'i jag rkun khyod/de snga nyi ma phan chod la/gling dkar lha lung 'dre lag brkyangs/pha spyi dpon gnas skor phebs pa'i shul/gzhis rgya nor longs spyod khyod kyis 'phrogade rjes rte khyu jag la bcad/kha sang mu pa'i bu gces khyer/blo bsam bskor na zhe sdang 'khrugaza che na rgun 'brum mchin kha na/rgyug che na rkang pa'i long sha 'dar/gshis ngan na pha ma bu sring 'gras/rtsub che na yul dpon 'bad kyis gsod/dpe zer srol bden srol gnyis ka red/gcan spyang sha bzan ar jag la/mi 'jig srog gi skyabs sbyin bral/bsad na yangs pa'i rgyal khams bde/270

gdol pa klu dang nag phyogs bdud/snying rjes skyob pa'i gnas ma yin/bsgral na yul khams 'dug byus bde/spun bsad bshan pa mdze can gnyis/gnyen dang nye ba'i 'dun pa med/rnam smin khur na rang sems bde/dpe don de tsho khrig khrig red/de ring dpa' rtags mda' la 'gran/g.yon gzig shubs nang nas gzhu gcig len/gzhu mo ra gzhu 'khyil can len/g.yas stag dong nang nas mda' gcig len/mda' mo gser ltong dgra 'dul len/gzhu yar muchog rgyud nas g.yu 'brug ldir/ma mchog rgyud nas glog lce 'khyugamade'u'i rtse nas tsha tsha 'phro/mtheb rtsal dpung pas brgyangs pa'i dus/glag nag zan la 'jum pa 'dra/dmigs pa'i 'ben la thebs pa'i dus/brag la thog dmar 'bab pa 'dra/khyod a ba re la snying re rje /ge sar dgra lha wer ma'i tshogs/klu gdol pa'i skye rgyud rtsad nas chod/dkar phyogs bstan pa dgung la bstod/271

khyod bdud nag yid la de ltar zhogaces glu de ltar blangs nas mda' de springs pas khos glu la dpyad de glu lan zhig sprad de dpa' de byas grags pa zhig bya bsacha/sa nas yod pas mda' de dgra bla wer ma'i mthus me lces bar sna/nga khengs te ya thod rdzi smin bar la thebs te ka li rmog dang bcas nga pha tshad du 'phangs te phung po rta las lhung ba dang lhan snang ngus 'phrul gyi bdud rta la ral shan brgyabs pas long gi nang khro' sar lhungs te 'gril ba dang thams cad kyis ki bswo btab/ phung po sar 'gril yang kho klu bdud kyi bu dngos yin pas dbugs rgyun ma chad par klu bdud kyis grogs byas na sbrul nag shin tu che ba zhig la gyur nas 'gul 'gul shig shig byas byung ba dang / skyes mchog seng chen de nyid kyis dgra lha'i go mchon sna dgu sku la bzhes nas 'do rje rkyang rgod 'phel po chibs/ te de ma thag der phebs nas bdud phung sbrul du gyur nga 'i lus de 'dam rdzab ltar brdzis nas nyam pa bdud sde mi dar ba'i thugs bskyed smon lam yang dag pa mdzad/de nas dmar po btsan skya 'bum thub dang / shed chen 'gran gyi ya med gnyis snying bton pa ltar sdug bsngal dang nga rgyal drag tu 'khrug ste 'chi ba srog la ltos med kyis ral gri 'phyar te byang nas khong dpa' rtul rnams dang gri kha yu na ring tsam 'gran yang r+shan tshutsha su la'ang gnod ma thub/ dpa' rtul gyi rogs su rgyal mchog thugs kyi sprul pa dang dgra lha gnyan stag gi sprul pa mi da7ra rta dkar dang mi dmar rta dmar gnyis kyis gri mdung du ma btab pas kho cag gi lus phyi ma rmas kyang nang gi rus chen bcad song snyam pa 272

byung nas phyi bros byed dgos byung / byang phyogs nas 'bum pa'i rgya tsha zhal dkar dang / seng a dom yi spyang mi/ gzig 'phen dar gyi thig le/ stag rong nya tsha a brtan bcas kyis ki shar 'a brug sga grags pa ltar byas te sgar nang du the tshom med par mchongs te nga dmag bya 'phru can sum cu tsam bcom pa dang / mi nyag g.yu rtse rgyal po de mi sngon go mtshon sngon po g.yu yi ral pa nyil le/ go mtshon la dug gi rlangs pa thul le/ rta nag 'brong 'dur rlung gshog la bzhon te nag po stong bdud lan med dang / ser po mi rgod ya med/ be thul 'chi bdag nag po bcas srog gcod stong thub dgus bskor nas/ dpa' rgya tsha'i gdong der rta kha bkag ste dpa' hang pa'i ngang nas glu 'di ltar blangs so/glu a lu 'u na tha lu red/tha lu 'u na la lu red/'u na la lu ngag glu red/mun pa nag po dngas med nas/bdud rgyal srog gcod sha za 'bum/da res bdud rgyal grogs la byon/rmon po'i mtshon gyi so kha phyung /dgra srog chod la dgra dbugs sdus/the'u rangs dkar nag khra gsum mkhyen/rang chus bstan pa mi nub shogs 'di zi ma'i rong smad red/nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na/373

shar mi nyag yul gyi shed rgyal yin/gcan sder chags nang gi seng gi yin/bya gshog thogs nang gi mkha' lding yin/chab chu gnas nang gi chu srin yin/mi brgya brgya'i nang gi dpa' rgod yin/yang rgod dpe la 'gran sa yin/e red mi red da red gsal/gling khrab gyon nang gi bu mo'i ngo /gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la /mtshon zha ne'i mdog la rno chod med/rta sre mong ngo la bang shugs med/sman khra gor ma la gzhi brling med/bu bu mo ngo la dpa' snying med/zer yang zer la bden yang bden/gling dpa' rtul zer ba'i pho khram khyu/de snga nyi ma yan chod la/sde 'bangs kun gyis gtsug na khur /drin can pha mas gces par bskyangs/ngan lob rang snang ham pa de/gzhan ma'i bu la 'gro le min/lung chung nang gi dpon chung de/dpa' mdog ngan shed nang la byed/pho rgod mig gis ma mthong 'dug274

e 'dug de ring ltad mo ltos/ gzhu mchog dkar shubs nas phyang bsam med/mda' nyag phran gral ra bshig rlo min/mdung khra ring shubs nas phyung le min/gri gu zi'i dpa' lung ci la 'ju/de ring dpa' rtags dpung la 'gran/dza re bzung nas sa la rdeb/gling khrag gor mo rdo yis thung /ltad mo a sngon dgung gis ltos/kha chems dog mo la sa la zhogami de grags tog thus ma byas na/nga rgyal po skyes dang ma skyes 'dra/ ces glu 'di ltar blangs nas nye bcar gyis rlung sbud pa ltar dpa' rgya tsha'i thog tu byang ba dang / rgya tsha ni glu len long khom ma byung bar ya zi lan gargyom btab kyang / 'dul skal med stabs go khrab bcad pa las ma thub/ khos sbar mo ldeng ste rgya tsha'i thang rtsa nas bsdus te mi rta phral ba dang lhan ge sar khong dang dgra lha'i gnyan stag gnyis kyis g.yu rtse rgyal po'i lag g.yas g.yon nas 'chang zhing phar tshur 'then pas rgya tsha shor/ kho rta las lhung / rgya tshas de ma thag bdud rgyal la rdog tho bsnun bzhin rmog dkar gyi mar gsham na g.yu mdog sna tshogs kyi ral pa bco brgyad yod pa de btogs nas sngo tha re btang ba dang bdud rgyal de nyid 'dul ba'i dus la ma bab pas 'od dmar po zhig la gyur nas shor/ rta de rgya 275

chos gri brgyab nas bsad/ da dung de'i g.yas zur nas ser po mi rgod ya med des dpa' la'i gdong bkag nas 'phrul mdung klad la bskor te glu 'di ltar blangs par gda'o/glu 'o na a lu thu lu red/tha lu ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/the'u rangs dkar nag khra gsum mkhyen/nyam pa btsun gzugs zhwa ser can/mi rgod bu la sdong grogs mdzod/sa 'di zi rong byang thang red/brgya yar mar 'gro ba'i mgron lam red/nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na/a ma gcig gi bu rgyud la/sgo nga'i nang nas rdol le red/nga rang rgyal po'i bu rgyud la/ser po mi rgod ya med zer/ser po sgo nga'i rang mdog ser/ mi rgod ya med rang ming red/ brgya brgya'i nang nas kher rgod yin/stong stong nang nas yang rgod yin/rang che min te yin lugs red/da res thug pa'i dpa' rtul dpung /shi 'dod de tsam ma brel dang /kha tshig gsum mtshams nas a lan yod/276

rta 'brong 'dur yod pas yong le min /rta pho chen rlung gcod sum cu yod/mi skad go ba'i rta dgu yod/rgyal po rta yis bshol sa med/dbu skra g.yu yi ral pa de/de ring med kyang rim spus tshar/ rgyal po'i g.yu ral phang nga/ med/khyod thub bsam yod de ci la thub/skye 'gro zas su za mi la/glu btsan rgyal gyi bde rtsal dgos/'dzam gling grags pas khyab mi la/'jang gi sa tham rgyal 'dra dgos/dpa' rgod dpung pas 'dul mi la/mi nyag g.yu rtse rgyal 'dra dgos/khyod sdar mablu dpung la snying re rje/rang snang mtho ba tshe re ra/skyid nyi ma'i gong la yod snang shar/ rtug ril gser phye yin snang shar/than gyi pu shud khra mo des/dar 'phru 'ja' las mdzes snang dang /skad drug 'gyur dbu rneg khyab snang shar/ zhe'u khyi yi dpa' rngam des/mche bzhi stag las rngam snang dang /277

ngar sgras sa gsum g.yo snang shar/gling sdug pho 'khyam snang ba la/pho rgod khyod gong med snang dang /mthong tshad dbang du bsdu snang shar/blo bsam bskor na gdong pa tsha/yang dgos mi dkar rta dkar can/rang 'dod sog 'gul shig se shigami 'jigs rkan sgra thag se thagarta rgyug 'dod kha skor 'khyil li li/gri g.yug 'dod dpa' lung tham se tham/pho ngar mdog can de tshur tshur bud/dpa' rtags khra ring mdung la 'gran/sbrul nag dug lce ngar ma 'di/dga' rab dbang phyug bla lcags la/bdud ha ri nag pos 'phrul rdung byas/rtse mo gcig la gshong zor bzhi/zor zor sha za ngar ma yin/gshong gshong khrag thung ngar ma/ yin/mdung yu lcags skud dpa' rogs byas/zhags la a long 'phrul lding btags/mi rgod dpung pas shed skor byed/de ring khyod la ho ma ya/dar dkar rlung gis bsgyel 'dra zhig278

ma byas dpa' bo min rtags gyis/khyod tsho'i yid la de ltar zhog ces glu de ltar blangs nas 'phrul mdung de klad nas lan gsum bskor te seng stag la lan gsum 'phul kyang rdo rje'i go khrab dang srung bas brtan te byang bu tha re gtor ba las ci ma gnod/seng stag gis ral gri shubs nas phyung te lan gcig g.yug pas 'phrul mdung dum mer bcad de na re/ pho las zad nyam pa rgyal po'i bu/ dpa' rgod lo yin tshe glu la nyon zer nas glu 'di ltar blangs so/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu a la tha la tha la red/tha la la mo la la red/ la la ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/dgra lha wer ma lha gnyan glu/zo dor rma gnyan spom ra sogs/'bral med mgon zhing srung skyob mdzod/sa 'di byang thang na ba'i ljongs/khyi spyang mche ba gtsigs sa red/ma nyam khyi shi spyang lus sa/nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na/ge sar rgyal po'i mdun blon la /seng a dom mi yi spyang ki zer/spyang dar ma 'dra ba'i lus rtsal des/279

7bdud sdang dgra lug khyu dkrug dkrug yin/mtshon leb chen mi yi bsha' gri zer/g.yug tshar na gnam lcag lan med yin/rta stong ri nor gyi bang mdzod de/bang btang na zer ma rlung yang zin/dgra 'chi bdag yin yang gtong bsam med/khyod de ring thug sa ma lo gda'/dam nyam smon log rgyal po'i bu/sangs rgyas chos la lta ba logatshad ldan bla ma'i sku la bsdos/dam chos bsnub cing dge 'dun bkrongs/'gro ba sems can sdug la gtad/pho khyod 'dras byed byed su yis byed/de ring rang byas rang la smin/nag po bdud kyi kha gnon la/ge sar rgyal po lha nas bskos/klu btsan thod mda' sprad rgyu yin/bdud yul chos la bsgyur rgyu yin/gur dkar gnya' sga sprad rgyu yin/hor ser stongs la bsgyur rgyu yin/ sa tham bdud rgan bsgral rgyu yin/'jang sa dbang du bsdu rgyu yin/'dzam gling bdud rigs ma lus rnams/280

bsgral nas dbang du 'du rgyu yin/g.yang gi gter rdzong 'a bebs rgyu yin/mi nyag g.yu rtse rgyal po de'i/ gzhan la med pa'i g.yu ral de/ma shi gson thog bya rgyu yin/brnyas pa'i nang gi yang brnyas yin/mgo ril le sa la 'phen rgyu yin/de res khra mo mig gis ltos/khyod kyang mi sdod 'chi ran yin/ngo chen rgyu yis bslu sa med/e red da res ltos dang gsal/skye sa tshar sa na sa gsum/'jig rten las la gang bskos red/'gyod pa las kyi tha ma red/lag na bzung ba'i leb chen gri/legs pa'i yon tan brgya kha 'dzoms/g.yug na khro chu'i pha wang 'bregami chod bsam pa sems la med/mdo gling bstan pa'i srung ma rnams/rnon po ral gri'i so kha 'tshos/nyam pa'i dgra bo khyod la ya/ces glu mjug rdzogs ma thag gri gcig g.yug pas dgra lha wer mas so kha 'tshos te phrag g.yon pa'i gong nas g.yas pa'i mchan 'og 281

bar bcad de sar lhung ba dang 'do ba rag pa gser mig de thal tshub pha ler phung po'i smad cha 'drud de sgar gyi g.yas nas g.yon du shor/ be thul 'chi bdag dang srog gcod stong thub rnams kyis 'chi ba srog la ltos med kyis mda' gri mdung gang 'khyol gyis lan btab cing dpa' rtul rnams dang yun tsam 'khrug pa na/ be thul 'chi bdag nas gling gi nor bu dpa' yag la mdung brgyab nas bsgrungs pa dang nya chos gri brgyab nas be thul 'chi bdag dang stong thub yan rkun/ rtse le gsum dus gcig tu bsad cing / dmag hrag bsdus lnga bcu skor bsad nas dmag sgar phyogs bzhir gtor te gling pas dpa' tshod bzung / rgyal mchog dam pas gling dmag rnams srung ba'i gur du btsud de rgyal blon rnams phar tsam phebs pa dang / yang g.yu rtse rgyal po dang nyam pa'i bu gzhi/ stong thub blon lnga bcas thog zer 'tshub pa ltar rjes 'ded du song zhing / dpa' rtul rnams tshur rta kha bskor ba dang / g.yu rtse rgyal pos g.yu zhags bya 'dzin de klad la 'phyar bzhin pho bdud kyi rngam gzugs la sdig pa'i na bun 'thul le'i ngang glu 'di ltar blangs par gda'o/glu 'u na a lu tha lu red na 'o 'o/tha lu 'u na la lu re na 'o 'o/la lu ngag gi 'gugs lugs red na 'o 'o/lhan gcig skyes pa'i bdud lha mkhyen no 'o 'o/yul la gnas pa'i gzhi bdag mkhyen/nag po bdud kyi lha srung rnams/ rlung ltar ma dal chas la shog282

skyen pa'i zhags kha 'tsho rogs gyis/sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na/dpa' med wa bros byed sa red/pha rgod am gtsigs bsdam sa red/ nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na/pho rgod yin rgyu'i bu de yin/sgos dgra gling la thug le red/phar phar bros na pho bla tshong /gling sdug nang gi bu mo red/bu mo 'phang cha 'khur mi red/da res dmag gi kha sngon nas/bu gces dbang thang rdzogs zhan 'dra/mi rgod mda' smyug sil ma yin/dpa' rgod gza' rgod 'grim 'grim yin/ru rting gnon pa'i rta rkyang skya/mtho 'dod pho gsar o zob can/ rta gsar 'gro 'dod kha skor can/ dpyad na ma ngan jo nā 'dra/da res thug pa yid sems spro/sgug ma dgos bdud lhas bkug lugs la/pho gsar rang snang che le de/chag sgo rang gis nyo mi red/'phrul dang bkra glags rgyal khams phung /283

nang tsho drug gnyen gyi gnya' gnon byed/med na phyi nang 'dug tshod bde/da res gson la bzhag bsam med/ dpe na 'dra ma e 'dra gda'/nyi zla 'od mdangs gsal bsam ste/4 sgra gcan khyab 'jug 'phrad nyin mo/'od 'khyil le'i ming de stong pa red/dug sbrul rngam 'jigs che bsam ste/ri rab bya rgyal 'phrad nyin mo/lus rngam 'jigs dug rlangs stong pa red/chu gnas za bar chu srin rngam/ dkar dung phrug gdong dang 'phrad nyin mo/lus che ba'i rngam 'jigs sto4pa red/skye 'gro phung ba'i jo ru bu/g.yu rtse rgyal dang 'phrad pa'i dus/5 ming snyan grags che le stong pa red/rta rkyang rgod zer ba'i grags pa can/ de ring me ris bang kha bsdur/mgyogs dar dang po sus len lta/ge sar zor ba'i snyan grags can/da res rgyal pos dpa' rgod bsdur/dpa' rtags mgo 'phru sus len lta/dpa' rtul zer ba'i grags pa can/284

gdug pa blon gyis dpa' kha 'gran/pho rgod rtags ma sus len lta/ dpa' thengs gcig rgyal bas rgyal ba min/g.yul thengs dgu 'gyed nas su rgyal lta/ngas lag na bzung ba'i g.yu zhags 'di/mi nyag rgyal gyi pha zog red/'og ma klu yi las zog red/sngon mo mtshon gyis chod le min/ btab na bar snang rlung yang zin/dngos yod yin na 'chor bsam med/lus gru gu bzhin du ma bsdams na/dpa' rgyal pos bshad bshad stong pa yin/e zer ltos la bsgugs nas sdod/ces glu de ltar blangs nas sku rje khong la g.yu zhags de springs byang bas rgyal mchog rin po ches phyi nam mkha' stong pa/ nang rloms nyid stong pa/ bar rtsa rgyud stong pa stong gsum stong pa'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhag pas khos g.yu zhags de lan gsum g.yug kyang bar snang 'ja' la thebs rgyu med stabs/ khos zhags pa bzhag ste ral gri shubs nas phyung rtsis ngang dpa' rtul la las mdung phyung /la las gri phyar/ la las gzhu bkang ba'i ngang / dgra bla'i gnyen stag dmar po'i sprul pa stag chas can sum cu tham pa bong ril ba pho 'doms sum cu tsam yod pa shin tu rngam zil can mi re res rdo 'brong g.yag tsam dang rdo bang ba tsam rdo g.yag tsam khyer nas thams 285

cad kyis klad la bskor te dpa' ngar gyis glu 'di ltar blangs so/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu a la tha la tha la red/tha la la mo la la red/la la glu yi len lugs red/ bde chen chos sku'i zhing khams nas/ dbal ldan kun tu bzang po la/yengs med ngang nas gsol ba 'debs/'khrul snang bdud bgegs rtsad nas chod/'khrul med bu la dbugs dbyung stsol/ ye shes lnga yi pho brang nas/ long sku rgyal ba rigs lnga la/gsal dag ngang nas gsol ba 'debs/dug lnga'i nyon mongs rtsad nas chod/ོbdag rgyud dag par dbugs dbyung stsol/sprul pa'i sku yi pho brang nas/sprul sku rigs gsum mgon po la/rang shar rang grol gsol ba 'debs/snang ba 'khrul rtogs bdud bgegs brlag 4skal ldan rnams la dbugs dbyung stsol/dgung sngon dag pa'i gnas mchog nas/bka' brgyud bla ma lha tshogs mkhyen/las nyog bdud bgegs rtsad nas chod/286

skal ldan bu la byin rlabs stsol/dbang drag drag po'i gzhal yas nas/yi dam pad+ma he ru ka/rnam dag dad pas gsol ba 'debs/ dngos grub stsol la bdud bgegs bzlogaskal ldan yongs la dngos grub stsol/dam tshig rnam dag gzhal yas nas/ma tshogs mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la/rnam dag yid kyis gsol ba 'debs/chags sdang 'dzin pa'i bdud bgegs bzlogaskal ldan bu dang 'bral med skyong /legs nyes bka' yi bya ra ba/ chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho la/ g.yel med mchod cing brtson lags na/sdang byed bdud bgegs rdul du rlogs/dpa' rtul bu la srung skyob mdzod/dkar phyogs bstan la mngon dga' ba'i/ dgra bla wer ma zo dor dang / bod khams gzhi bdag gnas bdag rnams/da res rgyab rten ma g.yel ciganag phyogs bstan dgra rdul du rlogs/sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na/dkar phyogs lha mi khrom bzhin 'tshogs/287

nag hrigs bstan dgra rdul bzhin 'tshub/lha bdud g.yul chen 'gyed sa red/ nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na/ gling ya tha tshang gi rta rdzi yin/ma tha tshang gi lug rdzi yin/bar tha tshang gi bel rdzi yin/sked 'khor gsum bskor la re re na/lus 'khor gsum bskor ba da skabs yin/mtshon rnon po g.yug la byang le min/ rdo gor mo nges gnyis sngar 'dris che/dpung rogs rdo bzung sum cu 'di/ dpa' rtul sum cu'i rdzi bo yin/rdzi khra yag rdza la 'grim pa'i dus/'brong khyu rdo char phab nas bsad/sha khrag khyim la chad med byas/ nags ma'i gseng la rdzi bo song /gcan sder chags rdo char phab nas bsad/grwa yag dpa' rtul bzhugs gdan byas/dgong mo na mar gzhung la song rkyang kha dkar rdo char phab nas bsad/sgo khyir sha khrag chad med byas/ma bsdad rdzi bo so la song /phyi dgra rdo char phab nas bsad/288

rdzi rgod po zer ba'i ming g.yer byung / rdo gyad rdo brgyab pa kha gro byung /rdzi nga rang lag gi dpa' rdo 'di/rdo dkar po sbra gur tsam zhig yod/ sku yab tshangalopa'i bla rdo yin/khyod g.yu rtse rgyal la rgyag rgyu yin/sha rus 'dam ltar bzo rgyu yin/ rdzi dkar po lag gi dpa' rtags la/rdo ser po 'brong g.yag tshad tsam 'di/gnyan chen sku lha'i bla rdo yin/nyam pa blon la rgyag rgyu yin/sgong kog brag bar btsir bzhin byed/rdzi sngon po'i lag gi dpa' rdo 'di/pha wang sngon po g.yag tsam yod/klu chen gtsug na'i bla rdo yin/stong thub blon la rgyag rgyu yin/ sprang ma rdog pas brdzis pa bzhin/gcig med shi malamed pa bzo/rdo 'dra 'dra bzung ba du ma 'di/ma phog shor na rgyag rgyu yin/brgyab nas yu med bzo rgyu yin/ —ma zad nangayokyi nyi ma la/ tsho chung jag rkun sgar chung 'dir/— 289

rdzi pho rgod rdo yi char pa 'bebs/ gson mi gcig mi gtong blo thag chod/khong ge sar seng ge dkaram̐ mo la/khyod rda li khyi yis 'gran bsam ste/ lus rtsal drug bskos pa mnyam le min/nang rnam shes yal ba'i snga ltas red/ dpa' dgra lha'i rgyal po bya rgyal la/ khyod ltas ngan khwa tas 'gran bsam ste/gshog stobs shugs bskos pa mnyam le min/nag thar re gshog rtsal 'thor ltas red/gling ge sar khri gdugs nyi ma la/ khyod me khyer srin 'bus 'gran snang ste/'od zer bkrag mdangs mnyam le min/srin 'bu'i gshog rtsal 'khum ltas red/ gtam 'di tsho gser thigs zil ma yin/blo shes gsal yod na yid la zhogaces glu de ltar gsungs nas sprul pa thams cad kyis dus gcig tu 'ur 'ur ldir ldir ngang gyad rdo 'phangs pas/ bdud kyi rgyal blon thams cad gros ma byas par dpa' mnyam chag gis 'bros pa la blo phyogs nas rang rang gi cho 'phrul chen po'i mthus/ bdud rgyal dang mnyam pa'i spun bzhi bcas pha tshad gcig tu shor/ stong thub lnga la 'phrul med stabs mi rta chag nyil gyis bsad/ dpa' rtul rnams kyis d+mer yang phyir log nas sgar dkrug rtsis na ge sar 290

:rdo rjes byange :she :rdo :she 'phru thob khyesgon sa nga dpa' kha ma las slar bas rgyu da gsungs nas thag gtsang mar bcad de ki bswo lha rgyal gyi sgra bsgagang mas tshar ngamag mar nga bas ba ngang bcas ce phebs ras thems / ra pa / / ༄ca rang / 7 /bcad dga' spro dang bcas te bzhugs so/ 291

le'u bdun pa/khrag ral ma nyid rgyal blon rtsa ru phyin/byang 'gro'i lam las bshol te 'phrul sgar bcas/rgyal btsun blon dmag gling la chas lam du/gling rje'i dbyeng gis sna gings khrag ral bsgral/de nas bdud kyi rgyal blon thams cad bya ba nyes pa'i sdug bsngal dang bcas dmag skur du 'dus nas thams cad bka' gros ma brtson pa'i skabs dom thugs dkar can gyi gdan steng nas nag po stong bdud lan med des gros thag gcod pa'i glu 'di blangs so/glu 'o na a lu tha lu red/ tha lu 'o na la lu red/la lu ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/gnam thel dkar po ra dkar skya/de ring rgyal po'i sku chus gzigs/bar thel khra bo ra khra skya/gdug pa blon la srung skyob mdzod/sa thil nag po ra nag skya/'bangs sde khra mo'i bstan chus 'tshos/292

sa 'di zi rong sa mtshams red/ nga 'dra nag po bdud kyi bu/nyi ma de snga yan chad la/stong bdud mi stong khrag la bsgres/lan ya med nas lan med thogs /phyogs yotshams kun la grags le yin/da res byas kyi yo lang la/gling sdurgo jag pa'i kha sngon nas/dpa' rtags nam mkha'i 'ja' ltar yal/phar g.yug mtshon gyis mi chod le/gnam lcag4khro chu'i pha wang red/'ching byed zhags kyis mi 'ching le/dngos med skyi bser rlung gi bu/mi gcig mi gnyis mi the ba'i/lus 'khor gsum skor tshad dpa' rgod red/rta gcig rta gnyis mi the ba'i/rta lus thob tshad rlung gshog red/ kha sang 'gran gyi ya med de/shed chen yongs la grags pas zer/khos zer zer rdzi bo yin pas zer/gcig mi tshad pho rgod sum cu gda'/gzugs che ba klu btsan sa tham 'dra/dngos med sgyu ma e yi na bsam/293

rdo pha wang rgyag rdo ya la la shed che ba'i 'ur sgra di ri ri/stong thub mi rta chag nyil bsad/ pho de la lan ya su yis zin/dgra la bstod pa ma yin te/la rgya yin tshul 'dra ma yin/de nas rgyal po blon po'i tshogs/gros dbang thams cad glu la gson/ kha gsang mgon po'i lha lung bzhin/mdang gsum 'dod yon longs spyod zas/rtsol sgrub ma dgos lhun gyis grub/lha yi dngos grub ngo mtshar— che/lha yi lung la nor 'khrul med/ zi ma sde pha'i ma tha na/nag shod mi med lung dgu yod/zhib par yid la mi rtogs te/ dpyad na zhag bdun ye slebs bsam/nyi ma sang gi nam langs nas/dpung dmag mi sdod shar bskyod 'gro/rgyal po khyod dang she le gnyis/sgyu ma 'phrul la dbang thob pas/rdzas dang yo byad ci dgos gsogadapung btsan khri ma 'bum du brdzus /294

dngos yod dpung yang de mnyam 'gro/me 'bar rdzas kyis dmag sgar srungs/zhag lam chu tshod bstud nas 'gro/rbadud kyis a mye 'bum thub mjal/'chi ba slong ba'i sman dpyad bsten/'dzam gling phung ba'i stobs 'phrul zhu/de rgyab rang yul gzhis la 'gro/gling sdug yu med bzo bas chog༄ rgyal sa rang tshang bdag pas chogade tsam brel ba dgos don med/lo gcig mi bshol rang thag chod/de ste bya ba mi legs 'dugaklu mgon 'gran med sku mched gnyis/de 'dra dgra yis 'tshe sems med/de ring dus gcig rmi lam bzhin/ blo sems mthun dang las don 'grub/'dir tshogs yid la de ltar zhogaces glu de ltar btang ste gros thag bcad nas 'gro ba'i grabs la brtson zhing bdud lhas bstsal ba'i zas gos thams cad nyar tshags byas/ nyi ma de yi snga dgong bdud mo khrag ral ma de nyal ba'i rmi lam shin tu 'tshub cing bsdad pas pa mi non/ dkar phyogs lhas sems myos par byas pa'i rkyen gyis ma dbang byed brdzus ma'i sar phyin nas ming po dang rgyal po bde min lta bar 'gro rgyu blo 295

dris pas/ dgra bla'i sring lcam dbang byed mos legs nyes ma 'dres pa gsal ler gzigs pas dgos don gnad la smin par mkhyen nas de ltar yong ba'i bka' slob gnang ma thag bdud mo'i 'jigs rngam mi zad ngang slar dbugs btsud rlung gi rkyal pa 'khrul 'khor gyi rkang pa bzhi byas pa la bzhon nas sprin grib las mgyogs par song nas chu tshod drug gi mtshams der bdud kyi dpung sgar der mun rub pa dang dus mnyam 'byor bas rgyal blon thams cad dga' tshor bsam gyis mi khyab pa byang / de nas nang du 'tshogs te za btung byed bzhin 'gro 'durgo kyi gtam gleng byas pa na/ klu mgon dang mi rgod ya med gnyis shor ba thos pas mo sdug bsngal gyis dran pa nyams par gyur kyang chus slar dran pa sos/ de nas bdud lhas lung byung lugs dang gros thag bcad lugs sogs zhib par chad lus med pa bshad pas/ mo gdug rtsub kyi nga rgyal mi bzod pa 'khrug pa'i ngang slar mos rang thag hril gyis bcad nas na re/'dir bzhugs rgyal po ming po tsho/ thugs ma bab ma gsung e 'dra bsam/ sman nga yi glu 'di gsan par zhu zer nas bdud mo'i 'o klu la drangs nas glu 'di ltar blangs so/glu 'o na a lu la lu red na 'o 'o/la glu 'o na len glu red na 'o 'o/'o na bdud kyis len lugs red na 'o 'o/dug gi rgya mtsho dmar nag klong / nad kyi nad bun 'thib pa'i dbus/phung byed gdol mo khrag mig ma/296

lhan skyes lha la mchod cing bstod/khrag ral bu bo'i glu sna drongs/sa 'di sngar rgyus che le min/de ring rgyal blon 'dzoms sa red/nga 'dra tha chung khrag ral ma/mo lo sum cu so drug yin/gnam lo 'di dang so bdun yin/skye 'gro yongs kyi srog bdag yin/dbyar zla gsum na bun nged gnyis 'grogs/rkang bzhi phyugs kyi srid la 'tshe/bzho ba'i nu ma skem par byed/ma zad 'gro ba yongs la 'tshe/ston zla gsum ser sprin nged gnyis 'grogs/rtsi bcud 'bras bu yongs la sdang /khyad par lo thog sad ser gtong /mu ge mi zad 'gro la gtong /dgun zla gsum kha ba rlung dang 'grogs/'gro la nad kyi sna 'dren byed/sdang dgra yongs kyi bla tshe rku/rang sems dga' ba'i las la 'bad/de ste da lo'i gnam lo la/bsam bsam lam du mi 'gro 'dugardzu 'phrul lus kyi rtsal yang nyams/297

bskyod na bla tshe mi lon 'dugand kyis 'gro kun mi 'chi 'dugablo bsam pa'i thog tu mi bab 'dugadabang po'i nus rtsal nyams pa 'dra/nyams kyang 'gyod pa ga la yod/da dung 'go lha sku drin zhu/'dir bzhugs rgyal blon rnam pa tsho/me 'bar4 rdzas kyi 'phral 'khor de/mkho ba'i nam zla narmo dus red/chu dang gad pa g.yangs sa de/sgyu ma ngom dus nam zla red/sgar srung dgos phebs ci la red/mi nyag g.yu rtse rgyal po khyod/gu lang dbang phyug grub pas zer/mi dang mi bzhin gleng rgyu yod/sna tshogs sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul de/mi dgos dus na rdul ltar 'tshub/dbyings nas thog lce'i 'phrul 'khor dang /bar snang rlung gri'i 'phrul 'khor gyis/sa gzhi stobs 'phrul steng 'og bsgyur/stobs rang dbang yod dus ma byas na/gzhan la re dus a dgos chung /'jam shu re mi yul ci la 'gro/298

shar bdud gdug pa'i bu rgyud tsho/nag po stong bdud lan med khyod/mkhas pa skyogs la dbang thob zer/bdud rgyal gonyan la blo 'dri gyis/pho rang tshod ma shor las gcig gyis /dmar po btsan skya 'bum thub khyod/mtshon gyi 'phral 'khor dbang thob zer/dmar po babyon la blo 'dri gyis/pho rang tshod ma shor las gcig gyis/shed chen 'gran gyi ya med khyod/dpung pas glang chen rdeb yin zer/nyams pa da mu bdud blo 'dri gyis/pho rang tshod ma shor las gcig dgos/dkar po she le lag ring khyod/sgyu ma'i 'phrul la dbang thob zer/the'u rangs 'phrul la blo 'dri gyis/rang tshod ma shor las gcig dgos/nga tha chung bu mo khrag ral mas/mthon po ri bo'i rtse nas 'gugs/rgya mtsho che yang hub kyis 'thung /nyi zla brjid kyang 'od dang 'gran/ ge sar rngam yang stobs dang 'gran/nyin la mi g.yel thabs shes lta/299

ma/tshan la mi g.yel bla tshe rku/ 'phrul chen yongs rdzogs ma 'gyed bar/nag shod yul der 'gro le min/ dper na 'dra ma e 'dra gda'/seng ge dkar yag gangs la rngam/rtsal drug 'dzoms tshe sder bzhi bsgrad/nam zhig gangs ri zhu song na/seng lcam ci yong las bskos red/ rgya stag nags ri 'dzoms dus rngam/gra yag rgyas tshe sder bzhi bsgrad/nam zhig nags ri bsregs song na/rgya stag ci yong las bskos red/gtsang rgyas chab la gser nya 'khor/gtsang chab rgyas tshe mtsho mtha' bskor/nam zhig nyi mas bskams song na/gser nya ci yong las bskos red/rgyal blon 'dzoms tshe dgra la rngam/dpung dmag ldan tshe 'thab ra 'cha'/nam phugs dpung gis ma brtan tshe/rgyal blon ci yong las bskos red/kha sang sku mched rnam pa gnyis/bkrongs pa'i sha tsapan ma lon na/lus 'khor gsum bskor ba a dgos chung /300

sang la bskyod rtsis bden nges na/wa rnga ma sha le bros pa bas/stag 'dzoms drug nyil le shi na dga'/zer yang zer la bden yang bden/ de tsho 'dir bzhugs yid la zhogaces glu de ltar blangs pas thams cad gong gi bdud lha'e lung la cha 'jog byas rung bdud mo ngan dbang btsan pa dang gling lhas bkug pa'i dbang gis 'gro rgya bshol te me 'bar rdzas kyi 'phral 'khor gyis dang po dmag sgar rū nas chab mtsho dpag tshad 'khyirlo ba/de'i phyi la gad pa stong brtsegs yod pa/ de'i phyi la me dpung dpag tshad tsam 'bar ba zhig tu bsgyur/ nang du bya spu sna tshogs dang / lcags phye dang zangs phye la brdzus pa'i dpung bya 'phru can sna tshogs yod pa bdun khri tham pa mngon sum ltar bsgyur te dpung dmag gis ji byed pa ltar dbyer mi phyes par gnas/ ti 3/ nge ri phyi nangs rang rang gi stobs 'phrul la brtson bzhin/ zhag bdun gnyis gong / dbyings nas thog lce'i 'phrul 'khor dang / bar snang rlung gri'i 'phrul 'khor/ sa gzhir stobs kyi phung sgosas/gzhan yang skyogs dang ral gri mtshon gyi 'phrul 'khor sogs 3༷nga pa byas nas rang rang la 'go ba'i bdud rnams mchod rgyur brtson dzor ra byed do/ nyi ma de yi dus su tsho drug gling dkar khra mo'i gtso pagadag mgo nag yongs kyi mgon skyabs/ nag phyogs bdung da gra'i 0 4shed ma/ gling rje ge sar rgyal po de dpa' rtul phu nu dpung dngabacas pas/ mtha' narnga4 bskor ba'i dus/ gling rje ge sar rgyal / ngo sa 〈/ 1

a khu spyi dpon dang bka' gros zhib par mdzad rjes slar dpa' rtul rnams gros rar 'dus nas thams cad kyi gros don thugs su chud/de nas stag rong dpon dang gdong btsan gnyis las gur du ma bos gong lha dang bla ma'i khrus dang sga sde'i me thun sogs gnang rjes nang du bos te gral mdor gdan rkyang gi steng du bzhag nas gling gi gzu pha khrims kyi dpon po 'khrul gyi lha blon gyis bka' don gyi glu 'di ltar blangs so/oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūṃ/glu a la tha la tha la red/tha la la mo la la red/la la ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo nas/drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma mkhyen/sems yengs med rang zhal mjal bar shogachos sku snang ba mtha' yas mkhyen/longs sku thugs rje chen po mkhyen/sprul sku pad+ma 'byang gnas mkhyen/rigs drug 'khor ba dong na sprugs/sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas par shogs 'di zi gling rong gsum rma/do/yang sgos rgyal blon sku mdun red/chos dang srid kyi khrims ra red/nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na/302

gnam a sngon dar nas sbrang char dar/char zim bu sa gzhi'i grogs la 'bab/brlan drod 'dzoms pas rtsi bcud 'khrungs/dbu nag skye 'gro'i rgyan la che/bod dbu nag dar nas dus bya dar/bya khu byug bod yul rgya lcang 'grim/skad drug 'gyur snyan pas sa steng khyab/mon bya skye 'gro'i rgyan la che/ gling tsho drug dar nas gzu pa dar/gzu bden rdzun dbye zhing dkar nag phye/rgyal khrims g.yo med gzu dpon byed/chos srid 'jig rten rgyan la che/gling gi rgyal rabs bco brgyad la/nga gzu pha blon rabs bco brgyad yin/a sngon mthong rgya che yang rung /de 'og yod pa'i nyi zla de/gling chen bzhi la rang dbang che/ri rab mtho rgya che yang rung /de ltag yod pa'i gser ri bdun/'dzam bu gling la rang dbang che/gling rgyal blon go sa che yang rung /khrims gcod gzu pha rang dbang che/chos khrims dar gyi mdud pa la/303

dar mdud pa rgyag mi gzu pha yin/rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing de/yang ljid 'gyogs ri/ gzu pha yin/yul bde dar dkar yug 'gril la/ras dar dkar kha tshar gzu pha yin/de rang bstod min ste 'dra ma yin/de nas ma bzhi dpon po dang /pho rgod gdong btsan a dang/'a/ gnyis/ gson zer na rig pa grung la phyangs/a sngon nam mkha'i rgyan gcirko po/khri gdugs nyi ma sku zil can /mun pa gsal ba'i sgron me la/ srin me khyer 'gran snang che le red/ri rab ri yi kha rgyan la/bya rgyal khyung chen stobs shugs can༈gdug pa 'dul ba'i stobs chen la/'ol ser 'gran snang che le red/dbu nag bod kyi rgyan gcig la/sa gsum 'gran med ge sar rgya' /rdzu 'phru' mnga' brnyes mkhyen brgya'i bangagapha khus 'gran snang che le red /zhe'u khyi yis seng la 'gran/gzugs gzhi 'thor ba'i snga ‘stas red/304

ser chung grum pas stag la 'gran/rnam shes yal ba'i snga ltas red/g.yag chung rog pos 'brong la 'gran/ru thur 'thor ba'i snga ltas red/stag rong dpon gyis rgyal la 'gran/gdan sa 'chor ba'i snga ltas red/ de tsho glu yi 'dra ma yin/a khu stag rong dpon po khyod /smug po gdong gi rgyal rgyud red/ gling da bzhugs rnams kyi che 'go red/tsho drug skyob pa'i dpon po byas/nyam chung kun gyi pha ma dang /'gro ba'i skyabs gnas yin mod kyang /ye nas rang rgyud ma thul ba/bden pa'i rgyu 'bras khyad du sad/rang rgyal gzhan pham zug ngu che /rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing ste/khri/ mas yig zhal lce bcu gsum la/ bdag dbang yod dus ma zhib nyes/spyi dpon tsho drug gling gi dpon/'on terna.a khu khro rgyal gyis/gser khri khrims yig khrims chas rnams/sger bdag byas pa rang gis nyes/ 305

rta sa g.yag sa 'bri sa dang /ra sa lug sa la sogs pa/sa bzang gsum mdo gong ma de/kha chad g.yar po lo gsum red/g.yar ngan bdag 'gyur lo drug red/'phrog dang dbang po che yis bdagami lo bco brgyad sger bdag byas/btsan tshod ma zin a khu nyes/ ge sar yid bzhin nor bu yi/sku la ci bsdos thugs bsam skor/— nu bo seng slon ga ma de/dbang med a sdug g.yog gral bshaṃganom chen rgyu nor sger bdag nyes/'og ma klu yi me tog de/a khur mgyogs dar ma thob rkyen/g.yo 'phrul ngan pa'i le khag bkal/zhe gnag sbyor tsub mi med bskyal/bya ba nyes chen gnyis pa yin/'gran med lha yi dung zla de/rgyu skar skar chen brdzus pa'i dus/gza' khyab 'jug gyur mid bya bsam yang /gza' sgra gcan ral pa sa ma 'thor/bya ba nyes pa gsum pa yin/306

dngos med blo yi phung bshig gis/bsam sbyor ngan pa gtsug la bkur/mngon sum byad ma phung bshig 'bad/bya ba srog gi tshab skyin bab/bya ba nag chen bzhi pa yin/lha yi mchod rdzas me tog la/ brnab sems log pa spyad spyad nas/log pa'i skur 'debs byas pa nyes/dbang po mig gis 'jal bshags bab/bya ba nyes chen lnga pa yin/phyi dgra tshan lnga de nang du bsus/dgra thon rnam pa lnga ru bab/yin na so sor de lugs bab/bya ba nyes chen drug pa yin/zad med nor bu'i bang mdzod nas/rgyu yod ston chen bco brgyad bzhagasprang por sma phab bco brgyad byas/a la ya lan de lugs bab/bya ba nyes chen bdun pa yin/btsan po btsan gyi bka' bcad las/bla lam med pa'i rgyan po bzhag7 zhe phugs gting la g.yu rta bzhagargya dkar nag bar rgyug btsan po'i bka'/ 307

yod po'i skra la thor cog dang /med po yu bzhar byed snying 'dod/btsan pos rang tshod ma zin 'gyod/bya ba nyes chen brgyad pa yin/ gal thob gser gyi khri la bkod/rang nor rang gis mnga' bdag dang /lha dang mi yis mnga' gsol dus/'os min pha khus sdang ltas dang /ri byol sdang dgra nang du bsus/bya ba nyes chen dgu pa yin/ nyes dgu'i khrims la bshags pa med/khrims yig zhal lce'i nang las gsal/gsan bzhes gnang ngam stag rong dpon/nyi ma de snga phan chod la/dmar po me las bka' khrims tsha/ri gseb spyang las rgyug kha myur/ chu nang nya las spyan mig gsal/ri gzar rbab las bang kha mgyogs/me cha rdeb las blo kha myar/byas byas blo yis bskor rdzogs gyis/nged cag dpa' rtul phu nu yis/ma bshad blo la yi ge bkra/ngo tsha 'jigs skrag 'gyod pa yis/308

sngar byas las la bshags pa bab/phyin chad gang bzhed ci gsung pa/ nyams med sgrub pa'i khas len 'tshal/drin chen-i yid bzhin nor bu der/thugs khro ba yod kyang 'dzin pa med/gnyen khu bo yongs la thugs rtsis che/ma skye 'gro yongs la byams pa che/ sgos stag sras rnams la brtse gdung che/de phyiṛ bka' gsal phebs don la/ bya kha ta nag lu'i rjes ngan la/mda' nyag phran min pa ma bab kyang / de mi byed mda' mkhan ngang rgyud bsrings/ bya thang dkar yag pa'i ngo drin 'jog srin bya 'ug pa'i ha bgad la/sngags gtor rgyag min pa ma bab kyang /de mi byed sngags rgan ngang rgyud bsrings/bdud mgon chen po'i ngo drin srung /ri gseb spyang ki'i byas rjes la/'ur khra ring rdzong mda' los bab kyang /de mi byed rdzi bos ngang rgyud bsrings/snang srid lha 'dre'i ngo drin srung /stag rong gdong btsan byas rjes la/gnas dbyangs nyes chen los bab kyang /༄ 309

de mi byed rgyal mchog ngang rgyud bsrings/sras rgyud rnams kyis ngo drin srung /lugs gnyis mgo nag yongs kyi gtso/phyi ma'i skyabs gnas 'khor lo'i mgon/shin tu bka' gnyan sku brjid las/ ling dar mtshon sna lnga'i zong yug brgya/gra yag stag lpags bcu gsum tshan/gser dngul rdel tshad sne grangs brgya/gong sa dpon la che bshags dgos/'bum pa'i lha sras zhal dkar mched/spyi dpon seng blon mched gnyis la/gra yag gzig lpags bcu gsum tshan/re re tshan pa grangs mnyam dgos/ dpa' rtags dgra mtha' bcom nus na/a khu sngar lam rang sar 'jog tsan+dan stag gdan rang babs gdan/stag rong chus srid sras rgyud gtso/rang snang lam 'khyer chog shes med/lha ri'i mgo la lha bsangs dang /klu ri'i mgo 'a/ klu bsangs dang / shar rma rgyal spom rar smer bsangs sogs/khrims kyi bab thang du ma yang yang bzos sras rgyud ngo drin yin/310 rdzo

slad nas bag yod spyod pa gzab/gdong btsan po bu yi a dpal bu/dmar po me ri 'bar ba la/shing skam 'bud kha ci la babs/yul grur chu chen 'bab sa la/char chu'i khan pa ci la babs/yul gru mi mthun rtsod gzhi dus/dbyen khas slar dkrug ci la byed/khro thung blo log skye ba'i dus/gting gyod gdong btsan ci la 'tsho/khyod shes med ba glang gser rgyan can/pho gsar rang snang che ba'i bu/a tsi mi yi ham shed la/skyid nyi mas gling bzhi bskor le dang /sgron mes khang pa gsal le gnyis/'dra bsam yod de 'dra le min/mun pa bsal lugarme kha kha red/khyu byag sngon mo'i gsung skad dang /tirngo ting byi'u'i snyan 'gyur gnyis/'dra bsam yod de 'dra le min/snyan pas khyab lugs kha kha red/rgya stag khra mo'i 'dzom drug dang /se chung grum pa'i gra lo gnyis/311

'dra bsam yod de 'dra le min/lus gra 'dzom me ri kha kha red/'dzam gling dbang bsgyur rgyal po dang /yul gru dbang ba'i dpon po gnyis/dbang 'dra bsam yod de 'dra le min/thob stobs 'byor mnga' thang kha kha red/yul gzhan rgyangs 'bud gtong ba 'am/khrims lugs bkod 'doms dgos nges kyang /sku mched sras kyi ngo drin 'jogastag rong rang gzhis bzung chog med/stag bde 'bo la gsar rnying nas/gdam dud dud grangs sum brgya dang /rang sger rgyu nor mig gsal bcas/gdong gi spyi dpon rgyal po la/zhe gnag bkur btab nyes 'gal du/tshe 'dir skyid sdug ci mdzad gyis/blon gral 'bangs sde gzhung bzang dgos/pha dang khu bo khyad par med/ bu la bu bzhin legs tshar na/sku chus zin pa rang lag yin/ma myong ma tshar ma skyes tshe/sna tshogs ci 'byang nges med red/'di don gzu zlos bka' bcad yin/312

mthon pos nga che shod sa med/khrims 'go a sngon dgung las mtho/khrims thig dgu thig las kyang drang / khrims gzhi sa gzhi las kyang brling /gzu ra slag gser khrab dpe bzhin du/nang phu nu rnams la yang bzos byas/gzu drang thig la ni bsnol rdzogs med/bdud yul 'khyar ba'i blon tshogs kyi/kun gzhi'i bsam pa 'gyur ma 'gyur/ rim sa pha bzhin du lta zhib byed/glu go na rna ba'i rgyan du zhogam go glu la 'bras bu med/khro mchog yab sras thugs la zhogaces bka' bcad pa ltar thams cad nas bslab bya gnang /stag rong dpon nas ci bya med par legs so zhu dgos byang nas phyis mi 'gyur ba'i gan rgya phul/ de nas lha dang bla mablo mdun sar rtsa gsum lha yi tshogs 'bum/ snang gsal mar me'i stong mchod/ rgya ja dmar po'i bzhes skyems sogs phul shing sku 'gyed gser ṭam lnga re phul zhing / lha dang bla ma'i thugs dgongs dwangs par byas/ gling gzu pha chen pos a khu sgom chen gting med dang rgyal mchog ge sar rin po che'i bka' ltar gdug pa rgyal blon la mthu zor rgyag dgos pa 'i bka' bcad byang ba bzhin rgyal dpon nas legs par sgrub rgyu dang / nya tsha darā gzigs 'phen gnyis 313

nas legs zhus kyis gdong btsan spyi dpon shog la 'jags rgyu mdzad nas bya ba 'phro gtsang zhing rten 'brel legs byas phun sum tshogs par gyur/ gong ma lha yi bden tshig gis/ gnyen yang dgra la dgra yang gnyen/ gnod skyel bya ba phan du bsgyur/ rten 'brel ya rabs mchog tu shis/ de nas nyi ma de yi phyi nang sgom chen gting med kyis gtor zor 'dren pa la thugs thag legs rung /a khu khro rgyal nas gnam lcags thog lce 'dren pa la mos/ de yis dus su del chen mtsho khug gi gseng zhig tu bon gtor zor chen po'i sgrub pa 'bad cing sku srung stag rong rang tshang gi sras blon dpung bcas kyis mdzad/ de nas zhag lnga'i gong nyams pa bdud kyi nang tshan srin bdud khrag ral ma de ming po shor ba'i sdug bsngal dang mthu rtsal che ba'i nga rgyal dang gdug tsub kyis khengs te mo rang gcig por gling sgar du rtags ma len du 'gro rgyu byas nas thon rtsis la kun gyis bshol yang bshol ma thob te/ g.yu rtse rgyal po dang she le lag ring gsum dpung sgrig rgyu kha dan byas nas rang rang gi chas gos go mtshon gyis bskor cing 'phrul gyi rta gsum la bzhon nas sgar nas thon pa dang / dgra lha gnyan stag de nyid gser gyi sbrang ma zhig la sprul nas skyes mchog dgra lha'i rgyal po'i snyan gong g.yas su bab nas/ kyai/ 'dzam gling skyong ba'i rgyal po/ snyan dbang dam pa gson dang / nyams pa gdug pa'i khrod nas/ dam sri bdud mo nag mo bdud pho g.yu rtse rgyal po/ blon po she le lag ring /dam sri mi min gsum po dpung bsgrigs sgar 'dir thon ran/ lha sgar nang du shor na/ nags tshal me yis bsreg bzhin byas la 'pho 314 rab

'phyug srid yong / ge sar khyed kyi sprul pa/ stag cha4canakyisabagyi 1phrag rgyal po'i sku yi srung ba/ zhe rtul khra glag spyang gsum/nged cag dgra bla'i dmag tshogs/ myar bar shugs kyis bskyod yong / lha bdud gnyis po stobs 'grar+sha/ gnam sa cha lang rdeb rdeb/ thugs gzhi spobs pa ma chung / bdud mo dgra lhas bcings yong / 'dul mdzad dgra lha mchog go/ de tshe gzhis sdod lha blas/ gu ru grags po'i gsal snang / lha sngags khyer so ma bral/ bka' slob myur du gnang 'tshal/ zhes zhus nas lha klu gnyan gsum ser sprin chad pa ltar bdud kyi rgyal btsun blon gsum gyi gdong len la phebs so/ dgra lha ge sar rgyal po de nyid rlung sems rta la bskyon nas gling gi bla ma dang a khu sgom chen gting med bcas kyi mdun sar phebs nas lha lung nyams med bka' bstsal/gu drag gi gsal snang dang lha sngags khyer so gsum mi 'bral ba byed dgos pa'i bka' slob gnang / de nas rgyal mchog rin po ches dgra lha'i go mtshon sna dgu sku la brjid par klubs te mjal na sems yid spro ba/ dgra bzhi zil gyi non le/ wer ma ngang gis 'du ba/ dgra lha grib bzhin 'grogs pa/ lha dbang g.yul du chas pa ltar chibs pa rkyang rgod 'phel po mthong dga' skyid pa'i gong du chibs/ 'dan ma dang dga' sde dpa' la gsum yang dpa' brjid yid du 'ong ba dgra dar tshubs se sku 'khor bzhi po bskal pa'i rlung chen bdun gyi shugs 'gros kyis bskyod pa na zi rong smad kyi yang 'gag der rgyal btsun blon gsum dang mda' ltong sprad pa ltar thug pas bdud kyi rje blon gsum nas de ma thag shin tu rngam pa rte/nga

rang 'dra dbyer mi phyes pa bcu re 'khor du bskor nas phyi chad med par byung ba dang rgyal mchog rin po che'i sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa dpa' bo ltag chas can brgya phrag dang / lha klu gnyan gsum gyi sprul pa brgya phrag chu sna ltar brdol zhing / de yi nang nas rgyal mchog sku yi sprul pa mi dkar lha yi dbang po lta bu rta dkar gangs seng la sga srab spras 'dra'i gong la thon nas rta kha bkag gri mgo 'phur nas dgra bo 'dul ba'i 'gying glu 'di ltar bzhengs so/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu a la pha rgyud nam mkha'i glu/tha la ma rgyud sa bzhi'i glu/ la la gnyis med zung 'jug glu/pha rgyud bka' rgyud bla ma'i glu/dgra nyon mongs mgo bo bcom nyin len/ma rgyud mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i glu/bdud mo dam la 'dogs nyin len/gnyis med thabs shes zung 'jug len/ nga bdag gzugs 'dzin bsgral nyin len/ lha dkon mchog rtsa gsum spyi bor bzhugs/dbang bzhi skal ldan bu la stsol/ nyon mongs sgrib ba'i dag par mdzod/'das ma 'ongs da lta'i sangs rgyas rnams/rgyab rten mdzod la bdung tshogs sgrol/lha klu gnyan gsum bgra lha'e dpung / 316

dkar phyogs bstan pa srung ba rnams/da res ma g.yel 'phrin las mdzod/snying rje khros po'i gzugs sku bzhengs/mngon spyod drag pa'i las la dgongs/bstan dgra sger dgra nyams pa'i dgra/bla tshe longs la snying khrag bzhes/ming tsam med pa rdul du rlogs/rnam shes dbyings bzhugs thugs dkar bstim/bde gshegs rgyal ba'i sras su bsgyur/ glu go'am thos sam rgyal btsun blon/sa 'di tsho 'gag dog gcong rong sa/bdud pho mo gnon sa'i sa cha red/nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na/lha chen tshangs pa'i sras po yin/ gtsug na rin chen tsha bo red/ ger mdzo gnyan po'i bu dod yin/dkar phyogs bstan pa'i gtsug rgyan yin/'gro ba bde la 'god mi yin/nag phyogs nyams bdud kha gnon yin/mngon sum mgo ske 'bral mi yin/gong ma lha nas bskos le yin/bskos pa'i mi de 'khrungs pa 'dra / btsugs pa'i shing de skyes pa 'dra /

bu dod lhun gyis grub pa 'dra/'phrang dog po 'di 'dra'i lam so la/sgug ma dgos dgra dang 'phrad lugs la/'dri mi dgos bdud kyi rje blon tsho/don gal chen de ring 'phrad pa skyid/mi nyob rdung rnam smin lci rogs red/bu de drag dpa' kha mnyam na gsal/pho su rgyal dbye ba de nas 'byed/rta su mgyogs mgyogs dar de nas lon/sman bu mo skra dmar srin mo'i ngo /'dri ma dgos tha chung khrag ral ma/ zhe sdang me ri 'bar ba la/snying rje chu bo'i kha gnon red/nu ma mche ba gzengs zhan 'dra/khro ba chen po'i gzi byin gyis/mi sdug srin mo zil gyis gnon/pho bdud sayu rtse rgyal po khyod/nus pa med pa'i nga rgyal can/depa' rtsal med pa wa mo'i bu/stong gtam g.yu 'brug sgra la 'gran/lag len nam mkha'i 'ja' shar khyod/a ba re la snying re rje/ kling rgyal blon dpung la 'gran mi la/318

lha klu gnyan gyi stobs rtsal dgos/'chi bdag 'dra ba'i nus mthu dgos/rlung bser bu 'dra ba'i dngos med dgos/glog dmar po 'dra ba'i myur mgyogs dgos/dpung zad med chu bo'i rgyun bzhin dgos/ar jag jag pa'i sprang dpon la/de la mdzangs ma zer rabs med/pho ngan rus med rkun po la/de la dpa' rgod zer4 rabs med/de snga byang lung rkun jag byas/pho rgod gdong dang ma 'phrad 'duganyams chung mi bsad rgyu nor 'phrogabyas pa'i las 'bras rang gi sdigade ring rang la smin nges yin/mtho ba dbyings nas 'gro lam bkagarlung gi spu gri'i 'khor lo bskor/bar snang khams nas mi shor le/ting 'dzin bcad rgya rim bdun btab/sa gzhi khams nas mi 'chor le/snang srid dregs pa las la bskul/khyod dngos yod min yang thar bsam med/dpa' rtsal yod na ngom ran red/sgyu ma yod na ston ran red/ 31(

da res yod na de yod yin/da res med na de med yin/de ring thar bsom dgra la sgyur/dgra bsgyur nag po bdud la sgyur / 4tshur chas pho rgod lha dmag dpung /gnam sa kha 'thab ya nga med/ gshin rje 'phrad kyang phyi nud med/sku srog lcags las grub le yin/'chi med rang dbang thob le yin/stong gsum gshog pa'i ral gri 'di/bdag 'dzin phung po gcode pa'i gri/skye rgyud rtsad nas gcod pa'i gri/gri 'di'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar che/dus la bab na rim pas gsal/min na mgo 'bul dwangs len dgos/ —bzang ngan glu lan smros la lta/glu go na gtam gyi rdo ga yin/ma go gla la 'bras bu med/khyod rtsog yid la de ltar zhogaces glu de ltar bzhengs pas bdud mo dam nyams mo sbrul la tsher lcag brab pa ltar shin tu khro zhing 'bar nas bong ring ri bran dang mnyam pa kha nas khrag gi char pa sna nas nad kyi na bun 'thul ba/sdig pa'i mun pa 'khrigs shing / bdud rgyal kho yang de bzhin 320

bdud kyi 'phrul chen po'i stobs rtsal gzugs byad khrag ral ma dang mnyam pa sa gzhi g.yo (5gul nyig nyig ri bo 'dar shi4/ shis nyi ma dmar 'od lam lam 'od zer mi snang bar bsgribs/ bzhin nga/ra phar ri'i rtse nas bzung tshur ri bdud mos bsnyil rtsis kyi rtsal phyung nas bdud mo des dpa' rngam gyi glu 'di ltar blangs par gad 'o glu a lu 'o na tha la red/'o na ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/'o gcig 'o gnyis 'o dang dgu/'o dgu steng na bzhugs pa yi/gu lang dbang phyug 'phrul po che/'khor du bdud rigs bye ba 'bum/gnod byed bgegs rigs sa yas bskor/skye 'gro yongs kyi srog gcod mkhan/de ring tha chung grogs la byon/dpa' rtags rtags ma lag la zhogadagra sha dgra khrag mchod pa 'bul/brgya stong khri gsod khas len 'bul/rang chus bstan pa dar bar shogs 'di rang sa 'phrul med yin/nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na/klu srin mi min sras mo la/a ma stobs chen dbang byed la/snang srid lha 'dre kun kyang 'du/du21

mi chen lha 'dre'i sras re 'khrungs/sgo nga rang mdog nang nas rdol/stobs rtsal 'gran med yongs la grags/nga 'dra tha chung khrag ral ma/mo bdud kun gyi rje mo yin/skye 'gro yongs kyi srog bdag yin/sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra bo yin/gling sdug khyod kyi dam sri yin/dam chos mi bden 'bras bu med/dge 'dun mi bden srung bya med/sangs rgyas mi bden lta ba med/ sems can mi bden rgyu 'bras med/dge sdig mi bden spangs blang med/ 7med la yod bzhin smra mkhas khyod/chos nang pa zer dus zhe spro lang / sgos gling sdug 'gog mo'i bu tsha khyod/rgyu nor zas med sprang po'i bu/bra ba gro ma kham zas byas/rgo ba be'u'i slog pa can/dar gos 'tsho zas skal ba chad/ngan pa yul dgu phung ba'i bu/gling sdug nang gi dkrug shing khyod/pha dang khu bo'i gnya' gnon khyod/

nged nag po bdud kyi sgos dgra khyod/de ring thug pa dga' lu mu/de drag rta dmag sha ra ra/dpa' rngam dgra zil tshubs se tshubs/mi 'jig rkan sgra thag se thagadapung yod mdog sngon rjes dmag gis bkang /dper na dgra ma e 'dra gda'/byi'u nag sag gshog sgra bsgrigs zhan 'dra/lcags khra nged la nyam nga med/bar snang rlung dang sdeb pa'i dus/mchu sder khrag la bsgres pas chogagayag chung ru gra bsgrigs zhan ('dra/kho mo 'brong la nyam nga med/ri gseb gad ngang sdeb pa'i dus/ru thur khrag la bsgres pas chog gcan spyang sder brgya bsgrad zhan 'dra/gangs seng dkar mor nyam nga med/sil sil sgra skad sgrogs che'i dus/gcan brgya zil gyis mnan pas chogagling sdug dpung gra bsgrigs zhan 'dra/rgyal btsun nged la ya nga med/dpung shugs stobs shugs phyung ba'i dus/yu med gtan dang phral bas chog

e zer ltos la mi zer ltos/dar gcis sgugs dang rim pas gsal/go bskor mtshon cha 'gran bsam med/bsnyil na ri rab rtse nas bsnyil/bsgyur na gnam sa steng 'og bsgyur/brdabs ma nyi zla cha 'a nga rdeb/dkrug na rgya mtsho'i gting nas dkruga'athab na gling sdug bu la 'thab/'gras na nang pa'i bstan la 'gras/brlag ni gling gi bstan pa brlagakhyod tsho bdud kyi phung 'dre red/ngeng kyang bstan bshig dam nyams yin/ rang snang dpa' mdog 'dra 'dra yin/rang sems zhe thag rbad chod yin/nag po bdud kyi lha srung tsho/ da res ma g.yel rgyab rten mdzod/'u sa grib ma bzhin du 'bral med skyongs/dpung shugs phyung la dgra 'dre sgrol/chags pa'i sa mal med pa byed/khyong rang yid la de ltar zhogaces glu de ltar blangs nas mo dang g.yu rtse gnyis kyis ri bo bsnyil du nye ba na/ ge sar dgra lha'i rgyal po khong gis ri gnyis po de lcags kyi dbus ri lhun po zhig la bsgoms pas ri g.yo 'gul 324

tsam las bsnyil rgyu phar bzhag mthar g.yo 'gul tsam yang ma nus/de ma thag sku rjes rlung gi pha ma bu dgu rlung bum pa can gyi zhabs su mnan te skad cig drag tu btang bas bdud kyi rgyal btsun blon gsum dpag tshad gcig nam mkhar btegs te sar lhung ba'i tshe bdud lhas dbugs dbyang nas srog chen ma chad kyang dar gcig rgyal ba'i tshe bdud khyab༄ pa lag ring dang nyul byed ma/ mi dgu khrag mig ma the'u rangs u wer ma la sogs pas rgyal btsun blon gsum pang du blangs nas dran pa sos shing na ba sangs/ de'i tshe gu lang dbang phyug dang dgra lha'i gnyan stag gnyis gdong thus pa dang / lha klu gnyan gsum dang the'u rangs dkar nag khra/ gsum 'khrug so so'i bzhi bdag dang zo do ra sog sa 'khrug nas ri g.yo ba dang 'a gul ba 'ur sgra dir sgra skar mda' dang me lce bab pa la sogs byas/ dpa' rtul gsum gyis ci bya dang 'di bya med pa'i ngang 'dan mas bdud lhar dmi gas nas mdun sa'i na bun 'thul ba'i phyogs la mda' brgyab/ seng stag gis ral gri g.yug sga sdes snang srid zil gnon gyi sku lam gyis gsal te phyogs mtshams la sdig mdzub me 'bar ba bstan pas bdud lha rnams rim gyis ma bzod nas rgyab rten dang sdongs grogs byas pa yal song / dgra lha ge sar rgyal po khong gis bdud kyi rje dpon gsum dus gcig bsgral bar dgongs kyang bdud lhas dbugs dbyung nas bdud lha'i grogs dang bcas phar tsam phyir log tu 'gro mus ngang / dgra bla gnyan stag dang lha klu gnyan gsum gyis zhags btab nas bdud mo tha chung khrag ral ma bzung ste skad gcig tu khra yis byi'u khyer ba ltar 32 du

rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis 'then pas bdud kyis rgyal blon gnyis kyis gar khyer ma mthong / kho rang gnyis la dgra bla wer ma dpa' bo stag chas can du mas gri rdo sogs char bzhin phab pas lus la phog nas gzer che bas sar lhung la khad du phar phar ded/ kho rang gnyis kyis mda' re 'phangs pas mi du ma bsgril thub pa'i snang ba shar bas mda' rnams yongs rdzogs zad/ gri mdung gis lan ci thub ca/ byung zhing dbugs nus zad cing dpa' tshod bzung nas dar ga sgar gyi phyogs su shor nas de thon 'gyod pa tshad med ngang la 'byor/ bdud mo tha chung khreg ral de sa 'gag de yi yar nang /srib ri nag po'i gdong sna/ nyin ri chu bo rbab sna/ sa zad thang si 'amo/ sa mdo der rgyal blon rnams 'dzoms pa'i sar khrid nas ga/tan— stag dmar pos 'di la sprul pa cho 'phrul yod pas ting nge (ra dzir gyi dmigs pa dang lha zhags kyis dam por bcings nas zhe rtu' blon rnams kyis zungs/ mo dam nyams gdug 'dre nyams pa bi sri na mo yin pas dad pa 'jog dka' bas drag po mngon spyod kyis sgrol la smon lam tha tshig bzang po mdzod gsungs pa'i lung byang ba ngang / zhe rtul rnams kyis mo la sdig mo mdzad pa na mos bsdud mo/'i cha lugs nu ma khrag la bkal shing mche ba gtsigs nas ngas khyong rang rnams kyi bstan pa smad cing srog gcod byed nus par shog ces zer ba dang / 'dzam gling bde skyid kyi lha skal/ mgo nag / yongs kyi dgra lha/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje byi na rlabs nus mthu gcig tu bsdus pa'i rang gzugs ge sar nor bu ngagra 'dul khong stong nyid snying rje chen po'i ngang ye shes khro bo chen 326

po'i sku ru bzhengs nas mo'i brang dkyil la zhabs g.yas pas brdzis nas gri chung shel gri yu dkar 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi phyag mtshan de phyag tu bzung nas snying rje chen po'i bden tshig smon lam gyi glu 'di ltar bzhengs par gda' 'o/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ glu a ni chos dbyings skye ba med/ la ni gsal mdangs longs spyod rdzogs/tha ni 'gag med sprul pa'i sku/sku gsum dug gsum rang grol glu/ ༄nyon mongs dgra bo 'dul ba'i glu/'dod chags bdud mo sgol ba'i glu/sangs rgyas sngon nas sajes rgyas pa'i/smon lam rnam dag mthu btsan pa'i/thog ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang /de la dgongs rgyud rdo rje sems/dga' rab rdo rje shri seng / pad ma 'byung gnas gtso dang 'khor/rje 'bangs grub chen brgyad cu dang /gter ston rig 'dzin rgyud bcas la/bzod med gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/skyes bu'i las smon 'grub par shogaphyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang /skal bzang sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis/327

dus gsum byon dang byon pa yi/byang chub sems pa ji snyed dang /gsung rabs mdo sde bcu gnyis chos/sde gnyis 'phags pa'i dge 'ducha la/bzod med gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ nyams bdud 'dul ba'i grogs la byon/sdig can phung po yon du 'bul/rnam shes bde chen zhing du drongs/skyes bu'i las smon 'grub par shogs 'di snang yul so so ste/dag na snang yul bde chen zhing /ma dag bdud mo bsha' ra red/mi nga la snang yul so so ste/ma dag jo ru srog gi gshed/nag po bdud kyi kha gnon yin/dag na sangs rgyas 'dus sku yin/khams gsum bde la 'god mi yin/rigs drug thar lam skyel mi yin/seng chen lha yi bla ma yin/de nas nyams pa'i bdud mo khyod/khyod ye thog sngon nas smon lam nyams/bar du ma rig dug lngas 'khrul/'khrul ba rang ngo ma zin pas/328

nyon mongs cher spyad nyon mongs 'phel/nyon mongs dgra la zad mtha' med/ zhe sdang dmyal ba'i gnas su skye /btso sres tsha grang ya re nga /ser sna'i rgyu rkyen yi dwags skye/bkres skom sdug bsngal ya re nga /'dod chags rang snang 'khrul ba'i rkyen/dag na snang mtha' bde chen zhing /gti nu/ga 'a/sa rkyen dud 'gror skye/glen lkugs bkol spyod sdug re bsngal/gti mug cher bskyed 'khru'/ ba'i rkyen/dag na rnam snang stug po bkod/phrag dog rgyu rkyen lha min skye/'thab rtsod pham ltung sdug bsngal che/phrag dog cher bskyed 'khrul ba'i rkyen/dag na don grub las rab rdzogs/nga rgyal rgyu rkyen lha ru skye/tshe lo ring po'i sdugo bsngal che/nga rgyal 'khrul ba nyon mongs rkyen/dag na rin 'byung dpal ldan zhing /dug lnga gnas dag ye shes lnga/ye shes rgyal ba rig lnga yab/khams lnga gnas dag yum chen lnga/ 3 29

tshogs brgyad gnas dag sems dpa' brgyad/yul brgyad gnas dag sems ma brgyad/rtogs tshogs gnas dag mchod lha brgyad/tshad med bzhi ldan sgo ma bzhi/ye shes gsal dag sgo ma bzhi/nyon mongs dug 'joms thub drug sku/rang lus rgyal ba zhi khro'i sku/shes na lha yi pho brang gsal/e ma bdud mo khrag ral ma/ 'gro ba sems can pha ma ste/gcig za gcig gsod ya re nga /rang gi lus la dpe longs la/gzhan 'a gnod pa ma byed cigadri ma med pa rgyal ba'i gsung /khyod skyes nas nyi ma da bar du/gnod cing 'tshe bar ci byas pa/bsam pa blo yis skor rdzogs gyis/ 'gro ba yongs kyi bla tshe brkus/srog bcad byas byas bgrang tshod med/rgya nor 'phrog bcom gleng tshod med/ rdokar po chos la skur ba btab/sangs rgyas bstan la log par bltas/bdag cag rnams la sgos dgra byas/330

sku gsung thugs kyi rten mchod bshigabastan dgra dam nyams bdud mo khyod/lo mang rim pas sdig bsags na/dmyal khams bco brgyad kha brgyud nas/bskal pa stong la yar thar med/khyod 'brel thams cad ngan song lhung /khyod ming thos pas bsod nams nyams/de phyir da lta nas bsgral na/'khor ba mtha' rkyen don yod phyir/byams dang snying rjes bsgral bar bya/ de snga lag 'brel byang tshad rnams/gcig kyang ngan gleng btang ma myong /nga gsod pa'i shan par ma bsgoms par/'dren pa'i bla mar sgom shes na/'pho ba myar thabs gsang lam gyis/mtshon rkyo khab rtse tsam sdig mi dgos/thar pa'i zhing skyel u 'u tsi/de tsho ci dga' smra lan gyis/yid la nges tshe bsam blo thongs/a mtshar mo bdud mo khrag ral ma/rngam pa'i mche ba gtsigs zhan 'dra/lha sras nga la ya nga med/gzugs brnyan sprul sgyuroci byas kyang /

ting 'dzin zhags pas 'chor sa med/g.yo 'khrul bslu thabs ci byas kyang /ci dang ci 'byang gsal ler gsal/dad pa'i 'dron pa ma thob par/ngan 'brel drag pos ma bsgral na/srin mo thar pa thob dus med/de phyir drag po'i las la 'jugagri chung yu ba dkar po 'di/lha rnams kun gyi phyag mtshan yin/shes rab ye shes ral gri yin/ma rig nyon mongs bdud lus 'dir/bzod med snying rje'i byed las byed/bdud kyi gnya' nas gnon pa'i phyir/lha dkon mchog thugs g.yeng ma mdzad cigabadud mo'i sdig sgrib byang bar shogadakar phyogs chos kyi dbu 'phang bstod/nag phyogs bstan pa phyi la gnon/dam nyams las ngan zad par shogamago nag skye lus thob par shogalta bar byed pa mig yin pas/bdud mo'i mig 'bras phyi la phyang /nyan par byed pa rna ba yin/ ༄bdud mo'i rna ba g.yas g.yo na 'breg332

snom par byed pa sna yin pas/nyams pa bdud mo'i sna de 'bregastob par byed pa lag yin pas/dam nyams bdud mo'i lag gnyis 'brega'agro bar byed pa rkang pa yin/dam nyams bdud mo'i rkang pa gcod/ma dkon mchog rtsa gsum mthu ma chung /rigasaṃ gsum mgon po thugs ma g.yel/pad ma 'byung gnas byin ma chung /dus gsum sangs rgyas byang chub sems/smon lam dam bca' ma dor bar/bdud mor rngan 'don srog bcad na/bsags pa'i sdig grib byang bar shogadakar phyogs bstan pa'i dbu 'phang bstod/nag phyogs bstan pa ar la gtod/dam nyams las ngan zad par shogalo'ongs skye ba phyi ma la/ nyon mongs dug lnga rang grol nas/ye shes lnga ldan khong nas shar/gzhan don bya ba byed nus shogadran par byed pa snying yin pas/snying gi dwangs ma phyi la 'don/snying rtsa shel gyi sbu gu na/3 33

zhi lha bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis bzhugs/mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo na/ dag pa rig 'dzin lha tshogs bzhugs/klad pa dung khang pho brang na/khrag 'thung khro bo'i lha tshogs bzhugs/mngon sum khyod kyis mthong bar shogalha de khyod kyi ye shes lha/zer de rang snang ye shes zer/ sgra thos hūṃ phaḍa rgyob sod smra/ thams cad rang gi ye shes smra/gzhan nas shar ba'i lha ma yin/rang snang lha la gsol ba thob/lha tshogs thugs rje ma chung zhigabadud mo dam nyams zhing la drongs/phung po 'dod yon tshogs su 'bul/rnam shes phaḍa kyis dbyings la sbyongs/ka pa la yi nang rol du/ sha khrag thams cad dum bur gtub/rang byang thod sgyid steng du btsugs/gturmo mo'i me sbar drod kyis khowa.a hūṃ yig 'bru 'od du zhu/sha khrag 'dod yon bdud rtsir 'gyur/thog ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang / 334

longs sku rgyal ba rigs lnga dang /sprul sku rigs gsum mgon po la/ sha khrag bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/rnam shes bde chen zhing du drongs/bdud lus lha la 'gyur ba shog smon lam bzang po rgyas thebs shoganyams pa'i sdig grib byang nas kyang /'bras bu gzhan don nus par shogakun bzang rdor sems rgyal po dza/ran+t+ra sems klong man ngag ste/bka' bab rig 'dzin bcu pa bcas/rdzogs chen rgyud pa'i bla ma la/sha khrag bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/rnam shes bde chen zhing du drongs/bdud lus lha la 'gyur bar shogasmon lam bzang po'i rgyas thob shoganyams pa'i sdig sgrib byang nas kyang /'bras bu gzhan don nus par shogadrin chen rtsa rgyud bla ma sogs/ thugs rje'i mnga' bdag khyed rnams la/sha khrag bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/rnam shes bde chen zhing du drongs/bdud lus /lha la 'gyur bar shog335

smon lam bzang po rgyas thebs shoganyams pa'i sdig sgrib byang nas kyang /'bras bu gzhan don nus par shogabade mchog kye yi rdo rje dang /yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drug dang / —bka' brgyad dgongs 'dus phur pa'i lha/phyag rdzogs rab 'byams yi dam lha/sha khrag bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/rnam shes bde chen zhing du drongs/bdud lus lha la 'gyur bar shogasmon lam bzang po rgyas thebs shog nyams pa'i sdig sgrib byang nas kyang / 'bras bu gzhan don nus par shogam tshogs mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo che rgyal yum rdo rje phag mo dang /sgrol ma nyer gcig rigs byed ma/lha mo 'od zer can ma sogs/gnas yul zhing skyong dpa' bo dang /ma tshogs mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la/sha khrag bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/rnam shes bde chen zhing du drongs/bdud lus lha la 'gyur bar shogasmon lam bzang po'i rgyas thebs nas/336

nyams pa'i sdig sgrib dag par shoga'abras bus gzhan don nus par shogatshangs pa lha dang dung skyong dkar/ger mdzo gnyan dang gnyan gyi tshogs/gtsug na klu dang klu sbrul 'od/ne ne gnam sman dkar mo dang /sring mo the le 'od 'phro sogs/dgra lha gnyan stag skyob pa'i lha/pho lha sum brgya drug cu la/sha khrag bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/rnam shes bde chen zhing du drongs/bdud lus lha la 'gyur bar shogasmon lam bzang po'i rgyas thebs nas/nyams pa'i sdig sgrib dag par shoga'abras bu gzhan don nus par shogawer ma sum brgya drug cu bswo/gnam sa bar snang wer ma che/'brug glog rlung dmar chibs pa dang /gangs brag rdza dang na ba chu/nags tshal la gnas wer ma che/stag seng 'brong rkyang rgo ba rgod/nya pir chibs pa'i wer ma la/sha khrag bdud rtsi'i dpa' skyems 'bul/33/7

dkar phyogs bstod la nag phyogs gnon/nyams pa'i bdud lus lha la sgyur/sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang /bstan dgra 'dul ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/mgon chen sde lnga dpal mgon tshogs/srid pa'i rgyal mo dmag zor ma/chos skyong pho rgyud mo rgyud la/ sha khrag bdud rtsi'i dpa' skyems 'bul/bdud mo thar pa'i lam du skyol/slad nas sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas/bdud kyi skye lus lha la sgyur/ dkar po chos kyi bstan pa mtho/ nag phyogs bstan dgra 'joms gyur cigatshe ring mched lnga g.yu sgron ma/ bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis dang /rje yi mgul lha bcu gsum dang /dge bsnyen nyi shu rtsa gcig dang /dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu dang /sngags bdag dregs chen bco brgyad sogs/bod dang bod khams skyong ba yi/ rig 'dzin pad mas bka' bsgos pa'i/snang srid gzhi gnas thams cad la/sha khrag bdud rtsi'i dpa' skyems 'bul/338

bdud mo 'di la gegs ma byed/bdud kyi skye lus lha la bsgyur/dkar po chos kyi bstan pa mtho/ nag phyogs bstan dgra 'joms gyur cigalegs ldan dgra bla bcu gsum dang /dgra lha gra ma mched dgu dang /dgra lha mi thub spun gsum dang /pha tshan dgra lha'i lha gnyan dang /skyes bu nga la 'go ba'i lha/ cogs po lam lha gnyan po dang /rma gnyen spom ra rma rigs sde/dogra lha gzhi bdag zo dor la/sha khrag bdud rtsi'i dpa' skyems 'bul/bdud mo sgrol bar gegs ma byed/ bdud kyi skye lus lha la bsgyur1dkar po chos kyi bstan pa mtho/phyogs las rnam rgyal rgyal mtshan phyor/snyan pa'i ba dan srid gsum sgrengs/grags pa'i dung chen khams gsum bus/'dzam gling khams kyi bdud rigs rnams/bstan rdagra ma lus thal bar rlogs/nag phyogs byang chub sems ldan zhing /dkar po'i srung sdom shes par shog339

dge rtsa mya gu 'khrungs par shogabyang sermos lo 'dab rgyas par shogasku gsum 'bras bu smin par shogaslad nas nyams pa'i bdud rigs la/'di 'dra'i ngan gsod mi dgos shogaphyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang /byang chub sems dpa' nyan rang sogs/chos dang dge 'dun bden stobs kyis/smon lam gang btab 'grub par shogartsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams dang /las smon rnam dag bdag gi stobs/kun tu bzang dang 'ardzam dbyangs dang /spyan ras gzigs sogs byang sems kyis/'gro ba sems can kun don phyir/smon lam stobs chen gang btab pa/de bzhin bdag smon grub gyur cigaces smon glu de ltar bstsal zhing snying rje tshad med pas spyan chab lo zil lhung ba ltar gyis 'gro ba sems can don la dgongs te bdud mo mngon spyod drag pos bsgral zhing phung po mngon sum du lha la tshogs su phul/ rnam shes btsan thabs kyis spar kyang ma dad pa'i dbang gis srin po rda ri ga'i grong du srin po'i bu mor skyes nas smon lam mthu btsan pas rim gyis gu ru rnam par gnon pa'i 'dul ba'i snod du gyur/340

de nas rgyal mchog dam pa dang zhe rtul khra glag spyang gsum dang bcas pa phyed yol lug gi dus gling sgar du bsu ma dang bcas phyag phebs/ gzhis sdod bla ma mi chen dpung bcas thugs sems bde ba'i mjal kha zhus shing las gur du 'tshogs pa na gling rje nyid kyis byes 'gro'i legs byas kyi glu 'di rgyal po'i khrom chen zil gnon la drangs nas bzhengs par gda' 'o/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ glu a la tha la tha la red/tha la skye yi len lugs red/la la ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/glu len na byang chub rgyud nas len/ngag bkug na don dam dbyings nas 'gugs/bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum/'bral med snying nas gso' ba 'debs/'gro khams chos la 'khod par shogs 'di tsho zi ma gling gi mtshams/rong gsum 'dus pa'i 'dus mdo red/nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na/'gog mo'i bu sdug jo ru nga /gling rgyal po'i ming thogs da tsam red/gdan gser khri mnan nas dgra mgo dar/dgra stobs chen thog dmar lhung lhung red/snying rtsal chen ma rdzogs skyid re che/341

de skyid de sngon gyi las bskos red/lha gong mas bdud dgra'i gshed la bskos /gsod lag len dus su snying re rje/don de yang dpyad na sems can don/da nang zhogs pa snga sa la/dgra lha gnyan stag dmar po des/lung bstan me lcags rdeb rdeb red/ ngedo bzhis rlung dmar 'tshub 'tshub byas/sa btsan zi rong yar 'gag tu/bdud kyi rgyal btsun blon gsum 'phrad/lha bdud gnyis pos stobs rtsal 'gran/dam sri bdud mo khrag ral ma/lus che ri bran tsam zhig la/kha nas khrag char thu lu lu/sna nas nad kyi na bun 'thul/mi sdug srin mo khro nyams la/snang srid lha 'dre yin kyang dngangs/bdud rgyal 'jigs rngam de bas che/nyin ri bdud mo'i lag gis bsnyab/srib ri bdud mos rtse nas bzung /sa gzhi g.yo 'gul nyig se nyigari mgo 'dar zhing rgya mtsho dkruganyi ma dmar 'od lam se lam/342

bdud lha ser sprin chad chad red/dpung rogs bu gces 'brang 'brang red/'jig rten bla 'og bsgyur rtsis dus/ngas dkar phyogs lha la ra mda' sbran/sems nyid chos sku'i klong yangs nas/rdzu 'phrul lus kyi rtsal yang phyung /smon log stobs rtsal zil gyis mnan/dpa' rtul dpung grogs nus shugs phyung /lha bdud gzhi bdag zo dor 'thab/gnam sa cha lang rdeb rdeb byas/bdud kyi rgyal blon gnyis po de/'thab 'thab rting pa'i so nam la/dgra lha wer ma'i gdong grogs kyis/lus rtsib chen bcag cing rtsib chung rmas/thang chad dpa' tshod phyir bros shor/bdud mo tha chung khrag ral ma/ 5gnyan stag dmar pos zhags kyis bzung /mi bzhin lag tu sprad nas byang /nged bzhis sdig mo byas tsa rno/ bdud mo khro gtum je che red/nu ma phrag bkal mche ba gtsigs/smon log ca co je zhan red/4 byams pasko bden tshig ma nyan byung /phya43

mngon spyod drag pos grichung phyang /dam nyams las sgrib byang bablo phyir/gzugs bzhi phung po lhu tshigs phral/sha re tsha ste gong ma'i bka'/yi re mug ste skye 'gro'i don/ya re nga ste byed blo med/rtsa gsum mchog gsum thugs rje bskul/smon lam bzang pos mtshams sbyar zhing /'pho ba bzang pos rgyas 'debs byas/sha khrag lha la gtang rag phul/bdud lus lha la 'gyur bar shogade tsho byes song lo rgyus lags/da res ar jag nyams pa 'di/dam sri spun dgu'i skye ba dngos/dpung kha zheng chung ste 'phrul re che/mi re re ngar ba'i gdong len dka'/rang 'gar brnyas bcos byed rgyu med/srung ba bla ma thugs ma g.yel/nga'i srang 'khor rdo rje'i gur khang de/cis rkyong g.yo med rim rgyas thob/skabs re bsad bzlog thugs blo brtan/sgom chen lung bab ji bzhin bsgrubs/a khu spyi dpon gtso byas pa'i/344

dpa' rtul phu nu thugs gros mdzod/dmag dang bu rta mgo thon pa/ rang byus rgyal dar dgung la phyar/sdang dgra thal bar brlag pa'i phyir/phar 'gro gza' skar bzang la dpyad/shes mchog mo mas mo phya thob/dgra thog tu ma bab snga rgol gzab/nyams pa bdud dang bser bu rlung /phyogs gang nas 'ur 'ong cha med red/g.yu rtse rgyal dang ser sprin gnyis/mtho mkha' nas nam 'tshub nges med red/nyams pa'i bdud blon yang thang gnyis/skya dza re nam slebs nges med red/nyams pa'i dpung dang dug sbrang gnyis/zi di ri bar snang nam 'tshab red/pho so sos le shor med le rdogos/nga ge sare rang che ci la khur/ gong ma lha nas bskos le yin/bskos bzhin bu yis khas len byas/chung ma las skyes nas tshun chad du/bdud dgra bo btul btul bshad tshod med/lho 'dzam gling bdud dgra ma thul bar/bu ge sar 'gro don rdzogs le min/446

lha bla ma'i dgongs pa 'gro la dgongs/'gro ba'i sdod chus ma 'grub bar/dam bca' thal bar dor bsam med/ lho 'dzam gling grags pas khyab pa dang /chos mdo sngags bstan pa spel bsam yod/dpa' rtul phu nu grogs mched rnams/sha khrag lus la ma 'khrungs dus/nyon mongs drib mas ma gos dus/'khor ba'i rkyen gyis ma bslad dus/skye lus grub chen sha stag red / nag phyogs bdud kyi kha gnon du/dus gcig gling la skye ba bzhes/— rgyal blon pha khu phu nu'i tshul/mi yul gdan gyi gral ra gcigatshang ma 'gro ba'i don la byon/ sems can gzhan don byed pa'i dus/rin chen srog la phang pa med/de phyir yin lugs glu chung red/glu mang po mi len mtshams la bzhagatshig don 'bras nor 'khrul med pas na/'dir 'khod thugs la de ltar zhog ces gsungs par thams cad yi rangs shing mngon par bstod/ de yi dus su thams cad nas rgyal mchog la rdzu 'phrul gyi 346

bkod pa dang thugs kyi mkhyen pa lha'i lung bstan sogs yod pa ma gtogs thabs blo gzhan ci mi 'dug sems/ pha spyi dpon gyi bsam par a khu sgom chen gting med dang / mo ma kun thig gnyis kyis dgongs las che/ 'on kyang rgyalamachog ge sar las lhag pa med pas rgyal po'i bka' la slar lan mi nus sems nas na re/ 'o na rgyal mchog gi bka' bzhin khra stod sgom chen gting med dang / shes mchog mo ma kun thig gnyis kyis lha lung byas mtha' nam rgyal/ dam nyams bdud kyi rgyal blon gyis gling rgyazlo blon dang lha sgar la 'tshe min/ dbang thang nam rdzogs kyi bka' lung zhig gnang ba thugs rje che zhes gsol ba dang / a khu sgom chen gting med des thugs mnyam par bzhag nas shesatso khong du chud nas slar ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs nas ya 'dir bzhugs rgyal blon grogs mched tsho/ nga sgom chen glu la tshur gson dang gsungs nas mgur glu 'di bzhengs so/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ glu a la tha la tha la red/tha la glu yi len lugs red/ la la ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/yongs med mtha' dang bral ba yi/sgom bya sgom byed blo las 'das/sku gsum rang thog rang shar la/sgom 'di sgom med cing gtad so med/gtad med gu yangs nga re spro/347

dgra dang mnod byed zug ngu med/bgegs dang lan chags gdon bgegs med/lha dang gnyen zhes bya ba med/re dgos med pa nga re skyid/'on kyang rnal 'byor tshogs dbus 'grim/sangs rgyas dgongs bcud gcig bsdus pa/rdo rje 'chang chen mi yi gzugs/bdud kyi gshed ma mthu bo che/ma sang 'phrul rgyal seng chen rje/zhal nyi mdangs rgyas pa mig yul pad/'khor blon tshogs grub chen sems dpa'i 'phrul/dus da lta sgrub pa'i tshul du bzhugs/bka' gsung brtag pa byed dgos gsungs/ci 'byung ma 'ong lung gsal de/a khus nga la dgos do gsungs/ khra rgan sgom rgan dgong sa mnyam yin/chos phyag rdzogs dbu gsum mnyam zhu yin/sgom 'tsho ba sbyor ba'i yon bdag yin/gsung zab mo slar ldog mi nus phyir/mi rgan kha nas glu chung len/mkhyen pa med kyang gang snang sgra/snang ba 'khrul pa'i brda lung la/da res glu zhig len snying byang /348 ༄

shing nags stug po brgya yod de/ dug bse shing zer ba brgya nang re /gcan sha bzan zer ba brgya yod kyang /stag mi bzan zer ba brgya nang re/bdud stobs chen zer ba brgya yod de/smon log pa'i dam nyams brgya nang re/da res dam sri nag mo 'di/pad ma'i sku la 'gran sems skyes/rje 'bangs lo paṇa chos rgyal la/gshe skur btab cing lta ba log gsang sngags chos la khyad du sdang /ma zad dam sri spun bdun de/mnar med gnas nas tshe 'phos te/dus gcig mi yul skye ba blangs/ ar jag jag pa'i sde tshogs chags/rim gyis mnga' thang je cher rgyas/mtha' ma dam nyams bdud kyi dmaga'adzam gling dbang bsgyur 'dzam gling khengs/skye 'gro sems can bkol spyod bran/mi che ches chung ngu za ba dang /sems can bde med sdug la gtad/shi tshad mnar med gan4su 'khrid/de phyir 'dul dgos rgyal ba'i lung /349
