dam nyams spun gyi a ma dang /da res btul ba'i dam sri mo/stobs de bas che ba su zhig yod/de thul ba dga' spro snying nas che/da mi 'gyangs nyams pa thul ran yin/bdud kyi gral ra zhig ran red/gdon bgegs rtsadanas 'bud ran red/kho cag bdud kyi rgyal blon rnams/nyams pa btsan bdud the'u rangs klu/dmu dang mi min 'byang po'i tshogs/mgon zhing mi bzhirno lung bstan gda'/dngos yod dpung sgar mi che ste/dngos med dngos ltar dmag sgar la/zil dang rngam brjid che le snang /ma zad dmag sgar phyi rol la/me chu gad pa sgyu ma'i 'phrul/mngon sum 'phrang la grub nas 'gi/rta rkyang min pas gshog sa med/rje seng chen med na byed blo med/khro rgyal dpon gyi zong zor des/dngos med dpung dang dngos yod bcas/gzhob rgod rdog pas brdzis pa bzhin/snga sa sngon nas gtong dgos yod/350

btang na dpa' kha thob nges red/da phyi na nyams pa'i bar gcod snang /kho cag bdud kyi cho 'phrul la/dbyings na thog lce'i 'phrul 'khor gcigabar snang rlung gri'i 'phrul 'khor gnyis/sa gzhir stobs kyi phung skyogs gsum/de 'brel 'phral gyis 'khor lo mang /nyin dang mazlon mo mi g.yel ba/da lta 'bad rtsol byed pa'i sgang /zhag bdun nas 'gyang na thub par dka'/nga rang snang ba'i brtag babs la/dpon khro rgyal zong zor gtor sgrub de/nyi ma gzhes la btang na sems/nyi ma de yi phyi nangs la/ma sang 'phrul gyi rgyal po la/sku 'khor dpa' rtul bcu gsum bcas/dgra sgar steng la bskyod na bsam/de phyir dpung dmag khas len 'di/a long bzhin du bskor na bsam/rgyal po phyi la mi 'chor ba'i/sga sdes bya rgod rgyu 'ching rgyobs/gal srid phyi la shor srid na/bdud kyi a mye 'buyothub rtsar/351

bdud lhas dbugs dbyung sna 'dren gyis/shor na bdud rgyal thul le min/ thugs rtsal chen bskyed mdzod rgyal blon rnams/rta 'do chen rbab rgod 'gril 'gril gyis/sha tsha bo'i snying rje skye rgyu med/ zas bcud chen rta yi phyi shar sdoms/thag gang la slebs 'gro nges med red/rdo sems khro bo sme brtsegs kyi/ skur bsgoms bsnyen sngags grangs su bzlos/nged rkyes srung 'khoram̐ skyabs 'og tu/cis kyang g.yeng med tshud par byed/'dus pa dpung dmag khra mo 'di/zhe sdang gdug tsub byed rgyu med/byams dang snying rje'i go cha sgos /shes rab ral gri'i gri gu phyung /nyon mongs dmag gi g.yul ngo gzhomo/dam pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan phyor/nang pa lha yi lha rgyal 'a then/de rjes lha yi lung yang srid/bdud kyi a mye 'a bum thub 'dul/ ngo mtshar che ba'i snying gter len/ar jag bdud sde stong skor de/ dkar phyogs dge ba'i lam la sgyur/352

dbu nag sdod chus gter g.yang len/gling rgyal blon bzhag pa thog ma yin/lho 'dzam gling chos la ma 'a/ pad bar/gling rgyal blon las mtha' rdzogs med red/sgom rgan nyams kyi glu dbyangs la/gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la/ khri gdugs nyi ma'i kha sngon nas/me khyer srin 'bus lam sna gsal/ma pham rgya mtsho'i klung 'gram na/sbrang char zil mas kha skom byed/ rma bya mdzes mo'i kha sngon na/de pho mtshal lus gshog mdangs ngom/sku rdo rje 'chang gi sku mdun na/sgom rgan nyams kyis lung brtag gnang /'gal 'khrul song na mthol lo bshags/rgyal blon grogs mched thugs la zhogaces brtag lung de ltar gnang bas sku rjes gser phye sbar gang dang / gser tram/ mdzod dar bcas phul nas dbu thod gtugs nas legs zhus gnang / de nas mo ma kun shes thig pos/dar dkar po gru bzhi kha gang ma zhig sa thog rtu bkram pa'i steng du me long la sogs pa'i mo chas rnams legs par bkod de mo ma'i rang ngag la drangs pa'i glu 'di blangs so/ o ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ 353

bar snang 'od gsal gzhal yas nas/gnyan gyi mo ma 'phrul po che/phyag na 'gugs pa'i zhags pa dang / ci yang brdzu ba'i stobs dang ldan/'od dmar klong nas mo phya ston/mo mkhyen mnga' ba 'bum gyis bskor/khams gsum gsal ba'i kha 'dzin mdzod/sgrib dang 'pho 'gyur med par mdzod/sa gzhi rgya mtsho 'khyil lam nas/klu mo mo la mnga' mdzad ma/sbrul lnga'i gdengs dang smad sbrul can/phyag na mo yi 'phrul spar bsnams/sku la rin chen sna tshogs dang /sgrib med 'ja' tshon sna lnga 'phro/mo la mnga' ba 'bum gyis bskor/de ring mo ma'i grogs la byon/gling dkar bstan pa'i chus srid dang /nyams pa'i dpung las nam rgyal ba/sgrib med gsal bar bstan du gsol/bzang ngan 'gyur ldog ma mdzad cigalha gnas sum cu rtsa gsum nas/ tshangs pa brgya byin lha 'khor 'bum/mngon mkhyen mnga' ba lha yi tshogs/354

de ring mo ma'i grogs la byon/mo 'debs phyin ci ma log pa/bzang ngan gsal bar bstan du gsol/srid pa ri rab khong seng nas/ dgra lha gnyan stag dmar po la/lha 'khor bye ba sa yas bskor/de ring mo ma'i grogs la byon/srid gsum lag mthil 'god rogs gyis/srid pa gsal ba'i gzhal yas nas/nu bo klu sbrul klu 'khor 'bum/thig le 'od 'phro snang srid lha/a ne rgod lcam lha 'khor 'bum/gling dkar bstan pa'i srung ma che/dam pa chos kyi bstan srung dang /bcom ldan rgyal ba shākya thub/rig 'dzin slob dpon pad+ma 'byung /bka' bsgos dam bzhag bstan srung dang /khyad par gdong rigs dgra lha'i sde/mthu chen wer ma'i tshogs dang bcas/de ring mo ma'i grogs la byon/srid gsum gsal ba'i mo 'di phob/bzang ngan go ldog ma nor zhigadagra lha'i bya rgyal gshog mo phobs/ 355

wer ma'i rgya stag 'dzoms rtsis phobs/ri rab kha yi rdul rtsis phobs/srid gsum gsal ba'i ju thig phobs/khra bo dmag gi mda' mo phobs/myur mgyogs jag pa'i sgrog mo phobs/ mo rigs brgya dang rtsa brgyad 'debs/mo chen ri bo'i rtse nas 'debs/mo gzhi rgya mtsho'i klong 'dra 'debs/khra bo dmag gi khrom rtsis 'debs/mo chen ri rab lhun po la/ gzhi phya 'pho 'gyur med pa'i mo/lha phya mthon po dgu thig la/ sprin dkar sked nas gcod pa'i mo/lha phya bar pa'i mo don 'di/'phral du mi lta rjes sor lta/ bdud nag po'i thog brdzis 'byung ba'i mo/mo gzhi ri rgyal 'pho 'gyur med/bar kha grogs phya dpag bsam shing /shing yal ga sked nas chag pa'i mo/dpyid g.yu 'dab rgyas rjes zhan pa de/rje ge sar mtshan 'dzin skyid pa'i sgang /bdud nag po'i bar gcod che ba'i mo/ mo gzhi rting pa gser gyi ri/356

gser phyes sa gzhi khyab pa'i mo/ge sar rgyal blon bzhag pa des/dbu nag skyid la 'khod pa'i mo/rting pa'i mo la thog mtha' bar/thog ma rin chen bum pa la/ bdud rtsi bcud kyis 'gengs pa dang /kha rgyan rma byas spras pa'i mo/gling dkar chos bstan mtho ba'i mo/bar pa bya rgyal thang dkar rgod/ brag dkar yag la gnas bca' zhing /ḍabar snang rlabs kyis gcod pa'i mo/rgyal blon dpa' rtul tshang ma rnams/'khor ba spangs nas dben gnas 'grim/bde chen sa lam bgrod pa'i mo/ tha ma me long nyi shar la/'ja' tshon 'od brgya 'phro ba'i mo/gling dkar yul skyes pho mo rnams/me long g.ya' rdul bral ba bzhin/nyon mongs zad nas chos nyid rgyas/tshom bu 'bum tsho 'bum tsho bcas/lus med 'pho chen rnyed pa'i mo/yi dwags dud 'gro dmyal ba'i gnas/thams cad stong zhing zad pa'i mo/357

de tsho gzhi gnas 'byang 'gyur lags/'phral mo dmag gi ṣ+pem rtsis la/ci dang ci 'byang gsal ba'i mo/dgu gcig rgosum lnga kher skyes gcigadang po'i nang nas mngon par mtho/dgu de spyang thang 'dan mar bab/sha bzan mda' mo sgro dkar 'dis/'phrul 'khor 'khor lo bshig pa'i mo/phung 'khor rtsad nas brlag pa'i mo/kher skyes stag mo stag rong dpon/btor zor dpa' rtags thob pa'i mo/dngos med sde dpung 'joms pa'i mo/lnga gsum khra glag gnyis la bab/sga sde dpa' la rgyal ngo mtho/rlung gri zer ma reg gcod mtho/leb chen mtshon kha bkye dgos yod/rlung gri sngo ljang gru gang de/lha min rlung srin lag la yod/leb chen so kha ma 'grims na/dpal rtul gzhan gyis lag len dka'/sga sde'i hūṃ shi phaḍa 'gyel sngags/rbad na dpa' rtags len pa'i mo/dgra bo rengs par 'ching ba'i mo/358

yang rgod thog lce zer ma bab/thog 'di dgra lha'i gdong rigs mo/dpa' dgra lha ge sar sku mched kyis/thog dmar pos rgya brag bshig pa bzhin/bdud rgyal blon rten dang phral ba'i mo/mo gzhung khrab dkar sil ma bab/dpa' rtul sku dgra med pa'i mo/dpa' rtags mtshon cha'i ngar la bab/dgra mtha' rtsad nas chod pa'i mo/da res gro bzhin khrums stod zla/yar ngo'i tshes pa bcu drug yin/gzhes nyin tshes pa bcu dgu nyin/nyi ma me bzhi sgrub sbyor la/drag po g.yul 'gyed dus tshod yin/tho rengs stag gi chu tshod la/sgra gcan rgyu ba'i gdong 'phrad na/zong zor gtor ma 'dren dus yin/nyi shar 'brug gi chu tshod la/drag po'i dpung dmag 'dren dus yin/nyi dros sbrul gyi chu tshod la/gling rjes 'phrang chen gshog dus yin/rta lug sprel bya chu tshod dus/'brong khyu ngar ma'i ra 'thab yin/359

rgyal blon rtsal kha zhan rgyu med /mchog dkar gzhu dang nyag phran mda'/mdung dang gri yi so kha gsos/pho chen rta la mgyogs rgyug sbyongs/ dpa' rtags rting ma'i rgyal mtshan che/sa gsum kun tu sgreng nges yin/sgom chen sgom thag gser gyi thig bka' gsung nges par nor 'khrul med/mo ma'i lung yang de mtshungs lags/de ring rgyal blon 'dzoms pa dang /dga' ba'i nyi ma 'char ba'i dus/bde skyid lha dang mnyam pa'i dus/thugs dgongs nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/gsung bzang tshangs dbyangs bdag la bstsal/legs nyes blang dor ston dgos gsungs/dper na 'dra ma e 'dra gda'/thabs kyi gzhu dang shes rab mda'/stag shar bzang po'i lus chas red/dpa' bo'i mtheb kyis rdzong nyin mo/'ur dir ri ma song mda' mo min/'do ba rta dang lhu bzhi sga/gong dpon lu bzang po'i sku chas red/skya da rgyug yob mthil sprad pa'i dus/360

seng khra le ma rgyug 'do chen min/gser ma dngul gyi gling bu de/bla lu dgon gyi sku chas red/dbugs skor mdzub rdeb byas pa'i dus/snyan lhang nger ma bkang gling bu min/sgom chen khong dang mo ma nga /gling dkar khra mo'i ming 'dzin red/dgos 'di gyis gsung bzang phebs pa'i dus/don ci 'dug ma bshad mo ma min/rje rgyal blon thugs kyi pad mo la/yid gnong 'gyod shor na mthol lo bshags/ngag 'khyal ba byung na bzod par gsol/zhes glu de ltar blangs pas skyes mchog ge sar rgyal pos gser tram lnga dang / dngul sgor bco lnga/ dar nyin mo bde legs bcas mo yon du bstsal/ mo don kun gyi thugs su chud/ gong gi rim 'gro thams cad kyis 'bad brtson g.yel ba med par byas so/361

le'u brgyad pa/g.yu rtse rgyal blon gros sar gnyan stag gis/bdud lhar sprul nas lung bstsal 'phrul sgar bzung /sgar sa gling gis bcom yang rgyal blon shor/'do rjes lung bstan dgra mtha' gcod lugs bshad/de nas bdud kyi rgyal blon gnyis dmag sgar du 'byor zhing /btsun mo khrag ral ma 'byor rgyu med pas shin tu sdug bsnga'/ gyis non nas gdan la 'khod pa dang / lo zla'i chang rag khrag la sbyar ba ngom par btungs nas rgyal blon gnyis kyis byes song gi lo rgyus bgrangs pa las 'di dang de byang gi don ma rtogs/ blon po mang ba'i yid la jo ru 'phrul po che༄ de'i kha sdun nas 'go thon pa khag po red snyam pa byung / dkar po she le lag ring de dar cig nas dran pa rnyed de rgyal blon la gros bslabs nas bdud lha la brtag pa zhu grabs kyis mi rta'i sha khrag gi bslar chen dud pa chil chil btang zhing bdud lha spyan 'dren 'bod skul byas pa na/ dag pa ye shes lha yi zhing khams nas rgyal dbang pad+ma 'byung gnas de nyid kyis legs nyes gsal bar gzigs nas dgra lha gnyan stag gi thugs rgyud bskul bas gnyan stag gis bdud kyi rang gzugs ji lta bur 362

sprul pa mdzad nas bdud kyi rgyal blon sar khyon nas sdig pa'i na bun 'khrigs pa zhig mdzad de lung bstan gyi glu thung 'di bzhengs so/glu 'u na a lu tha lu red na 'o 'o/tha lu 'o na la mo red na 'o 'o/lhan skyes lha yis kha 'dzin mdzod/'di 'dra bar snang dgung sngon nas/mun pa 'khrigs pa'i gur khang red/nga 'dra 'dri bshad ma dgos pa/rgyal blon mgon pa'i 'go lha red/legs nyes blo yi rdzi bo red/gros rogs blo 'dri byed sa yin/stobs ldan g.yu rtse rgyal po dang /rtsal chen nyams pa'i sku mched zung /blo mi bde kham kum ci la red/mya ngan sdug bsngal ci la gsogadran sdug chu rgyun ci la 'bebs/tshur tshur nyon dang 'dra ma yod/dug sbrul mgo yi nor bu de/dgos 'dod 'byang ba kun gyis shes/dang po'i dus na rā sems dgos/sems na nor bu lon r+ṣadagos/dpa' rgod gshin rje'i gdong len la/dpa' rtsal yod pa kunagyi4shes/ rte63

dang po gdong la ma lang dgos/langs na dgra srog chod le dgos/mdo mgron bskor ba'i tshong pa der/dka' ngal yod pa kun gyis shes/dang po'i dus nas ma bskyod dgos/bskyod nas khe skyed lon le dgos/rma khams gling gi 'thab ya de/dpa' rtsal rgod yin pa kun gyis shes/dang po'i dus nas ma 'gras dgos/'gras na rgyal kha lon nges dgos/de tsho babs kyi 'dra ma yin/thabs mkhas stobs rtsal 'gran med de/tha chung bu mo khrag ral red/dpa' med wa bros byed mi de/g.yu rtse rgyal blon rnam gnyis red/btsun mos 'thab 'thab 'dra mnyam las/dpa' mnyam pham rgyal ma byung dus/nged cag bdud lhas grogs byas nas/khrag ral 'dod pa'i re don ltar/a mye 'bum thub sku drung bskyal/ chad lus med pa zhu don gsol/thugs dgyes brtse bas rjes bzung nas/phan rim ci yang mdzad pa dang /364

'chi med tshe yi lcags ril dang /'chi ba slong ba'i sman dpyad bcas/zhag bdun thog la gnang rgyu mdzad/ma zad a mye 'bum thub kyang /btsun mos gdan 'dren thugs thag bcad/chas ka gdan gshoms zas sbyor zer/zhag brgyad mi 'gyangs 'byor nges yin/de tshe dpung sgar mgo thon pa'i/so so'i las 'gan bya ba rnams/le shor med par kun gyis sgrubs/blo rtse mang po'i 'dun gros de/ zer brjod mang na don 'bras phung /'gro 'dug mang na byur dang 'phrad/blo rtse mang na chag sgos ded/rgyal btsun blon tshogs ma 'dzoms bar/dpung sgar sgar sa gcig tu thobs/gyu ma 'phrul gyi sgar sngon nas/gling dpa' rtul ngar yang thar bsam med/skabs shig phar 'gro'i dmag kyang bshol/de rjes tho rengs nam mkha' la/skya rengs bun bun gsal du ran/'dun gros nyi ma 'char du ran/glu go na snying gi dkyil du zhog365

ma go tshig la 'bras bu med/'dir 'khod thugs la de ltar zhogaces bdud lha yin khul gyis bka' lung de ltar bstsal bas bdud kyi rgyal blon rnams yi rangs shing dga' ba tshad med ngang khrag chang gi phud skyems phul/ rang lugs kyi phyag btsal ba dang /lha'i sku gzugs rim gyis mi mngon par song / ar jag bdud kyi srog shing nyams pa bgegs kyi phung 'dre/ lta ba log pa'i ru tra/sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra bo/ rgyal blon thams cad blo sems bde bas khyab nas nam mkhar thog gi 'phrul 'khor/ bar snang la rlung gi 'khor lo/ sa gzhir sgyogs kyi 'khor lo/ sgyogs mi gcig skyogs sna bcu gsum/ mtshon 'khor gsum dang bcu drug la brtson bzhin zhag dus mi ring bar 'grub par bsam bzhin 'bad brtson dang / 'phrul gyi dpung dang me chu g.yang sa chen po sogs 'phrul chas kha gsab byed bzhin gnas so/ de nas pha mi kun gyi pha dmag gling dkar lha yi dmag tshogs de rnams srung ba'i bla ma rnams kyis gong tshes bcu drug gi tho rengs dkar phyogs bstan pa la dga' ba'i sde brgyad yul lha gzhi bdag zo dor dgra lha rnams/ 'phrin las ra mdar sbran te skyems phul zhing dam bsgrags mdzad/ ma rung nag phyogs kyi lha 'dre gzhi gnas sde brgyad gdug pa can thams cad spyan drangs shing dngos rten sna tshogs bshams te mig snang la mi 'dra gar dgu 'phrul po che bsgyur ba bkod pa la bdud lha rnams yengs su bcug de nas a khu khro rgyal dpon gyi sgrub zhag thim/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum rdzogs/ 'gugs 'ching 366 —

bsad sbyor gyi bya ba thams cad grub nas/ zha nag phod kha sogs sngags chas 'jigs su rung bas brjid par klubs nas bon ye gshen me dbal chen po'i sku ru mngon sum du bzhengs te me ri 'bar ba'i klong nas ri rab 'bar ba'i rdzong zor de phyag tu bzung nas bden bcol gyi glu 'di bon ngag bswo ya ye 'gyur la drangs nas blangs so/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu bswo ya cho yu drag thung rbad/gu lang nag po'i srog la ya/tri ya dgra bo'i snying chom/phung zhig khug ya brlag rbad dzaḥnam mkha'i gsal sgo gong ma nas/ye gshen sum brgya drug cu lha/drag tu khros pa'i sku gzugs la/dbu dgu dbu gsum zhal gcig pa/spyan gsum mche gtsigs bh+yo sgra sgrog /spyan nas me 'bar shangs dud 'thul/zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs/dgra bgegs sha khrag krum krum gsol/phyag ni bco brgyad phyag drug pa/'bar ba'i mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin/'dzin 'ching gcod gtub rdung la sogs/phyag gis thogs med las la myar/༄ 367

de ring cho ya dbyings nas che/dgra mkhar shig la dgra dpung chom/mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las mdzod/bar snang glog gi gur khang nas/bon lha mi thung 'brug la chibs/'bar ba me yi gos gyon zhing /glog 'phro bskal pa'i me chen 'bar/rang 'dra khro chung dpag med 'phyo/bar snang wer ma bon gyi lha/bye ba sa ya las la 'gyed/ thog char nyams pa dgra la 'bebs/da res dril dril phyung phyung 'du/dgra mkhar shig la dgra bo thul/mngon spyod rbad ya kha 'dzin mdzod/sa gzhi rlung nag 'tshub dkyil nas/ g.yung drung bon gyi srung ma'i tshogs/a bswo las ging dmar nag dang /bsro rgyal dre'u bzhon lha mo'i tshogs/g.yu sgron sman mo brtan ma bcas/sems dpa' g.yung drung bka' srung rnams/rngam pa drag po'i skur bzhengs la/mngon spyod las rbad mthu ma chung / dgra bgegs gnod byed ming med chom/368

ming tsam med pa da res ya/breng breng shag dza srog la rgyu/de ring zor 'phen nga la bab/khro rgyal khro mchog rta mgrin yin/bon gyi stag lha me 'bar yin/chos nyid dgongs pa'i klong du gcigadam nyams ar jag sde tshogs 'dis/rgyal dbang pad+ma'i sku la bsdos/smon lam log pa'i mtshams sbyor byas/gsang sngags chos la lta ba logadam sri dam nyams bdud sde'i dmagadage ba bcu po khyad du bsad/mi dge bcu sogs dang du blangs/sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra byas/gling dkar khra mo'i sgos dgra byas/skye 'gro sems can bla tshe 'phroga'agro ba'i bde skyid nyams par byed/zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bo 'di/bsgral bar 'os pa rgyal ba'i gsung /de phyir rgyal kun dgongs pa yin/ rtsa ba gsum pos rgyab rten mdzod/thugs rje'i rtsal chen nus pa bskyed/lha klu gnyan gsum dmag dpung 'dus/369

zong zor mtshon cha'i 'khor lo 'di/zor sna drongs la dgra dpung shigamatho ba gnam gyi 'ju thag chod/bar pa 'phrul gyi 'khor lo shig /dma' ba sa yi rten phur phud/phyogs mtshams ma shor srang sgo chod/rgyal blon gnyen la zong zor ya/btsan pa'i sgar la zong zor ya/'dun gros byed pa'i gtso la ya/rgyab rten byed pa'i lha la ya/rogs dan byed pa'i dpung la ya/mgyogs rgyug 'og gi rta la ya/dgra bo chags mal med pa gyis/dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa gsum lha/mthu chen nus pa ci 'dug lta/ge sar lha nas bskos pa dang /bdud nag po'i gnya' gnon yin nges na/khro rgyal rgyal po'i sku byus sgrub/dgra lha wer ma mthu ldan gyi/da res a khu'i dpung skyor nas/dgra bo chags mal med par gyis/gzigs dang gling dkar lha mi rnams/dpa' rtags dgung la mnyam par shog370

rgyal bstan sangs rgyas bstan pa de/ a sngon dgung la mnyam par shogasdang dgra'i skye rgyud rtsad nas chod/sha khrag gtang rag dgyes mchod 'bul/rnam shes dgi pa'i zhing la drongs/ma yel4 ma yel las la chos/zhes dmod glu de ltar blangs nas yi dam gyi rbad sngags bgrang bzhin gtor zor phyag tu blangs nas lha'i gsal snang gdengs ldan gyis dgra phyogs su 'phangs pa dang zor de 'ur ldir zer ba'i sgra chen pos sa gzhi g.yo ba'i ngang me dmar lhab se 'bar tsam nas bar snang me yis khengs te thog dmar bang ba tsam gyur cing dgra lha wer ma lha srung rnams kyis zor sna drangs nas dam sri nyams pa'i dmag khrod der gang nas 'di byung med par bar snang sa gzhi me lces khengs nas thog lces 'phrul 'khor dang / phung skyogs sna tshogs bzo mkhan las dmag dpung bdun brgya lhag bya sgro me yis bsregs pa bzhin du btang —ba ma zad bdud rta yang phyed sgril btang zhing der yod rje dpon tshang ma dran brgyal du song / g.yu rtse la rgyal po dpon khro rgyal gyis mgo rtags su sprad pa'i nor bu ke ta ka yod rkyen rgyal po'i las gur du yod pa'i 'khor dpung nyi brgya lhag tsam la ci ma thub/ 'phrul gyi dmag dpung 'dul rgyu yin yang de sngon khro rgyal la skyabs zhu myo nga la lta ba ma log rkyen ci thub med pa brdzus pa bzhin gnas/ khro rgyalanyus gtor zor btegs pa dang lhan sku rje ge sar rin po ches gtsos khra mo gling gi dpa' rtul rje 371

dpon de drag rnams go bskor mtshon thogs lha dang bla ma rnams kyis rab gnas dang / bsangs dang gser skyems kyis lha zhal bstod de dpung dmag bdun stong tham pa rta byang ma'i 'gros skor dkyil le/khrab dkar 'od mdangs lhang se/ dar 'phru tshe mdud spungs se brel khyug khyug gis phebs/ gzhi4su khu bo rnam gnyis sku 'khor sum stong gis bskor te skyabs 'gro sogs sku rim la brtson te bzhugs/ de yi dus nyi dros sbrul gyi chu tshod der gling dmag dang gling rje rgyal blon rnams zi gling gnyis kyi sa mtshams gnam khri bar ma'i na thang ar jag nyams pa'i dpung sgar gyi tshur mtha' der slebs pa dang lhan/ phyi rol du g.yang sa chen po rtseg stong yod pa rgod ngang ma min pa thar thabs med pa de'i nang chab mtshos bskor ba/ nya gser mig min pa rgyu lam med pa/ de'i nang 'bar ba me yis bskor ba/ rdzas ngan gyi dug rlangs mun ltar 'khrigs pa/g.yang sa dang chab mtsho me phung bcas kyis a long ltar bskor ba/dngos yod mi mi dgos/ dngos med lha 'dre'i rgyu lam med pa 'dra zhig yod pas/ dpa' rtul dpung bcas dpa' chag ste ci bya bral nas thams cad kyis sku rje la gsol ba btab nas ji ltar mdzad yong snyam pa'i ngang / ma sang 'phrul gyi rgyal po/ skyes mchog yid bzhin nor bu/ ge sar dgra lha'i rgyal po de nyid lha yi dbang po brgya sbyin lha min gyi g.yul du bskyod pa lta bu/ dgra lha'i go mtshon sna dgu la 'ja' 'od zer mdangs khyugs se/ dpe byad legs pa'i sku lus des khams gsum zil gyis non le/ dgra lha'i skar mda' 'khyug pa/ wer ma'i zer ra 'tshub bzhin/ mchog 372

gsum sprin ltar 'du ba/ chos skyong bu yurka'atshub pa/ 'do chen rkyang rgod 'phel po la chibs/ 'do chen de'i rtsa chen rgyud nas sgro chen/ rtsa chung rgyud nas sgro chung / spu rtse bar nas thul phran/chos sku'i dgongs don gyis 'od dang 'od zer shig se/ rmig bzhi sa la ma reg pa bar snang la 'phags pa'i tshe/ skyes bu ge sar de nyid thugs dpa' gdengs tshud cing sku'i gzi brjid bzod par dka' ba'i ngang dgra bla'i thog chings bar ma la drangs pa'i mgul glu 'di zhes so/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu a la len pa lha la len/lha dkon mchog 'bod pa byed pa'i glu/tha la bar ma gnyan la len/ gnyan chen ra mdar sbran pa'i glu/la la 'og ma klu la len/klu chen las la bkol ba'i glu/ rgya gar rtsa mchog shing drung na/bstan 'di'i bdag po shākya thub/nyan thos dgra 'joms 'khor tshogs la/gsol ba 'debs sothugs rjes gzigs/ston pa drug dang lhas sbyin sogs/sngon tshe khyod kyis bdud btul bzhin/da dus skyes bu'i grogs la byon/ dam nyams cham la 'bebs rogasamadzod/373

zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang nas/sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas la/rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i 'khor gyis bskor/skyes bus 'bod do thugs rjes gzigs/g.ya' ri'i nag la bdud btul bzhin/da dus ge sar grogs la byon/nyams pa cham la 'bebs rogs mdzod/steng phyogs lha yi gzhal yas nas/phu bo dung skyong dkar po la/lha dmag bye ba sa yas bskor/dung gi khu 'bangs 'gril 'gril gyis/nyams pa cham la 'bebs rogs mdzod/dam nyams mkha' la mi shor bar/mtho ba dbyings kyi srang sgo chod/bar ma gnyan gyi pho brang nas/gnyan chen sku lha ger mdzo la/gnyan dmag bye ba sa yas bskor/sbrang char zil ma 'bab pa bzhin/ge sar skyes bu'i grogs la byon/nyams pa cham la 'bebs rog4rmadzod/dam nyams bar nas ma shor bar/rlung gi spu gris gur khang sdoms/'og ma klu yi pho brang nas/374

klu chen gtsug na rin chen la/klu 'khor bye ba grangs med pa/geser bye mtsho nas rdol ba bzhin/ge sar skyes bu'i grogs la byon/nyams pa cham la 'bebs rogs mdzod/dam nyams 'ogo nas ma shor bar/'og phyogs rgya mtsho'i srang sgo sdoms/srid pa gsal ba'i pho brang nas/a ne gungasnan rgyal mo la/'khor du snang srid mkha' 'gro 'bum/ge sar skyes bu'i grogs la byon/nyams pa cham la 'bebs rogs mdzod/dam nyams phyogs mtshams ma shor bar/ye shes spyan gyi so pa mdzod/mthu ldan myar mgyogs pho brang nas/sring lcam theg le 'od 'phro la/'byang lnga lha mo'i 'khor gyis bskor/ge zlor skyes bu'i grogs la byon/nyams pa cham la'abebs rogs mdzod/bdud sde mig snang sgyu ma yin/cho 'phrul dgag ma zhi bar mdzod/ lus dang grib ba zhin 'grog4pa'i lha /lha chen tshang sa ba dkarayo nyid/37 5

ge sar skyes bu'i grogs la byon/cho 'phrul me phung zhi bar mdzod/rtag tu 'bral med brtse ba'i lha/tre dgra lha gnyan stag dmar po dang / nu bo klu sbrul 'od chung sogs/rdzu 'phrul mthu ldan dgra lha'i tshogs/ge sar skyes bu'i grogs la byon/nyams pa'i cho 'phral zhi bar mdzod/las la thogs mejo kha 'dzin myur/dgra lha nam mkha'i skar tshogs dang /wer ma sa kha'i rtsi shing grangs/chos skyong ser sprin gtib pa bzhin/thams cad ge sar grogs la byon/ cho 'phrul me phung rang yal thong /mig 'phrul chu bo skam pa dang /g.yang sa thang la sgyur rogs gyis/sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i lha/legs ldan mgon po lha dmag 'bum/ma zhinganag dang mgon po beng /rtsub 'gyur tshal nas skur bzhengs la/tsan dan beng chen lha dmag 'gyed/nag phyogs nyams pa'i 'phrul dmag 'di/ rtsi shing bskal mes bsregs pa bzhin/376

thal ba'i phung po med par mdzod/dbyings na bzhugs pa'i rtsa gsum lha/byin rlabs mgon skyabs ma g.yel gcig bar na lha sras ge sar ngas/rdzu 'phrul mthu dang stobs rtsal gyis/pho shi bdag byung yang phyi chad med/'og na rgyug pa'i rkyang rgod 'di/ snang ba mtha' yas sprul pa yin/ phyi na gyi ling rta yi tshul/cang shes rta yi rgyal po red/sems nyid chos sku'i dgongs pa las/'byung ba lnga la rang dbang bsgyu ra/thugs rje thabs mkhas rdzu 'phrul yod/g.yang sa'i 'phrang la 'phrad pa'i dus/bya rgyal khyung gi gshog rlabs yod/sngon mo chab la 'phyo ba'i dus/lto dkar gser nya'i rkyal gshog yod/'bar ba me phung gshog pa'i dus/'bar ba me gshog bco brgyad yod/rlung chen bang kha gshib pa'i dus/rlung gshog spu ru bco brgyadayod/ gang 'dod sa la yud kyis bgrod/sems nyidachos sku'i rtsal gshog yod/377

rta rgyug na bar snang khams nas rgyugaltad mo bar snang khams nas lta/ bdud 'dul na dam sri nyams pa 'dul/gtam snyan 'dzam gling bod la grags/mnangs len na rin chen gter g.yang len/dbu nag bod la bzhag pa byed/dgra 'dul na nang gi rnam rtog 'dul/rig pa 'dzin pa'i gshegs shul snyegs/gnyen skyong na 'gro drug sems can skyong /byang chub sems dpa'i mdzad spyod sgrub/bka' bsgrubs na gong lha'i bka' dgongs sgrub/dbu nag bod kyi 'dug chus sgrub/yar gyi mchog gsum dgyes le dang /bar du sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzugs/bstan pa phyogs kun khyab pa dang /mar gyi ngan song rdog pas gnon/'gro mang thar lam skyel ba zhigam nus ge sar min rtags gyis/a glu dga' lu skyid lu mu/ spro ba'i snang ba dgung dang mnyam/dgra bsad na bsad pa don yod yin/dkon mchog gsum gyis lam sna 'dren/btsan thabs 'pho ba'i dpung pas skyor/ 378

bsngo smon bzang pos rgyas btab nas/bde chen dag pa'i zhing la skyol/bdud nag po mi lus don ldan red/bdud 'dul dam pa'i chos la bsgyur/mtha' 'khob bde dga'i zhing la bsgyur/lha blon dpa' rtul phu nu'i dpung /dpung rogs gong ma lha nas bskos/'dul ni bdud kyi dmag tshogs 'dul/skyong ni 'gro drug sems can skyong /don ni gzhan don kho na yin/'dzugs ni sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzugs/'thab zla drag po'i dmag la 'thab/bsad pa don yod lha yis 'dren/rnam smin mi 'byang rgyal bas bsngags/nyams pa bdujo sde skye 'gro'i dgra/dgra 'di 'dul ba thog ma yin/phu nu 'dzoms pa'i dpung bsgrigs 'dis/nyams pa'i rgyal blon dpung sgar 'di/sgar btab shul mal med pa dang /dgra mtha' rtsad nas ma bcad na/rgyal blon lha bskos min rtags gyis/rta da rgyugs rkyang bu'i rjes la rgyugarta rkyang bu'i 'gros kha dal lhod ltos/379

blon da shog ge sar rjes la shogadapa' ge sar dgra 'thab tshod la ltos/lha dang bla ma mo ma'i ngagango shes gdong len 'thab zla gyis/'di tsho glu len don 'bras yin/rtsa ba gsum po skyabs ma g.yel/dpa' phu nu 'di dang 'bral med skyongs/dkon mchog gsum po thugs ma dal/da res mi rta 'bral med skyongs/gong ma'i bka' dgongs 'grub par shoga'adir tshogs phu nu'i thugs la zhogaces glu de ltar bzhengs nas nyi sras ge sar rgyal po mi rta gnyis g.yang sa'i bar snang thog nas bya 'phur ba lta bu dang / chu mtsho ngang pas gshog pa lta bu/ me nang du me ris gur khang 'bar ba bzhin byon te bar snang nas zhal tshur gzigs te rab gnas 'thor bas lha srung 'go lha thams cad sprin ltar gtib cing shig shig 'ur 'ur mer mer gyis sa g.yos pa dang lhan cig tu bdud kyi cho 'phrul chen po rang sar zhi nas thang de sngar las bde zhing dben pa nyams dga' ba zhig tu gyur/dpa' rtul rnams kyis de tsho mthong bas skyes bu mi rta gnyis la sngar las lhag pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ste mi phyed pa'i dad pa rtse gcig thob nas shin tu spro ba dang thugs dpa' tshud nas gcig shul gnyis mthud kyis rta'i bang btang nas rgyal mchog 380 —

ge sar gyi rjes bzhin du 'ur ba dang lhan gling dmag rnams chu bo kha lud pa ltar gshar ba'i tshe/ nyams pa bdud sde'i dmag dpung dam sri gdug pa phung 'dre/ rgyal bstan gnyis kyi dgra bo gling dkar khra mo'i sger dgra der yod rnams zong zor thog lces phyed brlag song bas thams cad blo mi bde hab hab kyis phyogs mtshams thams cad la lta zhib byas pas 'phrul gyi mgyogs rta gsum dang /rlung gri zer ma reg gcod kyi 'khrul 'khor dang 'phrul khang 'thor zhig tu song thog gzhan 'phrul mi rnams kyang phal che ba rkang lag skyon can mgo yan lag ma tshang ba red 'dug pas bdud kyi rgyal blon tshang ma mya ngan gyis non cing / gling gi byad ma yin pa shes te ci drag gros mol byed par las gur chen po'i nang du 'dus pa na der yod tshang ma gros blo mthun gyis rang gnas yul rdzong du phyir log 'gro rgyu thag chod pa dang lhan gling dkar khra mo'i lha dmag rnams ki bswo'i sgra dang bcas te g.yang sa dang me chu'i dgag 'phrang las brgal tshar ba mthong bas thams cad zing zing long long gis 'khor gsum bskor ba'i tshe na phyogs mtshams nas dpa' rtul thams cad der slebs tshar ba dang / the'u rangs nyams pa'i brdzus bu dkar po she le lag ring de 'phrul gyi mgyogs rta zhig gi gong du thon nas 'phrul mdung phyar te 'chi ba srog la mi 'tsher bar dmag gi gdong len du 'gril yong nas rgyal mchog ge sar la 'phrul mdung lan gsum 'phul yang 'ja' la btab pa ltar song / sku rje'i g.yas zur na dpa' tsha zhang 'dan ma byang khra yod pas la mo mda' gzhu dus mnyam du blangs nas glu len long khom ma byang bar ༄ 381

mda' zhig springs pas 'phrul gyi mgyogs rta'i 'khor lo dang po gtor/ yang mda' gcig 'phangs pas 'phrul 'khor gnyis pa gtor nas thang du 'gril ba dang / yang khos gang byung med pa'i the'u rangs 'phrul gyi rta zhig gi gong du thon pa dang dus mtshungs/gdong 'bum pa'i rgya tsha zhal dkar des 'do chen rgya bya sog dkar gyi gong nas mtshon rnon po ya zi skar phran gyi gri mgo 'phur nas seng dkar mo la g.yu ral rgyas 'dra zhig gi ngang nas stong 'jug med pa'i glu 'di ltar blangs so/ o ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ glu a la tha la tha la red/tha la la mo la la red/la la glu yi len lugs red/chos sangs rgyas gdan sa gong ma nas/rgya gar grub chen brgyad cu mkhyen/sems chos sku'i rang ngo zin par shogashar ri bo tā la'i pho brang nas/yi dam thugs rje chen po mkhyen/lag 'brel tshad thar lam thob par shogakhra mo gling gi lha srung dang /dgra bla wer ma zo dor mkhyen/sdang ba'i dgra bo cham la phob/sangs rgyas bstan pa dgung la bstod/sa 'di sa ngo e shes so/382

sa 'di'i sa ngo ma shes na/zi ma gling gi sa mtshams na/zi ma rong ma'i ya tha na/zi gling gnam khri bar ma red/mi med byang gi yang thang la/da lo 'khrug pa'i zhe thang la/nyams pa cham la 'bebs sa red/phung 'dre yu med bzo sa red/nga 'dra nga ngo e shes sam/nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na/bod 'dzam gling sa yi lte ba la/chos dkar po dbu 'phang mtho le de/rgya gar chos kyi rgyal po red/khrims mnga' thang khebs pa btsan le de/rgya nag khrims kyi rgyal po red/dpa' rgod dpung shugs btsan le de/rma khams gling gi rgyal po red/gdan khri 'dzin nyi ma tshur shar ro/dga' skyid nyi ma'i 'khor 'das red/gong rgyal po chen po'i sku mched la/gdong 'bum4 pa'i rgya tsha zhal dkar yin/gdong pha rigs che ba gnam nas chad/gnam khri bdun rgyal po'i rgyal rgyud yin/383

ma rgyud che ba rgya nas chad/rgya mi chen rgyal po'i tsha bo yin/'bum pa'i rgya tsha zhal dkar nga /'bum 'bum dmag gi gdam ya yin/khri khri dmag gi snying bcud yin/ de cho yin lugs 'dra ma red/da res thug pa nyams pa'i bu/ma yin yin brdzu byed mi khyod/mi dkar wa mo'i dpa' snying can/dpyad na she le lag ring 'dra/lag snga wa rnga su ru ru/lag len med pa 'ja' tshon 'dra/gling dkar rang yul bzung ba la/bdud mo'i phung rgyug ci go red/a wa re la snying re rje/gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la/phyag po 'dod pa'i tshong pa de/zlo nom chen rgyus rgya shes le dgos/bsam med tshong phrug kha ser des/mig khra khras mthong tshad zong du sgrub/mtha' ma zong zad tshong log 'gro/gnas 'gro 'dod pa'i bu mo de/rang gzhan ci mtha' shes le dgos/384

shes med bu mo 'phyor g.yer can/kha so dkar 'dzum tshad rogs su btsal/mtha' ma go log gnas 'khyar 'gro/gzhan dbang 'phrog pa'i jag rgod la/dpa' ngar dpung snon dpung btsan dgos/ci shes med pa'i jag rkun des/stong 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyu nor rku/mtha' ma ske srog dpon la 'chor/zer yang zer la bden yang bden/gling dkar 'gras yar 'tshol mi la/rgya dbus bar g.yer chod le dgos/dpung med khyod 'dra'i 'gran snang de/chag sgos rjes nas ded le red/bya ba rang gis bsgrubs le red/dpung rgyal blon nam langs skar ma 'dra/sgar btab mal lung thang mi ros bkang /lam skya ring ma dbang dmag gis bkagadapon gshin rje chos rgyal ge sar rgyal/'od gzi brjid lhang nger sngas mgor phebs/blon gshin rje'i las mkhan mtha' nas bskor/rlung zer ma yin yang thar sa med/bya gshog thogs yin yang 'phur dbang med/'phrul mkhas pas sgyu ma ston dbang med/385

dus da res tshe srog zhag dus thim/rig pa yod tshe bsam blo thongs/mgo 'bul ge sar rgyal la gyis/blo gtad gling dkar phyogs la gtod/go mtshon khrol la gus phyag 'tshal/da res mi gsod tshe thar gtong /min gcig da rung ngar 'dod na/dpa' rgya tsha'i dpung la nyam nga med/gri ya zi'i so la rno chod 'bar/sra pha wang yin yang ya ling bgo/ gri bzang po'i yon tan bshad khom med/mi khyod 'dra'i nyams 'gyur mthong tsa na/dpa' zhe rgod snying khams gting nas 'khrugagri g.yug 'dod dpung pa'i sha rgod 'phags/glu mang po mi len nyi ma bshol/ don yang dag lag len gtugs na gsal/glu go na yid kyis tshig la dpyod/ma go glu tshig 'bras bu med/nyams pa bdud blon yid la zhogaces glu de ltar blangs nas don du kho she le lag ring yin min nges par dpyad dgos/ khos 'di yin gyi glu zhig yong dgongs nas bsgugs pa dang / khos mi 'jigs pa'i rkan sgra drag tu brdabs nas rnon po dug gri'i dpa' lung la 'chang bzhin 'phrul 386

rta'i gong nas bzur 'dug cig byas nas na re/ ya kho re gling sdug rgya tsha bu/ sgug ma dgos da res thug lugs la/ tshig bzang po'i a lan yid la zhog dpa' ngar ma'i 'thab lugs rjes la yod zer nas dpa' glu 'di blangs so/glu 'o na a lu tha lu red/tha lu 'o na la mo red/la lu glu yi len lugs red/nag po bdud kyi lha srung 'bod/the'u rangs dkar nag khra gsum mkhyen/de ring bstan pa'i byus la gzigs/dpa' rtags rtags ma ma chung zhiga.a ma thel mo glig ltar chos/ral gri'i so kha 'tsho regasakyis/sa 'di khyod rang zer zer red/gling dkar gsod pa'i dur sa red/nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na/ar jag bdud sde'i a ma la/mi min lha 'dre'i sras bdun de/sgo nga'i nang nas 'khrungs le yin/rgyal khab bdun gyi gdam ya yin/gling dkar dmag gi 'thab ya yin/the'u rangs nag po'i 'phrul bu yin/she le bu dang gangs sengaganyis/ 387

dgra bu yug byung na snang ba spro/gcan sder chags thams cad zil gyis gnon/seng dkar mo zer nas skye 'gros smon/she le bu dang 'brong rgod gnyis/dgra mda' khyer byang na snang ba spro/mgo ru thur sde tshorkes zil gyis gnon/'brong ru dmar zer nas kun gyis smon/she le bu dang 'chi bdag bdud/ dgra gdong len byang na snang ba spro/pho gson tshad snyirngo khrag thang la 'pho/ming thos tshad skrag cing 'jigs snang shor/de tsho yin lugs 'dra ma red/de nas gling smyug rgya tsha bu/ma yin yin mdog byed mi khyod/wa mo stag la brdzu mi khyod/khyi rda li seng la brdzu mi khyod/dpa' med stong gtam shod mi khyod/yang mtha' stong gtam rlung la bskur/ma ngan jo ru nag rdzog la/phyag 'tshal mgo 'bul dgos do zer/bsam pa gling la gtad dgos zer/de mi yong tshig gi brnyas gtam red/gang ltar zhe sems gting nas 'khrug388

dran pa'i snying la dug rlangs 'thul/gangs ri mthong na dmar mdog snang /pho khyod cag mthong na zhed rgyu med/dgra 'chi bdag yin yang 'thab ra bca'/brag rdo rje yin yang mtshon gyis gshogarlung bser bu yin yang bang kha 'gran/bu nga bas mi tshad rgyal blon yod/gnam sa mgo ldog byed mi la/g.yu rtse rgyal po sku 'tsho bde/ shed chen ri bo pang mi la/shed chen 'gran gyis ya med yod/rgya mtsho hub kyis 'thung mi la/dmar po btsan skya 'bum thub yod/dgra rgod cham la 'bebs mi la/nag po stong bdud lan med yod/da rung dgra rgod sil ma yod/de e red da lta gsal nas yong / khyod rgya tsha zer ba'i stong gtam can/dpung rogs mi rta 'dzoms zhan 'dra/bu dpa' rtsal snying khams che chung yin/mtshon sngon mo'i rno chod zer rgyu de/bu dpa' bo'i g.yug lag byang zhan red/rta 'do ba'i 'gros kha rgyag lugs de/389

gong skya mi'i bca' rtsal bzang zhan yin/dmag bu rta'i rgyal kha thob zhan de/dmyo/sa gtso bo'i 'thab lugs yag nyes red/khyod thub bsam snang ba 'khrul lugs la/a wa re la snying re rje/da rung dpe na 'dra ma yod/nam mkhar skar tshogs mang zhan 'dra/skar chen 'od la 'gran zla med/sa gzhir ri rgyal mang zhan 'dra/gser ri 'dra na re res choga'adab skyes me tog mang zhan 'dra/rtsi gur gum 'dra na re res chogadepung mtshon bzung khas len mang zhan 'dra/bu nga 'dra yod na ra res chogade stong gtam min te 'dra ma'i tshig khyod rgya tsha am de mi dgos dang /kho ge sar red kyang zhed rgyu med/blon dpa' rtul stag ngar gzig ngar che/ngar bsam tshad a pho'i gdong la shogang 'phrul bu'i dpung la nyams nga med/ral gri dug lce ngar ma 'di/mkhas pa mgar bas brdungs le min/gu lang dbang phyag chen po des/390 ༄

dngos su bu la gnang le yin/nyin mo'i ngogs la dug rlangs 'thul/mtshan mo'i ngogs la me 'od 'bar/ g.yug gis brag gshag chab chu gcod/khyod dngos yod mi 'breg bsam pa med/kha bshad glu len mkhas zhan 'dra/don lag len su rgyal bltas na gsal/glu go na tshig don yid la zhogam go glu la 'bras bu med/khyod tsho'i yid la de ltar zhogaces de ltar blangs nas thung hril gyis 'phrul rta'i kha lo bsgyur nas mchongs byang ba dang / rgya tshas she le lag ring yin par shes nas the tshom rmod par mchongs te gri kha 'gran pas/ she les gri thengs mang g.yug pas rgya tsha la thebs rung srung bas brtan/ rgya tshas ya zi de glog 'khyug pa ltar gcig g.yug pas she le lag ring gi phrag g.yon pa'i thog nas g.yas pa'i rtsib 'og bar dum gyis bcad nas sar lhung ba dang da dung dbugs rgyun ma chad par lhu rnams ling ling gyis 'phar byang ba na/ dgra lha ge sar rgyal po'i chibs pa rkyang skyid kyis lag thre brdabs te dbugs rgyun bcad/ rgya tshas mgo 'phra gong len mdzad de ki bswo rdza ri nyil ba ltar btab mi'i tshe/bdud rnye rnams rten bkod la yengs yod pas tshor te skad cig der 'dus nas bdud mi'i dpung rogs byas/ 'phrul mkhas kher rgod mig dmar des mtshon gyi 'phrul 'khor bskor nas dpa' rtul 391

gyi gdong blangs/ de dang mnyam du 'brong nag ra bzung dang /stong thub kher skyes/ a khu yan thub dpung ring / gar sa 'gram ring sogs khas len mi dgu sngon du thon nas mda' 'phen shu sgra chil chil gyis mda' du ma btang byung ba dpa' rtul rnams kyi sku la thebs rung srung bas brten/ dpa' rtul 'dan mas mda' gsum btang bas gar sa 'gram ring dang / stag rgod lan med gnyis kyi dpral ba dang snying tshal par gtor te bsad/ mda' gcig kher rgod mig dmar la thebs rung ci ma thub/ kher rgod de nga rgyal drag tu 'khrugs te mtshon gyi 'khor lo'i shugs nan spar te btang byang bas/༄ nyi 'bum dang / sga sde/ nya tsha/ snang ngu rnams rkyo thog tu shu sgra 'ur gyis byung bas chibs rta rnams 'drog pa ltar bzur ba dang da dung rgyab kyi gser pa'i rab dgas gtsos khas len mi bdun mtshon 'khor gyis bsgrungs byang ba dang / sga sde myar bar chibs las gzhol nas rdo lug ro tsarmo zhig 'phangs pas rnye'i sdongs grogs dang bcas mtshon 'khor de gtor/ kher rgod des sga sde'i nye sar bcar te mtshon 'khor gnyis pa de gtor rtsis skabs/sga sde chos skyong ber nag de thugs rgyal drag tu 'khrugs nas kho'i thog tu mchongs nas dpung zur nas bsdus te sar mnan nas rdog tho dang khu tshur rdeb gsub bcas kyis bsad/ gzhan yang dpa' rtul rnams/ kyis brgya lug spyang kis gtor ba ltar sgar de bcom pa dang lhan dngos yod mi yi dpung dmag gcig brgya lhag tsam mtshon la drangs/ 'phrul gyi sgyu ma'i dpung mang tshan che ba dang gsod rgyu med stabs dngos yod mi dang sgyu ma'i 'phrul dpung gnyis dbyer ma 392

phye bar yud tsam song ba dang / dpa' rtul rnams kyi mtshon rnon po'i so kha dig dpung pa'i shed shugs rgud pa'i dus su/ dmu bdud dam sri rgyal blon rnams lhan cig 'bros rtsis kyis rlung 'khor dang lcags 'khor la zhib rtogs byed bzhin khol ril ril du yod pa na/ dpa' rtul rnams kyis las gur la ral shan brgyab ste btul ba dang / dgra lha ge sar rgyal pos lha la gsol ba 'debs pa'i mgur glu 'di bzhengs so/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu a la tha la tha la red/tha la glu yi len lugs red/la la ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/lha dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs/dkon mchog gsum gyis thugs rjes gzigs/ge sar skyes bu'i grogs la byon/dgra bla wer ma'i snyan gyis gson/nga 'dra yin pa ge sar red/bskos pa bdud kyi gnya' gnon la/gong ma lha nas bskos le red/bskos mi dkon mchog gsum po red/rgyal kun dgongs pa gcig mthun red/da res 'dul rgyu'i dgra bo 'di/nag po bdud kyi rten phur red/bdud chen yongs kyi bla gnas red/393

nad gdon bgegs kyi gtso bo red/mngon sum dam sri mi gzugs can/bdud 'di bas yan la yod snang med/sgyu ma 'phrul gyi phung 'khor la/rtsal 'di bas yan la su zhig yod/mi gcig gis 'dzam gling phung nges red/de ring rtsad nas ma bcad na/ge sar lha bskos min rtags gyis/'phrul gyi mi dang dngos yod gnyis/gzugs skye mched dod pa 'dra 'dra la/so sor dbye ba mi 'byed do/sngon mo mtshon gyi so kha diganyag phran mda' yi gral ra zhigadabye ba lha yis ma phyes na/sgyu ma'i dathung la ya bo dka'/de phyir rtsa gsum grogs la byon/bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas/dpal mgon zer ba'i lto dga' ba/sangs rgyas bstan srung yin pas zer/che mchog he ru ka dpal dang /shāka thub pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/bka' dang gdams la gnas pas zer/mthu stobs drag rtsal yod pas zer/394

glog bas myur mgyogs che bas zer/da res bos pa ma tshor ram/tsan dan beng gi dmag sgam na/sprul pa'i lha dmag yod pas zer/da res dmag chen mi 'gyed par/de ring gang la song le ang /ri rab lha zhal gzigs le ang /dur khrod ro la yengs le ang /sngon tshe dam bca' ma g.yel bar/ge sar rgyal po'i grogs la byon/dam sri rnams kyi sha chen gsur/dgyes pa'i rten mchod da res 'bul/glog dmar bzhin du chos la shogadam las ma 'da' thub par srung /dgra lha wer ma'i sku shugs phyungs/bu rta 'das grongs ma shor zhigamatho ba mkha' nas bya ra gyis/dma' ba sa nas 'phrang sgo sdoms/dam sri dngos med brlag par mdzod/lha mis go chod don ldan byed/lha dkon mchog mgon skyabs ma chung zhigachos skyong drag rtsal ma chung zhig de ring don go chod le byed/395

mkhyen ldan thugs la de ltar zhogaces lha 'bod kyi glu de ltar bzhengs nas bskul bas skad cig nyid du skyes bu ge sar gyi mdun thad me ri 'bar ba'i klong nas mgon po'i sprul pa'i lha dmag nag po lcags khrab lcags rmog can nyi khri chig stong thon te sgyu ma'i 'phrul dpung thams cad tho ba dang dgra stas rdung ba'i tshul byas pas skad cig yud tsam nas med par byas/dgra bla'i rgyal po ge sar khong gi ting 'dzin dmigs pas lha la gtang rag dgyes mchod phul/ de nas dam nyams bdud kyi dpung sgar de nam langs kyi skar ma bzhin du sgyu ma'i dpung sgar zhig nas/ g.yu rtse rgyal po dang btsan skya 'bum thub/ shed chen 'gran gyi ya med/ nag po stong bdud lan med bcas rje dpon bzhi la khas len brgyad cu tsam yod pa de rnams 'chi ba srog la mi phangs pa blo mnyam nas yod pa na dpa' rtul gling dmag rnams kyis 'ur 'ur bcom pa dang lcags 'khor lhu tshigs sgrig long ma byang bar dmag rta gang zin gyi gong du bud cing / dang po shed cherno 'gran gyi ya med de zhe rgod gting nas 'khrug ngar rgod kyi rlung dmar g.yos nas mi ljang ljon shing rgyas 'dra zhig byas nas gzigs 'phen dang / nya tsha/ wer ma lha dar rnams kyi gdong du byang nas ral gri 'brong rgod ling gcod zer ba phyed tsam bton te ༄ya kho re nyon dang gling sdug tsho/ bu dpa' bo'i rtags ma rjes la yod/ yin lugs kyi 'dra ma glu zhig yo da pas dang po khyod tshos nyon ang zer nas glu thung 'di blangs par gda'o/ raglu 'o na a lu tha lu red/396

tha lu 'o na len lugs red/'o na ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/bswo bswo mchod do dmu yi bdud/gu lang dbang phyug dga' rab lha/bstan pa'i byus la e gzigs do/gzigs na la mo chas la shogadapa' rtags dgra snying len par shogabargya gsod stong gsod khas len 'bul/sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na/zi ma rong gi sa mtshams red/zi ma stag zhal rgyal po de/zi khri skor bcu gnyis bdag po red/ nag po bdud kyi gyol phran red/rgyal khab brgya rtsa'i nang gral red/dpa' rgod tshad bzhag byed sa red/de 'dra'i rgyal po chen po des/zi smad a yan shog brgyad dang /yan kun khrom la'i shog dgu bcas/khong g.yu rtse rgyal la dpa' dar phul/lag len rtsis sprod dus mtshams nas/sha pha jo ru nag rdzog dang /pho khram gling gis bsgrungs nas thal/'di 'dra rgyal po'i gser sa red/397

rgyu rkyen bshad na nged rang sa/gru bzhi bde skyid pha yul red/nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na/mi ma 'phrul gyi a ma la/lha srin 'khrig pa'i rdzus bu bdun/sgo nga'i nang nas 'khrungs le red/bya 'dab chags min te bar snang 'phyo/nya gser mig min te chab la rgyu/seng dkar mo min te g.yu ral rgyas/stag dmar yag min te mi sha za/yang sgos dmu bdud brdzus bu la/shed chen 'gran gyi ya med zer/dgun zla bar pa'i nya tshes la/bdud nyi dus tshod dgu 'dzoms dus/byang thang mun pa skya mo la/pho 'dre klu btsan sku mdun na/bdud rgyal ming thogs gros ra bsdus/shed dang shugs rtsal 'gran pa'i dus/lcags kyi gdung ma dgu 'grig de/sa tham rgyal po'i phyag rtags red/pha klu btsan min pas mi theg dus/ngas pang du blangs nas phrag la bkal/sha ru gnam rdzong gdung ma byas/398

7pho de 'dra zer nas klu btsan dgyes/shed chen 'gran med de dus btags/ming don ma nor ya med ngas/dgra gling sdug thal bar mi brtsi'o/da res ngar 'dod pho gsar tsho/drin pha ma'i gces phrug skyag lang gcigasde tsho chung nang nas ngan lob gnyis/'go dpon med g.yo khram byas dang gsum/blo shes rig ma rdzogs rang 'dod bzhi/chag sgos rjes nas ded dang lnga/de lnga 'dzoms pa'i kha sngon nas/de ring thar bsam dgra la sgyur/dgra sgyur gling gi gnya' bar sgyur/da rung nyon dang 'dra ma yod/byi'u nag sag khyu dpung mang zhan 'dra/lcags khra ngar ma'i kham zas byed/nam mkha'i ska ratshogs mang zhan 'dra/khri gdugs shar bas zil 'og mnan/sder chags gcan gzan mang zhan 'dra/gangs seng ngar bas gcan brgya 'dar/gling sdug jag dmag mang zhan 'dra/shed chen ngar bas yu med bzo/de e zer lag len bstar dang gsal/399

dgra 'dre gling gi bya spyod la/dpyad na zhe sems gting nas 'khrugajag gling 'khrug pa'i gzhi rtsa de/g.yo chen khro thung dpon la thugabashad bshad don dang rgyab 'gal red/byas phyi nang dkrug pa'i ḍa ru mgo/d+me de 'dra med na ci la thogs/de ring thug na skyid pa la/dpa' rtags phyed bgos mi byed re/klu mgon bsgrubs pa'i sha pha la/'dan ma yod na gdong la bud/ya med bsgrungs pa'i sha pha la/seng stag yod na zur du bud/dpa' ba'i dpung gis ya lan yod/dpa' rgya tsha zer ba'i ming g.yer can/g.yer yang thog yin na da res shogage sar zer ba'i khri 'dzin dpon/khri yang 'dzin 'dod na da res shogasngon mo mtshon gyi mjal dar yod/shed chen dpung pa'i mjal rten yod/lag na bzung ba'i ral gri 'di/dmu bdud ye chags rgyal po des/gser ri'i khog nas gser zhun blangs/400

rdo rje 'bar ba'i brun zhun gnyis/bdud rgyal ri ti nag po des/tsan dan sol ba'i me la bzhus/dmar ser 'bar 'dra'i gri zhig brdungs/bkra ris 'bras ljang 'phyur ba 'dra/thur chen g.yu 'brug 'khyug pa 'dra/thur chung rta rnga gshib pa 'dra/khug chen rgya mtsho 'khyil ba 'dra/so kha mun pa rub pa 'dra/rtse mo phra la rno ba de/gshin rje'i mche rtse gzings pa 'dra/rtsa ba sra la brtan pa de/brag dmar thang nas skyes pa 'dra/g.yug na rgya brag yin yang gcod/ming btags na 'brong nag ling gcod zer/rmu bdud rgyal po'i pha zog red/rmu srin ma ma gzhon nu mas/a pho nga la rgyan char btags/g.yug na ri rab che yang 'bregasra ba rgya brag lhu dum bgo/khyod tsho mi 'breg bsam pa med/sgang sgang ro yis gang le dang /mi ro'i rtsig pa ri ltar bzo/401

gshong gshong khrag gis gang le la/mtsho dang yul chu 'ab ba 'dra byed/e zer ltos la bsgugs nas sdod/skya tshur chas yid la de ltar zhogaces glu de ltar blangs narme mchong rtsis byas pa na/ dpa' rtul yongs kyi bla rten/ snang ngu g.yu yi me tog dpa' rtsal can gyi bu rgyud/ shes rig bkra ba'i dpa' bo dgung grangs bcu la son pa khong gi dgongs pa la/ mi lngang 'di shed chen yin pa kho thag chod pas rang gi dgra skal yin pa lha bla'i lung la nor 'khrul med/dpa' rtul gzhan tsho dang dpung gtugs na kho mi thub ba'i khar dbu nyes 'gro dogs yod pas de bas rang nyid gdong len du nye bcar mi nyan yang / rgyang nas mda' zhig gis e thul lta dgos dgongs nas khos glu len mjug ma rdzogs gong nas mi chung rta la mdzes pa/rta chung mi la mdzes pa/ go mtshon sngon po gyon pa zhig kho'i gdong du krong nger byung nas mda' 'don gzhu 'don byas pa dang kho'i bsam pa la/ bu chung 'di 'dra zhig gis nga la do bsdo bsam pa spobs pa che/ 'on kyang khos glu lan zhig btab yong nges la su yin dang ci zer lta dgos/ de nas kho la khu tshur gcig las mi dgos las sla bsams nas zhe slod cing zhe khrel gye ha bgad cher bsgrags nas yod skabs snang ngu g.yu yi me tog des mda' mo gser ltong rgod sgro ma ge sar nas gnang ba de mda' stong sprad nas na re/ya kho re bdud blon shed chen bu/ dpa' khyod 'dra 'dzam gling med mdog kha/ nga na tshod chung ste 'gran snying 'dod/ 'tshub ril 402

ril ma byed glu la nyon/ dpa' rgod po yin na 'thab long yod zer nas glu 'di tha la'i ya 'gyur la drangs nas blangs so/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu a la tha la tha la red/tha la glu yi len lugs red/la la ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/a la glu yi 'go mo red/tha la gling gi gsho lugs red/ la la tshig gi gcod lugs red/'bru don yid la nges le len/mi mngon dbyings kyi pho brang nang /skyabs gnas dkon mchog rnam gsum la/sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba 'debs/'gro drug bde dang ldan par shogakhrag 'thung 'bar ba'i zhal yas nas/dbang drag pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/drag tu khros pa'i skur bzhengs la/dam sri gdug 'dre rdul du rlogagling dkar khra mo'i lha srung dang /ge sar skyes bu'i sku lha dang /snang chung nga yi 'go lha rnams/da res ma g.yel kha 'dzin mdzod/dgra la snying mda' 'phrod par shog403

sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na/ zi ma'i gnam khri bar ma red/zi ma stag zhal rgyal po de/mi dbang 'gran med rgyal pos btul/sger blon khri tsha rgya stag der/dpa' bo 'dan mas thod mda' sprad/zi sde gling gi 'bangs la bsgyur/dkar po dge ba'i rten gzhi btsugs/zi smad zi ma rong ma 'di/'dan ma dpon la dpa' dar thob/gser sa 'gyur med gling gi sa/sa bzang po'i lo rgyus de 'dra red/nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na/smug po gdong gi rgyud pa la/spyi dpon rgyal po'i bu gces yin/ge sar rgyal po'i nu bo yin/khra mo gling sde'i gces phrug yin/dgra la nga 'gro zer mi yin/khas len byas nas yong le yin/yin pa lo nyung bu chung yin/dgra thad du byang dus 'thab snying 'dod/rtse ya mda' zlo ma byas te/dgra la snying mda' e 'phrod bsam/404

dpa' bo'i ming de ma thogs te/shed chen gdong len e yong bsam/bya rgyal khyung gi phru gu yin/bar snang rlabs kyis e chod bsam/gangs seng dkar mo'i phru gu yin/bu yug 'tshub ma e gshog bsam/rgya stag khra mo'i bu rgyud yin/tsan dan nags ma e gshog bsam/dpa' rtul dpa' bo'i bu rgyud yin/dgra sgar g.yul chen e gshog bsam/bsam bsam gling nas chas le yin/tsho chung sgar la thug nas 'gi/dpung med nam langs skar ma la/dpa' rtul mi re dgos dogs med/snang chung nga yis yong bsam 'dugade nas bdud blon ngar rgod bu/rje ge sar rgya tsha sku mched gnyis/'dzam gling gsal ba'i nyi zla red/ri rab rtse yi khyung chen red/rgya mtsho'i nang gi nor bu red/rkang gnyis mi yi gtsug rgyan red/'gro drug skyabs gnas zhu sa red/khyod 'dra'i gdong len phebs dogs med/405

shig chung steng la sta re'i dpe/blon skyen po 'dan ma byang khra de/za hor rgyal po'i rgyal rgyud red/gling dkar chags pa'i srog shing red/sde khri skor bcu gnyis dpon po red/ge sar rgyal po'i gung blon red/'bum dmag khra mo'i snying bcud red/pho khyod 'dra'i gdong len phebs dogs med/dpa' bo seng stag a dom de/byang dar yul sde khri btsan po'i rgyud/gling dkar chags pa'i gung shing red/sdang ba dgra yi gnya' gnon red/byams pa gnyen gyi skyabs gnas red/mtshon sngon mor rang dbang thob pa'i bu/bdud mi rgod bsad pa'i yang rgod red/ngas ma thub shor na gsod mi red/'bod mi dgos gcig shor gnyis shor red/g.yo chen byas mgo bskor mi la/che btsan rnyeg rong rgyal po yod/gling dkar gshin rje'i kha sngon la/tshe zad sna 'dren a khus mdzad/da yang mjal byas pas ci la phan/sgos 'gyod pa las kyi mtha' ma red/406

de sngon dpon med jag rkun tsho/rang che'i snang ba mtho zhor red/pho rgod gdong la ma 'phrad zigadaper na 'dra ma e 'dra gda'/be'u'i nang gi g.yag shed des/g.yag ru rgyas yod le ma shes zigasnang ba mthon po'i ra 'thab de/lto ba ral ba'i snga ltas red/sgang ze 'grim pa'i spyang dkar des/gzig ngar ma yod le ma shes zigakha dung mche gzig la ngom rgyu de/spyang sgal tshig gtor ba'i snga ltas red/bar snang bya khra 'dzum can mas/khra dar ma yod le ma shes zigagashog 'jum khra la rngam rgyu de/bya khra'i bya sgro 'thor ltas red/ar jag dam sri dpon blon des/dpa' rgod yod pa ma tshor zigajag yan gling la chas rgyu de/chus bstan pa phung ba'i snga ltas red/de e red ma red bsam blo skor/khyod shed chen ming g.yer che zhan 'dra/nga snang chung khyod la zhed bsam med/4(37

mda' gtsang chab mtsho la chu srin rngam/dkar dung phrug chung ste srog gi gshed/nags tsan+dan dkyil la rgya stag rngam/mtshon sa mda' chung ste ha la 'phen/sra rgya brag dmar mo brjid zhan 'dra/thog dmar po chung ste thal bar bshigakhyed dpa' rgod tshad bzung med zhan 'dra/snang chung bu yis srog dmar gcod/kha bshad don dang khrig khrig yin/yang bshad rdo yi ri mo yin/lag len gser gyi thigaso pa yin/gling rje ge sar rgyal po de/zhal mjal ba tsam gyi ngan song med/'chi kha'i dad 'dun ma 'phyag dang /shi ngan 'gro mi lhung rang tharke chod/mda' 'then snga snang chung nga rang yin/gzhu ra rgod a long mi 'gugs te/lus go mtshon bskor ba'i yang chas red/shed dpung pa'i tshad zhig e lon lta/mda' gser ltong mtheb khas mi non kyang /mda' gzhu skud rgyud nas e 'grim lta/rtswa 'jag ma 'phen la e zin lta/khyod shed chen bzur na ngo re tsha/408

dgra sha pa'i nang nas bu mo yin/nga yang mi bzur rang thag chod/dang po mda' 'gran lan dgu byed/dpa' rtags rgyal kha sus thob lta/de nas phra ring mdung 'gran byed/'phrul 'khor skyen rtags su rgyal lta/de nas gri 'gran su rgyal lta/rnon po ngar ma su red lta/de nas khrab chen dpung 'dzing byed/gsub dang rdeb res su rgyal lta/— khe pham sngon gyi bskos pa red/glu mang po mi len nyi ma bshol/de ring dgra mtha' gcod rgyu yin/gling dkar yul gyi lha srung rnams/rgyab rten mdzod la mda' sne drongs/dmigs pa'i dgra la ho ma ya/khyod rang yid la de ltar zhogaces glu de ltar blangs nas glu mjug rdzogs ma thag mda' de shugs drag dan gsum gyis 'phangs pas khos glu tshig la dpyad nas bu chung lce mkhas brnyas gtam che/ ngas dzar re bzung nas rdo la rdeb bsam pa'i ngang snang ngu'i mda' de 'ur sgra dang me 'od 'phro bzhin lha srung gis mda' sne drangs nas nyam pa rmu yi brdzus bu shed chen ya med kyi snying khar 'bab pa ltar thebs nas snying tshal par 4(39

gtor nas ljon shing rlung gis bsgyel ba ltar rta thog nas lhungs te thul/ mgo 'phru gong len byas te ki bso 'brug ltong ldir ba ltar btab pa dang g.yu rtse rgyal po dang / btsan skya 'bum thub/ nag po stong bdud lan med/ stong thub kher skyes/ yan thub dpung ring / 'brong nag ra bzung sogs kyis gtsos khas len sum cus bskor te yod pas bya ba nyes pa mthong nas bdud kyi rgyal blon thams cad snang ngu'i thad du 'ur gyis brgyugs pa dang / skyes mchog ge sar rgyal po khong gis phyi nam mkha' stong pa/ nang sems nyid stong pa/ bar rtsa rlung stong pa/ stong gsum ga'u kha sbyor gyi srung 'khor brtan pos dpa' rtul dpung dmag gur du bcugasku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa du ma bkyes nas dpa' rtul mi re'i dpung rogs su ge sar re phebs/ sku yi ngo bo ge sar dang / lha chen tshangs pa'i sprul pas mi pho shel gyi khrab rmog 'khor gsum can gnyis kyis g.yu rtse rgyal po la gri 'thab mdzad/ rgya tsha dang /'dan ma/ sga sde gsum gyis btsan skya'i gdong blangs te 'thab/nyi 'bum dang / mu spyang / dpa' seng / seng stag sogs kyis stong bdud la 'thab/ nya tsha dang / gzig 'phen/ 'brug rgyal sogs dpa' rtul rnams kyis brgya lug ma bu 'phrad 'phrad/stong lug lhas rar bskor 'dra byas nas 'thab pas nyams pa'i dam sri rnams la'ang rang gi bdud lhas srung skyob byas nas/ gri g.yug sngo 'od lam se/ mdung 'gran skar mda' chad chad/ mda' 'gran bu yug 'tshub 'tshub byas nas yud tsam 'thab pa'i ngang/tshur yang gling shog nas 'om bu'i bu gces khra yag dang / stag 410

rong shog nas dpa' yag thog rgod dpung ring gis gtsos khas len mi bdun mtshon 'og du shor/ phar yang ka bzhi lhun grub nas yan thub dpung ring gri ngar la drangs/ brgya dpon dmar lu nas 'brong nag mdung gi so la drangs/ dkar ru thar pa rgyal mtshan nas stong thub kher skyes gri ngar la drangs/ nya tshas zi ra dmar po dang yan rgod rjes med gnyis gri 'thab kyis bsad/ de nas skyes mchog khong gis bdud rgyal la ral gri du ma btab kyang ma chod/lha chen gyi ral gris kyang ma bcad/ bdud rgyal gyis rgyal mchog la ral gri du ma g.yug kyang brag la brgyab pa ltar yang yud tsam gri 'thab byas/ btsan skya dang / dpa' rtul gsum po sus kyang mtshon ma blangs par yud tsam gri 'thab byas kyang pham rgyal ma byung /btsan skya'i 'go lhas dpung rogs byas nas rlung gri sngon po reg gcod zhig kho'i lag tu sprad pa dang lhan gnyan sku lhas btsan skya gdong bzhi la gri 'gran byas nas phar tsam ded/ gnyan stag dmar pos de ma thag rlung gri 'phrog shor nas kho'i lag tu ral gri med stabs/ dpa' rtul rnams kyis gri shubs su btsud nas spar 'dzing gis bzung rtsis byas pa na phar tsam du shor/ gzig 'phen dar gyi thig le dmar yag stag gi bu rgyud des btsan skya dang ma 'phrad pas sgar de'i phyogs mtshams kun nas nyul bas gdong thug pa dang lhan gzig 'phen gyis sha khyis sha ba mthong ba bzhin nye bar bcar nas shor dogs kyis glu len dal dal ma byung bar mdung nag dug lce ngar ma de dam sri btsan skya 'bum thub kyi lto bar bsnun pas rgyab na mdung so sngo rgyang nge thon nas dar dmar rlung gis bsgyel ba 411

ltar thul lo/ gling mi rnams kyis ki bso rdza ri nyil ba ltar byas/de nas nag po stong bdud lan med de la klu chen gtsug na'i sprul pa mi sngon rta sngon can zhig dang / zo dor rma gnyan gyi sprul pa dpon khro thung ji lta ba zhig gnyis dang 'phrad pas/ stong bdud zhe rgod 'khrugs nas glu len med par na re/ rdzun gyi rkyal pa stag rong dpon/ mna' khrel med pa dug gi sdong / g.yo chen phung ba'i gzhi ma khyod/ da res de 'dra 'phrad lugs la/ a pho'i bsam pa 'grub lugs la/ de ring gson la btang rgyu min/ pho nga bas skyid cig e yod na/ zer nas ral gri nam mkhar phyar nas byang ba dang klu chen gyi sprul pa dang / rma gnyan gyi sprul pa gnyis rkyos rub pa'i tshul gyis gri 'thab byas pas klu chen gtsug na'i chu gri rno ngar che bas kho'i ral gri dum bur bcad/ kho gtsug na dang rma gnyan gnyis kyis 'dul skal med stabs lus la btab rung ci ma thub/ khos sprul pa'i dgra bla gnyis la gri btab rung 'ja' la btab pa ltar song ba ma zad/ ral gri dum bur song bas dpa' chag nas ya bo med par rtogs te phar tsam bros pa dang sprul pa'i dmag dpon gnyis gar 'gro cha med par rgyal po g.yu rtse'i rtsar brgyugs rung / zhag dus chu tshod 'dzol bas bdud rgyal g.yu rtse la mtshon ma song / khos rang 'dra gsum du brdzus nas 'thab pa dang / phan tshun dka' ngal gyis dbugs rgyun har sgra di ri ba spu'i rgyud nas chu thigs re zag nas thang chad pa dang dus mnyam du/bdud lhas rgyal blon gnyis kyi rna bar da bros zer ba'i sgra byang /gu lang gis grogs byas te bar snang nas 'od nag po zhig shar r+shar 412

gyis byang ba dang / rgyal blon gnyis 'od des 'then pa 'dra ba zhig byes nas gling sgar gyi phyi rol du thon pa dang gu lang dbang phyag chen pos grogs byas nas rang gnas su skyel rtsis kyis bdud skyo rmu zhags bsrings kyang gling dkar gyi lha srung dgra bla wer ma rnams kyis rmu zhags bcad nas lha bdud 'go lha yud tsam 'khrugs nas sa g.yo ba ri 'dar ba glog 'khyug pa sogs byas pa'i mthar gling lha rgyal/bdud kyi rgyal blon gnyis la bdud khyab pa lag ring gis grogs byas nas bdud rta nag po sga chas rang 'grig byang ba la bzhon nas rang yul du bros rtsis la bdud lhas bar snang snas khyod rang gnyis yar khams byang ma'i ri dang a chen hor la bros shig zer ba thos pas gnyis ka blo mnyam gdong nub la gtad nas mgyogs pa rlung ltar song / de yi dus su gling rje ge sar dang dpa' rtul rnams kyi nyams pa bdud kyi rgyal blon gnyis 'od nag po zhig 'phros pa dang lhan gar song ma mthong bas shor bar dogs pa'i sems khral che zhing ci bya med par phar rgyug tshur rgyug byas shing / lhag par rgyal mchog dam pa'i thugs dgongs la/ bdud rgyal g.yu rtse rgyal po 'di rang res 'dul rgyu yin pa thag chod rung kho la mtshon 'gran de tsam byas par mtshon gyis mi chod pas ma tshad kho la sgyu 'phrul dang dpa' rtsal de tsam 'dug stong bdud ya med kyi dpa' rtsal yang de dang 'dra ba ma tshad kho gnyis dus mnyam du shor/ gling lha rnams mi gzugs dngos su bstan nas 'thab kyang dpa' rtags ma thob/ 'od nag po de bdud lha'i 'phrul zhags yin 'dug pas bdud yul phyogs su shor ba yin nam snyam pa thugs dgongs la shar/413

sga sde nas kyang stong bdud ni rang nyid kyi dgra skal yin pa lha'i lung la yod pa de rang dang gdong thug rung su yin dbye ba ma phyes par shor/ ma tshad dgra bo 'bros rgyu med pa'i sngags chings kyang long khom ma byung ba g.yeng lhod du song / dpa' rtul tsho yang rang gis go ma chod par dma' 'bebs shin tu che dgongs nas thugs skyo ba dang yi mug pa tshad med pa'i ngang mgon po beng nag dmigs pas ra mdar sbran/ dpa' rtul rnams gcig ngo gcig la lta bzhin phyogs mtshams la bya ra byas nas yod skabs snang ba mtha' yas gyi sprul pa/ thogs med mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul mnga' ba 'asko rje rkyang rgod 'phel po des lag bro brdabs nas 'tsher skad cig sgrog bzhin mi skad kyi tshul du glu 'di ltar bstsal to/bswo bswo he he/me ri 'bar ba'i gur khang nas/bswo bswo he he/dbang drag pad+ma drag po rtsal la he he/rta mgrin lha la gsol ba 'debs/rta 'dre gnod byed rdul du rlogarngog chags srung zhing skyob par mdzod/sa 'di zi rong sa mtshams la/nyam pa sgar gyi shul mal red/dam sri snying khrag 'pho sa red/bdud dpung rtsad nas 'bud sa red/ar jag yu med bzo sa la/414

phung ro gnon sa'i dur khrod red/nga 'dra nga ngo los dgongs te/phyi la gyi ling rta yi tshul/nang na sangs rgyas dgongs pa dngos/mkha' la 'phyo na bya ma rta/bya rgyal khyung gi rjes kyang zin/sa la brgyugs na rlung rjes zin/'phrang brag chu la thogs pa med/sems nyid rlung gi spu ru yis/zhing khams nyul na thogs pa med/sangs rgyas rnams dang bgro gleng byed /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams gar yang nyul/'byang ba'i khams la rang dbang bsgyur/cadro shes rta yi rgyal po dang /gnyis su med pa'i rkyang rgod yin/rkyang ni spu mdog rkyang dmar yin/pad+ma rwa ga'i mdog can red/sangs rgyas snang mtha'i sku mdog mdangs/rgod ni nam mkha'i rgod ltar lding /ngal dub med pa'i rgod po yin/gong na chibs pa'i ge sar dpon/rig gsum mgon po'i rnam 'phrul red/lha o rgyan pad+ma'i thugs sras red/415

rgyal kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo red/'dzam bu gling gi rgyal po red/ mgo nag mi yi dgra bla red/rgya bod gnyis kyi nor bdag red/bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu red/bstan dgra ru tra'i kha gnon red/'gro drug sems can skyabs gnas red/'gro la bde skyid spel mi red/gong ma lha nas bskos le red/bar ma mi yul 'khrungs le red/da res bdud dang 'phrad le red/thugs de tsam 'tshub don ci la red/gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la/nam mkha'i khri gdugs nyi ma de/shar nas shar zhing nub la 'gro/gsal res smag res gnyis ka gda'/nyin mtshan 'pho 'gyur res mos red/ /rtsi bcud me tog mdangs yag de/dbyar la 'khrungs shing dgun la skem/'khrungs res yal res gnyis ka gda'/dbyar dgun 'pho 'gyur res mos red/mon bya sngon mo'i gsung snyan de/dpyid dbyar grags shing ston dus 'gro/416

grags res 'gro res gnyis ka srid/ 'gro 'ong 'pho 'gyur res mos red/lha bdud gnyis po'i g.yul 'gyed de/dus la 'dzoms shing tshod nas byer/khe res pham res gnyis ka srid/shi gson 'pho 'gyur res mos red/'gran med lha yi sras gcig pu/thugs sems de 'dra 'gyod rgyu med/tshangs pa lha dang klu srin gnyis/khengs log rgyal res pham res gda'/dung rta glog rta 'phar ma gnyis/bang la dal brel yong dus yod/shel gri dug gri ngar ma gnyis/thengs gcig rno gcod yong dus yod/lha yi 'phrul dang bdud 'phrul gnyis/zhag dus dbang gis dar rgud yod/de ring chu tshod bzur le red/dgong chen srod la nye le red/bdud kyi dpa' kha dar dus red/ do nub bdud rgyal tshe thar red/bdud kyi lung dang blo mthun nas/ hor bdud yul du bskyod bsam yod/do nub zi rgan rtsa thang du/ 417

dgra bla wer mas dgag ma byed/mthon po dbyings la shor dogs med/lha chen tshangs pa'i dgag ma yod/dgag ma mi 'dzom rta 'dzom la/gtso 'khor kha ba 'bab 'bab yin/bar snang khams nas shor dwogs med/dgra la gnyan gyi dgag ma yod/dgag ma mi 'dzom rta 'dzom yod/gtso 'khor bu yug 'tshub 'tshub yin/'og phyogs sa nas shor dogs med/wer ma nyis khri chig stong dang /klu gtsug na rin chen dgag ma yod/dgag ma mi 'dzom rta 'dzom yin/gtso 'khor gser phye nyil nyil yin/mtshams bzhir rgyal chen sde bzhi yod/phyogs skyong bcu pos phyogs nas srung /so pa brtan ma bcu gnyis yod/rgod lcam dkar mo'i mel tshe yod/de ring bdud rgyal byang la shor/lha rgyal thugs blo 'gyod rgyu med/rta rkyang bu'i bang la chad lus med/rgyug thag ring na 'bros kha myur/dpa' dgra lha'i dpung la nyams rgud med/418

rgyang mi yul 'gro dus zhe rtsa rgod/ lha dkon mchog gsum la bslu ba med/blo rtse gcig gtad na thugs rjes bzung /sang byes 'gro gcig zhor don go gnyis/mu stegs mchod gnas a mye de/bdud dbang phyug bsgrubs nas lo dgu song /gsal byed mig gis ma bltas yod/lo ngo bcu gnyis lon pa'i dus/dbang phyag kho dang ngo bo gcigamig brnyes pas 'jig rten sreg nges red/zhor du dam la ma bzhag na/bstan la 'pho 'phyug gtong nges yin/de phyir sang la don go sgrubs/che drag dpa' rtul phu nu tsho/nyams pa bdud kyi phung ro de/ma thor sa la mnan pa dgos/a khu sgom chen gdan 'dren gyis/ sgar gyi dngos rdzas mnangs su longs/blo bde bag yangs phebs par gyis/sga sde cho skyongs ber nag gis/mgyogs pa g.yu bya rte'u sngon chibs/ge sar rgyal dang sku mnyam phebs/dgra skal mi thul bsam pa med/419

bros rjes mi zin yong dogs med/do nub lha sgar dkyil la 'gro/blo bde bag yangs zhag sa byed/myos byed lto bcud ril bu dang /sta chen brag ri hab gshog gcigazhags pa nyi zla 'phrul zin gnyis/nad brgya sel ba'i sman mchog gsum/de gsum cis kyang brjed rgyu med/sang skya rengs shar nas 'gro rgyu gyis/lam sna rkyang bu nga yis byed/thang chen gcod cing la chen brgal/mgyogs pa'i dgag ma ma nus na/ nged lha rta gnyis po min rtags gyis/mda' dang gzhu rgyud sprad 'drad dang /lha bdud gdong 'phrad byang ba'i dus/ci mdzad rgyal blon ma dargings med/dpa' rtsal ci 'dug ltad mo lta/de ring thugs blo 'gyod rgyu med/bya ba las don 'grub le yin/bdud dmag dgra mtha' chod le yin/sang gi las don a'u tsi/ 'dir bzhugs rgyal mchog thugs la zhogaces glu de ltar mi skad du gsungs pa dang / rgyal mchog ge 420

sar chibs las bzhol nas/ nga steng gi mi pho yin kyang 'phral du don ma rtogs khyed 'og gi rta yi tshul yin yang sangs rgyas sngang mtha'i sprul pa rdzu 'phrul dang mngon shes de tsam mnga' ba ma shes pas nongs pa dang 'gal ba mthol lo bshags/ phyin chad kyang blo 'dri yul rta mchog khyed yin lugs gsungs nas byug byug dang dbu thod gtugs/ dpa' rtul rnams kyang ha las te sangs rgyar byi sprul pas lung don mi skad smra ba la yi rangs te phyag dang skor ba byas shing dbu thod gtugs/ de nas dam nyams ar jag gi dpung sde gcig kyang med par thal ba'i phung po ltar byas te gling dpung dmag rnams kyis sgar gyi dngos chas thams cad 'thor med bsdus/nyams pa spun gsum gyi phung po gnan pa bya rgyu'i don du rta la bkal nas 'dren rgyu byas/ gling dmag rnams kyis bdud dgra las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan gyi tshul du ki bswo lha rgyal 'then nas sngon du dpa' rtul rgyal blon thams cad sgar du mtshan mo tshur phyag phebs/dpung dmag rnams rim bzhin rjes su 'byor/ a khu spyi dpon dang khro thung sogs lhan rgyas shing dmag 'gro byes song gi lo rgyus gsung gleng zhib rgyas gnang nas spro dgar longs spyad nas bzhugs par gda'o/ 421

le'u dgu pa/ge sar rgyal dang sga sde rjes 'ded byon/g.yu rtse rgyal blon bsgral zhing byang du phebs/a myes sgom pa snying rje'i me yis bsregs/byes don legs grub gling gi sgar du byon/phyi nangs skya rengs ma shar gong nas dpa' rtul nang g.yog rnams kyis gsol ja drangs pa dang chibs sga bsgron zhing phebs pa la bshol med mdzad/ bcud chen lto bcud ril bu/ nad brgya sel ba'i sman ril/ zhags pa nyi zla 'phrul zin sogs sku chas yongs rdzogs chad lus med par bsnams/ sku la dgra lha'i go mtshon brjid par gsol zhing / dpa' rgya tsha dang / 'dan ma/khro thung rnams zhabs 'bring du 'gro 'dod kyi glu thung re yod kyang nyob dogs kyis bzhag rgyal mchog nas dgos gal chen dus phyag mda' bang chen du mngag rgyu'i zhal bkod mdzad nas skar chen 'od mdangs mngon pa'i dus lha yi dbang po brgya byin lha min gyi g.yu la du chas pa 'dra zhig gis chibs gong du thon pa dang / sga sde chos skyong de yang mi nag ral nag nyil li go mtshon brjid rngam khrigs se g.yu bya rte'u sngon gyi gong du bud pas gzhis sdod rnams 422

kyis lha bsangs btang zhing phyag dang skyabs 'gro 'ur dir gyis phul ba'i ngang lha rta 'do rje de spu mdog pad+ma rwa ga 'bru gsum spu la rang byon/ snum 'od 'od zer 'khyil le/ rnga rngog zi ra tshubs se rkang rjes dung dkar g.yas 'khyil/ 'gro 'dod sna sgra di ri/ mngon mkhyen thogs med lag mthil du 'bru rdog bzhag pa ltar gdong nub byang gi phyogs su gtad nas bya 'phur ba ltar phebs/ mgyogs pa g.yu bya rte'u sngon de yang rlung gshog spu ru bco brgyad de bya gshog thad la bkrab pa ltar byas nas rkyang rgod dang bang mnyam pa'i tshul du zi ma'i na gzhung bco brgyad brgal zhing zi ma'i phred la de chu tshod gcig la bcad/ rma a 'dam gyi na ba gzhung brgyad kyi thang de shog skya bsgril ba ltar byas nas rma rgyab kyi mgron lam bar ma mtsho che chung gsum gyi 'dus mdo der nyi ma shar ba dang mnyam par phebs te rkyang skyid kyis der sgug dgos pa'i brda bstan pas rgyal blon gnyis chibs las bshol nas der bsgugs pa dang / lha klu gnyan dang rma rgyal zo dor dgra bla wer ma thams cad kha ba 'bab pa ltar phyogs der 'dus/ mtsho nang nas klu mo byang nas klu yi 'dod yon zas rigs du mas lha yi mi rta bzhi la sgrordo zhu bsnyen bkur byas/dri ba du ma'i glu mang po yod pa nyob dogs kyis bzhag de nas bdud kyi rgyal blon gnyis po bdud rta bzhon nas zi ma'i gnam la bar ma'i la rgyab/ zi thang bye ma'i gzhung drug bcad nas zi ma la rgan gyi la rtsar sa rub pa dang lhan du 'byor ba dang gling lhas char sprin nag po'i mun pas g.yog nas lam ma mthong bar lam gyi zur rdo pha wang khrab khrob kyi bar gseng du bsdad nas nam e gsal gyi re 423

ba dang rjes gcod ra mda' yong dogs kyi blo 'tshab 'tshub mi bde kum kham ngang mtshan mo der lus/ nam gsal ba dang ra mda' ma byang bas cung blo bde ba'i ngang la rgan brgal nas phar nang zi ma'i dh+rir sde shog yan ma zer ba'i 'brog dud kyi ru sne zin nas bdud kyi rgyal blon gnyis gros ma byas blo mnyam ste ru dkyil du babs nas bza' bca' khyer shog zer nas 'bod brda sprad pas ru 'brog gi mi thams cad mi yi rngam 'jigs la zhed de su yin ma shes kyang 'tsho zas sha mar khyer bas bdud kyi rgyal blon gnyis nas rta yi phyi sha la bkal te zi chu bcad nas rma ā dam gyi yul chu yan 'ded byas nas na gzhung brgyad de hab kyis bcad de thang mgor 'tsho zas de zos pa dang / stong bdud nas rta rjes e 'dra bsams nas blo the ma tshom du g.yu rtse rgyal po'i blo gri ngar ma de khos btags/ dgra su la thug kyang phyi bros dang mgo 'bul mi byed rgyu'i kha dan mna' skyel byas te rta thog tu bud nas mtsho chen gyi yang gong / 'o mtsho dkar mo'i mar 'og sbal 'dra mtsho yi 'gram der slebs pa dang rkyang skyid nas bya ra byed cing lag bro sar brdabs pas dgra bo slebs yod pa mkhyen pa na sga sdes sngags btab nas dgra bo bros su mi thar ba'i rgyas btab/ chibs gong du thon nas yar bsu ma 'dra zhig mdzad nas phebs pas 'o mtsho dkar mo'i mar gsham mtsho rnga chu yi khug so der mda' ltong sprad pa ltar 'phrad pas bdud kyi rgyal blon gyi bsam pa la/ gling sdug jo ru'i dgag ma yin pa thag chod/las bzang ngan ci la thug kyang dgra lan sprod bsam pa dang /mthong snang du mi rta dkar po dang dmar po sngon po nag po du mas 424

thang de khengs pa mthong yang phyi chad med par shar gyis yong ba dang /'bru sga sde chos skyong be nag de zil rngam brjid pa'i dpa' rtsal la pho mo 'brong g.yag 'gying 'dra dgra 'chi bdag yin kyang 'bros thung dgos le zhig byas nas khra ring mdung gi so phyung nas ki bso'i sgra dang bcas nye bar bcar nas gyi glu 'di ltar blangs so/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu a la tha la tha la red/tha la glu yi len lugs red/la la ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/dbyings che mchog he ru ka dpal la/gsol ba 'debs so rgyab rten mdzod/gnon byed dam nyams rdul du rlogs/bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas/dpal ldan mgon po'i lha tshogs mkhyen/de ring dgra rgod cham la phob/sha khrag gtang rag tshogs su 'bul/bstan pa rin chen dgung la bstod/skye 'gro bde dang ldan par shogs 'di sa ngo e shes do/sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na/ri dkar po dung seng mchong 'dra 'di/shar gyi rma rgyal spom ra red/mdun dkar po leb shog bco brgyad de/425

khra mo gling la bstan le red/gling gi zo dor mchod lha red/rgyab nag po'i gdong zur bco brgyad de/nag po bdud la bstan le red/de phyir bdud kyi kha gnon red/ri mtha' mtsho yis bskor le red/mtsho mtha' me tog rwa ba red/longs spyod che don de nas byang /rma a dom na ba gzhung brgyardo gong /mtsho che chung chags pa'i zur 'gram red/nga 'dra nga ngo e shes do/nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na/rma khams gling gi sa cha nas/sga pa sga la shar nub yod/ sga 'bru zi ma'i khri sde chags/sga pha mi khri rta 'bum zer/khri sde chags pa'i gzhi dkyil la/mkhar mi 'gyur 'bru yi rab mkhar nas/'bru sga sde chos skyong ber nag zer/mgon po ber nag sprul pa yin/ge sar skyes bu'i sku srung yin/sdang ba dgra yi kha gnon yin/shar gling rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/426

nga rang chos skyong gral gnas yin/ de tsho yin lugs 'dra ma red/'dir byon pa ge sar rgyal po red/dad na bla ma sangs rgyas red/khams gsum chos la 'god mi red/ma shes bdud kyi kha gnon la/klu btsan thod mda' sprod mi red/hor gur dkar gnya' sga gtod mi red/sa tham snying mda' sprod mi red/bdud nag cham la 'bebs mi red/'dzam gling mnga' dbang sgyur mi red/rdzong gter bco brgyad 'bebs mi red/dbu nag bzhag pa byed mi yin/stong bdud lan med glu la nyon/khra mo gli dang a sngon gnam/ gnam a sngon med zhabs gang na 'gro/dpung gling dkar med sa ga na bros/khyod kha sang bros pas thar bsam ste/de ring 'gro sa ga na yod/gling gi rgyal blon rnam gnyis de/rlung bser bu bzhin du 'tshub nas yong /gshin rje'i dgag ma byas nas yod/nyi ma'i 'khor 'das rdzogs le red/427

grib so smag dang nye le red/ ’ bde skyid pha yul shor le red/shi bar do'i gnas la nye le red/nye le ma tshad slebs le red/gcig de sngon gyi smon lam red/gnyis de rang gis bsgrubs le red/gsum de las kyi 'bras bu red/byas pa rang thog smin le red/wa bros byas pas ci la phan/skrag na gling rje ge sar la/'khor gsum phul nas skyabs gnas zhus/'di phyi 'dod na dang len gyis/gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la/yi ga yod tshe chu thang 'thung /kha zas skam chad dus 'gyod rgyu med/skyid 'dod dpon la skyabs gnas zhus/bu khrims la thug dus 'gyod rgyu med/ rig pa yod tshe bla ma sgoms/shi dmyal bar lhung dus 'gyod rgyu med/zer yang zer la bden yang bden/dkar nag lam gyi 'dus mdo red/yag nyes mtheb gang sa mtshams red/shi gson gnyis kyi sa mtshams red/428

de e red blo la skor rdzogs gyis/min gcig dpa' rgod ngar 'dod na/mdung mo dug lce ngar ma 'di/mgon po nag po'i rten mdung yin/bshad pa mang ste lag len myar/ci dga' khyod gnyis blo darngo bstun/glu go na a la ya lan sprod/ ma go snying gi 'dzer ru gyis/khyod tsho'i yid la de ltar zhogaces glu de ltar blangs pas bdud kyi rgyal blon gnyis po dam sri dngos yin pas las dbang drag po'i stabs kyis glu de thos pas zhe sdang gi me chen 'bar/ khyad par du stong bdud lan med de yis mdung phyang ste sga sde'i thad du byang nas mi 'jigs pa'i nyams dang bcas rno re/ khyod gling sdug r+sha mo dpon blon gnyis/ ngar mdog stag mo'i ngar sgra de/ zer nas tshig gis tha ma ru glu 'di ltar blangs par gda'o/glu len a lu tha lu red/tha lu 'o na la lu red/la lu ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/mun pa nag po'i sa gzhi nas/ sha yi ri bo brtsigs sa nas/khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khyil sa nas/dbugs rlangs na bun 'thul sa nas/429

bdud rgyal khyab pa lag ring la/nad bdag srog bdag 'bum gyis bskor/a bus 'bod do la mo byon/dgra rgod cham la 'bebs rogs gyis/sa 'di'i lo rgyus nged la med/de ring rkang mthil bcag pa'i sa/pho rgod stag ngar gzig ngar la/yang rgod dbye thang phye sa red/nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na/ming ci ma yin la mi 'bod rgyu/nag po bdud kyi brdzus bu la/ya med stong bdud lan med red/pho lo bcu gsum gong thog nas/shar ha khang yul la dgra jag song /gos sngon skya can la chig stong bsad/mkhar gser bad can la gcig brgya bshig /dre'u thod dar can la lnga brgya blangs/bu nga la lacha med de nas thogs/dgra bsad bsad skra yi nyag ma'i grangs/ chos sgom gra'i ban la sum brgya bsad/gos dmar po mthong dus zhe spro lang /da rung blo sems ma khengs yod/dngos yod ma sring lhan du song /430

'dzam gling nyul zhing bla tshe 'phrogabyas byas bsgrang tshod mi zin ste/da rung mi byed zhe la med/de tsho gtam gyi glu zhor red/nyon dang gling sdug rgyal blon gnyis/thub bsam yod kyang thub le min/dper na 'dra ma e 'dra gda'/gangs dkar yag nyi mas bzhus zhan 'dra/seng dkar mo'i g.yu ral ma nyams yod/gangs dkar yag ri la ri mthud yin/seng dkar mo gar song rang khyim red/nags tsan dan me yis bsregs zhan 'dra/stag mo'i 'dzom drug ma nyams yod/nags tsan dan ri la ri mthud yod/stag dmar yag gar song pha yul red/chab ko mtsho nyi mas gdung zhan 'dra/nya gser mig gser bshog ma nyams yod/mda' gtsang chab chu la chu mthud yin/nya gser mig gar song pha yul red/dpung bu rta jag la shor zhan 'dra/rje rgyal po'i sku 'tsho bde mo yin/bdud rgyal khab gcig la gcig mthud yin/rje rgyal po gar phebs gdan sa red/431

gtam dngos gnas tshig gi rgyan cha red/tshig sba gsang med na de bas bzang /— dpa' thod gtug dpa' bo'i gtam snyan bzang /dgos dpa' mnyam shi na de bas bzang /a mtshar po e shes gling gi blon/g.yang dkar lug gu spyang kis khyer/bu zos pas mi tshim ngu co 'debs/sha pho chen dung rwa rngon pas blangs/des mi tshad ki bswos lung thang bkang / mda' rgya zhing lo tog ser bas brdungs /des mi tshad 'brug sgras bar snang khengs/spun 'gran med gling sdug blon gyis bsgrungs/snying de yis mi tshim da rung ngar/gtam brnyas pa glu yi mtshar zhad la/phung 'dre gling gi rgyal blon la/skyabs zhus gson pas shi ba dga'/shi dmyal ba zer le yod dogs med/yod na 'dir 'dug ltad mo ston/dpung khyod la yod na nga la yod/tshong dang nye sdeb bya le min/a ma'i bu gces 'dra 'dra yin/mdung khyod la yod na nga la yod/mdung rno chen bshad na 'dra 'dra yin/432

'phrul mdung 'phul na su mkhas yin/glu mang du mi len rna ba tsha/blon nged gnyis yang rgod su red lta/da mchongs shog gling sdug sga sde bu/gdong thug dus phyi bros ma shor dgos/khyod cag yid la de ltar zhogaces glu mjug rdzogs ma thag stong bdud rlung sbud pa ltar mchongs nas sga sde la mdung lan gsum 'phul ba na srung bas brtan cing mtshon gyis ma tshugs rung shed shugs che stabs ling ling gis mi rta phral la khad pa dang gzi thom thom byang / sga sde nas lha'i gsal snang brtan po'i ngang mdung de shugazlo bskyed nas bsnun pas sog rgyab g.yas nas mdun g.yon du bud nas nyams pa bdud kyi bu de am gtsigs tham tham ngang shing rgan 'gyel ba ltar rta thog nas lhungs te thul lo/ de'i dus su 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs gnas/sems can kun gyi pha ma gling rje ge sar rgyal po khong dang g.yu rtse rgyal po gnyis nye bar 'phrad pa dang / bdud rgyal des ge sar yin pa shes nas zhe sdang mi bzod pa'i ngang nas glu len khom med par mda' gsum springs byung bas sku yi zur phyogs nas sar lhung ba las byams dang snying rje ldan pa'i sku la nyon mongs zhe sdang 'bar ba'i dug mda' ma thebs/ yang khos stag dong nas dga' rab bdud kyi bla mda' lcags mda' 'ug sgro ma de bton nas gzhu steng du bzhag ste glu thung 'di blangs so/glu len a lu tha lu red/433

tha lu 'u na la mo red/glu 'o na zer ba rang glu red/tha lu lha la 'bod sa red/nam mkha' sprin gyi gur khang nas/bdud rgyal gu lang dbang phyug lha/bdud lha bye ba 'bum gyis bskor/da res dpung la la mo byon/myes rabs pha dang rang re gsum/sha khrag phud zas khyod la mchod/blo sems skyabs bcol zhus le yin/de ring yod na de yod yin/de ring med na de med red/sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na/zi hor gling gi sa mtshams la/rma a 'dam na ba gzhung brgyad zer/mgron po'i ja lam bar ma zer/ja 'u zi nag po rgya nas 'dren/stod la dwag mnga' ris 'gro lam red/nga 'dra rgyal po g.yu rtse red/bdud chen bzhi yi nang gras red/dpa' rtsal can gyi bu rgyud yin/khra mo gling gi sgos dgra yin/sangs rgyas chos kyi bstan dgra yin /434

yin te blo sems ma khengs yod/sha pha gling gi rgyal po khyod/snang chung rang snang che lugs la/pho gsar chag sgos ded le ang /rta gsar rgyug 'dod mi lo gda'/mna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la/za che na mar dkar mchin kha na/mchong che na stag mo sked pa 'bud/grags che na g.yu 'brug mtsho la lhung /zil che na nyi zla gza' yis sgrib/zer yang zer la bden yang bden/rta gsar rgyug 'dod che rgyu de/rkang rwa bzhi rdo la rgyag ltas red/pho gsar dpa' mdog che rgyu de/srog lus dgra la shor ltas red/e ma mtshar gyi che ba la/blo skor rdzogs byas na zhe sems 'khrugakhyod skyes nas nyi ma da bar du/bdud rgyal stobs ldan nag po gcigazi ma'i stag zhal rgyal po gnyis/pho bdud yongs kyi btsan dang gsum/mo bdud yongs kyi gla ske bzhi /mi min bu mo spun gsum lnga/435
