chu 'dre nya mgo can dang drugaphung bdud kong bdud spun mched dgu/da res nged kyi ming sring bcas/brlag brlag bsad bsad bsgrangs tshod med/bdud sde'i sha pha lag dmar khyod/med na bdud sde 'dug chus bde/blo dkar nang me dgra la sgyur/da res snying mda' sprod rgyu yin/gzhu steng bzhag pa'i mda' mo 'di/stag dong mda' yi srung ba yin/dga' rab bdud kyi bla mda' yin/lcags mda' srin bya'i sgro can 'di/'phangs na ri rab che yang gtor/—— 'ben nyi zla bzhag na thang la lhung /mda' 'di 'dra'i lo rgyus bshad tshod med/khyod dngos yod yin na thar bsam med/'ja' dngos med 'dra na rgyal rtags red/glu go na snying gi dkyil la zhogatsho ma go glu la 'bras bu med/ces zer nas mda' de shugs bskyed de springs byang bas dug gi rlangs pa chil le shugs kyi 'ur sgra di ri bdud rmerdo' me stag tshubs se byung ba na lha chen tshangs pa dkar pos gser phub mda' rtser gtad nas bzhugs pas sku rje'i phyogs tsam la ma nye bar mtshor 436

thebs pas dug gis mtsho mer ba zhig dang / dug rlangs kyi stobs kyis nyi ma dmar mdog snang ba zhig byang / de nas sku rje khong gi dgongs pa la/ zhi bas chos kyi bgon 'bras bshad na khos nyan pa'i phyogs tsam yadza mi 'dug de bas mngon spyod kyis bsgral nas bsngo smon rgyas 'debs dang 'pho ba'i mtshams sbyar dgongs nas/ thugs snying rje'i ngang khros pa'i skur bzhengs nas mi smug g.yu yi smin ma/ dgra lha'i me stag thar re/ wer ma'i zir ra tshubs se/ spyan mig la kha'i skar rgyan de dmar mo khrag gis g.yos nas gzhu mo rwa rgod 'khyil can du mda' mo lcags nag 'phur babs shes pa de phyag mtheb kyis ltong sprad nas khyod nyon mongs bdud rgyal g.yu ral can/ shi de tsam ma brel slebs le red/ bar do 'grim nyin phan pa'i tshig nga ge sar glu la tshur nyon dang / gtam don chen rdo ga 'di ltar yod/ gsungs nas dgra bla'i dpa' glu ngar sgra 'di ltar bstsal to/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu a la tha la tha la red/tha la la mo la la red/la la glu yi len lugs red/gnas rnga yab zangs mdog dpal ri nas/rgyal ba kun 'dus pad+ma 'byung /bod yul gdul bya skyong ba'i dus/sde lnga mtshan brgyad rnam 'phrul ston/ngo bo gcig po pad+ma 'byang /༄ 437

gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes gzigs/'brel tshad don dang ldan par shogalha klu gnyan gsum dgra lha'i tshogs/wer ma zo dor las la 'dus/bstan dgra sgrol la snying khrag bzhes/dkar phyogs bstan pa dgung la bstod/sa 'di zo dor rma rgyal sa/sdar mas bros lam 'tshol sa red/dpa' bos dgag ra rgyag sa red/rta pho'i bgros gom gshib sa red/ma mgyogs sga chad yong sa red/lha bdud dpa' rtsal 'gran sa red/bdud rgyal gsod sa'i bshas ra red/nga 'dra gling rje ge sar zer/pho lo bcu gsum gong thog yin/khyed rang zer ba de rang yin/dpa' dang rtsal drug lus la tshang /bdud rgyal ming thogs bco brgyad bsad/smon log tsi tsi grangs med bsad/nyams pa'i bla gnas cham la phab/tshad bzhag gleng tshod yod sa med/rgya dkar nag snyan pas rgyab le yin/kha sngon kha yi zla ba la/438

rma khams gling rgyal bskos le red/nyams pa'i bdud dang 'phrad le red/dam sri spun dgu rgyal blon de/de ring dgra rtsad gcod le yin/rtags ma brgya yi 'go mo yin/'go mo rten 'brel legs le yin/gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la/gnyen nye ba yag na gzhung bzang yagagrogasabla mar bcar na rang rgyud thul/dpon mtho sar bcar na khebs pa che/jag 'go mo yag na rting pa yagabakra dang po shis na rjes don 'grub/ da res rten brel legs le yin/rim rim bdud rgyal 'dul rgyu yin/nor mdzod g.yang la len rgyu yin/'gro la bzhag pa byed rgyu yin/lha bdud bar gyis dbye ba de/bsam pa bzang ngan rgyu la brten/mtshams sbyar smon lam bzang ngan red/gzhi don 'gro drug sems can 'di/pha ma ma byas gcig kyang med/bde ba 'dod kyang sdug bsngal 'byang /'gro la gnod 'tshe'i bdud rigazlo la/439

phan sems 'chang zhing phan 'dogs lta/lha yis 'gro la phan pa'i don/rim par byed pa'i smon lam 'debs/bdud kyis gnod 'tshe srog gcod las/rim gyis byas pas smon lam logalha bdud 'byang khungs de 'dra red/khyod rang skyerlo nas da bar du/'gro mang srog bcad rgyu nor 'phroga'agro kun sdug bsngal mnar gcod byas/rim gyis byed pa'i rming gzhi btings/brtsis na bsgrang tshod yod sa med/sdig pa'i khur po je che las/phyi ma 'gro lam gcig las med/de phyir ge sar skyes bu ngas/smon log dmyal ba'i 'brel thag gcod/ nga ge sar 'gro drug pha ma yin/gzhan don min pa bya rgyu med/lha nas khas len byas le yin/byas pa rang gis sgrub nges yin/'dzam gling bde la ma 'khod bar/ge sar jag 'gro rdzogs dus med/lus srog dka' ngal ltos pa med/rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' ltar/440

'gro ba'i don chen byed nges yin/khyod rang smon log g.yu rtse khyod/ma bsad tshe thar btang bas na/skye 'gro bde skyid ldan dus med/sems can kun gyi sgos dgra khyod/de ring ma bsgral ge sar min/mda' de 'dra mi 'phen e 'dra 'phen/gzhu mchog dkar 'gugs la bkug pa de/glag rog po zan la 'jum pa 'dra/ mda' nyag— phran bar snang 'grim pa'i dus/glog dmar mo mkha' nas 'khyug pa 'dra/dmigs gtad 'ben la thebs pa'i dus/rgya brag thog lces gtor 'dra byed/dkar phyogs thar pa'i sa bon de/khyod kyi lus la thebs le yin/bsags bsags ngan song 'brel thag de/shes rab ral gris gcod le yin/gtam bshad ma yin nges don tshigashi bar dor dad 'dun ma 'phyug dang /skyid dag pa'i zhing la bskyal bas chogaglu go na bden 'bras yid la zung /ma go glu la 'bras bu med/bdud rgyal yid la de ltar zhog441

ces glu de ltar bzhengs nas mda' de springs pas g.yu rtse rgyal pos go bzur nas yod pas sga 'gyur gyis mda' bzur byed bsam pa yod rung lha mda' de bdud rgyal gyi snying khar thebs nas mar me rlung gis bdas pa bzhin nag ye re rta las lhungs nas dam sri nyams pa'i rgyal po nag po bdud kyi rten phur/ sems can kun gyi spyi dgra/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sgos dgra/ mi min 'dre bdud kyi phung tshang / lta ba log pa'i ru tra de thul/ lha mi rnams kyi ki bswo ldir/ grags snyan 'jig rten gsum la khyab/ mi mthun dgra las rgyal ba'i ba dan srid gsum du bsgrengs par gda'o/ de nas bdud kyis phung po'i g.yu yi ral pa de dpa' rtags su bzhes/phung po de mgo mjug ldog nas gnyis ka lhan du mnan/ de'i steng du skyes bu mi rta gnyis kyis bdud mi dar ba'i smon lam dang bcas bro gar mdzad pas mi rta'i zhabs rjes gsol ba rma a 'dam du rdo pha wang mchod— rten gzugs byon gyi gsham du da lta yang mjal rgyu yod zer zhing / skyes mchog rgyal blon gnyis kyis bsngo smon dang 'pho ba'i mtshams sbyar mdzad pas g.yu rtse de'i smon log sdig bsags kyi las rgyun chod nas 'jang sa mi nyag yul du che rgyud pa'i bu gces ka ra zhes par tshe 'phos nas slar ge sar zhal mjal zhing phan pa'i grogs su gyur pa'i lus rten thob/ stong bdud de mi lus kha shas brjes pa'i mthar sga sde zhing la nyul ba'i dus bde chen sa lam bgrod pa'i rtags mtshan shar/ de yi dus su nyi ma gsal lhang lhang shar te lha dgyes pa'i 'ja' 'od kyi gur chen phub/ bar du lha srin sde brgyad dkar phyogs la mngon par dga' ba rnams kyis rang 442

/ gzugs dngos su bstan nas grogs dang 'phrin las sgrub pa'i khas — len dam bca' bzhag mtsho nas klu rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung nas skor ba dang phyag byas/ klu de tsho'i nang nas klu chen mdog dkar po sbrul lnga'i gdengs ka dang smad gser sgrul 'khyil ba zhig rlung ma'i rlung zi dar gyi ling steng du bzhag nas khyer byung ba ge sar rgyal blon gyi mdun du 'khod nas phyag dang bcas te zhus pa/kye ma 'gro ba'i skyabs gnas rin po che/ khyed ni stobs ldan rdzu 'phrul can/ 'khrungs yul gang dang mdzad pa ci/ rigs dang mtshan sogs gang ltar lags/ bdag ni kru rgyal nye dga' bo/shakya'i bstan la mngon par dad/ chos kyi khrims la rab gnas kyang / hor dang zi ma nag shod lung / ri nyul dmar thab bkru bshal gyis/ bdag lus rmar gyur zug gzer mnar/ shin tu sdug cing bsngal bas na/ khyed ni thams cad mkhyen pa ste/bdag la sman mchog bstsal du gsol/ khrus dngabadud rtsi legs gnang zhu/ ci gsung bka' nyan 'bangs su mchis/ zhes zhus pa na rgyal mchog ge sar khong gis spyan ras gzigs thugs rje chen ོོpo'i sku lam gyis bstan nas nad brgya sel ba'i sman mchog phyag tu bzung ste bka' glu 'di ltar bstsal to/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ —glu a la dkon mchog rtsa ba gsum/tha la snying nas gsol ba 'debs/la la 'bral med spyi bor brgyan/ 'gro drug bde la 'kho/da par shog4 43

sa 'di rma zla sgang gi sa/bod dbu nag skyong ba'i zo dor che/shar rma rgyal spom ra'i ri rgyab na/mtsho che chung gsum gyi 'dus mdo red/nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na/pha rigs che ba bod nas chad/ bod chos rgyal khri sde'i gdung rgyud yin/ ma rigs gnyan po lha 'dre'i rigs/ rma ri sman mo'i sras rgyud la/gdongo ra khri ru khri'i gdung rgyud red/sde 'ibengs rma khams gling yul chags/chos la 'phen dang chos 'phen nagad lta'i pha myes yan chod la/ rim byon rgyal rabs bco brgyad red/rgyal rabs de 'dra'i rgyud pa la/ pha rigs klu mo mdzes ldan ma/slob dpon pad+ma'i dbang yon yin/na gardzu na'i sman yon yin/mi yul yar la byon pa'i dus/'gog a rdo'i chu mig gong ma la/ me tog nang nas byon le yin/ra lo ston pa'i bo gces byas/'gog gling 'khrug nas gling la 'khyar/ 444

nga rang rigs gsum mgon po yin/bar ma gling gi rgyal po yin/ nang don bla ma sangs rgyas yin/bcom ldan shākya'i rgyal po dang /slob dpon pad+ma'i pho nya yin/ ming la ge sar dgra 'dul zer/ lo chung ngu'i dus na jo ru zer/gong ma lha nas bskos le yin/ nag phyogs bdud kyi kha gnon yin/dkar phyogasadabu 'phang bstod mi yin/smon log cham la 'bebs ri'iyin/ kha sang nyam pa spun dgu btul/da res rting brdzogs le yin/ de tsho de snga'i yin lugs red/de3ba'iklu rgyal nye dga' bo/nga rang 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi 'phrul/rig gnas yon tan mkhyen pa'i bdagaskad rig sa sgra la thogs pa med/gzungs spobs nor bu'i gter sgo 'byed/ gsung 'gyur med spyan ras gzigs dbang yin/byams pa'i semasakyis gzhan don byed/—snying rjes lus srog phang med sbyin/ thugs rje khams gargyusapha'agro la bsgyur/445

thugs mchog phyag na rdo rje yin/ma rungs nyams pa'i bdud dang bgegs/dngos yod dngos sled bya ma'i rigs/ 'gro la gnod 'tshe byed mkhan rnams/skad cig tsam gyis 'joms par byed/nad rigs sdug bsngal sel ba yin/sman mchog yon tan brgyad ldan 'di/sangs rgyas sman lha'i sman mchog bsdus/mched brgyad rnams kyis byin rlabs mdzad/rig 'dzin pad+mas gter du sbas/ rma shel gyi brag nas gter byon rnyed/de ring klu chen khyed la sbyin/ na ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar shogadag byed khrus kyi ril bu sbyin/ lus nyams sems nyams dbang po nyams/nyams grib gos pa sangs gyur cig klu rgyal sngar ltar bde bar shogahor dang zi ma nag shod lung / nag phyogs sdig la dga' ba'i bu/ yul dang mi grangs ji tsam yod/bdud kyi a mye 'bum thub der/lo rgyus 'dris zab yod dam ci/yod na lung pa'i chags tshul dang /446

'khor g.yog 'gro lugs spyod lam ci/ma nor skad cha drang gtam gyis/gnas yul gcig tu ma nges te/rma lha ri'i mtsho la gnas spos bzang/yul khams dkar phyogs gnas pa yis/nyams grib mi gtsang 'byang dwogs med/shes rab ye shes dbang rāskur bas/blo rmongs sgrib pa sel bar shogadakon mchog rtsa gsum rnams kyi mthus/klu rgyal bu sring 'khor g.yog bcas/mi bde gegs kyis mi tshugs shoganang pa'i khrims la gnas par shogabastan la bya ra byed par shogakhyod cag yid la de ltar zhogaces gsungs te sman ril dang khrus chab gnang / ri thang mtsho rnams la yang khrus chab bstsal bas de ma thag klu rmar gyur nga rmongs pa mi bde ba thams cad me long ngog las rdul phyis pa ltar tsha ba las sangs/ klu rgyal 'khor tshogs dgyes shing dga' ba checha pos rang gi yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel 'bul bar byed pa lag tu bzung nas na ga ra dza'i sgra skad kyis glu lan 'di ltar phul lo/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ glu na ga ra dza tam bu ra/ e ta ma ya ha hi hu/ 447

rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul sa nas/bcom ldan shākya'i rgyal po la/dgra bcom byang sems nyan thos tshogs/lha mi 'jig rten 'khor tshogs bcas/lam mer dran zhing gsol ba 'debs/de ring mjal ba'i skyes bu nyid/ ge sar khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ bdag ni yid ches snying nas spro/'bral med rtag tu 'grogs par smon/nga ni klu rgyal nye dga' ste/ ma tha' mtsho rol mtsho tshun chad nas/'dzam gling mtsho chen mtsho chung dang /rgyun 'bab chu mig lag mthil yan/gnas dang bdag po nga dbang che/shākya'i bstan la mngon par dad/zhal mjal gsung thos byin rlabs thob/'jig rten sa bcud 'phel rgyas phyir/ rgyal ba'i lung gis bsngags pa las/lnga brgya phrag bcur klu gzugs su/'gro la phan thogs tha tshig gnang /de rjes 'og min zhing khams sam/ byams pa'i 'khor gyi thog mar gsungs/de rjes 'phags pa'i yul sa nas/448

tshas rgyal mya ngan med pa la/ longs spyod gser phye grogs bcol nas/ston pa'i bka' bsdu bar pa byas/ de rjes byang sems paṇa grub mjal/grogs byas gdams pa du ma thob/'jig rten dge la phyogs gyur na/na ba med cing gzi brjid che/ 'gro khams ma rungs las bgyis na/klu rgyal thams cad mi bder 'gyur/de phyir rgyal khams bde dus med / da dus ser chen hor rgyal dang /ma rungs nyams pa'i sdig spyod 'gar/mun rub skar tshogs mngon pa bzhin/phyogs mtshams yul gzhan khengs nas 'dugade las rkyen pa'i na tsha mang /ma zad 'di nas byang shar 'tshams/gdol pa rigs kyi glu gnas mtsho/mtsho nag brag nag sa gzhi naganag po lung pa'i 'dus mod na/bdud kyi a mye 'bum thub yod/mu stegs gu lang dbang phyug bsgrubs/ngan sngags mchil mas rgya mtsho skem/dkar phyogs bstan pa'i dgra bo de/449

nag phyogs bdud la phan cha sgrub/shi ba slong nus sman dpyad sogs/bdud kyi tshe srog brtan par byed/nag phyogs 'bangs sde du ma yod/'khor du mu stegs gra 'bangs yod/srung ba dngos med sde tshogs yod/ gnas sa brag nag btsan rdzong bca'/rgyun par sus kyang mthong shes med/sprul pa bya g.yag kham pa sogs/ nges med phyogs kun nyul yang srid/zhib pa lo rgyus mi mnga' lags/nag shod zi byang bar tha na/rdza ri dkar po'i mdun zhol na/mtsho dkar po yon chab gshams 'dra yod/de brtan ma rma sman gnas pa'i mtsho/mtsho de khar phebs la 'dri bshad mdzod/de mkhyen ldan lo rgyus can gyi sman/grogs ra mda' 'phrin las bsgrubs nas yong /dgos 'dod char ltar 'bebs pa yi yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel 'di/'og ma klu yi nor bu yin/ 4de ring ge sar khyod la 'bul/longs spyod 'dzad med dngos grub rgyun //50

'gro khams dbul ba sel bar shogab skyes bu'i bzhag pa bzang bar shoganag shod lung mdo'i mtsho mo de/klu gdol nag po'i pho brang red/byang a 'dam mi bde byed mkhan red/khyod sprul pa'i stobs kyis dam la zhogabadag cag 'khor tshogs bcas rnams kyis/khyed kyi bstan pa srung bar byed/gnas spos lha ri'i mtsho la byed/nam yang 'bral med thugs rjes skyongs/mi yi mchog gyur thugs la zhogace4zhus shing nor bu phul/ sga sde la yang gser 'bab nor bu phul/ rgyal mchog gi klu mo 'khor dang bcas pa la rigs gsum mgon po'i sgom khrid sogs rgyas par gnang zhing 'gro don rgyas par mdzad/ de nub der zhag sa khel bas klu yis sri zhu bsnyen bkur mdzad/ phyi nang rma rgyal gyis sna 'dren dang bcas rgyal blon gnyis po 'do ba rta yi bang rtsal phyung nas myur bar phebs pas zi ma byang sga bar tha nag shod kyi sa tha/ rma sman gnas pa'i mtsho khar phebs pa na/ rkyang skyid kyis lag bro brdabs pas sa gzhi 'gul/ ge sar khong nas hūṃ mdzad kyis phyag rgya mdzad/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dmig pas gnad bskul bas/ brtan ma rma ri de nyid mngon sum gzhon nu ma mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa zhig byas nas der phebs nas ge sar dpon blon 'byom 451

dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan 'dri bshad ma dgos par gsal ler mkhyen nas dpon blon gyi chibs pa'i kha ru nas bzung ste glu 'di ltar bzhengs so/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/pi sha tsi pa tam bu ra/ 'a ra 'u ta ha ho he/glu sga skad lha 'dre'i len lugs red/radro snang dag pa lha yi zhing /bcom ldan shākya'i rgyal po dang /gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje dang /slob dpon pad+ma 'byang gnas la/gsol ba 'debs rmo bdag rgyud skyongs/sa 'di bod ljongs chen po'i ljongs/zi dang zi ma'i sa mtshams la/rma sman dbyar zla gnas pa'i ri/ nga 'dra ma rgyud sman mo red/ brtan ma bcu gnyis nang gral red/bod khams skyong ba'i so pa red/tshangs pa'i drung dang yongs 'du'i zhing /gnas yul bye ba phrag brgya la/ nges med gnas bcas rgyu ba yin/de nas gling rje lha yi sras/khyed bltams nas nyi ma da bar du/ 452

gos gong ba bzhin du 'bral med byas ma lhas mi skyob su yis skyob/khyod gcig du sangs rgyas 'dus sku yin/gnyis su 'gro don ded dpon red/gsum du rang rgyud 'phrul med phyir/dgongs bzhed ci mnga' bka' don sgrub/de snga ge sar mdzad spyod de/spren bral nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de/dkar yag gangs la phog pa bzhin/mdzad spyod ngo mtshar bkra re shis/bkra shis nyi ma 'gro la khyab/ —sdug gi mun pa mtha' nas sangs/stobs ldan nag po phyin chad nas/da res nyams bdud dam sri yan/hor thog thog yang thog thog lha sogs/phung bdud mo btsan de tsam btul/gcan gzan sde lnga phyin chad nas/bdud kyi bla gnas de tsarma btul/zi ma'i rta dang 'dan ma'i nas/sa bdag gser dang yo skyid lugagayang chen du ma de tsam phab/ nag po bdud kyi gnya' nas mnan/ 'gro ba yongs la phan thogs pa'i/ 453

dkar po dge ba'i gzhi bzang bsgrubs/da phyin mdzad pa'i thog ma la/bdud kyi a mye 'bum thub de/pha yul zhang zhung yul nas yin/shar zi dmar yul la 'gro don zer/mu stegs log chos kun la ston/hor bdud 'jang stag rgyal dang sdeb/nang pa'i bstan la 'tshe bar byed/'chi ba slong ba'i nus mthu yod/hor gyi bla ma dbu dkar dang /mi dbon yang dbon slob grwa yod/dngos yod dngos med 'phral yang yod/khyod jo ru zer ba mi g.yerno dus/hor la dpa' rtags bzhag pa'i dus/snyan grags bdud yul khyab pa'i dus/bdud kyi bla mchod 'bum thub de/ge sar khyed la sgos dgra dang /nang pa'i bstan dgra byed sems kyis/gu lang bsgrubs nas lo dgu song /phyi srung 'bar ba dmar mo yod/sprul pa stag gis 'dul dgos yod/so pa mtshan bya 'ug pa yod/ nges don the'u rangs srung ba red/454

chu srung sbal ba mgo dgu yod/de klu bdud nag po'i srung ba red/ 'phrang srung phug ron sngon mo brgya/de nges don mu stegs gra 'bangs red/brag nag thag phur brdabs 'dra de/nang don a mye'i sku mkhar red/brag phug shing nags sgo khebs can/shing la stag tshang bca' ba de/gu lang bdud kyi srung ba red/rtsal seng ge dkar mo'i sder 'dra dgos/brag thog go bo lding skor de/a mye'i chu ma nyul byed yin/zhags pa nyi zla 'phrul zin thob/bden tshig bsgrags mdzod dam la zhogade'i nang la a mye 'bum thub de/sngon mo mtshon gyis chod le min/bden 'bras tshig la nyan le min/'bar ba'i me la sreg dgos yod/sbar thabs lha mi gnyis kyis byed/pho brang brag nag bshig mi la/sta chen brag ri tab gshog dgos/da rung de bas mi tshad pa'i/brag nag de 'dra'i rgyab phyogs na/455

rtsa chu 'dzoms pa'i spang ri la/a mye'i bla gnas byang g.yag kham/gnas pa sa yul nges med rgyu/zhags pas 'ching ngam mda' la drongs/de nas rgyarla blon rnam pa gnyis/dpa' rtsal lus la rdzogs kyang rung /rdzu 'phrul med na 'gro thabs med/nus mthu med na 'dul thabs med/drag po'i dmag tshan ngom sa med/de phyir blon chen sga sde khyed/sna bo zo dor yul lhas byed/phyir log dmag sgar phebs na bzang /dpa' rtul thugs sems bde bar mdzod/zhag po bdun gyi gong thog nas/nag shod sde 'bangs gzhi dkyil la/che drag hrag bsdus bsu la shogasde 'bangs rgyu nor ya bdag byed/de tshe rgyal mchog dpung rogs ni/dkar phyogs bstan srung rnams kyis byed/phra man mchong gi phreng zhags 'di/ lha blon mjal ba'i dga' rtags yin/sku rje yid bzhin nor bu khyed/thugs brel ba ma gnang pho brang phebs/456

lha klu gnyan gsum gros ra tshogs/sang nyin a mye 'dul du 'gro/ de ring sman mo yang 'khor la/ tshim pa'i chos char 'bebs par mdzod/glu 'phrul ba byung na snying nas bshags/ngag 'khyal ba byung na bzod bzhes gsol/ 'dir phebs rgyal blon thugs la zhogaces glu de ltar phu la ba dang / rgyal mchog yid bzhin nor bu khong sman mo'i zhu don tshig la nor 'phrul med par gzigs nas chibs las gzho la te rkyalatswarnyan gnyis gsung gli nga dang bcud chen zas bcud ril bu myos byed a rag ril bu/ skom sel mkha' mgro'i tshe chang sogs lalha mi kun gyis longs spyad de dga' spro bsam gyi4mi khyab pa'i ngang 'brong ri'i zo dor mi nag rta nag can dang / gyim rtse khra cog mi rta dkar bo bcas kyi 'khor gyis bskor nas sga sde phyir log phebs/ de nas mtsho de sgo mo phyes pa 'dra ba zhig byung ba da nga rgyal mchog mi rta gnyis nyams snang bag tsha med par nang du phebs pa na rin po che'i gling me tog sna tshogs bkrag pa bya tshogs skad rnyin 'byin pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba de'i dbus rin chen bdun gyis sbras pa'i khang bzang rgya che zhing mdzes pa lha dbang gi gzhal yas khang dang mtshungs pa'i nang du spyan drangs nas rin po che'i khri dar zab gos kyis klubs pa'i steng du bzhugs su gsol nas brtan ma dang ya ma'i tshogs sman mo 'bum sde du mas bro gar dang dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs 'dod yon gyi zas rigs du mas 457

mchod dang pa bcas bzhugs shing / rgyal mchog nas las 'bras dang 'khor ba'i nyes mig gi bka' chos gsungs pa na sman mo'i tshogs kyis gsol btab zhu bskul byas pas slar 'dod yon gyis tshogs 'khor la rol dgyes mdzad cing dbang phyag he ru ka la a mes byang chub kyi dgongs bzhed gnad du bsnurdo te chos 'khor bskor ba na nyin mtshan drug gi dus 'das/ slar snang mtha'i sprul pa rkyang rgod 'phel po nas tsher lhang dang bcas byon dgos pa brdas bskul bas de ma thag thugs brel dang bcas phebs grabs mdzad cing lha klu gnyan dang brtan ma'i tshogs bcas rlung 'tshub pa bzhin phebs pa na nag shod srib ri'i rtse'i bdud srin lce spyang ma de 'phar ba la brdzus nas bya ra byed kyin yod skabs ge sar lha yi 'khor tshogs rnams der phebs pa'i rtags mtshan sa 'gul ba na gcan spyang 'phar ba mo glo bur du ci yin med pa'i dngas skrag cig byung nas 'phar bar sprul pa de zhig nas rang gzugs bud med nag mo mi sdug srin mo'i gzugs kyis bya ra byed sa de nas rlung dmar zhig g.yos pas dgra bla'i gnyan stag dang / sku rje ge sar gnyis kyis rgya stag gnyis la sprul te so srung dza re bzung ste phar tshur 'then nas lus dum bur bcad de btul/ de nas la lung zhig brgal bas brag ri sbrul gyen la 'gro ba 'dra ba'i mgor the'u rangs srung ma 'ug par sprul nas so par bsdad yod pa der yang nyams snang sngar dang mi 'dra ba skyi g.ya' ba tsha zing zing zhig byung ba dang phar tshur bya ra byas4 pas/ spang leb steng na bu mo shin tu mdzes ma g.yu yi rna cha can chu dar dkar dmor gyi gos gyon pa gnyis sho rgyag bzhin sho 458

bshad byed pa zhig mthong bas khos ci yin med par sho la dga' nas de'i rtsar phyin pa dang lhan bu mo gnyis gcig gi gdong la gcig gis bltas nas mig brda byas pa dang lhan rgyal mchog nas nyi zla 'phrul zhags de glog 'khyug pa ltar 'phangs pa the'u rangs ber ma nag po'i sker thebs nas lus gru gu bzhin du bsdams pas khos srog snying phul bas mgar ba nag po la gnyer bcol nas 'bangs su bkod cing dam la bzhag de nas phebs pa na khrom chu chen po'i rab kha na sbal pa mgo dgu rngam zhing brjid pa de so lta bya ra byed bzhin 'dug pa4 ge sar skyes bu khong rnam4kyis gzugs med 'od dmar po shar ba zhig la brdzus nas nye bar phebs pa na klu bdud kyis tshor te lus sbra chen sum 'gyur tsam byas nas 'bab chu 'akag nas mtshor bskyil te mgo bo yar bkyag nas phyogs kun la lta zhing zing zing du yod pa na/ rgyal mchog ge sar gyis gzigs nas de ma thag lha chen tshangs pa'i sprul pa bya khyung 'jigs su rung ba zhig gis bar snang la bteg sa pa dngalhan sman mo'i brda lung dang bstun rgyal ma chog na sasta chen brag ri hab gshog lan gsum btab ste rnam shes 'phos/ — sha khrag dgra bla wer mar mchod/ de'i tshe sa 'gul ba dang ri sgra dang sha 'od kyi sgra chen po grags pas brag nag pho brang gi nang rdzong bdud kyi a mye des tshor te rtags mtshan 'tshub stabs glo bur du dngangs skrag gis de phyo gas la bltas pa na/ mig las me 'bar te mu stegs 'jang pa nag po/ hor yan thub 'chi gsos sman pa/ zi shang 'phrul gyi bla ma zhang zhung ka ra keng log stag yan ngan sngags sgom pa lnga mdun 'khor du yod pa na me lce 'bar ba 459

ltar mes tshig kho ci bya med par phar tshur bltas pas nyin rdzas sman dpyad thams cad mes tshig yang lta stangs gsum par a mye'i sgrub sgam yang mes tshig pa mthong bas kho rnam rtogs mi zad pas rgyud 'khrugs te phyi rol du don rtsis na dpal ri zhing nas pad mas rgyud bskul te dpal mgon ma ning de nyid skad cig glog 'khyug pa bzhi na dbang phyug chen po'i gzugs su brdzus nas e mye'i mdun thad nas mgur glu 'di ltar gsungs so/ — glu 'u na a lu tha lu red/ tha lu 'u na len lugs red/ la lu ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/ snying dkyil lha la mchod cing bstod/ dmigs pa'i sha khrag mchod pa 'bul/sa'adi a mye'i sgrub khang red/ nga 'dra lnge ngo ma shes na/ steng mkhar lha yi pho brang nas/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed gnas nas 'ongs/bsgrubs bsgrub4dbang phyug nga rang yin/lha mi lus dang 'bral med kyang / sgom mkhan rnam rtog che bas phung /dam bca' mi lo bcu gnyis red/da res lo dgu ma lon yod/ mig lta stangs rang dgra rang gshed red/rten sgam sman dpyad rang slob de/460

'dzam gling nyul yang rnyid pa dka' /de yang mdang gsum rmi lam bzhin/de bsgrubs kyang bla ma rangagis bsgrubs/ phung yang ma mye rang gis phung /dper na 'dra ma e 'dra gda'/stag shar bzang po jag la 'gro/blo rtse gnyis med na jag lam yagasems khol ril can gyis shar lu des/do na mi 'grub mi khas lung thang bkang / ma sru bzang po gnas la 'gro/sems gcig tu brtan na gnas lam yagablo gya gyu can gyi sman chung des/ gnas sa mi zin go ru logadapon lu bzang po sde skyong byon/rang don rgyab bskyur gzhan don yagamatho dang grags 'dod dpon chung des/rang don bsgrubs pas sku chus shor/bla lu bzang po gzhan don byon/ 4re dogs 'khrul bral gzhan don rab/the tshom mkhan gyi bla grwa des/ 'brel tshad rang gzhan gnyis ka phung /dpe zer srol bden srol gnyis ka red/khyod a mye'i gong na nam mkha' gda'/4(di1

de yod kyang mgo bo rdeb dgos med/zil la che ba nyi zla gda'/ yod kyang kha dog 'ugran dgos med/stobs khyod bas che ba nga rang yod/yod kyang mgon skyabs byed mkhan yin/༄dud yongs kyi dgra bo jo ru red/ red kyang sang med gnang med red/phyi so srung 'phar ba rgyug mgyogs che/nang don srin mo dwag rtsal che/the'u rangs 'ug pa mig rna gsang /klu bdud sbal pa 'jigs rngam che/grwa 'bangs sngon mo sa g.yel med srung /nged cag lha yis 'bral med skyong /'jig rten nyi zla'i bar gseng na/ zhed dgos su la yod dwogs med/phyi rol rgyu ba gang la 'gro/ hor 'jang zi zhang stag gzig gi/gra 'bangs rnams kyi rus bu bsdus/rim gyis 'chi gsos sman sbyor gyis/lo gcig 'gor med sos nges yin/da rung sgrubs la snying rus 'bungs/bsgrubs pa'i lha dang ngo bo mnyam/dmigs sa dgra bo'i yul khams de/462

yud kyis sreg pa smos ci dgos/'jig rten khams kyi mi gzugs la/rtsal khyod la che ba yong dwogs med / 'phur na nam mkha'i bya ltar 'phur/'dzul na sa 'og byi ltar 'dzul/ ri brag chu la thogs pa med/mu stegs yongs kyi skyabs mgon 'gyur/las dang skal pa khyod la yod/ gna' mi yongs kyis gtam dpe la/dka' ngal sa thag ma bcad na/re ba'i sa la mi slebs zer/dpyid dus so nam ma byas na/ston dus za ma mi rag zer/ rgyun par lha la ma re na/'uwug 'bod pas mi skyob zer/ —dka' ngal sgrub la ma gzhol na/rdzu 'phrul rtags mtshan rnyed le min/de tsho a mye'i thugs la zhogaskrag dngangs rtags mtshan zhan pa de/ sgrub la gzhol ba'i bar chad yin/da rung slong tshad ci byang yang /rtag par ma 'dzin rngong sar zhoga.u tshags sngar nga6nonadeskom la dril/463

rje ring nga 'phrad thog ma yin/ lha yi lung don dang po yin/de nas rim pas lung bstan dang /mthar thug lha yi ngo bo mnyam/'jig rten mnga' dbang bsgyur bas chogagatam 'di brjed med yid la zung /yid 'thad pa 'dra na sgrub la 'bungs /min na thugs byor ci 'thad gyis/'es ma yin yin mdog gi glu de ltar gnang nga/be ༄ na mye kho bdud lha'i lung yin bsams shing dad gus spro ba tshad med pa byang /1rngordo1jo rā:rto zu ga 1therdo/re//re: 'jug zir yang skabs ma ma gyas na bsgrubs pa' dasa' rang lha yin min the ma tshom du 'dug lha yin na ngan sngags 'phrul 'khor dang / mu stegs phyi rgyud shan 'byed sogs gang zab bdag la bstan par mdzod ces zer bas mgon po nag pos mu r+sha tsas phyi rgyud kyi ngag sngags shan 'byed phung 'khor dang 'phrul 'khor rgyud ji lta ba bkrol nas gsungs pas kho mngon par yi rangs nas dam bca' phul zhing sngar ltar sgrub pa la 'bungs so/ de tshe rgyal mchog ge sar nas bla g.yag nyul ba dang rgyal po'i sku 'khor 'brong g.yag dar ma bcu gsum nyin re de'i phyogs la 'byong khyu dum gcig la brdzus nas rtswa za chu 'thu nga ltar yan du yod pa na/ bla 'brong kham pa ru rgyas de yis 'brong du ma mthong nas dga' ba skyes te mi 'jigs pa'i ngar sgra 'byin bzhin ra brdar dang rnga ma phyar nas tshur byang ba dang / rgyal mchog ge sar nas phyag mda' zhig ya thod ba/zhi rādor 464

springs nas der thul ba dang / a mye yang grib lta bus nag thom me yud tsam brgyal du song / de nas lha mi bka' gros la bdud kyi a mye de glo bur mes sreg dgos pa la dgra bla wer mas tsan dan gyi shing phung til mar sogs mkho chas bsags rgyu dang grwa 'bangs kyis ma mthong sngon a mye 'dul rgyu bka' gros mthun/ de nas a mye'i chung ma nyul byed ma go bo nag po zhig yod pa brag la tshang bcas bya ra byed bzhin yod pa de la skyes bu khong gis nyi zla'i 'phrul zhags btab pas snyi la thebs pa dang shugs rtsalam gyis 'then te mi dmar gshin rje'i zhal ras la/ dmar nag khrag 4gi spyan rtsa g.yos/ shin tu rngam pa'i so sgra 'khrol bzhin par bya go bo'i gshog pa nas phyag gis bzang ste sdig mo mdzad pa'i mgulaskru 'di ltar bstsaloto/ ma ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ — glu a la tha la tha la re da/ tha la la mo la la red/ la la ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/ bde chen lte yi zhing kham sa nas/ dkon mchog rgyal ba rgya mtsho la/ gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes bstuglogs /sa 'di nag shod bdud kyi yul/ mu stegs a mye'i pha mkhar red/ nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na/ rma khams gling yulakhra mo nas/bu lha sras jo ru ge sar zer/465

ge ge dgra la lang mi yin/sar ni dpa' sar 'gran zla med/skyes bu lha yi rnam 'phrul yin/ sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzugs mi yin/ a/ mye'i srog shing shan pa yin/ chung ma bdud mo nyul byed ma/phyi sob go bo'i bya thul can/nang don so srung bya ra mo/khas len mkhan gyi chung ma khyod/de ring dgra bo'i lag la tshud/gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la/ko long can gyi mig de long /som nyi can la lhas mi skyob/re ba can gyis don mi 'grub/dwogs pa can la mi dge mang /zer yang zer la bden yang bden/de snga lo dgu'i tshun chad du/nyin gsum mi g.yel bya ra byas/mtshan gsum mi g.yel so pa byas/re ba bdud kyi bstan pa de/a sngon dgung las e mtho bsam/mchod bla a mye e yong bsam/dogs pa ge sar nga la byas/466

phyi nang bar gsum srung ba bzhag gal dus so phas ma mthong zi/dngos yod thams cad cham la phab/yang sgos chung ma nyul byed ma/ge sar nga yi sgos dgra khyod/ bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bo khyod/da res dgra bo bzung lugs la/gling rje'i bsam pa 'grub lugs la/gri chung shel gri yu dkar 'di/'jam dbyangs dmar po'i phyag mtshan yin/ sor tshad thung ste rno kha tsha/de ring go bo gson bsha' byed/sha dmar rgyun len dre rgyu yin/— rnam shes mar me yal rgyu yin/ge sar nga la dge sems med/go bo bsad na dpa' rtags mtho/shi khar 'tshe na 'gan len gyis/glu go narna ba'i bdud rtsi la/ma go glu la 'bras bu med/ so srung go bo'i yid la zhogaces glu de ltar gnang nas gri3rtsong shel gri yu dkar shubs nas phyang ste gsod grabs mdzad pa 'i tshulagyis go bo'i ske nas dam du badh+ring ba dang nyul byed mos a mye'i nor mdzod kyi lde mig nyi shu 467

phul nas skyabs zhus/ rgyal mchog ge sar rin po ches skyabs 'gro'i sdom lung gnang nas sgyu 'phrul gyi bkod pa du ma bstan pas mo mngon par dad nas khas blang4dam bcas slad sangs kyi bstan pa srung bar dam la gnas so/ de nas dgra bla gnyan stag dang gnyan chen sku lha ge sar bcas khong rnam gsum gyi sprul pa seng ge dkar mo gsum gar byang med par sgo srung stag mo'i thog ngar sgra sa g.yo ba bzhin byas pa dong lhan mchongs pa dang seng ge dang stag mo ‘sder 'dzing byas nas stag mo bsubs pa dang / gu lang gi sprul pa stag mo de 'chi la nye ba'i tsha gzer dang skrag dngangs tshad med myangs pas sprul pa bsdus te rlung ltar rang gnas su song / de nas rgyal mchog mi yi nor bu/ lha klu gnyan gyi thugs sras/ 'gro ba 'dren pa'i ded dpon khong phyi nas mjal na 'khor gsum dgra dar tshubs se/ rmog dkar dar 'phru tshubs se/ khrag dkar 'od mdangs lhang se/ rta pho 'gro 'dod shar re nang don sangs rgyas dgongs pa yengs med stong gsal wa le/ kun tu bzang po'i dgongs pa mngon du gyur gyur nas 'khor dgra bla wer ma chos skyong rgya mtsho kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa bzhin skyes bu dang mnyam du phebs rtsis kyis sta chen brag ri hab gshog de lan gsum brag sgor bsnun pas sgo wang gis bye nas skyes bu mi rta gnyis dang / 'khor tshogs bcas nang du thogs med byon nas a mye'i mdun thad du phebs pa dang brag sgo phyes pa'i 'ur sgra chen po a myes thos rung lha'i lung ltar snang ba bsgyur te gnas so/ de nas skyes bu khong gis dgongs pa la dad pas grol bar ma gyur kyang bden 'bras zhig ma bshad na 468

rang dgar mer bsregs pas mi 'thus dgongarme nas skyes bu ge sar khong gis sku la rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha thams cad ril gyi sgang bu kha phyes pa bzhin rdzogs pa zhig bstan pa na a mye mig btsums nas yod pas dgra bla wer ma rnams kyis mer sreg rtsis kyi gra sgrig tshar zhing mi tshor bar srung zhing yod pa dang rgyal mchog khong gis a mye'i ya thod la mtheb kor gyis gag kug lan gsum mdzad nas ya 'o na a mye sgom chen lags/ rgyud byang chub sems la ma sbyangs na/dgra gnyen can chags sdang sgom tshul de/ sangs mi rgya dka' tsheg che rogs red/ 'on kyang nga yi glu 'di nyon dang 'dra ma zhig yod ang gsungs nas dgra lha'i dpa' thung la drangs pa'i mgul glu 'di ltar bzhengs par gda' 'o/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me rgyurto glu a la dkon mchog 'bod glu red/ tha la rtsa gsum rgyud skul glu/la la rang sems༄ngas rgyas dang /'khrul med dgag med glu zhig len/ blangs pa don dang ldan par shogs 'di nag shod bdud kyi yul/mu stegs bla mchod pho brang nang /a myes khyod kyi sku mkhar red /nga 'dra nga ngo o shes 'dugang 'dra nga ngo ma shes na/ steng lha nas bu thod dkarayo zer/469

tshangs pa lha yi sras po yin/ —dus gsurma sangs rgyas bka' gros nas/nag phyogs bdud kyi kha gnon la/gshed ma lha nas bskol le yin/bar ma rma khams gling yul la/gling smug po'i gdung la 'khrungs le yin/jo jo dgra la jo le yin/ru ru dgra la ru le yin/bdud che phra yongs kyi gnya' gnon yin/gleng gleng gtam gyi rdo ga de/a mye'i mdun la slebs le yin/bser bu rlung dang jo ru gnyis/so dang dgag mas ci la khoga'abyung ba lnga la rang dbang thob/sgrim med mngon shes thogs pa med/byang chub sems dpa'i lam bzung nas/'bras bu sangs rgyas dgongs ya mnga'/de tsho babs kyi 'dra ma yin/de nas nyon dang sgom tshul mkhan/mu stegs a mye glu la nyon/'gro drug sems can 'di dag ni/pha ma ma byas gcig kyang med/'khor ba 'di la skye zhing 'khor/470

thams cad bde ba 'dod pa la/ —sdug bsngal las bsags shugs kyis 'khor/rtsa ba rang khe gzhan pham rkyen/dug lnga grokharabacad rgyu las rkyen/rang bsags las sgrib grib ma bzhin/ rang dang 'azal ba med pas na/khyod 'dra'i sgom tshul dka' tshegs de/'gro kun mi bde sdug bsngal gzhi /sems can che phra chung gsum rnams/srog la ga cesab 'dra 'dra yin/bde ba 'dod pa de bzhin gcigargyu rkyen byung tshul ma shes pa/'jig rten mu stegs lha la dad/ gu lang dbang phyug sgrub cing brtson/sems can bsad nas gi khrag mchod/phrag dog 'gran sems khong du bcugadakar phyogs sangs rgyas bstan pa dang / gling dkar bstan la 'tshe bas ma ste/sgrub pa'i re don smin le min/min don rtsa ba bshad pas na/ skyabs gnas rnam gsum pha ma byas/bka' gsung nyam med snying la bzhaga'agro drug sems can bu rgyud byas/471

rang bas gzhan gces las don sgrub/thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa yi/go 'phang thob pa'i bden pa brda re/nang pa sangs rgyas bstan la btsud/ las dang rgyu 'bras dkar nag phye/ rdzong gter skye 'gro'i donal phag zhib na rang don spu tsam med/— nges don rgya la ba'i gsung bzang yin/khyod kyis 'jig brten lha sgrub pa/tshe 'dir longs spyod snyan grags dang / mthu che ngan 'phrul thob bya'i phyir/ mi lo mang la dka' tshegs byed/ tshe 'dir 'bras bu cung thob kyang / phyi ma 'brel tshad dmyal bar 'khrid/ — de bden du e mthong zhib zlos dpyod / da res khyod dang nga rang gnyis/ sger gyi rtsod gleng til tsam med/rig pa'i lha dang ma rig bdud/lha bdud gnyis kyi cha las grub/ nga rig pa ye shes sangs rgyas sku/ ngas rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha/ rang zhal mjal ba'i brda rtags su/rtsa gsum zhing dang mkha' 'gro lha/ 472

til gyi sgang bu kha bye bzhin/ bkrag mdangs 'od zer shig se shig—'a di gzhan las ma btsal rang las rnyed/rang nyid sangs rgyas ltaḥdagongs gces/'gro la byams dang snying rje byed/dkon mchog gsum la skyabs gsol thob/ 4nga ge sar rtsa ba'i bla mar sgoms/ 'dun pa'i lam la snyeg shes na/ bde chen sa lam bskyal bsa'ichogatshig bden pa'i glu la zhib dpyad gyis/mig sdang mig bsgrad pas phan go chung /nga ge sar lha rgyu lhun gyis grub/ nga rgyul 'phrul gyi me phung de/byams dang snying rje'i chu yis gsod/khol ril ril brel bas phan pa med/nga ge sar gshin rje slebs nas yod/'bros dbang med pa'i dus mtshams 'dir/bsam blo bzhi gsum bcu gnyis thong /blo rtse nyi shu rtsa lnga khod/bde ba 'dod nadad 'dun gyis/min na de ring thar bsam med/lha bdud dbyegasabye ran yin/bye nas gson sreg byed rgyuyin/473

nyes sgrib khur po sbyang rgyu yin/dus yag nyes lam la dkar nag med/tshig 'gyur med bden pa'i drang gtam yin/glu go na a la ya lan gyis/ma go glu la 'bras bu med/ a myes yid la de ltar zhog ces glu de ltar bzhengs pa na/ khos mig sdang mig lta bzhin mig nas me yi tsha tsha 'phro bzhin gu lang gi gzugs su brdzus nas bsam pa la/ a tsi jo ru 'di 'phrul che ba la sus kyang bkag ma thub pa 'dir 'byor bas ma tshad 'khor g.yog kyang 'di tsam 'dugadapung gis 'thab kyang mi thub/ de bas mthu rtsal gyis bsgral e thub re nas/ dad 'dun med pa'i khar zhe sdang nga rgyal drag pos skyes bu khong gi gsung mgul glu len mjug rdzogs ma thag mu stegs nag po'i thun rdzas me 'bar de khos rdeg rtsis kyis lag tu bzung nas na re khyod jo ru zer ba'i ming g.yer can/ e 'phrad re ba byas le de/ gu lang lha yis bkug le red/ brkug nas bu dang 'phrad dus 'dir/ tshig gsum bden 'bras e 'dra yod pas nyon yang zer nas glu 'di ltar blangs par gda' 'o/glu a tri pa tri du tri zhing / zhang zhung bon gyi len lugs red/mtho ba gnam gyi dbyings shed na/ dbugs rlangs na bun 'thul sa nas/ drag po'i thog rlung 'tshub sa nas/474

gu lang dbang phyug bdud kyi lha/srog gcod 'khor tshogs bye ba 'bum/glog dmar bzhin du chos la shogadagra mtha' chod la dpung rogs mdzod/sa 'di tsho a mye'i mkhar rdzong red/mi nga 'dra a mye 'bum thub yin/mu stegs nag po'i bla gnas yin/kun gyis bkur ba'i bla ma yin/gu lang lha dang dbyer med yin/nag po bdud kyi rten phur yin/'chi med lcags srog thob pa'i bu/shi ba slong ba'i sman dpyad yod/gur dkar gur ser gur nag dpon/zhang zhung khri brtan klu btsan dpon/shing khri g.yu rtse sa tham rgyal/stag gzig rgyal dang kha che rgyal/bdud rgyal khab yongs kyi bla gnas yin/re ltos skyabs gnas zhu sa yin/pho nga yi gong la su zhig yod/de nas ma ngan jo ru bu/chos dkar po am de ci la zer/thams cad phung ba'i phung 'dre la/dad pa'i 'dun pa ci la 'jog 475

khyod skyes nas nyi ma da bar du/thog thog rgyal dang thog lha ring /stobs ldan zi rgyal a bu sman/'gran gyis mi thub rgyal phran mang /dngos yod dngos med du ma'i dpung /chag mal med pa bzos pa de/bya ba nyes chen khyod rang yin/rang bas gzhan gces ci go red/srog la gces dmar 'dra 'dra yin/da rung khyod la dad dgos zer/thams cad phung ba'i dgra bo la/dad 'dun zer ba snying khams 'khrugasnying dkyil dran pa 'gre ldog byed/sgyu ma 'phrul gyi lha gzugs 'a di/'phrul khyod la yod na nga la yod/rtsal khyod kyis phyung na ngas kyang phyung /srid pa dar nas lha bdud dar/so so'i rang chus rang gi bzung /sdod bde byas na kun kyang skyid/le lan rtsa ba khyod la thug chab chu mgo gting nas ma dkrug na/klu gdol pa'i khon 'gras yong don med/klu gdol par khon 'gras ma shor na/476

lus 'dom gang mdze yis zin don med/mgron sprang po'i sgo rdung ma byas na/khyi rda lis nya nas 'ju don med/rda lis nya nas ma 'jus na/lus 'byung gzhi na chos mnar don med/khyod byu rus bdud la ma dgra na/bdud nag pos 'tshe ba byed don med/4 bdud yongs kyi 'tshe ba ma byas na/tshe 'di la mi dge 'byang don med/don de la dpyad nas go ba long /tshe 'di la mthu rtsal ma che na/phyi ma zer ba ci go red/gdos bcas lus 'di bya khyis za/sems la lus gzhi grub don med/mi yi rtsa ba mi la grub/shing smyug ma shug par 'gyur dogs med/'bras sa lu nas la 'gyur rgyu med/rdo pha wang sa la yong mi srid/mi srid srid pa'i rdzun gtam la/bden pa a myes mi mthong 'dugagatam yang bshad rna ba tsha rogs red/khyod srog la gces na phar phar song /min tshe nga la rgol 'dod na/

mu stegs nag po'i thun rdzas 'di/gnam lcags thog dang ci mi 'dra/btab na ri brag thal bar bzo/khyod lus dum bur ma btang na/thun rdzas zer ba a dgos chung /da rung mi lpags g.yab mo yod/g.yab na skye 'gro'i bla tshe bsdu/da rung bsha' gri ngar ma yod/ g.yug na ri brag dum bur gcod/sdug khyod cag tsam la a'u tsi/ da ma 'dug la mo rang gnas song /rngam na a mye mi khro re/ lag len gser thigs mi byed re/dgra jo rus bsam blo thongs dang dga'/glu go don yid la de ltar zhogaces glu de ltar blangs nas phar tsam e 'bros re nas stod langs kyi sdang ltas rngam rngam byas byang ba na/ ge sar gyi zhal nas/he he/ nga thag ring nas khyod kyi༄ don la 'ong ba yin pas nga phyir log tu 'gro ba mi srid/ byams dang snying rje med na drag sngags kyis bgegs mi thul/ skyabs 'gro dang tshad med bzhi'i sems bskyed med na 'khor ba'i mtsho las mi sgrol/ sku gsum mngon du ma 'gyur na 'gro ba'i don mi nus/ dug lnga yi shes lngar ma smin na rang gzhan 'tshang mi rgya/ khyod kyi a 'thas ther gzugs kyi gu lang 478

lha'i gsal snang lhang rje med pa'i rmod pa'i thun rdzas la nga ya mi nga /stong gsal ting nge 'dzin ye shes kyi lus po g.yab mos mi khug la gris kyang mi chod/ mtshon la ya mi nga gsungs pas/ kho lhag par khros nas thun btab pa na me lce'i zer ra thar re byang yang ge sar khong stong gsal ting nge 'dzin rdo rje'i lus su smi( pa la cis kyang gnod ma nus/ de nas g.yab mo lan gsum btab rung rlung 'tshub g.yo ba tsam las ci ma thub/ bsgral gri 'a/na gsum g.yug byung yang 'ja' la btab pa ltar song zhing / lha klu gnyan dang bstan srung rnams phyi rol du phyi chad cung zad byed dgos pa byung yang / khos ge sar ma thub pa shes nas/la mo 'phrul gyi rnga la bzhon nas bros rtsis byas pa dang lhan ge sar rgyal mchog 0rin po ches de ma thag a mye'i mgul pa nas bsdus te sar mnan nas zhags pas gru gu bzhin du bsdams/ mi 'chor ba srung 'khor gyis rgyas btab nas thugs snying rje khros pa'i sku ru bzhengs nas mgul glu 'di ltar gsungs so/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me ྅ཿglu a la tha la tha la red/tha la la mo la la red/bde chen dag pa'i zhing khams nas/chos longs sprul gsum thod phreng rtsal/gu ru mtshun brgyad yang sprul sogs/gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes gzigs/byas tshad chos su 'gro bar shog 479

'phags pa rigs gsum mgon po'i tshogs/dbyings bzhugs rtsa gsum lha tshogs la/gsol 'debs byin rlabs ma chung zhig bdud lha dag pa'i zhing la drongs/sa 'di dang nga 'dra'i lo rgyus de/a mye khyod kyi yid la gsal/ de ring khyod dang nga rang gnyis/lha bdud bar gyi smon lam dang /'gro drug sems can kun gyi don/phan gnod bar gyi bden tshig 'bras/dgra gshed las kyis grub le red/grub nas lag len dus skabs red/a mye'i mthu dang zha nye'i mdung /dgra la btsugs na rtse mo guga.a mye'i sgom dang byis pa'i mkhar/yun du mi brtan ming nas 'gyel/ a mye'i lha dang nam mkha'i 'ja'/dgos nges skyabs na stong par yal/a mye'i stobs dang thal grang me/mthong ma thag tu thal bar 'gyur/ a mye'i dpa' gtam g.yu 'brug sgra/nyan yag byas na lag len stong /de snga bsgrubs bsgrubs bya ba de/480

rang mthu rang gi ltag par babs/khyod la gus bkur sri zhu mkhan/mu stegs 'jang pa nag po dang /hor yan thub 'chi gsos sman pa gnyis/zi shang 'phrul gyi bla ma gsum/zhang zhung ka ra king mgo bzhi/stag yan ngan sngags sgom pa lnga/khyod la dad pa'i slob 'bangs byas/mtha' ma a myes srog dmar bcad/skyabs gnas zhus na de mtshungs red/lha gu lang sgrub la btson rgyu de/dgos nges rtags dang nus mthu med/dgra thog tu byang dus 'ja' ltar yal/) re ltos yid zlog chad sa red/nyes mid sems can bsad bsad nas/sha khrag mchod pa'i 'bras bu med/sdig lhung rnam smin khur po lci/rang bsags rang la smin nges yin/smin pa'i mgo mo tshugs le yin/nag phyogs bdud kyi kha gnon la/gong ma lha yi btang le yin/nga 'gro khas len byas le yin/rgyal kun mthun sbyor byin rlabs mdzad/481

chung ma las skyes nas dpa' rtsal dang /stobs shugs rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med/'dzam gling mnga' dbang bsgyur nges la/hor bdud 'jang mon bdud kyi rigs/rkang 'og thal bar mi brtsi 'o/chus bstan rlung la bskur rgyu yin/khyod rkang drug 'bu la mi brtsi 'o dgos nges bslab bya ma nyan nas/rang sdug rang gis nyos pa'i bu/gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la/go ba med pa'i bu chung la/'jam pa'i tshig gis ngo bsu las/thal lcag dbyag pas bcos na dga'/shes med bu rmi dred ma la/drin chen pha ma'i kha dwa las/mi yul nyams myong mthong na dga'/chos lad dpon lad sprang lad la/blo nye'i bslab bya byas pa bas/myang myoje lan gcig mthong na dga'/zer yang zer la bden yang bden/bden pa'i lag len byed rgyu yin/las 'bras mngon sum 'don rgyu yin/sro ma ra tsa'i thag pa 'dis/482

gru gu bzhin du bsdams nas zhogablo ngag 'phrul nyes sgrib byang bar shogatil mar snum gyis brlan pa yi/ras/ bal mgo 'jug med pabadakris/las bsags sdig lhung byang nas kyang /bdud lus lha ru 'gyur ba shogade la ye shes mosbar bas/dug lnga'i tshang shing bsregs nas kyang /sku lnga'i 'bras bu thob par shogathal ba chu la bskur byed pa/bdud bstan mgo bo ma mtho zhigakhro bo khro mo ye shes tshos/skyes bu nga yi mgon skyob mdzod/dad na dga' ba'i zhing la 'dren/sdang na las bsags rnam smin gyis/dmyal ba'i gnas su ma 'grim par/gdod bcas lus la smin par shog las sgrib khur po byang nas kyang /ma 'ong 'gro la phan byed shogakhyod a mye'i yid la de ltar zhogaces glu de ltar gsungs pa dang / dgra lha wer ma'i tshogs kyis ge sar gyi bka' bzhin yan lag dam du bsdams/ lus snum ras kyis dkris nas sgrub phug de yi yang sbug mun dong du bcug ste 483

3nga brtsegs/ de la ge sar khong gis smon lam bden tshig dang sbra gas ye shes kyi me sbar nas/ dud pa 'thul med ngang sgrub sgo rdo zhun gyi/sbyar/ nang du mu stegs a mye a tsha a na'i 'bod sgra di ri'i ngang yod pa bsregs nas btul/ der a mye'i mkho rdzas sgam dang rgyu nor khyad 'phags 'jig rten na mkho ba mes tshig 'phro rnams lha srung gis phyi rol du drangs/ gling rje mi yi nyi ma khong sprul pa'i lcag khra brgya rtsa brgyad dang dgra bla wer ma'i sprul pa khra glag du mas gra 'bangs brgya phug ron brgyar brdzus nas yod pa de dag 'jum rtsal gyis bcum pa na/ gra 'bangs bdun bser rlung la brdzus nas zhang zhung du shor/ gra 'bangs gzhan rnams la sku re bstan nas bden 'bras kyi gsung glu'i chos char phab nas thams bcad 'dun pa la 'kho bas mtshams sbyar nas sa spyod sham bha lar bde bar bkod/ de nas dgra mtha' rtsad nas chod cing de nub brag phug tu lha 'dre 'khor dang bcas pa 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs la rol nas thugs sems bde bar bzhugs/ de yi phyi nang rma rgyal gyis gdan zhu dang bcas dgra lha sman mo'i 'khor tshogs dang bcas pa rma rgyal gyi pho brang du phebs/ zhag gsum ring 'khor lo sdom pa'i dbang dang chos char bzang po phab/ lha klu 'khor dang rgyal blon sde bzhi bran du 'khol ba'i rang rtags su lha tshangs pa dang brgya byin/rgya'/ chen sde bzhi sogs 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyis gtsug tu bkur ba'i mthus/ 'jig rten sa gzhi 'gul ba'i ngang shar phyogs nam mkha'i mthongs nas lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad 'od zer dpag tshad brgya phrag 'phro ba zhig 'khyil li li 'khor bzhin 484

pa je dma' je dmar song nas sku rje la lan dgu bskor rjes saser sga nyi ma rang shar gyi snga ru'i rgyan la bab/ bar snang nas rol cho/'i rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgra byang ba'i ngang la/ nag phyogs bdud kyi gnya' gnon lcags kyi 'kher los bsgyur rgyal/ 'dzam bu gling gi ya bdag ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul/ rgyal po chen po a la la ho zhes bar snang phyogs kun nas sgra chen po gsal la dag nga / zhig byang ngo / de las rten 'brel gyi bar pa/ 'dzam bu gling la mngarlo dbang bsgyur ba/ 'jig rten 'di na stobs rtsal che ba/snyan pa'i grags pa sa gsum du khyab pa/ pha rol mi mthun pa'i phyogs kun las rnam par rgyal ba/ lcags kyi 'khor los bsgyur rgyal yongs su khyab pa rgyal po chen po'i mtshan ge sar 'phrul gyi rgyal po zhes yongs grags de ltar byang ngo / phyis rgyal po chen po'i rnam thar la'ang 'chad pa po'i rtsa༄ khams dwangs min dang theg pa mtho dman rang rgyud snod la dpag pa/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi mdzad pa/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rnam thar du ma 'byang ba la yid ches dad 'dun gzab pa gal che/ de narme rma rgyazlo gyis gser gyi mo khrab cha tshang / gzi mchong mu tig gi mgul phreng / gzi yi bum pa lha yi bdud rtsis bkang ba/ phra men rin chen gyi zhal dkar seng ge dkar mo'i 'o mas gtams pa/ slob dpon pad+ma'i sku tshab bse yi ga'u'i nang bcug pa zhig phul zhing smon lam dang bcas bstan pa srung bar khas blangs shing gsung gleng zhib rgyas mdzad/ ma lha dang zhang lha rnams dam tshigs gtsang zhing 'bral med de ltar byang / de nas zhag lnga song ba'i nyin skya rengs ༄byi 485

shar ba dang lhan du 'tsho zas la longs spyad nas dgra lha'i 'khor gyis bslor nas nag shod chung ma nyul ma'i rtsar phebs nas kha seng phul ba'i lde mig gis nor mdzod nyi shu tham pa'i sgo phyes shig gsungs pas mos de ma thag rgyan chas bzang pos spras pa'i bud med bzang po'i rnam 'gyur bstan cing lag gi dri ma chus bkrus nas brag ri de'i rtsa ba/ gra 'bangs 'du ri'i g.ya nga phu ga gi sgo rdo'i gton bus brdungs pas sgo wang gis bye ba de'i nang chu shel nor bu'i 'od kyis gsal ba shel gyi khang pa'i nang rno skug sogs kyi sgam rigs mi 'dra ba yod pa rnams kha phye nas dngos nor gyi ming dang lo rgyus che 'don gyi glu 'di ltar phul bar gda' 'o/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu 'u na a lu tha lu red/de tsho glu yi len lugs red/sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang /lha sras khyod la gsol ba 'debs/'bral med thugs kyis yang yang gzigs/ nga 'dra nyul byed nag mo zer/zhong zhung shing ha'i yul grong na/pha ni lha 'dre ma rigs mi/dngos yod dngos med ci yang nus/mu stegs bla ma'i chung ma byas/nag phyogs yongs la mnga' yang bsgyur/da bar ma byas ci kyang med/486

nang pa'i chos la sdang lta byas/khyed jo ru zer dus zhe btsog bltas/sngar byas las la bshags pa byed/phyin chad dam bca' sngon bzhin byed/khyed 'jal ba tsam gyis sems yid spro/sku sgyu 'phrul bstan pas yid dbang 'du/gsung chos zab gnang bas bdag rgyud smin/ rje khyed 'dra 'jig rten khams na dkon/nga dad pas skyabs su snying nas mchis/de nas 'gran med stobs kyi rgyal/'di phyi'i skyabs mgon rin po che/mu stegs a mye'i rgyu nor 'di/rin dang gong thang brtsi rgyu med/rdo smug grub pa'i sgam chen dgu/gser gyi rang 'thag ra 'khor yod/dus rgyun gser phye thu lu lu/ sa bdag the se'i snying nor red/gser bum gser rnga gser lder dang /mkho dgu gser la grub pa yodardo sgam khra bo che gsum nang /se mo do dang be+eḍūr+ya/iṇ+ḍa ni la mar gad dang /rin po che yi mgul phreng zhags/487

gu lang lha yis bstsal le red/sgam 'di byur bur gang ba yod/gzi mchong khra men bse ga dang /lha 'dre'i snying nor sgam gsum yod/rdo dmar grub pa'i sgam gsum yod/gshen mu stegs ston pa'i thod pa la/ nyin mo dud pa thu lu lu/mtshan mo me 'bar lhabs se lhab/ci 'dod gsol btab 'dod dgu 'byung /mu stegs bla ma'i 'phrul zhags yod/'phangs na nyi zla zin pas zer/g.yug na tshe nor 'gugs pas zer/hor gyi rgyal po'i pha nor la/nor bu dkarā nag khra gsum yod/de the'u rangs dkar nag khra gsum gyi/bla rdo nor bu yin pas zer/lha 'dre'i gnod 'tshe mi 'byung zer/lus bcangs ci bsam 'phrul yang ldan/me chu'i 'phrang la thogs pa med/'jang gi nor bu dmar ser yod/gsol btab 'bru drug 'byung bas zer/bden nges 'bru sran sna lnga de/rang byung 'char bzhin 'beb pa yod/488

da rung nor bu du ma yod/rgyu dang 'byung khungs ma rtogs kyang /dngos grub ya mtshan chen po gda'/la la gser lder nang bzhag dus/gser phye mer gyis gang ba 'dugadangul sgam nang la bcug pa'i dus/dngul phye mer gyis gang ba gda'/chab chu la reg na 'o mar 'gyur/bang mdzod nang la bcug pa'i dus/mi 'dzad slar yang 'phel ba gda'/la la tshe la phan yong zer/la la nor phyag 'phel yong zer/bzang po rgyon gsum tshogs pa yi/dngos grub sna tshogs yod pas zer/rgyal po chen pos zhib dpyod mdzod/khro las grub pa'i sgam gsum nang /ral gri go mtshon du ma 'dugasgam dkar po gos kyi bye brag red/'dzad med dri rdul mi gos zer/'di lo dri mas cung zhig gos/bye brag sne grangs brgya phrag yod/sgam gcig mu tig 'phrul gyi rgyud/ngan sngags me yi phreng ba dang /489

las byed 'phral gyi po ti yod/gu lang lha yi r+sha rten yod/ ma zad 'chi gsos sman sbyor yod/sgrub khang nang la dam rdzas mang /nor rigs brgya dang rtsa brgyad yod/de ring 'phrul rgyal khyed la 'bul/nyar tshag 'khor g.yog rnams kyis gyis/da rung lcags kyi sgam nang na/gzim med mar me bco brgyad gda'/mar me re re'i rtsa ba na/sgo nga nag po the bong tsam/'od dang thig le nag po'i mtshan/lo zlar je cher 'gro ba gda'/bdud kyi bla gnas yin pas zer/zla re mar ngo'i nyer dgu la/ gra 'bangs bla slob 'tshogs pa yis/mi rta'i khrag mchod byed pa dang /mi tshil mar me'i kha gsab dgos/zhag rer bya re sems can rigs/gang rung khrag gi mchod pa dgos/khrag gi ngam chags gshin dri dro/kha sang sngon nas byi dor byas/khyed rgyal po phebs pa'i re 'dun byas/490

de ring rje la spyan gzisas rabul/yag nyes thugs kyis zhib yul dpyod/de nas rgyal po rin po che/nag thod shog chen bco brgyad 'di/a mye'i sger sde yin pas zer/mi rigs bdud yul byang nas chad/sa nag brag nag rlangs pa nags la chags pa'i nag shod zer/sde dud lnga stong bzhi brgya yod/sger gyi nor khag sum cu yod/bdud khal kham pa ru ring yod/klu zog sngon mo dung rwa can/mtsho glang dmar ser gser rna can/mdzo mo chig stong yar lhag yo/da/zi ma'i rta yi snying nor mang /spu mdog dung la gshis le la/ g.yu yi ze rngog sa la 'khyil/ mgyogs pa rlung gi bang dang rtse/a bse rgu 'grus rlung gshog zer/zi ma rgyal gyis phul ba'i nor/rta rigs stong dang yar lhag yod/klu lug gser nya'i rnga ma can/lug rigs brgya la yar nye yod/191

bdud lug nag po ra bzhi can/rigs rgyud stong la zin pa yod/sog lug dkar po rnga leb can/lug rigs stong dang sum brgya lhagali bal lug dang bod kyi lugarigs rgyud khri la zin lhag tsam/de tsho nor rdzas dpag med rnams/mi dbang rgyal po che la 'bul/sde dud yongs kyi mgo 'doms la/a mye'i tsha bo thog khri yod/pho lo brgya la yar lhag red/mu stegs lha dang 'bral med zer/'khor du rigs rgyud bu gsum yod/yang rgyud bu mo nor mtsho ma/gzugs dang kha dog yid 'ong ma/spyod pa nang pa'i chos la dad/rkang bzhi phyags kyi 'khri shing zer/sde dud re rnyis byed sa red/yu'/ thog re la shog dpon re/de 'khor de bab de mtshungs yod/gu lang ma chod nga 'i khral 'jal la/zhag rer sems can ske gcod dang /zla re mi rta'i khras mchod re/492

'tshub 'gyur che na de lhag dgos//de tsho yin lugs 'dra ma red/nga rang bu mo nyul byed ma/grogs med blo 'dri byed sa med/tshe 'dir legs nyes ci mdzad kyang /ge sar min pa skyabs gnas med/chos nang pa min pa blo 'du4na med/ phyis ci mdzad rgyal pos ma dgongs med/glu 'khrul shor bzod par mdzad du gsol/'gran med rin chen thugs la zhogaces glu de ltar phul bas rgyal mchog gi thugs/ dgongs 'a/ rgyu nor longs spyod kyi gzhi ma nor bu'i gter chen po 'dug kyang 'byang khungs bzang ngan 'dres ma 'di ma 'ong pa la phan pa 'byang ngazlo ci/mu stegs kyi rgyud gu lang gi sku rten bdud kyi bla gnas rām/sa cad mer sreg dgos pa ma zad nyul byed nag mo 'di yang da lta dam 'a/ gnas shing skyabs 'gro'i sdom lung phog ge sar bdag dang mang pa la 'dun pa 'dra yang ma 'ongs pa na dam la gnas ri/ma cha ca mchis/ yul khams sogs ci byed lha la blo 'dri byas te ‘sta'i rwa ོ dang bstun dgos dgongs nas rgya' mchog dam pa'i 'a' / dos/ khyod dngos yod dngos med bzhin bzang ma bsam ngarkar 'dun pas rgyu nor phul/ sba gsang med pa'i gtam 'brang babang r+ṣa bas tshe/bon yo nga pas blo bde gyis/ dpa' dar yod nga/ ba༅da ma rdogos/ dngos nor rnams cung zad sgam nang rang mal 'os

ngas 'khor rnams dang gros zhig bya/ khyod bya dga'i bdud rtsi 'di thungs/ gsu nga nas lha yi bdud rtsi thod phor gang gnang bas mo dga' bde tshad med pa'i ngang chang gis myos nas 'gyel zhing gnas so/de yi tshe lha la thugs rgyud bskul bas lha'i khrom tshogs kyi nang nas blo ma ris ston pa'i rdzi bo a/ ne rgod lcam dkar mo des 'di dang 'di byed lung bstan gyi mgul glu 'di ltar gsungs so/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu a la yig ge drug ma yin/tha la lha 'bod khra chung yin/la la tshig gi gcod don red/dkon mchog rnam gsum 'bod glu red/sa 'di tsho nag shod sde dkyil na/brag nag po sbrul nag gyen 'gro 'dra/de mu stegs a mye'i pha mkhar red/da dus lha yi tshogs ra red/nor g.yang gter rdzong len sa red/nga 'dra a ni rgod lcam yin/ma shes blo 'dri byed sa red/ma shes zer ba mi dar te/blo 'dri gros rogs byed pa'i dus//'di byed nam langs nyi shar 'dra/ dpung grogs ra mda' 'ur ba'i dus/bar snang glog gi myur mgyogs can/ 194

'gyur med gser gyi pha wang la/dngos grub rin chen phra tshom spras/gling dkar lha yi rgyan du che/de nas gdong rigs dgra lha'i bu/lo bcu gsum lon nas gser khri mnan/stobs lcags kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal/nang don sangs rgyas rin po che/ge sar nged kyis nyar tshag byed/hor bdud 'jang gsum dbang du 'du/lha yis bskos pa'i blon gsum 'byang /lhan skyes zo dor yin pa'i phyir/ ༄de dus dpa' dar phyag 'phrod byed/'jang gi nor bu dmar ser de/'bru sran sna lnga'i dngos grub yod/da rung nor bu bcu gsum yod/gling dgon khag lha sku'i nang rten 'jogadangos grub yu'/ khams kun la 'byang /khro sgam ral gri go mtshon de/ ༄rgyal khab du ma'i pha ral red/bgo skal ming ldan yongs 'gyed mdzod/sgam dkar gos kyi bye brag de/nang pa gling la 'kho dgos med/sde shog 'go 'dzin 'ga' re la//() 5

che 'don dpa' dar byas na chogathog khri bu rgyud pha dang bzhi/ 'dun pa nang la gtang dka' bas/gnod sbyin yul gyi pha tha la/gtad nas rdzong ba'i go bkon mdzod/dar sna lnga yi gos zong lnga/sgrub khang nang gi g.yu byur rgyan/ci 'dod 'byung ba'i zhal bu dang /'phrul gri thod phur g.yab lpags bcas/nyul byed mo yi rten skal gyis/dpal ldan lha mo'i 'khor g.yog tu/ shākya'i bstan pa ma rdzogs bar/bstan srung phrin las gnyer bcol gyis/da rung sgrub khang nang byung ba'i/gser dngul yo byad grangs las 'das/gnas 'dir dgon bzhengs rten rtsa bsngos/ngan sngags 'phrul dpe ci yod rnams/gling dkar khra mo'i rgyan la che/ma 'ong bod la bzhag pa bzang /nyi ma gnangs kyi snga cha la/'bum pa'i zhal lus gtso byas pa'i/hrag thus rta dmag stong tsho gcigargyal po bsu mar 'byor ran yin/496

'byor nas lhan zhal rgyas rgyu yin/yul khams dge bcu'i khrims la khod/byas rjes bzang po 'grub nges gyis/nye myur dmag sgar gzhis la sdoms/rgyal po lha yi dpung dang bcas/ ar jag gzhis yul phebs dgos yod/lam mkhan nged cag lhan du 'grogs/che nor rin chen g.yang bdun de/nor bu 'dra min re re yod/sprul pa mkha' 'gro'i lam mkhan yod/mi nyag nor bu'i dgon pa nas/sangs rgyas lha sku mnangs su bcad/log lta'i mun dong nang la bcugali gser sangs rgyas stong sku yod/tshe dpag med dang sman lha'i sku/rgyu bzang byin ldan de mtshungs yod/bsher phyin mdo zung pod mang yod/gtsang sar thon la khrus chab gsol/sdis bshags snang gsal khri mchod mdzod/nag shod dgon yul rten skal sprod/da rung mkho dgu bsam las 'das/gling dkar 'gro ba'i rgyan du che/rmu bu mkhar sngon thog gis gum/497

a thod thar pa'i zor sna de/lha lus yin kyang dam tshig nyams/rmug btsan bu yang de mtshungs gnyis/kha sngon lha yi bka' chad gyis/khrag zug dug gzer drag pos 'phos/de gzhan rjes mkho gling la khrid/mtsho bsub rdzong bshig stong la sgyur/bdud sde nag shod sde dang sbrel/mtshams kyi stong sde'i gral la zhogade byas bya ba 'grub le yin/ bya ba las kyi 'go mo de/yang rtse'i thog la slebs le yin/zi ma gnam khri bar ma nas/ de'u chen dpung sgar 'dzoms sa ru/rgyu nor sde 'bangs yongs 'gyed gyis/sdongs grogs lha la gtang rag phul/nga pham khyod rgyal med pa byed/de nas gling dkar gzhis la 'khor/dga' mo chos kyi bya ba byed/skyid mo nang bzang tshang du skyid/de tsho lha sras thugs la zhogaglu 'khrul pa byung na rje la bshags/ngag 'khyal ba byung na bzod par bzhes/498

'gran bral thugs la de ltar zhog ces bka' lung de ltar bstsal bas rgyal mchog rin po che shin tu dgyes nas dgra lha wer ma yong la bdud rtsi chang gi dpa' skyems phul/ rgyal mchog la yang bdud rtsi drangs pas stobs rtsal yon tan rgyas shing shes rab kyi rtsal bye ba sogs rten 'brel bzang po lhun gyis grub/ mu stegs kyi rgyud dang bdud kyi bla gnas thams cad lcags sgam dud pa 'thu9pa med kyi nang du bcug ste sreg blugs mdzad cing / khro bo'i skur bzhengs nas bdud rten me yi tshwa tsha 'phro ba de la bdud lha mthu nyams pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas sta chen gyis phye mar bgos/ klu chen gyis dong rim pa dgu drus nas sbas/ mchod rten gyis mnan nas smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar/gu lang gi mthu nus nyams shing gling la cher 'tshe mi thub pa'i rten 'brel du gyur/ nyul byed ma la rin chen gyi rgyan cha du mas spras shing dar gos kyis klubs/ lha'i rlung g.yab phur pa gri thod bcas lag la bzhag ste dpal ldan lha mo'i 'khor du gnyer bcol mdzad/rgyu nor nyams grib kyis gos pa rnams lha yi khrus dang bsangs dud kyis dag par byas/ sgrub gnas rnams kyang nyams pa sangs te phyis rtsa gsum 'du ba'i gnas su bsgyur/ de yi mthus brag ri de dang yul khams la 'ja' 'od 'khrigs/ me tog si char bab/dri bzang gi dud pas khyab cing yod pa de'i tshe sbra nag ri bo'i nang bcud gshen bon thog khri nag po dang bu che ba yi gshen g.yung drung mchog rab mu stegs 'phrul gyis bon chung tha chung 'phrul gyi lde mig bcas dang / yul dpon dge ba mchog rab/ dbang phyug drag /99

rtsal 'jigs med sogs kyis mthong bas sngar dang mi 'dra ba ci yin bsam pa'i re dogs kyi gnas su gyur yang de nyin ci bya ma byang /nyi ma de yi phyi nangs skya rengs gsal ba'i tshe lha chen tshangs pa'i hūṃl pa mi dkar rta dkar khrab rmog 'khor gsum dkar po grangs mang ba kha ba 'bab 'bab/ gnyan sku lha'i sprul pa mi ser rta ser 'khor gsum ser po grangs mang rtsi shing phyag 'dra/ klu chen gtsug na'i sprul pa mi sngon rta sngon khrab rmog sngode po thang chen la mtsho mo 'khyil 'dra dus gcig ri thang med pa nag shod yul khams dmag gis bkang nas sbra nag ri bo'i pha tha thang chen gzhung dgu'i gzhi dkyil la gur dkar ser sngon gsum sgar gra bsgrigs nas yod pa yul khams kun gyis mthong zhing khyad par gshen bon thog khri nag po rigs rgyud 'khor 'bangs dang bcas pas mthong ba dang snying mi bde ba gzer zug drag pos mnar nas yud tsam thom mer lus/slar rig pa sor chud nas rang gdan thog hor 'dug gis bsdad de bsam tshul gyi glu 'di ltar blangs par gda' 'o/bswo ya cho ya g.yung drung lha/ sgrub mchod bu la kha 'dzin mdzod/a mye ye gshen bon gyi lha/ de ring byas la e gzigs do/ yul kharmos bde zhing skyid par shogs 'di'i lo rgyus kun gyis shes/mu stegs bon gyi sde shog red/nga 'dra thog khri nag po de/500

pho lo brgya la yar lhag yin/a mye bla ma'i rgyal tshab yin/ mu stegs bon gyi srog shing yin/'chi med srog rtsa grub mi yin/nag shod sde 'bangs 'go 'doms yin/mu stegs bon gyi srog mthud pa/srad rgyud che 'bring chung gsum gson/mo dang zag med mnga' mi la/lta mig khog snying nor mtsho gson/nang 'khor yod tshad tshang ma nyon/nyon zer le mi tshad mig gis ltos/'di 'khrul pa red dam mngon sum red/nag shod shog chen sde dkyil la/ mi rta dkar zhing khrab rmog dkar/gcig mtshungs kha ba 'bab 'bab red/sde stod ya gi dmag gis khengs/a tsi dmag gi rngam brjid la/lus khrab dkar g.yo bas ri rab 'gul/'phru dkar dmar lho sprin 'tshub 'tshub red/rta'i mig sgra g.yu 'brug grags grags red/dmag sngon byang rgya mtsho 'khyil 'khyil red/sgar sngon thorno maṇ+ḍal bkod 'dra red/dmag sgab chu bo 'bab 'bab red/5()1

'di lha dmag mi dmag gang gi dmagakhong a mye grags pa che che nas/zhu mjal gdan zhu e yin nam/ hor bdud mi nyag 'jang dang mon/bdud rgyal dpung dmag mi 'dra 'dugakhrab rmog dar 'phru'i brgyan lugs la/stod kyi rgya gar chos dmag gcigabar gyi sku rgyal bod dmag gnyis/rma khams khra mo'i gling dmag gsum/de gsum cha lugs e mtshungs do/ma tshad kha sa nyi ma la/yul khams sngar dus mi 'dra ba/bla ma'i sgrub gnas ri rtse la/snga dus mi 'dra'i 'ja' tshon shar/gshin dri yal nas sman dri bro/khrag char chad nas me tog 'bab/mthong thos med pa'i rtags shig byang /bon thog khri blo sems mi bde ang༄ /bu gsum po rta la sga chas sprod/mu stegs bla ma'i sku mdun 'gro/ci gsung thugs blo 'dri bar 'gro/yul dpon dge ba mchog rab dang /grogs dpon dbang phyag drag rtsal gnyis/50 2 ༄

de bar yun tsam gzhis sgar zung /mgyogs pa chu tshod bskor nas 'ongs/'dir tshogs blo sems bde bar gyis/gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la/pho rab pho 'bring pho mtha' gsum/pho rab blo gsal nyi ma shar/don gal la thug dus gling bzhi skor/nyes pa'i mun pa mtha' nas sel/blo spobs pa mi chung mtha' rgya che/pho 'bring nam mkha' yar lang 'dra/don yag nyes mtshams nas blo kha skor/legs nyes bar nas bden mtha' 'bud/chags bzhag dpyad mtha' ngang gis 'grub/pho mtha' ma'i blo de rlung 'tshub 'dra/las gcig mgo bzung tshe gcig rjes nod/chags gcig la mi 'pher rgya sde khrel/don 'u la thug dus blo mun rub/ las de 'dra ba de a dgos chung /'gro zer na rlung dmar 'tshub la ltos/pho dgag ma byung yang ya nga med /me phung 'bar kyang dkyil nas gshogargya mtsho red kyang gting nas dkrugadapung 'thab ya byung na thal bar brlag503

lus la srung ba'i 'khor lo 'dogs/thun rdzas g.yab phur mtshon cha khyer/bu nga phyir rjes la rim rim shogadon ci dgos rim gyis dpyad pas choganang 'khor tshogs yid la de ltar zhogaces glu de ltar blangs nas mgyogs brem 'ur 'ur gyis gong ltar thon rtsis byas pa na/ sras mo nor mtsho des yab ye gshen g.yung drung mchog rab kyis gtsos mye bo khu bo rnams la dar btang /lo chang sum gtams shig drangs nas na re/ pha dang a mye khu bo gsum/ 'jig rten 'di na bka' drin che/ las yag nyes mtheb kyi gang mtshams la/ brel ril ril ma mdzad thugs blo skor/nga bu mo'i nyams rtog e 'dra yod zer nas tshe glu'i ngag la drangs nas glu 'di ltar blangs so/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu a lu dga' lu tha lu mu/la lu tshe glu 'gyur med red/a lu drin chen pha lu la/dga' lu tshe la 'dzoms par shogamu lu skyid la 'khod par shog sa 'di byang yan sde shog gi/ sbra nag smug po'i nang bcud la/pha ma longs spyod 'dzoms sa red/'dzoms pa de ring dus skabs red/504

nga 'dra nga ngo los mkhyen red/re lu sbra yi me tog yin/mtho dman yongs kyi gces phrag yin/ ༄de snga bu mo'i dga' skyid de/ ༄dbyar gsum spang gi me tog 'dra/nam zla bskos thang rjes la red/mig gnyis mgo dang byang khog snying /mye bo pha dang khu bo yin/dus yag nyes gnyis kyi so mtshams 'dir/thugs brel la ma bskyod glu la gson/kha sngon dbyar zla'i thog ma la/bu mo'i zar zir rmi lam la/shar phi nas 'ja' tshon sna lnga shar/'ja' sna lnga 'khrug pa'i gur khang na/mi dkar po ya mtshan ldan pa zhigagadugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can/bar snang khams nas bya ltar babs/gu lang sgrub pa'i thugs nag bsgyel/de'i mal gdugs de btsugs pa rmis/gdugs de las nyi ma'i zer ltar shar/ mun pa rang sar zhi bar rmis/de bzang ngan bu mos ma shes gsang /de rjes kha sngon dngos dus su/505

gsal ba'i rmi lam thengs 'ga' byung /a pha khyed la lam tsam zhus/ma shod bzlog par gyur cig gsungs/rmi lam yang dag thig nas byang /dang po rmis pa'i rmi lam la༄/mkha' nas sgra chen grags pa rmis/bstan pa'i gsero gyi 'khor lo zhigamakha' la nyi ltar shar ba rmis/yud tsam gyis ni 'khor lo de/bya rgyal khyung la 'gyur ba rmis/gshog pas shar lho nub byang bkab/lding skor lan gcig rgyab pa'i mtshams/mtsho nag gting zab nang rol nas/nya dang chu srin sbal sbrul sdiga'adra min dgu po sbar gyis bzung /krang kring rngan sgra sgrog bzhin du/thams cad khyung des zos pa rmis/da rung khyung de ma 'brang par/mtsho phyogs bya ra byed bzhin par/bar snang rlabs kyis bcad pa rmis/rlabs rkyen rlung nag 'tshub ma g.yos/go bo phug ron rlung gis brdabs/bya spu bar snang khengs pa rmis/506

rlung gis gnam sa bsgyur ba rmis/bu mo dngangs skrag 'phro mjug sad/de rjes kha sang rmi lam la/bla ma'i sgrub khang rtse mo la/seng ge dkar mo 'gying ba rmis/seng ges g.yu ral gsig pa'i dus/'dam seng sgal pa ral ba rmis/ral nas me la bsregs pa rmis/sgrub bras mgo 'jug ldog pa'i steng /rin chen gser las grub pa yi/ya mtshan mchod rten mjal ba rmis/nyin mtshan med par 'od zer 'phro/nag shod yul khams gsal zhing dro/bu mo snang sems spro ba byang /de rjes da nang tho rengarlo dus/bon lha bswo dmar7 skyes cig dang /mu stegs nag po'i lha 'khor bcas/ brel 'tshub se rang mdog rta la bzhon/dgra jo ru'i lha mis dpung dmag phab/yul bcom zhing bstan la 'pho 'gyur byung /skyabs btsal na bde ba thob lags kyang /de mi 'dod pha mthar bros 'gro zer/'ur 'tshubs se gad khog la mo bergyab/ 507

yud tsam nas mig gis mi mthong 'dugade rjes a mye pha khu rnams/rlung dmar 'tshubs pa'i gseng lam nas/rjes rjes la mo brgyab pa rmis/nged ma bus bos kyang ma tshor thal/bzod med sdug bsngal byang nas sad/yud tsam blo yis skor rdzorges byas/de rjes skya rengs shar nye'i dus/rab rib thun cig rmi lam la/yul khams sngar dang mi mtshungs pa'i/'ja' thang rgya zhing 'khor 'das la/'bru sran sna lnga 'khrungs pa rmis/'ja' thang chu mtsho mkhyil ba de/'o ma'i mtsho la gyur pa rmisamatsho kha'i me tog brgya brgya de/dkyil 'khor rgyan la bshams pa rmis/ mi dmangs dga' ba'i bro gar 'khrab/sems skyid pa'i ngang nas gnyid de sad/da res ling log 'di la thugade nas drin chen pha khu rnams/nga rang bu mo'i bsam tshul la/rgya gar rgyal dang sku rgyal bod/don med mi dpung phab don med/508

shig chung sta re a dgos chung /yin nges rma khams jo ru 'dra/mu stegs a mye bla ma des/dgra jo ru gsung nan che dang gcigamathu sngags sgrub yun ring dang gnyis/ lha bdud rtsod gzhi che dang gsum/jo ru stobs 'phrul che dang bzhi/mu stegs lha ngo rgud dang lnga/de lnga 'dzoms pa'i kha sngon nas/bon mu stegs bstan pa de ka tsam/chus bstan pa'i srang mda' 'tsho don med/a mye bdud kyi bla ma de/rmi lam dpyad na rtags mtshan zhan/—khyod drin chen rang chus rang gis zung / ma thub dgra bo gtsug la bkur/skyabs btsal na bu bas byams kyang srid/gling jo ru sngar 'dris mi che ste/nga bu mo 'dun mar thon pas chogs mtha' med yul la dga' skyid med/nged ma bu byams pas skyong bar zhu/snying brtse ba ldan pa'i tshig gsum gtam/rje gong dkar sems la 'jorge par zhu/glu 'khrul pa byung na snying nas bshags/509

ngag 'khyal ba byang na bzod par gsol/drin pha khu'i thurgos la de ltar zhogaces glu de ltar blangs pa dang sngon smon zhan pa'i mthus nyan pa'i phyogs med par mu stegs bla ma'i drung du song nas chu tshod tsam mi 'gyang bar slebs thub pa byas nas gros 'dun byed chog zer nas thams cad blo mthun te bshol mang btab kyang ma thebs bam̐r rang chas spras te rlung ltar mgyogs par song ba na lha klu gnyan la 'dul skal med stabs ma mthong ba ltar gnod tshe med par btang /yud rtsem nas bla ma'i sgrub phug der 'byor zes/ ge sar khong sgyu ma'i 'phrul gyis mu stegs bla ma'i gzugs su brdzus shing 'khor 'bangs sngar ltar gnas yod pa la mjal dgos pa'i zhu 'phrin phul te rim gyis bla ma mjal bas bla ma ni sngar las bag dro zhing gzi brjid dang ldan pa la slob 'bangs nag pos phyag phul zhing mu stegs 'phrul gyi bon chung des dar btang nas/ stobs rgyal bla ma rin po che/ sku g.yo med bzhugs pa bka' drin che/ yul mi dge sdang dgra'i g.yab mo byang / don gal chen mi mjal ka med red/ tshig yang dag 'brarā bu gsan par zhu zer nas glu 'di ltar blangs so/glu bswo ya cho ya zhang zhung lha/gu lang dbang phyug 'phrul po che/rtsal chen bla ma mi dbang sogase/rgyab rten lha la gsol ba 'debs/rang chus bstod la gzhan srid gnon/510

dgra bo'i sha khrag gtang rag 'bul/de nas 'gran med rin po che/dus g.yo 'gul byang ba los mkhyen te/don zhu 'phrin snyirngo po e 'dra yod/nag shod shog chen sde 'bangs 'dis/phyogs mtshams so dang nyul ma de/zhag lnga bdun 'gyang med ring lta byas/nang gi so dang srung ba de/zhag dang chu tshod 'gyang med byas/byas te don go ma chod byung /so ring thung mig gis ma mthong byang /da rang nam mkha' langs pa'i rdzus/dmag mi rta dkar po dar 'phru dkar/mngon sum mi la dpa' rngam can/grangs mang bu yug 'tshub 'tshub red/ri thang smug rlangs g.yog g.yog red/mi ser rta ser de mtshungs red/grangs mang sa kha'i rtsi thog red/ma tshad mi sngon rta sngon can/mi rta gcig la dpe ba 'dra/mi rngam brjid lha dmag gcig mtshungs red/rta che nyams 'brong khyu yan pa 'dra/grangs mang le ri thang 'ur gyis gnan/511

dmag sngon thon sgar gra rim 'grig red/dmag sgab chu bo lud lud red/mi rta'i cha lugs dpyad bzhag na/rgya gar bod dang gling pa gsu ma/de gsum bu red yin thag chod/rang tshang bu mo nor mtsho de/rmi lam brtag pa gsal mi red/da nang zhog pa'i gleng mo la/bla ma rje dang 'khor 'bangs la/ yul khams rtsub pa'i rmi lam 'ga'/bshad bshad snying khams 'khrug rogs red/ yang dgos jo ru'i las dmag des/yul khams 'joms pa smos med zer/nged nang 'khor mgo rgu dgos 'dug zer/tshig blo thag chod pos zhu bab byang tho/ de byang ba blo la ma babs nas༄/rngajo nang 'khor bla ma khyed mdun yong /khyod nag po bdud kyi bla ma red/shi ba slong ba'i mthu nus yod/'byang ba'i khams la rang dbang bsgyur/garnom sa bar gyi gseng lam la/rtsal khyed las che ba yod snyam med/lo zla mang po'i sgom bzlas de/512

de ring dgos pa'i dus shig shar/gu lang lha dang gnyis su med/lha yi lung la ci 'dra gda'/'dzam gling yul rgyan nor bu'i rigs/go mtshon mkho chas du ma yod/yod bzhin rngam lugs ci 'dra dgos/gsung ngag bdud rtsi'i char rgyun de/nged cag tshim par mdzad du gsol/glu 'khrul pa byang na mthol lo bshags/ngag 'khyal dro byung na bzod par gsol/ skyabs gnas bla ma'i thugs la zhogaces glu de ltar phul bas ge sar gyi sprul pa'i zhal nas snying dang 'dra ba'i slob 'bangs rnams/ sa 'di ru byon pa dga' spro che/dgra yod pa ma shes ma yin te/ don gnad gal thug dus bzlos thabs dka'/ 'on kyang lha lung dang mkhyen pa 'di ltar yod nga/sa nyon yang gsungs nas bon ngag 'gyur med la drangs nas mgul glu 'di bstsal lo/ ༄glu bswo ya cho ya lhan skyes lha/bla ma nga la 'igo ba'i lha/'bod ma dgos 'bral med kha 'dzin mdzod/sa 'di tsho(bla ma'i sgrub phug red/ ོgal chen po min na 'grim sa med/nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na/513

mu stegs a mye bla ma zer/tshe sngar dus dbang po yar dar dus/a mye bla ma'i mthu nus de/zhang zhung rgyal dang hor bdud 'jang /nag po bdud la ma khyab med/'chi ba srog mthud rgas pa gzhon/sman dpyad ngan sngags rdzu 'phrul sogs/a pho'i gong la yod bsam med/slob 'bangs du ma'i bla ma byas/bon mu stegs 'dzam gling e dar bsam/lha gu lang dngos su e 'grub bsam/ ban nang pa'i bstan pa gtso byas pa'i/dgra jo ru'i gnya' gnon e yong bsam/lo mang la sgrub pa'i mtshams rgya bsdams/mig btsums nas dka' spyad drag po byas/lo song bzhin grub thag je ring red/kha sang kha yi nyi ma la/lha gu lang 'dra ba'i rang gzugs la/gzi byin med pa dngos dang 'iphrad/tshig tha ma'i lung bstan 'di 'dra gda'/dkar po'i chos dang nag po'i bdud/dar rgud chags 'jig res mos de/dus bska la pa chags nas dbyar dgun dar/514

mtho nyi zla dar nas gsal 'grib dar/chab chu bo dar nas 'phel 'grib dar/lha bdud dar nas khe pham dar/rgyal rabs song bzhin bdud sde dar/nyi ma da bar yan chad du/bdud nag pos sa steng gang le red/mthu rtsal stobs shugs snyan grags de/lho rgyal yongs la grags le red/da lan bskal pa'i 'pho 'argyur red/lha yi chos ngo mtho le red/rgya gar chos kyi rgyal po de/lcags pho stag la 'khrungs le red/rgyal phran brgya yi gtsug rgyan red/chos mdo sngags bstan pa'i sbyin bdag red/dus deng sang bstan pa yar dar red/sog rgyal nyang khri lha dkar dang /bal rgyal nyi ma btsan po dang /bod rgyal mnga' bdag ldan khri gsum/lo rtags stag la 'khrungs le red/ma zad gling gi jo ru de/lo khams rgyal dang dus mtshungs red/ 'dzam gling dbang du bsgyur nges red/klu btsan thod mda' sprod nges red/5/da

gur dkar gnya' sga gtod nges red/sa tham dug gis gsod nges red/shing khri me la sreg nges red/zhang rgyal ral gris gtub nges red/ma zad bdud kyi rgyal khab rnams/rim pas yul 'joms dbang du 'du/dus la 'pho 'gyur 'gro ba'i dus/khong dga' rab mtha' med bros/ song zer/khyod bla ma slob 'bangs nag shod sde/skyabs btsal na gling la 'gyur ldog med/chos nang par 'gyur na phyi ma dge/tshe da gang bde ba 'thob do zer/tshig de las lha lung mi 'dug mod/yang rgyud nor mtsho'i rmi lam de/rmi lam ma red mngon shes red/mngon shes lags kyis blangs le red/lha lung don dang khrig khrig red/'thab pas dpung gis thub le min/ye thog las kyi bskos thang red/'gyod pa byas pas phan pa med/byams pas bskyabs na skyob nges red/'u nga dang rmi lam blo dpyad gsum/chags 'jog mgo 'bul la mo gyis/516

'dir tshogs slob 'bangs yid la zhogaces gsungs pas gshen bon thog khri nag po dang mu stegs 'phrul gyi bon chung / tha chung 'phrul gyi lde mig gsum las smon zhan pa'i dbang gis yid la ma babs par dpa' ngar ngar glu re blangs kyang dgos med nyob dgos kyi bzhag ye gshen g.yung drung mchog rab ni bla ma'i gsung dang nor mtsho'i glu zhus la yid mos/ ge sar gyi sprul ba'i bla ma'i zhal bkod la pha bu gsum pos nyan du ma gtub pa na bla ma'i zhal nas 'o na khyod pha bu rnams kyis tshe 'dir sman bzas 'chi khar dug zer ba'i dpe ltar/ khyod rnams kyis nga la dgos dus mthu med lha med zer ba'i gshe smar de tsam btab pas dam tshig nyams nas nga yi lhan du khrid pa'i snus pa zad pas khyod rnams la dpa' stobs yod na rim gyis ngoms shig nga ni bde bar zhing la 'gro ba yin gsungs nas bla ma har gyis sgrub phug gi phyi rol du byon nas 'ja' dang 'od zer khyugs se/ dgra lha wer ma dkar phyogs kyi lhas rol mo 'ur ldir 'khrol bzhin pa'i ngang rgod thang dkar nam 'phang bcad pa bzhin 'phur ba na g.yung drung mchog rab nas phyag phul te bla ma nyid kyis ci gsung 'u cag nas bsgrub pas mi gshegs gzhugs bar mdzod ces zhus kyang khyod cag mgo 'bul gyis dang bla ma dang dem tshig mi 'gal/ rang cag bde bar 'ong gsub / gzhan gsum po ni las sgrib che stabs gling la mgo 'bul byed pa'i 'dun pa ma shar te sdug bsngal gyis lcebs par brtsams pa na ge sar bla ma'i thugs kyis mkhyen nas slar yang spyi bo'i thad mda' rgyang gang gi tshad tsam nas mgul glu 'di gsungs 517

so/glu bswo bswo mchod do kha 'dzin lha/mgon skyabs sdong grogs ma g.yel cig sa 'di gung sngon nag mkha'i dbyings/'ja' 'od 'khrug pa'i gur khang nas/rol mo'i sgra skad— 'ur ru ru/nga bla ma zhing khams bsu ma red/nga 'dra 'dri bshad ma dgos pa'i/tshe sngar stod a mye bla ma zer/da dus rdo rje 'dzin pa yin/'gro la byams pa byed mi yin/dad pas slob 'bangs skyong mi yin/sgyu ma ston pa'i slob dpon yin/mi rtag zhing la 'gro mi yin/nga bla ma'i glu la yar yar nyon/gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la/bu tsha rab 'bring tha ma gsum/rab de pha mar srid zhu che/mgo cod paṇa bzhin du gtsug na bkur/zas gos phud mchod ci gsung nyan/bsod nams nyi ma yar shar red/bu 'bring de pha mar brtse gdung che/gros legs nyes 'dri zhing blo lam nyan/518

zas gos rang bas pha mar gtso/rgyu 'bras tshe bsod gnyis ka dar/bu tha ma nang 'khor gnyen la tsub/drin pha ma gnyis der zas skal gcod/rang 'dod thog ma byung pha ma rdung /tshe bsod nams mun chu rub pa 'dra/slob ma rab 'bring tha gsum yod/rab des bla mas ci gsung sgrub/tshad mar bsgrubs pas bla mar mnyam/'bring des gsung la chag nyam ngang /bshags sbyang phul bas rang mgo thon/mtha' mas bla mar log lta byed/nyes ltung che bas dmyal bar lhung /'bangs sde rab 'bring tha gsum yod/sde ya rab dpon la che bkur byed/gsung khyab bdal gser gyi thig par brtsi/'bring gis dpon la gnyen bzhin brtsi/yar zhu mar gnang bde don 'grub/tha mas dpon la zhu nyes byed/yul stongs rang mkhos dpon la 'chor/de tsho snga ma'i 'jig rten gtam/zer srol bden srol gnyis ka yod/slob ma rab de bla mar mnyam/519

dam tshig ma nyams nga'i phyir shogabyams pa med na 'gro don dkon/gzhan phan med na byang sems bral/rtogs pa med na sa mi bgrod/mi yid bslu pa'i ngan sngags mthu/bde bar bgrod na nga'i phyir shogagrogs mo nyul byed gra 'khor 'bangs/dam tshig can rnams nga'i phyir shoganged cag bde ba'i chos ra na/nang pa sangs rgyas bstan la 'jugarang gzhan dge ba'i dam chos 'bung /gzhan phan 'gro 'dren ded dpon byed/bla ma slob ma 'dra bsam na/dgung sngon nam mkha'i mthongs la shogagazi brjid ldan pa 'dra bsam na/'ja' tshon 'od zer shig se shogasnyan dang grags pa 'dra bsam na/rol mo'i sgra skad 'ur re shogatshe gcig bsten pa'i bla ma la/dgos dus lha med mthu med zer/zhu 'chal lce bde snying nag po/nga bla ma lhan du 'grogs skal med/bla mas slob ma ma bskyangs med/520

thog khri bon chung tha chung gsum/nga yang brtse dang gdung ba che/rang srog bcad pas ci zhig bya/ma rab bya ba byed don med/da yang bla mas drin gyis skyong /dad na lam mkhan bla mas byed/'dun pa snying nas gsol ba thob/lnga bcangs 'chang bu 'phrul gyi rta/gzugs legs bris 'dra'i rnam pa la/bang la mgyogs pa glog bas myur/'ja' tshon sna lnga'i spu ris can/mkho dgos tshim pa la spyod pa'i/'dod yon lnga ldan rgyags phye bcas/lam mkhan mun sel sgron me sbar/ma 'dug byang phyogs rgya mtsho'i mtha'/yul ljongs gser la grub pa'i yul/gnod sbyin sdod gnas de ru song /ma 'ongs nga dang zhal 'jal na/gzhung zab gsam pas grol bar shogade bar gzhan gnod bral bar shog chos srung rgya mtshos mtha' mtshams srung /nga bla ma'i bsam don 'grub par shogapha ye gshen bu mo'i rtsa la song /521

tshig gros blo mthun dang don gnyer 'grub/nga mi sdod dgung sngon dbyings la 'gro/rang don bla ma rang gis sgrub/gzhan phan sgrub la gzhan gnod spong/de tsho bla ma'i bzhed srol red/nga bla ma'i bka' de ri rbab 'dra/yar ldog lag gis len blo med/nyan na 'di phyi gnyis ka 'tsheng / 'gal na byar gyi sna 'dren yin/da༄ ma 'durgo e go mgyogs par song /sgyu ma yas kyi rta la bzhon/glud rdzas 'dod yon rdzong du 'debs/ byang phyogs gnod sbyin pha mthar song /'os min yar zhu mar gnang med/phyi mig tsam zhig lta chog med/bltas na khyod lus tshal par 'thor/de bas tha tshig dam ma 'da'/blangs dor tshul bzhin yid la zhogaces gsung glu de ltar gnang zhing lnga bcangs 'chang bu la ting 'dzin gyi byin brlabs nas bsam yul las 'das pa'i cang shes la bsgyur/ glud rdzad 'dod yon dkor nor bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rdzong ba dang bcas thog khrid dang bon chung / tha chung gsum rta gong la bud pa'i snang yun tsam nas byang ri nag po bcu gsum gyi pha 522 7
