mtha' klu bdud lha shan gyi grong nas phung mo mi zan ma snod stong khyer nas yong ba dang gdong 'phrad pas der gnas chags shing sde tshogs spel te phyis mi lo brgyad brgya tsam nas bstan pa'i gshed du mi 'gyur ba'i nges pa med do/ ye gshen g.yung drung gachog rab ni 'od dmar po zhig gis dkris te g.yug pa'i snang tsam gyis rang gzhis su 'byor zhing nor mtshos lha la smon lun tshad med bgyis pa'i bden stobs kyis pha bu 'phrad de nor mtsho'i bslab byar nyan nas bu mo dang / yul dpon dge ba mchog rab/ grong dpon dbang phyug drag rtsal bcas dpon g.yog bdun mgo 'bul gyis mjal kha'i tshul du yong ba dang skyes mchog ge sar gyis sgar gyi las gur dang 'khor blon ji lta ba bzhin sprul nas bzhugs shing / lha mo nor rgyun mas btsun mo'i cha lugs kyis zhu sna mdzad de nag shod yul khams dbang du 'dus par gda' 'o/blon chen sga sde ber nag de lha'i skyel ma dang bcas sa srod khar gling dkar lha dmag gi sgar du rlung sbud pa ltar phebs nas gros dbang rnams 'du ra 'dus nas byes su song nas bdud rgyal btul tshul dang / lha'i zhabs zhu byung tshul/ bsu ma 'gro dgos lugs bcas sga sdes glu len dang 'brel zhib par zhus pas bsu ma nga 'gro kho 'gro zer ba'i glu sna mang tsam yod kyang nyob dogs kyis bzhag chibs bsur gdong 'bum pa'i zhal lu dkar po dang /tsha zhang 'dan rje bsam grub/ gzig 'phen nya tsha spun gnyis/srid pa'i mo bon rtsis gsum bcas phebs rgyu gtan 'khel nas 'khor rta dmag sum stong dang bcas phebs nas zhag brgyad nyin 523

nag shod spyang mo 'dur lam/ sde yan spyang 'brong shog dgur 'byor ba na ge sar khong gis mkhyen nas lha glu gnyan gyi bsu ma sum brgya btang ba na/ spyang 'brong sa nag tu 'phrad pa dang / dang po 'dan rje bsam grub nas su yin glu dang 'brel don du rgyal mchog dam pa'i lha'i bsu ma btang ba shes nas lha la dmigs pa'i gtang rag phul/ lhas kyang mi bzhin dga' spro dang bcas lhan du byon nas sbra nag ri bo'i phar mtha'/ thang chen gzhung dgu'i gzhi dkyil/ lha sgar mthil gyi sgar du phebs te rgyal blon lhan zhal rgyas/skyid pa'i nyi ma shar/ nag phyogs mun pa gsal/ mtha' g.yang nang du 'dus/ dam chos dar zhing rgyas/ de nas rgyal mchog rin po che dang phu nu rnams dga' spro tshad med kyis gsung gleng zhib rgyas dang / yul shog tshang ma thams cad 'dus nas sras mo brgyud rgyu dngos rten dang bcas pa phul te dogs med blo bde'i dang du gnas/ nyi ma de yi phyi nang sbra nag gi gong du chos kyi rgyal mtshan dkar po btsugs/ serdza ge'i khri sogs bshams nas phyi nang tshang ma phyag bdar gyis nyag nyig dri ma med par byas/ gdan rab du ma bkod cing / rgyal mchog dpon blon gdan 'dren gyis bzhugs khri dang gdan la 'khod pa dang / bza' btung phun sum tshogs pa phul mthar sras mo nor mtsho de mdzes sdug ldan pa'i bzhin ras la/ rma bya'i sgro 'dra'i rgyan gos spras/ lus yid dad pa'i phyag dang bcas/g.yang nor yod tshul gyi glu 'di pi wang dgu 'gyur gyi rda la drangs nas phul lo/524

oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu a la tha la yid spro'i glu/tha la snang ba skyid glu red/ ོla la do gal che dus len/chos skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po dang /rgyal blon rje la gsol ba 'debs/'di phyi kun tu thugs rjes zung /sa 'di chos med mu stegs yul/lta log bdud kyi pha yul red/de ring chos rgyal phebs yul red/nga 'dra rigs rus mu stegs rgyud/bsam pa nang pa'i bstan la dad/rang lo lnga gsum bco lnga yin/mtho dman yongs kyis bces phrug yin/rab rib rmi lam yod mi yin/chus bstan 'tsho ba'i shes blo med/bu med bu yi dod po yin/gdan gser khri'i steng bzhugs 'gran med rgyal/sku lta bas mi bzod yid spro'i gnas/mtshan thos pa tsam las 'jal myong med/de ring las 'brel dbang gis mjal/dus yang yang mjal ba'i thog ma yin/de nas 'gran med rin po che/525

mu stegs a mye bla ma de/nus mthu yod de byang sems med/sgrub u tshug nus te sems bskyed nyams/stobs 'ikhrul ldan te gol sa 'chugagason grags g.yer che ste rang don chung /gnyen brtse ba che ste 'gro phan chung /sgos pha khu mye bo'i skyabs mgon yin/blon bla ma a mye khu bo bcas/tshe phyi ma'i re ltos khyed kyis gzigs/rgyu nor zas rgyal po'i spyan sngar 'bul/nag shod 'dam ra gong ma na/phyags zog nor khag bcu gsum yod/r+bheg po bre ser kham nag khyu/nor grangs dgu khri lnga brgya ltagabadud g.yag kham pa ru ring bcas/nor phyugs ya bdag spyan sngar 'bul/'dam shod mtsho khra bar ma na/klu zog sngon mo dung ra can/rigs rgyud lnga khri dgu stong lhagamatsho glang dmar ser gser sna can/ngar ngur sgrog pas sbrang char 'bebs/mtsho nang sa gzhi kun tu rgyu/dngos grub gser gyi phye ma 'bebs/526

rigs rgyud mdzo mo gcig stong lhagadakar po 'o ma'i rgya mtsho 'khyel/khyon 'bor nor khag bdun po de/ya bdag rgyal po'i sku mdun 'bul/nag shod gser lung bco brgyad la/nor spu mdog mi gcig nor khag bcu/khyon grangs brgyad khri bzhi stong yod/lha g.yag ru gdong khrigs se yod/'bri zal mo ngur sgra di ri yod/be'u chung rtse gar shigs se yod/rog gu smug sprin tshub se yod/nor zal mo 'phel sgab che ba'i sa/ngo mtshar ba'i gcan gzan sa gzhi khengs/da rung de bas mi tshad pa'i/zi ma'i rta g.yang snying nor la/spu mdog dung la ze rngog g.yu/khra bo gzi mig rmig bzhi mthing /a bse rgu 'brus rlung gshog gtsos/pho chen rta pho lnga brgya lhagimagyogs 'dod rkyang dang bang kha rtse/sna sgra mig sgra di ri ri/rta a ma rag dkar gser mig gtsos/rgod ma gcig stong yar lhag tsam/527

rtse' nge la nge mtshangs tsam /—rte zlo rmi'i :ra rnyeng si li li/ rte'u'i rtse bro khrig se khrigade ya bdag rgyal po'i sku mdun 'bul/klu lug gser nya'i rnga ma can/li lug gro mo rwa bzhi can/ sog lug dkur po rnga leb can/bal lug mon bu gro sngon can/bod lug dkar po dung ma go can/ lug rigs mi gcig du ma yod/grangs mang thang la ser 'bab 'dra/ya bdag rgyal po'i sku mdun 'bul/gser gyi mkhar rnga 'brug ldir gcigakhri shang stong gsum sgra ldan gnyis/dar gdugs tsha grang gdung sel gsum/bcud 'dzin zangs dkar mar khu'i mtsho/rin chen sna lnga'i zhal dkar lnga/rgyu nor rigs kyi sne grang brgya/dang po 'jal ba'i 'jal rten yin/thog gi rnga thug man chad nas/sgo kha'i khyi nag dom bu yan/bar du mgon pa'i skyabs rten yine/mgo yi nor g.yu man chad nas / 528

rkang gi dar lham yan chad de /lus ngag yid kyi re ltos phyir/'di phyi skyabs kyi rten du 'bul/dus gsum khyed dang mi 'bral shoga.a pha g.yung drung gachog rab 'di/nang pa'i chos kyis grol bar shogayul khams dge bcu dar bar shogaci mdzad re ltos rje bas ma/khyen/byams pa'i nyi ma sbar bar mdzod/sdug sdig pa'i smag rum sel bar shogaglu 'gal 'phrul shor na bzod par gsol/'dir bzhugs rgyal blon thugs la zhogaces glu de ltar phul ba na/ rgyal mchog ge sar dang dpa' rtul sku 'khor rnams thugs dgyes bzhin du lha rdzas srid na ring ba'i mgul dar gnang nas rgyal mchog rin po che'i zhal nas nged cag steng gong ma lha nas bar mi yul du sems can bde la 'god par chas pa yin pas de bzhin bya dgos pa smos med yin/ khyod kyi zhu don shin tu legs pas phyi rabs sgang pa bod la g.yang ba'ag rten 'brel lhun gyis grub pa snying nas spro/ byes song gi gzhis khag sdom rgyu'i brel tshab yod pas nyi ma de ring nas bzung zhas bdun ring chos zab kyi smin grol dang dge bcu'i khrims srol rgyun 'dzugs dgos pas 'du ra 'phral bsdu'i las kur khyod nas gtso 'gan khur dgos pa dang / rang nyid kyi skyid sdug thad rgyal blon bka' gros rta2 9

gcig gyur gyi thog nas zhib gzigs gnang rgyu de don yid la zhog gsung nas bkas bcad do/ de 'phral nag shos yul gyi rgan mgo bse man chad dang chung a thig yan chad 'du rar 'dus te sbra nag gi phyogs mtshams su slar dpung sgar btab/ rgyal mchog dam pa'i sku lnga'i sprul pa mang pos sems can gyi blor mtshungs pa'i dge sdig dbye zhib 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sogs gsungs pa dang g.yung drung mchog rab kyis gtsos phyi rgyud la mkhas pa'i mi gsum la phyi nang gi grub mtha' theg pa'i 'jug sgo dang / byang sems kyi bslab pa sogs gnang nas mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob ste gnas su bkod/ der 'dus pa tshang mas zhal mjal zhing gsung thos pas las ngan gyi sgrib pa byang / las skal ldan pa rnams kyis bla ma sangs rgyas su mthong / 'bring gis lugs gnyis chab srid la 'dun te pha ma ltar bkur sti zhu 'os kyi gnas su bkod/ tha mas kyang zhal ras mjal bas snang ba 'gyur ba gsung tho4 pas snying nas bden par 'dzin pa dga' ba/ gling dkar gyi rjes su ji srid bar 'jug snyam pa'i nges shes gting nas rnyed pa byung / rang rang mos pa'i rgyu nor bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul ba thams cad dang nor g.yang khag phul ba'i nang g.yang ldan nor phyugs phul ba'i phyed cha gling dkar gyi sku 'gyed du bzhagaphyed cha yul dgon gsar bskrun bya rgyu'i rten rtsar bzhag yul khams dge ba'i lha yul du bsgyur/ mu stegs bla ma'i 'phrul gos brgya phrag yod pa yul dpon sogs la gnang / gzhan bla ma'i rgyu nor 'thor med rta drel la bkal te yul mi ming ldan dang bsdoms 530

nas rgyal blon thams cad chur thon thog zhag bcu'i gong zi la gnam khri bar ma'i dben lung del chen bcu gsum gyi rtsa ba sngar gyi sgar phyogs su bsu ba dang bcas phyag phebs shing / rgyu nor dang bcas pa rim 'byor tshe gzhis sgar gyi mi rnams mu stegs bla ma'i stobs 'byor la ha las pa ltar byung / zhag gsum bar rgyal blon rnams dga' skyid zung ldan gyis bzhugs par gda' 'o/

le'u bcu pa / ༄ de nas ge sar ar jag yul du byon/jag yul 'bangs su bkug nas bde la bkod/sangs rgyas sku brnyan mun pa'i dong las drangs/rin chin gter blangs nor 'gyed chim par mdzad/de'i tshe ar jag gi gzhis su phebs mkhan chi drag dpa' rtul la bslab bya gnang ba'i zhu lan cha shas yod pa nyob dogs kyis bzhagargyal mchog sku rkyang du phebs rgyu bka' bcad kyi dbang du song bas skya renges mkha' nas gsal ba'i dus lha klu gnyan gsum sku 'khor dang bcas lha'i cho 'phrul dang rkyang skyid kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis bar snang las bya rgyal nam 'phang gcod pa bzhin phebs nas ar jag bdud sde'i gzhi dkyil mkhar 'brong nag snying rdzong der dgra lha'i sring lcam dbang byed mar brdzus pa des bsu ma dang bcas bsangs dud dang khrus chab kyis dag par byas pa'i thog khang du gdan bshams par 'khod cing lha'i cho 'phrul chen po'i dpung dmag 'khor gsum can gyis rdzong bkang ba na bran g.yog mgyogs 'ul sum cu yod pa la la rir bros/ la la g.yang brag las lhung te zing zing long long gis dgra byung zer ba'i bya btang ste skad kyis la lung bkang ba dang dus 532

mnyam/ dgra bla'i sring lcam dbang byed mar brdzus pa des mi rkang gling bu'i 'bod sgra/ mi lpags rnga bo skor rdung / rnga thug nag po'i g.yab mo/ thag ring ba rnams mgyogs bya/ bar pa rnams la mgyogs khyi btang nas zhag gcig gong nas gzhis sdod thams cad bros kyang ma phod snying mi bde rnga mo rdung rdung / dbugs mi bde byang khog 'tshang bzhin du phal cher rdzong gi phyi rol du 'dus pa na/dbang byed du brdzus pa des lcog rtse'i steng hor 'dug zhig byas nas glu 'di ltar blangs par gda' 'o/glu 'u na a lu tha lu red/tha lu 'u na la lu red/sman nga la 'go ba'i lha srung rnams/spyan gyis gzigs la byams pas skyongs/blo dpyad tshad bsam don 'grub par shogatshig smras tshad thog tu 'khel bar shogs 'di'i lo rgyus kun shes red/nga 'dra yid 'phrog dbang byed ma/sde srid chags pa'i gzhi ma red/sngar dus sde brgyad yongs dang bsdebs/sde brgyad yongs kyi sras re 'khrungs/dga' skyid mtho la mnyam pa'i dus/sdod chus ma zin gling la 'gras/sna bo g.yo 'phrul ngan pas phung /rang snang che ba'i dpung jag phab/533

zla grangs ma 'gor byus mtha' rdzogs/— rgyal blon gcig med phung la sbyar/byus mtha' nag po 'di la thugam zad kha sang nyi ma la/ rgyal blon dpung dmag hrag bsdus de/mtho mkha' nas sbrang char bzhin du babs/ dma' mthil nas rgya mtsho bzhin du lud/bar skyi bser rlung bzhin dpung dmag babs/rdzong khra mo steng shog dmag gis bkang /ngas rtsal 'gran ma thub srog la thugaskyabs zhus na pha ma grogs las lhagablo 'dun na stobs 'byor thob yang srid/'dir 'khod ar jag sde 'bangs rnams/gnyan pa'i srog la su yang gces/bsags pa'i nor la kun yang phang /'phrod lus grogs la du yang brtse/de phyir khe nyen so mtshams red/mi ring mi thung mdung mo gang /blo rab skyabs gnas zhus na bsam/mtho gnam sa gnyis kyi bar lam la/'dug bde bar 'dod na mgo 'bul byed/snyid nad zhe sha gcod don med/ gyod rkyen rtsa g.yo mi nga rang tsho/534

— ma thub 'gyod pa ci la byed/ byes 'gro gzhis sdod tshang ma rnams/thams cad blo sems mthun le yin/gshin po gson la chags rgyu med/mi pho shi shi byas la shi/rta pho shi shi zlog la shi/gson po gshin la yid 'phreng med/rang chus ma gzab phyug nor bu/da rung phyug nor rang rtsa snyegade phyir rang chus gzab na bsam/gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la/ zhig ral rdo rje brag la yod/skye 'chi nyi zla gnyis la srid/'jig rten dus bzhir 'gyur ldog gda'/nam dus mi rtag du ma 'gyur/ blo de la dpyad cing rang sems gso/dpon ming sring mang po'i a ma nga /sdug gzhan la ma babs rang thog babs/de babs kyang 'gyod med sngon las red/bu spun gyis bsags pa'i nor rdzas de/phugs nor stag sgams man chad nas/sgo kha'i dom bu'i lcag thag yan/ bdag dang za dbang can gyi/bu/535

ge sar rgyal blon phyag la 'bul/a ma man chad snang chung yan/'phrod lus 'bangs sde'i skyabs gnas zhu/ci gsung bka' de dang bas len/blo sems mthun pa'i 'dun gros yin/la mo phyag 'tshal zhus na dga'/a mas 'gan len sngon nas thal/tshe 'di'i 'phen pa ma rdzogs na/jus dbang 'pho 'gyur yong bsam med/de tsho 'dir 'khod yid la zhogaces glu de ltar bstsal bas de 'khod phal cher tshang ma 'thab pas mi thub bros pas mi thar/ dbang byed yang yid mos pa de tsam 'dug pas thams cad la bzang po yong bar bsams te de 'gan len ci drag dbang byed nyid nas mkhyen/ de sngon da phyin gang thad skyabs gnas nyid las nged cag rnams la skyabs gzhan ma mchis zer 'ur dir zhu ba phul ba dang sring lcam dbang byed la brdzus pa de thugs dgyes bzhin du gling rgyal blon mdun yar zhu mar gnang gi tshul byas te yul khems thams cad bran du bkol/ ma sang 'phrul gyi rgyal po sangs rgyas stong gi thugs sras shakya thub pa'i rgyal tshab/ o rgyan pad+ma'i rnam 'phrul/ skye bo mgo nag yongs kyi dgra lha dus gsum 'a gro ba'i 'dren mchog khong gi sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa mang pos snang srid lha 'dre dbang du 'dus/ mchod par 'od pa'i dkar phyogs la mos pa rnams gnas srung du bskos shing 536

dam la bzhag klu srin mi min gdug pa'i tshogs thams cad pha thar bskrad/ ri klung nyams pa gsos shing / gsas mkhar dgu brtsegs gdol pa nag po'i mtsho bsubs shing mi mgon dkar po'i klu mtsho bstod/ g.yang gter bcu gsum bzhes shing slar gu ru'i sku tshab dang / be ro'i zhal bu mtsho rgyal gyi snyan rgyan/ gsung zab shog dril bcu gsum sbas nas ma 'ongs rang nor spyod par smon lam gyi rgyas btab/ nyams pa bdud kyi rgyu nor thams cad 'bangs sde la pham rgyal med par bgos te dbul zhing phongs pa'i 'jigs pa las bskyabs/ mi nyag nor dgon bshig ste mnangs su bcad/sing ga la nas 'ba' khams rong la phul ba'i li ser gyi sangs rgyas stong sku dang / sta k+ṣim gyi tshi dpag med mgon/ zhun kya'i sman lha che brgyad/ 'ba' rol bla rgyud gser sku/ gser snying gnas brtan bcu drug sogs sku 'bur dang thang bris brgya dang rtsa brgyad/sher phyin gyis gtsos mdo sngags kyi gzungs pod stong la nye ba sogs jag bcad mun dong du bcug yod pa gsal char bton nas khrus gsol dang mchod 'bul mdzad/ stag rong gi blon 'khor nyi khri bu yi lhun grub dang spyang mo bu yi rjes med/ bya ma bu yi 'ug migakhang le bu yi nor dgas gtsos gling gi bu tsha bzhin bskyangs/ mkho dgu ci 'dod so sor bstsal/ zor sna dang rgu bu rlung bu gsum 'phos par lam ston gyis bde la bkod/ mjal ba thams cad sems yid mgu/ blo sems 'khri ba pha la dpe/ rdzong bshig lhas mdzad pa stongs la bsgyur/ dgra bla'i sring lcam ma nyid kyis/bkas bskul sde dud 'bangs nor bkug bya ba gegs med lhun 537

gyis grub/ gling skyes bu'i mdzad pa rnga mchar cha/de nas zhag bdun gnyis thog skyes bu sku 'khor rnams chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur nas phebs shing zi ma'i rong la khra mo brgyud byon skabs lha srin dam la btags/ phyis gnas gsar 'byed pa'i byin rlabs smon 'dun rgya chen btab nas spang ri del chen lha sgar du bsu ba dang bcas phyag phebs/ bdud sde rnams lha sgar gyi pha thar sgar babs/ gling mu spyang dpon rta pa gcig brgya bsu mar byang ba dang thams cad dga' skyid zung du 'brel/ de nas rgyal rmochog dam pa dang spyi dpon gyis gtsos che drag gros dbang thams cad bka' gros la brtson nas lha'i lung gzhir bzhag gros thag chod nas de'i phyi nangs las gur du rngam brjid ldan pa'i tshogs grwa bsgrigs nas phyi nang thams cad lhan rgyas/ gter g.yang nor rdzas rnams mdun du bkod de bza' btung 'dod dgu'i dpal la longs spyad mthar rgyal mchog ge sar nas bka' bkod kyi mgul glu 'di ltar bstsal bar gda' 'o/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu a la tha la tha la red/tha la la mo la la red/la la ngag gi 'gugs lugs red/glu a la mtho zhing mtho nas len/lha tshangs pa dbu 'phang mtho nas len/chos sangs rgyas bstan pa mtho bar shogaglu tha la btsan drag 'dzom nas len/538

gnyen sku lha'i glu de rngam nas len/lus khrab dkar dbu rmog btsan par shogal la ngag de dal nas 'gugs/klu gtsag na'i glu de zhi dal che/phyug longs spyod gter g.yang 'phel bar shogalha dkon mchog rtsa gsum pad+ma 'byung /mgon skyabs gnas rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/dus gsum kun tu mi 'bral shoga'agro drug chos la 'khod par shogs 'di zi smad rong ma'i mtshams/del chen sa spyod dben lung red/zhi drag lha yi sgar dkyil red/nga 'dra lo rgyus kun gsal red/ming ge sar thogs pa deng sang red/snyan grags pas khyab pa sngar nas red/de ring lha nyi bzang po'i dros/ gdan rma bya nor bu'i yang steng nas/ a khu sgom chen gteng med gtsos/che khag bla ma bcu gsum gson/ chags chen a khu ga nes gtsos/pha khu dpa' rtul glu la gson/nyams pa 'dud dgra'i gshed ma la/dmag dpon dgra 'dul tshang ma gson/5 39

gson zer ba don chen 'grub glu yin/dgra mtha' chod pa'i dpa' glu yin/rgyu nor g.yang 'gyed pa'i g.yang glu yin/bkra shis lha lnga'i ldem glu yin/de ring gling dkar khrom la len/lta log nyams pa'i dam srid sde/'dul dgos gong ma lha nas bskos/las smon dpung gis cham la phab rgyu g.yang nor bu du ma blangs/zang zing nor rdzas 'bangs la 'gyed/rming med sa yul stongs la bsgyur/sbas gnas sngar bzhin gnas sgo bsdams/no su 'byed pa'i smon rgyas btab/gong ma lha yi bka' don 'grub/ma zad zhor gcig don gnyis 'grub/bdud sda'i bla gnas bla chos thul/nag phyogs bstan pa'i ru dar bsnyil/'dzam gling nor gyi rgyu g.yang phab/dbu nag bod la bzhag pa 'grub/de ring rten 'brel mgo mo legs/'di babs gnang bgos rgyal pos byed/gser rta dung rta g.yu rta gsum/gser khrab dung khrab g.yu khrab gsum/540

'dod 'byung nor bu mtshan ldan gsum/rgyu nor re 'dus sne grangs brgya/gong ma lha la phud skal 'bul/gser bum gser rnga gser sder dang / mkho dgu gser grub mchod chas sgam sangs rgyas lung bstan rgyal po che/a sho ka yi mchod chas rgyu/rgya gar rgyal po'i che nor zer/gong ma lha yis khrus chab gsol/khyed dbu bla rnams kyi mchod chas yin/khra men rin chen zhags phreng re/ lha klu'i mkho dgu yo byad rigs/ gser grub rigs kyi sne grangs brgya/se mo do dang be+eḍūr+ya/iṇ+ḍa ni la ke ke ru/mar gad man shel zhags pa re/lha dang bla ma'i sku skal yin/sa bdag rgyal po'i snying nor la/gser gyi rang 'thag gser phye 'bab/gser phye khal brgya bre stong gda'/gser phye gser pa dpon gyis 'gyed/rang 'thag sa bdag phyag la 'bul/sa g.yang bcud mi nyams dgos pa yod/5 1

— —mtsho glang dmar ser klu lug gnyis/rma lha ri'i mtsho la sger 'bul byed/nor phyus sgab kyi 'phel kha rgyas/phyug g.yang 'khor ba'i rten 'brel yod/thod pa mtshan ldan me 'bar de/gshen bla ston pa'i thod pa zer/legs ldan lha la 'bul rgyu yin/mu lce kas ar la gtad pa'i brda/mu rnyegs bon gyi 'phrul zhags 'di/btab na nyi zla zin pas zer/nus ldan sngags pa'i las zog 'di/stag rong a khu dpon la 'bul/nyam sa pa thul ba'i rkyen rtsa'i ched/da yang ci byas yag par shogathun mong dngos grub che ba'i nor/lha 'dre'i rgyu nor nor bu bdun/gdug pa 'dul ba'i dpa' rtul tsho/dpa' dar sho rgyan gang babs byed/thi'u rangs dkar nag khra gsum gyi/bla rdo nor bu re re yod/nang mi gling la mkho dgos chang /༄ hor bdud 'jang gsum dbang bsgyur dus/lhas bskos blon chen re re yod/ 542

de 'dra'i lag la sprod dgos gsung /de bar mkha' 'gros nyar tshag mdzong /'jang gi nor bu dmar ser la/'bru sran sna lnga'i dngos grub yod/skyid lha mkhar bang mdzod dkyil la 'jogade 'brel nor bu bcu gsum 'dug che chung dbyibs la 'dra min mang /gling dgon khag lha sku'i nang rten byed/spyir 'dzam gling yongs la dngos grub thob/khro sgam ral gri go mtshon nor/rgyalakhab mang po'i pha ral zer/ rno dang mdzes rngam ldan pa 'gi/zad pa'i snang ba mi dgos pa/dpon dmag rnams la re re sprod/ mthun rkyen dgra bla wer mas stsol/da rung lha mi'i rgyu nor 'di/ dpon dang dpung dmag 'dir yod tshor/nga pham khyod rgyal med par bgo/dpa' rtul dpon rer nor re 'gyed/'dang min som nyi ma dgos pa/mthun rkyen lha yi gdong grogs yod/skya lo'i khye'u 'athrug rgyas kyis/nor lug phyugs kyi bgo 'grem gyis/543

nor phud lha dang bla mar phul/de mchan dpa' rtul dpung 'gyed byed/dbul po nor dang ldan le byed/phyug po rgyal dang mnyam le byed/zhag lnga dga' skyid ngang la 'dugade nas gling la bskyod rgyu yin/ da rung phyi nang glu la nyon/ bya gzhag bka' bkod 'ga' re yod/bdud yul chos la ma bsgyur na/ bran du bkol bas ci la phan/bstan dgon rgya chen ma bskrun na/ —bdud bstan bsnubs pas ci la phan/—bla chen zhi 'od bzang pos gtsos/'gro 'dul bla gra gcig brgya de/zla gcig 'gyang med phebs rgyu yin/rgyu nor grangs kyis mi lang ba/pha bu g.yung drung mchog rab gtsos/yul dpon rnams la gnyer gtad yod/bstan dgon chos grwa tshugs la shog mi nyag yul gyi rten gsum 'di/lo rgyus dkar chag zung dang 'brel/nag shod yul gyi chos skal yin/gsar bskrun dgon nang bzhugs rgyu yin/544

ye gshen g.yung drung mchog rab khyod/chos zab theg dgu nyam len gyis/sde dang bstan dgon 'tsho skyong gyis/yul khams nang pa'i dge bcu'i khrims/kha tsam min pa dar spel dgos/sang pha nang da lta'i dus tshod la/nor rgyun sprul pa nor mtsho ma/sga pa sga yi dpon sa nas/rta'u dpon sras gzhis bzung dgos/las bskos gong ma lha yi lung /de bar brtan te sku byas ltos/nyams pa bdud kyi stong sde 'di/sga rta'u dpon gyi zur sde gyis/sdod yul ma zhan bu mos ltos/ skyabs bcol na byams pa'i bu bzhin skyongs/da rung nag shod sde 'bangs dang /zi ma'i khri sde bcu gnyis bcas/dpa' rtul sde bgos rjes dpyad byed/khyod cag sde 'bangs 'dir 'khod tsho/skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po bzang /'di dang phyi ma thugs rjes skyob/rgyab rten gling dkar rgyal blon bzang /ri rgyal lhun las gzhi brling che/545

'dzam gling dbang du bsgyur ba yi/rten 'brel las kyi thog ma yin/bya ba las kyi 'go mo yin/snying nas dga' ba skye shes na/de las skyid gcig ga nas yong / rgyun par dkon mchog ma brjed dgos/bla mar dam tshig ma nyams dgos/dpon la 'khon 'gras ma shor dgos/pha ma yi mug ma skye dgos/'bangs sde'i mig la ma gzan dgos/sdig pa'i las la ma 'bag dgos/de tsho babs kyi kha da yin/ma brjed snying la 'jog rgyu gyise/༄rgyal po'i zhal gyi bka' bkod yin/'dir 'khod phyi nang thugs la zhogaces bka' khyab de ltar gnang bar thams cad thugs yi rangs te legs zhus dang 'brel nom chen rgyu nor gyi gter sgo phyes te dang po gser pa'i nyi ma 'bum thub des rgyal mchog gi bka' bzhin gser gyi mchod chas yongs rdzogs dang gser khal re bla ma'i sku skal du phul/ gser gyi zhal bu bcu gsum lha la mchod/gser gyi rang 'thag de sa bdag the se la mchod zer ba dang lhan sa bdag dngos su mthong rgyu yod pa byas te khyer/ rgyal po la gser gyi ko ṭa lnga bcu/ de 'og che bgres la nyer lnga/ dpon rgyud dpa' 546

rtul la nyi hūṃ/ ru 'dren la bco lnga/ dpung dmag la lnga re/'bangs sde der 'khod la gang re zad med kyi snang ba bskyed nas 'gyed pas da rung du ma lhag rgyu yod byang / de rjes gdong 'bum pa'i zhal lu dkar pos se mo de'i rgogs 'phreng 'gyed skabs re dogs sgrogs kyis bcings te ma phul na ngo tsha'i rgyu yin dgongs nas rgyal mchog dang bla ma rnams la zhags bcu re/ dpa' rtul la zhags pa re/ dpung dmag la rdog bcu re/ 'bangs sde la rdog re 'gyed pas/ rdog gnyis las lhag rgyu med pa byang / sga sde nas iṇ+ḍa ni la gong gi grangs las log 'phar 'gyed/ 0༄da dung phreng skor bcu phrag lhag gzig 'phen nas ke ke ru 'gyed pas zhal dkar gyis 'gyed pa de dang 'dra ba byang / ya tha'i dpon nas be+edhur+ya dang / mar gad cha bgos te r+shaser pa'i nyi 'bum gyis 'gyed pa ltar 'gyed pas lhun gyis grub te 'phreng zhag stong phrag tsam lhag nas phyis sku rten bzhengs pa'i rgyan gyi dra phyed du rten 'brel lhun gyis grub/ dpa' tsha zhang 'dan ma dpon nas g.yu byar de rnams zad med sa rdo'i 'du shes bskyed nas ge sar sangs rgyazlo dngos kyi bka' yin bsam pa bskyed nas bre dang 'bo la 'jal nas bla ma rnams la brgya skal/ dpon po 4rnams la brgya phyed/ ru 'dren rnams la de'i phyed da dung dmag dang sde 'bangs rnams la bre re/ so sor rang skal sprod cig gsungs nas tshang mas de ltar skal ba blangs kyang rim 'phel ltar rdzogs pa ma byang / de ni mu stegs a mye yis lha 'dre'i rgyu nor 'phrog pa khal rgyarā gsum las med kyang 'dan ma blon pos ge sar rgyal po bla ma sangs rgyas su mthong zhing sngar 'dan ma'i 547

nas rdzong 'bebs skabs rdzu 'phrul mdzad spyod mthong ba'i dad pa la 'gyur mdog med pa'i dam tshig shin tu gtsang ba'i mthus rje dpon dpung sde tshang ma ngo mtshar ba la rmi lam ni ma yin ci snyam pa'i spro dga' byang / gdong ma gzhi dpon po khro thung nas kyang de mthong nas gardon thog nas bzhengs nas ber ser po gser 'od can gyi gos mnabs shing sgro sgam rtsar phebs nas nang du bltas pas sgam nang zhal yas khang lta bu de'i nang gser g.yu dung dngul sogs kyi khrab rmog zad pa med pa dang / de 'brel ral gri sogs 'dug pa gzigs nas 'jigs pa'i chas dang bcas glu dang sbrags/ dang pogaser khrab dang g.yu khrab gong ma lha la rten skal phul/ gser gyi khrab rmog bcu gsum rgyal po che ba'i sku skal du bzhag g.yu yi khrab rmog cha lnga dang / rno tsha spus ldan gyi ral gri dpa' rtul blon la re re phul/ dpung dmag re la 'khor gsum cha tshang re sprod rgyu'i bka' bcad lag len bstar tshe khrab rmog la bse dang zangs gzhi rin chen lnga'i phra bkod pa mthong myong med pa phra lam me dngos grub rtsa ba de 'gyed ran pa dang chung rgyud dpung dmag shog la thug pa dang a khus 'di stag rong shog la sprod dgos 'dug bsam nas stag rong mi tsho'i dmag 'bod par btang ba dang lhan nga rgyal gzhan pham gyi bsam pas rkyen byas chung rgyud dpung dmag mjug rdzogs pa dang lhan lcags kyi khrab rmog brgya cha gnyis/ mtshams sgam stong pa je chung du song nas khrog khrog zer zhing 'gyed rgyu ma byang bar 'phros dmag rnams la skal ba chad pa na thams cad ha gad༄ di ri song / khro thung skyengs te glu len yod rung don cher med pas bzhag des rkyen 548

byas nor rdzas du ma 'gyed rgyu yod rung dpa' rtul nas 'gyed du ma spobs par thams cad gang 'dod len zhing hab thob byas pas khe pham mang du byung / nor rdzas rnams ma 'phel bar rim gyi zad/skya lo'i bi'u 'brug rgyal nas mtsho glang klu lug byang g.yag gsum spu mdog legs pa'i nor phyag stong / dkon mchog lha la che skal bzhag lha g.yag stong rdong lha 'dri stong / spu mdog 'dra min lnga stong re/ ma sang rgyal gyi sku skal bsngos/ dpa' rtul phu nu ming thogs la/ mtho dman ma ltos brgya mtsho re/ dmag rer nor phyug bcu re brtsis/ yod rgu'i mdzub ston nor bgos mdzad/e bse rta yi rgu 'grus rigs/ g.yang chen gcig ba rgya tham pa de/khra mo gzhis la sku 'bab byas/ de min dgon rten bzhengs rten du skabs shig rang dgar yul der bzhag mdzad pa lhun grub dga' ston che/ ngo mtshar bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu chen po las/ sgyu ma'i nor rdzas smon lam stobs/ lha mi'i brtul bzhugs gcig bsdus kyis/ nam mkha' mdzod de sgo phyes nas/phyi rabs 'gro la phan pa'i ched/ g.yang 'gyed dga' ston de ltar grub/ rdzong phran nang nas dngos grub 'phags/ sa ma ya/ de nas gter g.yang gi nor rdzas bgo 'grems skabs dga' skyid zung 'brel g.yeng med brel brtson gyis zhag lnga'i dus rdzogs te las don mjug 'gril/ lha 'dre'i nor bu bdun rgya tsha dang / 'dan ma sga sde/ gzig 'phen/ snang ngu/ seng stag bcas la gnang /nor bu tshe la dbang ba dmar ser de spyi dpon la gnang nas bya ba las kyi mjug ma bsdus/ dgra lha'i sring lcam mo la dgyes mchod kyi 549

gtang rag phul nas slar mi mngon par 'ja' 'od du thim pa na ar jag bdud sdes dbang byed ma shi ba'i tshul mthong ba de la rgyal mchog rin po ches mi rtag pa'i khrid kyis sdug bsngal bsal ba'i tshul bstan/ nor mtsho pha bu yul dpon ming ldan du bskos shing bdud sde dang sbrags nag shod du btang nas byes don lhun gyis grub par gda' 'o/

le' bca gcig pa/༄ ༄ / /g.yul rgyal gzhis byes 'dzoms pa'i dga' lton bgyis/bod sgang ris med chos grar bsnyen bkur zhus/phu bo rgya tsha'i btsun mor dgra lha 'khrungs/rje 'bangs kun gyis btsas ston zab rgyas mdzad/de nas skyes bu sku 'khor rta dmag bdun stong sngon du phebs/rta dmag sum stong lhag tsam gyis nor phyugs rgyu nor skyel 'dren rim pas byas nas ston zla tha ma'i tshes dgu nyin khra mo gling la phyag phebs pas ma sru mo sman thams cad kyis bsus te sku mkhar nye skor nas 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyis ser bsu/ bla ma bzang pa'i dar lam rol cha dang maṇ+ḍal gyi bsu ba la sogs pa sa gzhi g.yo ba ltar byung ba'i ngang ja mkhar ring mo ru phyag phebs/ dpa' rtul yongs rdzogs 'du rar 'dus nas rang gdan du 'jags te gzhis sdod ming ldan brgya phrag mang pos skyes mchog yid bzhin nor bu la mjal dar phul ba dang phyag dbang zhus/ dpa' rtul rnams la byon zhus khams 'dri zhu lan mdzad/ a khu stag rong rgya bo ni byol gyi gnong skyengs chil lir mgo bo bkug ste tsan dan gyi khri steng la bzhugs par gda' 'o/ de nas che khag ma sru bcu gsum gyis rgyan rab 551

lus la spras te gser dngul gyi skyems bu ja chang gis bkang nas rgyal mchog la gsum zhus phul mthar skya lo seng lcam 'brug mo de mdzes pa'i lus la nyams brgya'i sgeg rgyan rab bcu gsum lus la rdzogs/ dga' ba'i mdzes 'dzum mer re/ snang mtho a sngon dgung dang mnyam pa'i ngang gsung ngag pi wang gi sgra la drangs pa'i glu 'di bzhengs so/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu a la tha la tha la red/tha la la ngag gi 'gug lugs red/la la glu yi len lugs red/ shar g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing khams nas/ma rje btsun sgrom ma dkar sngon dang /'khor sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig la/ a ser mos 'bod do thugs rjes gzigs/lhan skyes lha yis kha 'dzin mdzod/skyid la pho 'gyur mi yonga'agogs 'di rma khams gling khri nas/ 'du ra ja mkhar pho brang red/nor bu bzang po'i chags gzhi btings/lha klu gnyan gyis bzhengs pa zer/bsam las 'das pa'i 'phrul gyi mkhar/da rung de bas mi tshad pa'i/seng 'brug stag rtse zer ba de/552

gangs thog seng ge 'gying ba 'dra/seng la g.yu ral rgyas pa 'dra/rgod tshang kha gser zer ba de/brag thog thang dkar gshog brgyangs 'dra/nyi dbon rdzong gi pho brang de/sha bas shi'u chung skung ba 'dra/gad pa chu rdzong rdzong mkhar de/sa mdo chen g.yu 'brug dgung 'khyug 'dra/de ma sang rgyal po'i 'khrungs mkhar red/ngo mtshar ba'i pho brang lhun gyis grub/sa byang rong rgya zhing 'bru drug rgyas/nyin zhing lha thang bshams pa 'dra/srib zhing po ti brtsigs pa 'dra/ thang zhing g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal 'dra/'bru lo thog rgyas dus gser gzhong 'dra/sngar med da dus 'dzoms le 'di/'phrul rgyal khri phebs mdzad nor red/sman nga 'dra skya lo'i bu mo la/ming g.yer grags can gyi 'brug mo zer/bya ri dwags min pa 'tshang kha rgyagaphyugs dud 'gro min pas yid smon byed/don yang dag mdo khams rgyal mo red/'dzam gling bu mo'i phud gcig red / 553

snang ba dgung la mnyam dus red/ bkrag mdangs zil mo chi dus red/'ja' tshon mdangs la 'gran dus red/yid dga'i glu chung len le 'di/gzhis byes go ru 'dzoms dus red/de ring rgyal blon rnam pa tsho/phebs pa dga' la byon pa skyid/sku 'o brgyal che chung ci 'dra byung /mi nyag g.yu rtse rgyal po la/dpa' rngam stobs rtsal ci 'dra gda'/dam nyams gdug pa bu sring la/dpa' rtsal ngar rgod ci 'dra gda'/mtha' gzhug 'dul lugs ci 'dra mdzad/stobs 'byor longs spyod ji tsam gda'/de rjes byang la phebs pas zer/bka' chab nyams med 'byor nas byang /byon don 'o brgyal ci 'dra byang / ༄'gro don mtha' rgyas e byadro lags/'brel tshad don dang e tren lags/gling dkar gzhi ma stag rong dpon/gzhis la phebs pa sems yid spro/gling gzhis rgan gzhon blo mthun gyis/da bar byes 'gro'i sku rim nge /554

nar mar rgyun bzhin bsgrubs le yin/gzhis sdod bgegs med longs spyod dar/lo legs 'bru 'phel bzang nas yod/pho rab gtam dang mo rab glu/'dri ldan mi dgos shugs 'byang rdol/rab 'dzom/sa rgyal blon rnam tho tsho/ci mdzad gtam gyi rdo ga de/ gzhis sdod nyan pa'i 'dun pa che/de phyir gsung ngag bstsal du gsol/ dus yang yang 'bral med 'dzom pur shog glu 'khrul pa byung na bzod par gsol/ngag 'khyal ba byung na mthol lo bshags/'gran med rgyal blon thugs pa zhogaces glu zhus de ltar dang skyems chang btegs pa na/ dpa' rtul rnam/sa nas rgyal mchog rin po ches bka' lan gnang bar 'os bsams nas 'jig khrig ge bsdad pa na rgyal mchog ge sar khong nas/ zha' 'dzum bzhin du khyed cag gzhis sdod gling dkar tsho/ bde zhing skyid pa sems yid spro/ byes song gang ci bkra re shis/ 'on kyang bshad na 'di ltar lags gsungs nas khrom chen zil sanon 'a drangs pa'i mgul glu 'di ltar gsungs par gda' 'o/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ glu a la pha rgyud thabs kyi glu/tha la ma rgyud shes rab glu/555

thabs shes rab gnyis med zung ོ'jug glu/gzhis byes lhan du 'dzoms nyin len/dbyings la bzhugs pa'i rtsa gsum lha/'bral med spyi bo'i rgyan la bzhugs/ma bsgrubs rang bzhin 'khor ba'i lha/dgra bla wer ma lhan skyes lha/dkar phyogs lha yi mgon skyabs mdzod/sa 'di rma g.yang gling gi yul/chos khrims srid gnyis dar sa cha la /snyan grags pas 'dzam gling khyab yul red/nga 'dra ming mang tshangs le de/'gog mo'i bu sdug jo ru red/sha mong spang las rdol 'dra de/ma sang 'khrul gyi rgyal po la/ge sar skyes bu don grub red/gling rgyal po'i ming thogs tshun chad nas/5 zla gsum zla kha ma lon gong /dam nyams sgab bdud 'tshe ba byung /lhag tu sangs rgyas bstan la 'tshe/sgos su mu pa tshang la sdang / 'gul shig shig las dus 'bab le red/zi smad gnam khri bar ma'i rgyab/del chen ri la dpung sgar brgyab/556

lha lung khu byag grags grags red/bdud mi rgyod rdo lhung lhung red/nag phyogs sde brgyad brdzus bu la/mi re dpa' ba'i ngar lam nas/'brong bre lu red kyang rwa nas 'dzin/seng dkar mo red kyang g.yu ral 'thogastag dmar yag red kyang kha phor mnye/dgra gshin rje red kyang thang rtsa bsdu/pho kho 'dra'i yan la med snang gda'/dmar mo srog gi bla gnas de/lha yi thabs stobs thugs rjes btul/mi nyag g.yu rtse rgyal po de/ lus che thang sdum tsam zhig la/g.yu yi ral pa nyi li li/sgyu ma 'phrul gyi stobs rtsal ldan/dngos yod dngos med brdzu ba'i bu/mthong na bros thung shor le 'dugabatsun mo bdud mo khrag ral ma/zhi drag rang mdog los yod de/khro rngam dgra la chas pa'i dus/mdog nag srin mo'i rang mdangs la/mche ba gengs ri ltar du gtsigs/mche ba'i rtse nas khrag thig 'bab/557

ri bo rtse nas bsnyil kyang nus/stobs kyis rgya mtsho dkrug cing gda'/lha klu dgra lha wer ma dang / ge sar rgyal dang zhe rtul blon/ dpung rub 'thab 'thab zhags kyis bzung /nag phyogs 'go lha rim bzhin bros/bdud mos dad 'dun ma nyan dus/las 'bras sbyangs pa'i sems bskyed kyis/sha kham khrag thig ngan 'bras byas/bden tshig 'pho ba 'tshams sbyar kyang /bde che na sa lam ma thob bar/skye res gcig gyi phyi ma la/thar pa thob pa'i nges shes rnyed/gdol pa nag po'i brdzus bu la/klu mgon stong thub ya med zer/mi sngon thang sdum tsam zhig la/sbrul gyi skra chun nyi le 'gi/dpa' rtsal stobs shugs ngar rgod de/g.yu rtse rgyal dang gcig mtshungs red/dgra gcig rjes gnyis 'dzing du ma 'thab/mtha' gzhug 'dan mas thod mda' sprad/rgyal kha khra mo gling gis blangs/ nyams pa btsan gyi brdzus bu la/558

dmar po btsan skya 'bum thub zer/kha shob rdol khrag char 'bebs mi 'gi/khros tshe ral pa dmar po can / dpa' rngam stobs shugs gcig mtshungs red/yang mthar gzig 'phen khong gis btul/dpa' bo'i rgyal kha gling gis blangs /the'u rang 'phrul gyi brdzus bu la/dkar po she le lag ring gda'/sgyu ma'i sprul pa byed mi dang /lag ring mi la stob pa'i dus/dpag tshad sa nas lon pas zer/mtha' ma rgya tsha'i gri ngar drangs/snyan grags dpa' kha gling gis blangs/sgyu ma 'khrul gyi me phung dang /g.yang sa chu yis dgag pa'i dus/gong ma lha yi mthun skyen dang /rta mchog rkyang bu'i shugs kyis bsgral/smon lam las kyi sgyu ma bshigastag rong dpon gyi zong zor gyis/ bdud jag dmag dpung gzhob du bsregs/'phros lus dmag dpung nyis brgya lhagarim 'thab so so'i rgyal kha blangs/nyams pa rmu yi brdzus bu la/559

shed chen 'gran gyi ya med zer/mi ljang dbyar zhing rgyas 'dra'i mdog༄shed 'gran med yar khams byang la grags/lcags kyi gdung ma dgu 'grig cigasha ru rdzong gi gdung mar bzhagaklu btsan khong dang shed mnyam zer/sha chen rgyang g.yer nges thag chod/bltas na phyi nang zhed pa'i bu/snang ngu khong gis mda' ngar drangs/g.yer snyan grags rgyal kha gling gis blangs/dam nyams rgyal po'i brdzus bu la/mi ser rta ser gser mdangs can/ser po mi rgod ya med zer/dpa' rngam gcig la gcig mtshungs red/yang dag dpa' las gri ngar drangs/rgod g.yer grags pa gling gis blangs/gling stod nor bu 'od ldan gtsos/dpa' bo bcu shas mtshon 'og shor/de min dkon mchog thugs rjes bskyabs/dbyings na thog lho'i 'phrul 'khor dang /bar snang rlung phri'i 'phrul 'khor gnyis/ sa gzhi stobs kyi phung skyogs dang /mkha' la 'gro ba'i lcags bya bcas/560

ngan sngags 'phrul 'khor du ma 'duga'adug te lha yi srung mas 'tshos/sgyu ma'i 'phrul dpung bya 'phru can/mtshon g.yug so kha zad nye'i dus/legs ldan lha yi beng dmag 'gyed/gcig med thal ba til bzhin brdungs/dngos yod dmag gi dpung sde de/gcig med ro la ma gyur bar/mgo rgu byed pa ma dar gda'/ru 'dren dpa' rtul ngar lam nas/g.yu rtse stong bdud rgyal blon gnyis/bdud lha'i stobs kyis shor nas thal/de gzhan dus gcig phung ror bsgyur/sgar gzhis 'thor med gling gis bdaga'abru sga sde nged gnyis rjes gcod phyin/rta rkyang bu'i 'gros dang g.yu bya'i bang /zi ma'i na gzhung bco brgyad de/mgyogs 'dod rgyug sna gcig gis bcad/zi ma'i bred la gnam thug de/bya thang dkar bar snang lding skor bzhin/mgyogs pa chu tshod gcig la bcad/rma a 'dam na ba gzhung brgyad de/mig lta mgyogs rgyug bang kha tsha/du61

blo skor rdzogs yud kyis sa thag bcad/bdud rgyal blon gnyis po'i lam sna bkagapho rgod dpung pa mnyam pa'i dus/dad 'jog 'pho bas e drongs bsam/bsam pa'i thog la ma song dus/khong sga sdes stong bdud mdung gis 'dzer/me nyag g.yu rtse zhe sdang che/mda' 'phen sngas nyi 'od bsgribs nas byang /ngas stong nyid snying rje'i glu dang sbrags/ ༄mda' lcags nag 'phur shes ngar la drangs/ phung po dngos de mgo bsnol sbas/bdud mi dar rten 'brel lhun gyis grub/rnam shes 'jang mi chos dad rjes/skye rjes thar pa thob sems shar/mtsho dkar klu yi gdan 'dren byang /klu chen chos kyis grol bar byas༄/ 4dngos grub nor bu mnangs su thob/rma rgyal sman btsun dkar phyogs lha/mi bzhin 'grogs nas mthun rkyen mdzad/sga sde dmag gi dpung bsur btang /mu stegs a mye zer ba de/pha yul zhang zhung yin pa 'dra/mu stegs ngan sngags rang dbang thob/562

hor 'jang bdud kyi bla ma rad/'chi ba slong ba'i nus mthu sman/hor bla ma rnams kyi rgyab rten red/bdud dga' rab dngos su bsgrubs pa'i phyir/bdud bla srog gnas pa'i rten phur red/sngon du a mye ma thul na/bdud gzhan mi thul thag chod red/stobs rtsal ngan sngags che ba yis/sa bdag the po'i snying nor yan/rgya gar chos rgyal man chad nas/mi dang lha 'dre'i rgyu nor de/gsang chen a mye'i lag la gda'/rgyu nor zas 'dzad med sa rdo 'dra/sde nag shod dngos yod lnga stong lhagaso pa phyi nang rim gsum btul/sgrub khang brag nag nang rdzong byas/mig ma bltas gu lang dbang phyug sgrub/mig bltas na 'jig rten sreg par gsungs/sgos nged dang dkar phyogs yongs la 'tshi/sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra de/nged dang dkar phyogs lha dmag dpung /blo mthun stobs kyis me la bsregs/rten grogs lha mo'i 'khor du bcol/ 563

'bangs 'khor la la mtha' la sgyub/sa /phal cher dad pas rang gnas bzhagardzu 'khrul lha dmag bran du 'gyed/dus gcig yul khams dbang du 'dus/las skal sdan pa cha shas kyis/grogs byas yul khams chos la bsgyur/rgyu 'byor zad med mnangs bgos byas /gser dang g.yu byur 'bo la 'jal/da rung ma zad du ma lhagase mo do dang be+edhur+ya/in ḍa ni la mar gad sogs/rin chen 'gyed 'gyed zad mtha' med/mngon sum mig gis ma mthong bar/ bshad pas yid ches bden 'dzin dka'/gser bum gser rnga gser snod sder/sngon chos rgyal a sho'i chos chas zer/de mtshungs bla ma'i mkho chas gda'/'jang pa'i nor bu du ma la/'bru sna lnga char 'bebs nor bu 'dugad rung lha 'dre'i nor bu mang /gang 'dod gsol btab 'byung nges 'dugadang/'a ba'i bu la dpa' dar sprang / pho chas khrab rdzo/ga 'khor gsum gda'/ 564

gyon chas dar dang gorme chen gda'/ming thogs ming med rgyan cha'i rigs/mtsho glang byang g.yag klu lug dang /zi ma'i rta yi rigs rgyud bcas/rkang bzhi phyags nor tshad las 'das/ma 'ongs rlogro la bzhag pa'i ched/phu nu sde dpung yongs la 'gyed/bdud yul bstan dgon ma bzhengs na/sdig bsags rnam smin lci rogs red/de phyir bstan rtsa nom par bzhagayul khams chos kyi bstan pa btsugs/ar jag yul sa stong la bsgyur/ri klung nyams pa khrus kyi sbyangs/ma 'ong 'gro phan gter gyi bka'/phyis su sbas gnas phye yang srid/sde 'bangs sa sdod gnas nag shod 'brel/'dun gros rta'u dpon sdes byas/byes song lo rgyus de ltar lags/nged tsho dpa' rtul phu nu'i dpung /rang don nor rjes ma 'brangs te/skyes pa'i mi bsad rgyu nor 'phrogadus gcig gling yul phyug la 'gyur/dus rgyun dkon mchog yomachod na /565

nor la rtag med ba mo 'dra/tshe la nges med mar me 'dra/ mi rtag 'gyur ba'i chos nyid de/lung dang mthong chod mngon sum byang /de phyir rten gyi rtag pa de/ ༄dam pa'i chos la nged shes rnyed/tshang mas dkon cog blo gtad gyis/ngas kyang dam chos blo gtad byas/yab gzan gser gyi khri 'phang mnan/ phyi snang ngo'i cha la sgyu 'phrul gar/lha lung 'gro don ma gtogs pa/rang don shig tsam srog bcad med/las 'bras bsod nams longs spyod 'dzom/de chos la mos pa'i bden mthu red/'dir 'khod mi dbang che dgu'i bdagalongs spyod snyan grags 'dzom le 'di/sngon dam chos spyad pa'i las 'bras red/da yang nar med dge la 'bad/phyi ma rang ga'an sa lam bgrod/tshe 'di'i byas byas rmi lam 'dra/dga' skyid mi rtag dbyar dgun 'gyur/'jig rten spyi dang sgos gling dkar/dar rgud ring min 'byung yang thang /566

snang ba ma mtho chos spyod mdzod/bdud bla slob snang ba mtho bas phung /stobs 'byor pa ldan kyang snying po med/de e red gzhis byes tshang mas soms/dus de ring skyid 'dzom dkon mchog drin/lha dkon mchog bka' drin ma brjed na/sdurge zer ba nam yang yong bsam med/de tsho a pho'i dran tshal yin/ de ring gezhis byerlo 'dzom le red/byes 'a gro dga' ba'i lag rtags sprod/rin chen rgyu nor phongs pa med/gzhis sdod snyan chen phun sum tshogs/dpa' rtul grub chen skye ba red/ja ma ma tshogs mkha' 'gro red/rigs rgyud dpa' bo dpa' mo red/'dod yon tshogs kyi 'khor lo red/glu dbyangs ngag gi mchod pa red/snang ba spro ba'i 'dri bshad glu/ 'dir 'khod thugs la de ltar zhogaces gsungs pas tshang mas byes phebs lo rgyus rtogs te legs zhus dang 'brel glu len ngag bkug mang tsam byas nas zhag bdun bar gling che 'bring chung gsum̐m/ོ ga 'bru rta gsum/ stod smad bar gsum/ zi rong shog ga༄kha/ dkar nag gser 567

gsem glerge—so rkye —stene— chi—rne daje —'ebre la gzhis 'irbeb rim bezhirne phul/ma sang 'phrul gyi rgyal pos gling gi dgon khag sum cu la gong nor de rnams kyi sum cha gcig spyi 'jog dang bla gra sger bcas la mang ja dang 'brel 'bul ba mdzad/ ru gcig bod yul dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi dgon pa che phra tshang ma la snyen bkur mang ja'i don du gdong a rgyas nam mkha'i sen zhal dang sman pa kun dga' nyi ma 'brong pa ye shes dpal rgyal bcas la 'khor g.yog bco lnga dang khal drel brgya la rten chas bkal nas lo gcig ring gtong rgyu'i bka' gros kyi 'go btsugs pa na dpa' rtul thams cad kyis kyang gong sa rgyal po chen po'i gsung dang mdzad spyod la yi rangs te jag thob kyi rgu nor pha la che ba bod yul chos gra ris med yongs la 'bul rgyu'i zeka' gros mthun/ de rjes pha bu ma sru rgan gras stong phrag lhag ngachas skor la phebs rgyu'i dge ba'i cha rkyen byang / gong sa mchog nas rgyu nor ru gcig gling yul gyi sprang slong zlo bstsal te bkres skom dbul ba bsal/ lha ri bzang la ri stod la byang g.yag ru ring gi ri 'bul dang khrab rmog 'khor gsum gyi rten thug btsugs/ lha riri g.yu mtsho bcu gsum la chu glang dang klu lug chu rta gsum gyis sa/tsos rmang gzhi'i rigs la brgya 'bul/ 'jig rten mi yi yo byad sme tshang dag cing gtsang bar byas te mtsho 'bul dang lha klu sde brgyad ngo so bstod/ bar pa mi yul bde dang ldan/ mi yis lha mchod lha yis mi la mgon/ bar mi yul du dngos grub mtsho ltar 'khyil ba'i gzhi ma phan bde dge legs kyi char chen bsnyil to/ de nas zhag bdun rdzogs nas dpa' rtul thams cad kyis rgyal mchog la mjal 568

——— dar sum̐l nase rang rejing— :go gezhis mkher du phebase so/'jig rten 'di na 'gran pa'i zla med pa/ phan dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas chos kyi rgyal/ sgab 'dre dam sri'i sde tshogs thal bar brlag 'dzad med rin chen sna tshogs g.yang gter phab༈mdzad spyod thog mar skyid pa'i nyi ma shar/ chung rgyud khas btsam shin tu dar ba'i gzhi/ dpa' ba'i rgyud la dgra lha 'khrungs pa'i gtam/ dgos gal che bas snyan dbang dam pas gson/ za nas ge sar rgyal po'i phu bo gdong 'bum pa'i zhal lu dkar po lha ngang yag dkar po'i rnam 'phrul de nyid rang mkhar la phyag phebaru/rtsis kyi snga nub dgong mo'i rmi lam la bud med ḍak+ki'i chas sob/ dkar po mnabs pa zhig gis khyod kyi snying las thon pa'i dung se rgyal mtshan zhig mkhar rdzong gi steng du 'dzugs dgos pas de rna 'dzugs thabs su sgom chen gting med dang rgyal mchog la zhus dang myur du don smin yong gsungs/ su yin dris pa na nga 'phags pa'i spyan chab las byang ba'i sgrol ma dkar mo yin/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po khyed cas sgrub pa'i yi dam gyi lha yin no zer ba rmis pa'i mod la nam langs pa dang mnal sad/ nangs par sgom chen dang rgyal mchog lhan mdun de nub rmis pa'i rmi lam zhu4pha na sgom chen gyi zhal nas de ni sngon lung bstan bzhin dkon cog gsum la gsol ba btab na lha sras bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhig nges par 'byung ba'i rtags su go/ — nye bar lha mchod tshogs 'khor bshams nas lha brgyud bskul na 'bras bu smin gsungs/ rgyal mchog rin po ches kyang sgom chen gyis zhal bzhes bzhin lha khang du mchod tshogs dpag nga64

med phul/ dkar chab gsol zhidza khyi sprang brngan/ gong ma lha la bden bdar byas na bar chad med par smin par 'gyur gsungs nas dar li ma dkar po'i phyag bdud gcig gnang / sgom chen nas tsa ka li zhig gnang nas bla ma sgrub khang du byon/ zhal dkar dngul chu rdzong du phebs nas rdzong du mchod tshogs dpag med bshams te 'dan lha khang ring mo'i bla gra bcu gsum gyis bde phag ge sgo nas tshogs 'bum bsags par mdzad/ dgun zla dang po'i tshes bcu nyin rgyal mchog dang sgom chen gnyis kyis thugs brgyud bskul bas 'od zer yi ge hris mtshan pa 'od lnga ldan zhig rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugs kur phog gu ru'i thugs nas 'od zer sna lnga phyogs bcu'i zhing gi rgyal ba rnams la phog nas byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam pa tshur 'dus nas smad 'byung gnas la thim/ yang gu ru'i thugs nas 'od lnga 'phros nas chos 'phen 'ba' ram pa rig 'dzin gyi gral la bzhugs/ de nyid yi ge aḥdakar po'i rnam par byon pas rig 'dzin bla ma rnams kyis shis brjod dang rab gnas 'thor/dpa' bo dpa' mo dgra lha wer mas bgegs bskrad de mi yul dngul chu khro rdzong du rag bza'i lhums su bzhugs/ zla ba bzhi nas sras mo/ da par shes te yar dgon khag la rgyal bka' dag tshar dang rgyud sde'i tshogs bskang 'bum ther re bsags/ mar sprang slong la dkor mdzod bcu gsum sbyin pa btang / tshe snying gser zam stong dang rtsa brgyad btsugs pa dang / sa tsha mtshon ldan 'bum ther bsgrubs nas slar sgom chen dang rgyal mchog la tshe sgrub dang brtag pa zhus pas spyir bzang ba dang 'khrungs yul dgra bla'i ri dmar gnas 570

phug la babs te rag bza'i skyo grogs blo thub ne chung lu gu tshar yag dang / kun dga' g.yu yi mtsho skyid/ 'bru bza' shes rab dbang mo/ spyi dpon bu mo g.yu sgron/ tsha zhang bu mo mdzes sgron bcas dben rir zla gcig ring bzhugs skabs shing pho 'brug gi dbyar zla tha ma'i tshes nyer dgu nas lus gzugs cung mi bde bsasman dang byin rlabs rim bsten byas pa sa ston zla dang po'i tshes gsum nyin nyi shar la sku 'khrungs pa dang me teg gi char bab/ de nas sgron ma sngon mo'i sku skye ne'u chung lu gu tshar yag des dar dkar gyi lcibs nas smon lam gyi glu 'di blangs so/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu a la tha la tha la red/tha la la mo la la red/glu a la dkon mchog 'bod glu red/tha la snang ba skyid glu red/shar g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing khams nas/dung lo 'bar ba'i khri steng nas/rje btsun sgron ma dkar sngon mkhyen/bu gdong rigs lha yi sras pho 'di/shar gling dkar rgyan la 'khrungs le red/mthong tshad zil gyis gnon par shogade ring gnam skar dus tshod legs/bzang po brgyad 'dzom lhom shar/dar gyi gos dkar drisad 'di/571

lha tshengese pa'i dar gos nang nas byang /ge sar rgyal pos gnang le red/ ༄de ring bu la bkon rgyu yin/tshangs pa lha yi stobs rtsal de/deng tshas bu 'a/ 'dzom par shogabe sar ngamag gi rgyal po yis/'dzam gling dbang du bsgyur ba'i dus/gcig chog don sgo 'thus par shoga.a/ ma dritsha chen mkha' 'gro ma/das byed lha yi khrus chab mdzod/sku la nyes pas mi sgrib shogasasu nga la 'gag pa med par shogathugs rig mkhyen brgya bkra bar shogaspyi dpon gling gi rten phur yin/sra/sa mo lha mo sgron ma khyed/lte ba gcod pa'i chas grabs gyis/nyom mongs mi dge'i 'khrul thag chod/lha lus rdo rje'i sku 'grub shogangs mgul ga rin chen pa tra nas /grub pa'i rgyal mo'i tshe chu la/bla ma sum cus kha gsab mdzad/shel brag gter sgo phye ba'i dus/gu ru pad+ma'i tshe chu dang /572

nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman mchog bsres/'dren pa lha bu khyed la 'dren /mgo rmog dkar nang nas dbu lo dkar/lus khrab dkar nang nas dgra bzhi thul/sked 'khor gsum bskor nas 'dzam gling skyongs/chos skyong ba'i rgyal po snyan grags can/stobs 'jig rten khams la grags par shogage sar rgyal po'i gter zog las/klu g.yang lha 'bri ga ma dang /shar rma rgyal seng ge'i 'o ma la/ma mkha' 'gro'i stobs bcud ril bu bcas/mched sras mo gsum gyi re re drongs/zhal la 'dren zhing smon lam zhus/dam tshig dag pa mkha' 'gro ma'i/bkra shis smon lam 'grub nges yin/lha'i bdud rtsi ro mchog brgyad ldan gyi/zas phun sum tshogs la spyod par shogamada' dar sna lnga phyag la 'bul/mda' 'di la ci 'dzom 'dzom par shogayab khu bo'i gdan sa zin par shogam yum gyi drin lan skyong bar shogabakrag dang gzi mdangs snyan grags gsum/nyi mas gar khyab khyab par shog573

brling che ba ri rgyal lta bu shogazab che ba rol mtsho lta bu shogarngam che ba lha dbang lta bu shogaphyug la klu dbang lta bu shogarnam thos sras kyi longs spyod shogagu ru pad+ma'i rgyal tshab des/khams gsum chos la 'khod par shog smug po gdong gi gdung rgyud de/lha rgyud chos rgyud mi chad cing /gling tsho drurge chags pa'i rten phur shogang a chung lha mo ne'u chung mtsho/skye ba sman de skye lus mtho/shar sgro' ma sngon mo'i skye ba yin/chung rgyud gser gyi sgrom bu la/dam tshig chags nyams ma song yod/ smon lam ci btab bgrub par shogagrogs mched dam gtsang mkha' 'gro ma'i/bkra shis bden tshig 'grub par shogaces bkra shis bden tshig brjod bzhin par thog mar mas khrus chab gsol/ g.yu sgron gyis lte ba bcad/ ne'u chung nas yongs 'dus kyi tshe chu dang nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman ril bcas drangs/ klu g.yang gwa ma'i 'o ma dang seng ge'i 'o ma/ mkha' 'gro'i stobs bcud kyi ril bu gsum bcas mdzes sgron dang kun 574

dga' g.yu mtsho/ 'bru bza' she rab sogayokyis sras la drangs nas glu len ngag bkug ma byang rung bkra shis pa'i skyabs 'gro smon lam 'ur dir dir phul ba rno grogs mched rnams bde chen ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dam tshig rnam par dag pa'i mthus bden tshig thams cad grub ste dbang thang che ba/ longs spyod 'dzoms pa/nad med/ bkra shis shing tshe ring ba bcas byang / dgra lha wer ma rnams kyis 'ja' sprin bsdus/ me tog gi zlor dang 'bru dkar gyi rab gnas 'thor nas bgegs med cing / chung rgyud dar zhing khas btsan pa'i rten 'brel mdzad/ lha sras dgra lha rtse rgyal sku 'khrungs nas zhag bdun gsum bar mo sman thams cad kyis tshogs dang mchod pa phul zhing dga' spro'i ngang bzhugs/ de nas gdong 'bum pa'i zhal lu rta pa sku 'khor dgu dang bcas sgrub phug dben ri gong ma ru sgom chen gting med bdun lha sras khyer te khrus dang tshe dbang zhuca/ pa na dam se la gyi khruru/ dang sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshe dbang gnang ste/ sngon gyi lung ltar smug po gdong gi rgyud pa tsho drug gling gi rgyal po/ ge sar rgyal po'i dpung rogs/byams pa gnyen gyi 'khri shing / gling mi 'thor brtan pa'i gzhung shing / 'dzam gling du grags pa'i lha sras dgra bla ngang gis 'du ba/wer ma rnams kyi dang rtse/ dpa' rtags g.yul las rgyal ba'i dpa' bo 'di la lha sras dgra lha rtse rgyal zhes mtshan thogs gsungs nas dar mdud dang gong ma rnams kyi srung byin sogs gnang ba dang 'brel bla ma rnams kyis dngos po'i tshan grangs mang po dang tshe dbang srung byin phul nas phyir phebs shing sku mkhar seng 'brug stag rtse rdzong 575

du mu pa gnam gyi rgyal po'i lha sras dgra lha 'khrungs pa'i dga' ston zas nor tshad med 'dzom par byas nas phu mda' bar gsum 'du ba'i brdas bskul te ming ldan thams bcad gcig gathud gnyis 'dzom gyis lha mkhar du 'dzoms shing gong sa rgyal mchog la mjal dar phul nas gdan la ja chang la longs spyad nas bzhugs/gdong 'bum pa'i zhal lu yab sras khrir phebs pa dang lhan gdong gi a khu spyi dpon rgyal po des che ba bstod pa'i tshan grangs mdun du bkram/ lha sras la tshe g.yang mar gyi srung tshom bkod nas rten 'brel shis brjod kyi glu 'di la ba ring mo la drangs nas gsungs so/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu a la nam mkha' mtho ba'i glu/tha la sa gzhi brtan pa'i glu/che brling 'dzom pa'i glu zhig len/chos sku longs sku sprul sku gsum/sku gsum lha la gsol ba 'debs/ sems stong nyid ngo bo zin par shogashar gling dkar yul gyi lha srung mkhyen/glu len pa'i bden tshig 'grub par shogs 'di sa ngo los mkhyen te/rma khog seng ge 'gying lung na/seng dkar mo g.yu ral rgyas 'dra'i mkhar/ming smras na seng 'brug stag rtse zer/ —rje seng chen rgyal po'i sku mkhar red/576

phu nu dpa' rtul 'dzom sa red/skyid lha mkhar lha yi pho brang red/'du ra skyid pa'i nyi ra red/nga 'dra nga ngo los mkhyen te/gdong gi spyi dpon rgyal po zer/mi rabs gsum gyi mi rgan yin/shar gling dkar phu nu'i pha khu yin/pha khu g.yang rgan 'khor sa yin/lha rabs gsum gyi lha rgan yin/chos yig drug bsgrangs pas dung so 'khrungs/sems stong nyid bsgoms pas chos sku rtogs/don rang don spangs nas spi don bsgrubs/nga spyi dpon zer ba de don nid/lag la g.yang chen 'khor mi yin/kha lab tshad bden tshig 'grub le yin/tshe dang longs spyod dam chos gsum/spyi dpon ring la 'dzom le yin/'bum pa'i zhal lu dkar po la/lha sras dbang thang can zhig 'khrungs/ rtsa gsum lha yis bskos le red/dgra bla wer ma 'i mthun rkyen red/gling chung rgyud sde pha'i mig 'bras red/ gling ge sar rgyal po'i dpung rogs red/577

spyir 'dzam gling khebs pa'i dpon po red/sdang ba dgra yi gnya' gnon red/byams pa gnyen gyi skyabs gnas red/de ring phu nu'i gral dar rgyas/'khrul gyi rgyal po gong na bzhugs/pha dang khu bo gdan gral 'dzom/ma sru mo sman bzhes chang 'dren/skyid pa'i yar gyi nyi ma la/mtshan bzang ldan pa'i lha sras la/ya mtshan che ba bshad ma dgos/dbu la tshe g.yang mar gyis brgyan/tshe ring dbu 'phang mtho bar shogazhal la tshe chang 'o ma 'dren/phun tshogs lha yi zas la spyod/mi tshe skyid la 'khod par shogamadun du stag gzig tshan pa 'bul/mtha' nor dbang du 'du bar shoga'akhor lo dung dkar rol cha 'bul/— chos srid gnyis ldan stobs 'byor ldan/grags pas 'jig rten khyab par shogadar sna lnga yi gos bzang 'bul// 'byang ba'i khams la dbang bsgyur zhing /gaskro med rdo rje'i sku 'grub shog678

nga a khu'i bsam pa 'grub le yin/rgas pa rnams gyi mtha' skyong shogagazhon pa rnams kyi lus rten shog rgya gar chos g.yang 'khor rten shogargya nag khrims g.yang lon par shogabod sku rgyal mgon po'i sku rten shogasems can yongs kyi dpal mgon shogamado sngags bstan pa'i sbyin bdag shogaskad mi gcig 'khor du 'du bar shogagos mi gcig yongs kyi gtsug rgyan shogalha zhal dung bas dkar ba shogasku srog lcags las sra ba shogami rgyud chu las ring ba shogami 'phel 'bru bas snum par shogasri bgegs gdon gyis mi tshugs shogagling 'dus sde mtha' nas skyong bar shogabazang po'i yon tan brgya ldan de/bu lha sras khyed la 'dzom par shogangan pa nyes skyon gang mchis pa/thams cad rdog zhabs non par shogage sa4'phral gyi rgyal pothan/rgyal tshabathred sde skyong bar shog bzang po'i smon lam ci btab pa/ 579

rtsa gsum bden r+shas 'grub par /shogargyal pos mthun 'gyur shis pa mdzod/ nga spyi dpon snying nas spro ba'i lha/'khrul pa byang na mthol lo bshags/ngag 'khyarlo ba byang na bzod par gsol/las bden stozlos smon lam 'grub par shogaces glu de ltar gsungs shing gdan la 'khod pa dang gling skyes mchog yid bzhin nor bu nyid kyis rten 'bul bstsal ba rnams nang blon tshos bsgrigs te smon lam gyi bden tshig mgul glu 'di bzhengs so/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu a la tha la tha la red/tha la la mo la la red/la la ngag gi 'gug lugs red/gnas zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang nas/pad 'byang rig 'dzin rgya mtsho la/gsol dro 'debs so thugs rjes gzigs/glu len smon lam 'grub par shogatshangs pa lha dang ger mdzo gnyan/gtsug na rma rgyal bka' 'khor 'bum/de ring rgyal po'i grogs la byon/ mthun sbyor bden tshig 'grub par shogs 'di rgyal blon 'dzom mkhar red/580

chos sridaganyis ldan pho brang red/ nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na/mngal grib nyon mongs ma gos dus/ lha lus mi la ma bsgyur gong /rigs gsum mgon po'i sprul pa yin/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus sku yin/o rgyan pad+ma'i rgyal tshab yin/bar ma mi lus blangs pa'i dus/seng blon rgyal po'i bu skal yin/chung rgyud 'du ba'i srog shing yin/yar dar gling gi rgyal po yin/phu bo rgya tsha zhal dkar yin/rtsa gsum lha la tshogs mchod phul/rgyal ba'i gsung rab zab mo bklagamar gyi sprang slong sbyin pas brngan/bla ma rnams la mthun sbyor zhus/bu 'dod bsgrubs pa grub le de/dkon mchog rtsa gsum thugs sras red/tshos 'phen nag po'i ngo bo red/chung rgyud dbu 'phang a sngon dgung /dar rgyas khebs pa'i nyi zla shar/bsam don lhun gyis grub le red/seng ma rtsal che na bu rtsal che/581

'brong ru thur rngam na yang rgyud rngam/stag 'dzom ldan bu rgyud thig le bkra/gling smug po gdong la dpa' rgod 'khrungs/srid rang dbang bsgyur ba lag pa'i mthil/dar mi gcig dar sna dgu po la/tshe mdud rdo rje'i bsnol ma mdud/'gyur med leb rgyan dar chings dgu/khra tshub se mgul gyi srung bar 'dogs/li ser sangs rgyas thub sku dang /byin ldan rje btsun sgrol ma'i sku/gser sa le sbram gyi tshe dpag sku/gsung chos gser bris skal bzang pod/bkra shis lha babs mchod rten bcas/de ring lha sras brtan bzhugs yin/stobs 'byor lha yi rgyal srid 'di/dus lang tsho dar tshe rim bdag mdzod/de ring smon lam bkra shis glu/dgra lha'i gnyan stag dmar po yis/bu ge sar nga la 'go ba bzhin/bgegs rigs gdon gyis mi 'tshe bar/rtse rgyal 'di la srung bar mdzod/phu bo dung skyong dkar po dang /nu bo klu sbrul 'od chung dang /582

sring lcam thi le 'od 'phro ma/ a ne rgod lcam dkar mo sogs/ dgra lha wer ma'i tshogs bcas kyis/bu rtse rgyal 'di la srung bar mdzod/bgegs gdon 'byang po'i 'tshe ba sol/gdon cherna 'phrog stu ma 'jug cigagadon chung brku ru ma 'jug cigaban bun byad dbang ma gtong zhig lha dang bla mas byin rlabs mdzod/'chi med tshe la mnga' brnyes shogayi dam rta phag 'bral med skyongs/mchog mthun dngos grub 'grub par shogadam can chos skyong 'bral med 'grogs/bu stobs rtsal khas dbang btsan par shoganor lha gter bdag rnams kyis skyongs/longs spyod mtsho ltar 'khyil bar shogadagra lha ngang gis 'du bar shogastong gsum dbang du bsgyur bar shogawer ma shugs kyis 'khor bar shog 'jig rten yongs khams zil gyis gnon/sdang dgra'i gnya' nas gnon par shogaphu nu'i blo yi 'khri shing shogakhu bo ge sar mdzad dge de/583

khrims srid rang 'go non par shogamago la thod can gyi yang rgyal shogakhebs pa can gyi dpon po la/ lus 'khor gsum can gyi bdag po shogaganam a sngon chags pa'i ngo ya dang /sa mi 'gyur chags pa'i rten phur shogagling sngar yang dar la phyis kyang dar/dar rgyas lha yi bskos thang de/ bu khyed kyi tshe la 'grub par shoga'adzam gling chos la 'gyur bar shogaskyid la 'pho 'gyur med par shogang ge sar 'gro don ma rdzogs bar/bu rtse rgyal sku tshe mthar phyin shogapha khu bo'i smon lam 'grub kyang 'grub/sgos ge sar smon lam thog bas btsan/lha dkon mchog gsum gyis dpang po mdzod/tshig smras tshad mngon du 'grub par shogaces smon lam 'gul glu de ltar gsungs shing srung rten sogs gnang bas sku na shin tu chung yang lha yi rnam sprul yin stabs tshe dar dang sku rten la 'tham pa'i tshul gyis bzhad pa'i sgra thengs gsum grags pa kun gyis thos/ der tshogs pa'i gling gi dpa' rtul thams cad dga' bas yi rangs shing bzhad pas thams cad dga' zhing skyid pa'i rten 'brel lhun gyis grub bo/ de nas sa ra ha pa'i 584 4

rnam 'phrum bu sa chags pa'i rten shing / sdang ba dgra yi kha gnon/g.yas ru dmag gis ru 'dren/ gling de yod gcigaXchog tsha zhang 'dan ma byang khra de nyid kyis sngar nas grabs pa'i blon byur zhwa can bdun la 'bul tshan rnams khyer du bcug nas spyan sngar bkrams/gong sa rgyal po chen po la dar mi gcig sna lnga phul/ ling dar gsum phyag tu bzung nas gral mdor rgya grum sngon po bkod pa'i steng nas glu tha la drug 'gyur gyi ngag la drangs pa'i glu 'di phul lo/o ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/glu a la tha la tha la red/tha la glu yi len lugs red/la la ngag gi 'gug lugs red/shar rgya gar rtsa mchog gong ma nas/grub chen sa ra ha pa mkhyen/ las nyon mongs sdig sgrib dag par shogalha rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho mkhyen/chos sangs rgyas bstan pa dar bar shogalha klu gnyan gsum dgra lha'i dpung /rma rgyal yul gyi zo dor mkhyen/gling dkar bstan pa dgung la bstod/sa 'di rma g.yang chags pa'i sa/mu pa gnam gyi rgyal po yi / gdan sa pho brang stag rtse red/mkhar gong sa dpon gyis zhal bkod mdzad/585

nor bu bzang pos rmang gzhi btings /dgra lha wer ma las la bskul/bsam brjod mkhar 'di ngo mtshar che/ma zad gling yul phu mda' na/'phrul mkhar sum cu so lnga yod/dbu nag sde pha'i sdod chus la/mdzo khyung mdun lam rgya zhing bzos/dgos 'dod 'bru yi gter kha phyes/dbu nag 'dug skyid che bar mdzad/gong ge sar rgyal po'i mdzad bzhag red/bu nga 'dra nga ngo mkhyen kyang mkhyen/pha yab rgyud zwa hor rgyal rgyud red/ma yum rgyud 'dan yul rgyal rgyud red/bu rang ming 'dan ma bsam grub zer/tsha zhang 'dan rje rgyal po nga /mu pa gnam gyi rgyal po yi/rgyal rabs bco brgyad sku ring la/'dan ma blon rabs bco brgyad srid/dpon blon dam tshig 'gyur med byas/rang sde gser phye sgril sgril byas/sde zad med sa kha'i rtsi thog rgyas/mu pa gnam gyi sku ring la/'dan ma dgu tshigs skya mo byas/586

zhal lu gser gyi nyi ma shar/rong tsha chu shel zla ba tshes/sras chung smin drug mtha' nas bkra/dga' e shes mun pa rang sangs bzhin/skyid e she bstan pa yar dar red/khri gces 'dan ma bsam grub nga /bsam dkar gangs ri rtse rgyas la/don grub nyi mdangs phog le red/de ring yar gyi nyi ma la/nyin mdzod dar gyis sna drangs pa'i/stag lpags kyis gtsos pags rigs dgu/ther phrug dar phrug gos sna dgu/khrab dkar gyis gtsos go mtshon dgu/rgya ja sgam dang 'bru dmar sgam/shing tog sna tshogs zas rigs la/do sgam nyi shu rtsa lnga yod/gzhan yang sne grangs brgya rtsa yod/mu pa gnam gyi rgyal po yi/phu bo 'bum pa zhal dkar la/gdung lha sras 'khrungs pa'i dga' ston yin/'bul bas sa gzhi mi khyab ste/re ba'i sems kyi dga' ston yin/rten 'brel bkra shis zhu rten yin/587

21rngasno khurajo(34 /khro—chirngo bsdo —kyipe 'uste rngaspro —95/che la nga che kho che ste/ri mchog rab bzhin du che bar shogagating la nga zab kho zab kyang /rol mtsho bdun ltar zab par shogagaser gyi ri bdun mtha' nas bskor/ri rab ze la lha gnas chags/phyogs bzhi gling chen bzhi pos bskor/mtshams bzhi gling phran brgyad pos bskor/rtsa ba klu yi grong khyer chags/ri de la dpe ba'i sku bsod rgyas/che rgyal po'i 'khor du 'du bar shogalha de la dpe ba'i dga' skyid ldan/skyid la 'pho 'gyur med par shoga'og glu la dpe ba'i longs spyod ldan/longs spyod 'phel 'grib med par shogashar gling dpe ba'i gzugs mdzes ldan/sku gzi brjid gzhan snang gnon par shogalho 'dzam gling dpe ba'i dam chos ldan/chos rgyal po'i rgyal srid skyong bar shoganub gling la dbang ba'i dkon nor ldan/phyag rgyal pos 'gro kun skyob par shogabyeng gling la dpe ba'i tshe ring bzhin/588

gling de ka—re po'i mtha' dus skyong bar shoganyi zla ri rab bad kha 'grim/gling bzhi gling phran phyogs kun gsal/ skyid nyi zla lta bu'i sku bsod ldan/stong khams dbang du bsgyur bar shogargyu skar khra mo'i phyog4na bkragarabangs sde zad med mtha' nas brgyan/2dzam gling yongs kyi skyabs mgon shogarnga/ khu bo ge sar dbyer med pa'i/lha gong ma'i bka' dgongs 'grub par shogaskyid g.yang thams cad 'du ba'i rten/ri rab bzhin du brtan par shogang 'dan ma bsam grubs smon lam 'di/dam tshig gtsang mas 'grub kyang 'grub/de ring smon tshad 'grub par shogaphyis bsam thams cad 'grub par shogagong ma'i bka' dgongs 'grub gyur cigami 'dod nyer tshe zhi gyur cigasangs rgyas bstan pa dar bar shogargyal blon dam tshig rnam kun gtsang /snyan pa'i grags pa chen po yis/ma 'ongs dbu nag snyan pa ra shogaglu 'khrul ba byung na mthol lo bshags/589

ngag 'khyal ba byung na bzod phar gsol/'dir bzhugs 'gran med thugs la zhogaces glu de ltar blangs nas dar gyis sna drangs 'bul mtshan gyi rigs rnams phul zhing rang babs g.yas gral stag gad na gyi 'gor bzhugs/ de bzhin gling tsho drug gi dpon po ming thogs rnams nas kyang rgyu 'byor 'khos dang bstun pa'i btsas ston legs 'bul mdzad/ zhag lnga mtshams mu pa'i go babs kyi ston rten du pho chen rta pho'i dgu tshan/ mdzo pho'i bdun tshan/ 'khor drug rgya ja'i lnga tshan ral gri sum tshan btags nas 'du ra grol/ lha sras dgra lha rtse rgyal de nyid shin tu gces pa'i ngang dri 'khru bī bza' rin mtsho dang nu bstun ma la sogs pas skyed bsrings pa na lha dang klu dang dgra lha sogs dkar phyogs lha yis mgon skyabs mel tshe mdzad pa'i mthus zla skyed tsam na gzhan lo 'khor gsum las lus bongs gom shugs sogs che zhing bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan du ma dang ldan pa de ltar byang bar gda' 'o/༄ e ma/dgra lha'i rgyal po rdo rje tshe yi rgyal/mgo nag yongs kyi rgyal po ge sar rje/'gro ba'i don du bdud btul rdzong g.yang phab/thog mar bdud kyi bla gnas nyams pa'i sde/btul zhing che nor g.yang du phab pa'i tshul/rten 'brel legs dgu 'byang ba'i gzhi ma che/yangs pa'i rgyal bstan rgurdo pa'i bskal ngan zhing /590

phan bde'i 'byung gnas phan bde 'dzin pa rnams/bzhedas shing dpal gnas nyi zla'i 'od ltar gsal/dngosagrub byin tshan dwangs ma'i thig le ltar/ma sang rtse rgyal sprul pas bod yul 'dul/mu tig phreng ba lta bu grangs las 'das/shar phyogs ljongs nas gsal ba'i nyi ma shar/zer thig 'gyur med bod yul mthil du 'char/sngon yul mun pa gsal ba'i go la che/mun pa'i smag rum lhag med deng ba'i gnyen /dgra bla wer ma sman btsun klong gcig ltar/las kyi 'phro zab rloms nas mngon par bkod/dgra bla nyid kyi mdzad spyod ji lta ba/de 'dra bdag sogs yongs la smin par shogarnam thar dad byas som nyi med pa dang /spro dga' dngas ba'i rjes su 'jug gyur na/yon tan nges par brgya ldan thob par 'gyur/dus min 'chi ba'i rkyen dang nyer 'tshe'i rigs/mi mthun rgud pa'i tshogs rnams zhi bar 'gyur/slar smras pa/sku mchog mi 'gyur 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs/mkhyen rab ye shes rmongs blo lhag med bcom/gsung mchog mi 'gag 'gro 'dul spyan ras gzigs/ snying rje tshad med 'khor ba dong nas sprugs/591

thug mchog mi 'gyur phyeg na rdo rje'i sku/ ma rungs nyams pa'i dgra bgegs thal bar brlagayon tan ngo bo bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku/rgyal ba'i dgongs bskangs 'gro ba'i re 'dod bskangs/phrin las ngo bo pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal/bod ljongs yongs la mchog dngos ster bar mdzad/sku lnga gcig bsdus seng chen yid bzhin rgyal/mdzad pa'i rnam thar rgya mtsho chen po las/skra rtses chu thig blangs bzhin 'a—god pa'i dges/las la dbang ba'i mdzad 'phrin legs tshogs rgyas/rgyal bstan dge bcu'i nyi 'od phyogs kun khyab/snyan snyan thams cad 'jig rten phyogs brgyar skad/rgyal mchog nyid kyi rnams thar ji lta ba/dgos pa kun 'grub dar zhing rgyas gyur cigadza ya dza ya su dza ya/maṅga lam/592
